translations: 你感觉到自己被净化了。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of purifier.  Why does it feel so strange?
translations: 你喝下了大量的净化剂。为什么感觉这么奇怪？

messages.msgid: You consumed a huge amount of purifier, and you can tell that something isn't right.
translations: 你喝下了大量的净化剂，你可以感觉到有些东西不对劲。

messages.msgid: You sense an otherworldy danger here.
translations: 你感觉到这里有一种异界的危险。
你将 %s 放进你的 %s 里
选择要挂在腰带上的物品

messages.msgid: Your index fingers have become talons.  They make for wicked natural daggers.  Unfortunately, they get in the way of everything including gloves.
translations: 你的指头变长，类似鸟爪，仿佛天然的匕首。不幸的是，有了他们你就不能带手套了。

messages.msgid: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.
translations: 小金属茶壶，没有它的存在你的下午茶时间就是不完整的。

messages.msgid: Your index fingers have grown into huge talons.  After a bit of practice, you find that this does not affect your dexterity, but allows for a deadly unarmed attack.  They also prevent wearing gloves.
translations: 你的食指已经变成了一个巨大的猛禽利爪，经过实践后你发现，这并不影响你的敏捷，还可以造成致命一击。但你穿不了手套了。
你在此地感知到了什么。

messages.msgid: You have grown even more massive, to the point where you cannot usefully fit into human-sized clothing or vehicles.  Much of it is powerful muscle mass (Strength +4), but it's a real pain to haul around.
translations: 你的巨型身材很难找到匹配的衣服，连钻进汽车都困难。尽管你的力量惊人（力量+4）但是与之相随的迟缓笨重令你相当头痛。

messages.msgid: Your cardiovascular system has caught up with your muscular physique, so who needs pathetic human cars?  Strength +4.
translations: 你的生理系统已经足够驱动你巨大的身形，惊人的力量在你身上得到了完美的平衡。你堪称人形汽车。力量+4。

messages.msgid: You bite a chunk out of %s!
translations: 你咬掉了 %s 的一部分！

messages.msgid: A light metal framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.
translations: 一个可折叠的轻型金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面。如果构成载具的所有框架和部件都可折叠，那么这辆载具能够被打包折叠并可像普通物品一样被拾取带走。
你感觉到这里有东西在动。

messages.msgid: Give some electric damage for Electrolaser spell.  Subspell; you aren't allowed to see it except in debug mode.
translations: 电子激光法术所造成电击伤害。子法术；除非在调试模式下，否则不应该看到它。

messages.msgid: Allows you to swap places with a previously existing holographic image of yourself.  If the universe itself can't tell you apart, who could?
translations: 让你能够和已存在自身的全息投影交换位置。如果宇宙本身无法区分你们，谁还能呢？

messages.msgid: You are totally immobile and invulnerable.
translations: 你完全无法动弹，也无法被伤害。

messages.msgid: Embedded into your back and connected to your bionic power supply is a powerful spell focus able to consume blood from dead creatures to produce bionic power.  It can store up to 750 mL of blood.
translations: 你的背部装有一个强大的法术枢纽，并连接至你的生化能量系统，能够消耗其它生物的血液以产生生化能量。可以存放最多 750 毫升血液。

messages.msgid: Internal tank for blood power generator bionic.
translations: 用于血液燃料电池CBM的内置储罐。

messages.msgid: Your magic protects your mind against assault.
translations: 你的魔法保护你的意识免受袭击。

messages.msgid: Your skill in the arcane.  Represents magic theory and all that entails.  A higher skill increases how quickly you can learn spells, and decreases their spell failure chance.  You learn this skill by studying books or spells.
translations: 神秘的奥术。代表了魔法理论和相关知识。更高的技能可以提高你学习法术的速度，降低法术失败几率。你可以通过学习魔法书及法术来提高这项技能。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of manipulating the mana of objects through application of chemical laws.
translations: 你知道如何运用化学定律来操纵物体的魔力。

messages.msgid: The forging of magical alloys is a complex process requiring an understanding of both mundane metals and alchemy.
translations: 魔法合金的锻造是一个复杂的过程，需要了解普通金属加工和炼金术。

messages.msgid: Working with dragon leather requires a specific set of skills and tools… a set you are familiar with.
translations: 制造龙皮需要特定的技能和工具……你早已谙熟此道。

messages.msgid: Working with dragon scales requires a specific set of skills and tools… a set you are familiar with.
translations: 制造龙麟需要特定的技能和工具……你早已谙熟此道。

messages.msgid: Infusing shaped material with your will and the ability to move is hard but you're starting to get it.
translations: 用魔法塑造物体并赋予其移动的能力是非困难的，但你开始掌握到技巧。
你是个有经验的附魔师。

messages.msgid: The art of instilling mystical energy into fruit.
translations: 将神秘的能量注入水果的艺术。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with how to channel magic and quickly release it with destructive potential.
translations: 你很熟悉如何引导魔法并迅速释放具有破坏性的魔法。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in quickly pooling magical energy for forceful casting.
translations: 你十分娴熟地掌握了快速集中魔法能量进行强力施法的方法。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of casting evocative magic, able to pool large amounts of your mana for quick, powerful spells.
translations: 你已经掌握了塑能法术的施法技巧，能够汇聚大量的魔力快速施放出强大的法术。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with the methods used to efficiently channel mana in prolonged casting.
translations: 你已经熟悉了在长时间施法中有效引导魔法的方法。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in keeping a steady hand when channeling magic for long amounts of time.
translations: 你十分娴熟地掌握了长时间稳定引导魔法的方法。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of letting magic flow through you in long stretches.
translations: 你已经掌握了让魔力在你身上长时间流动的艺术。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with the ideal ways of conjuring something with the power of magic.
translations: 你已经逐渐熟悉了使用魔法召唤出某种东西的合适方法。

messages.msgid: You're proficient with the methods used in conjuring magical things.
translations: 你十分娴熟地掌握了召唤魔法生物的各种方法。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of conjuring things with the power of magic.
translations: 你已经完全掌握了使用魔法召唤物品或生物的施法技艺。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with improving a creature by way of magical enhancement.
translations: 你已经逐渐熟悉了通过魔法增强生物的能力。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in boosting the capabilities of your subject with magic.
translations: 你十分娴熟地掌握了使用魔法增加目标能力的方法。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of improving yourself and others with the power of magical incantations.
translations: 你已经完全掌握了使用魔法法术提升自己和他人能力的施法技艺。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with debilitating your enemies through magic.
translations: 你已经逐渐熟悉了使用魔法弱化你的敌人的方法。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in debilitating your enemies through magic.
translations: 你十分娴熟地掌握了使用魔法弱化你的敌人的方法。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of debilitating your enemies with the power of magical incantations.
translations: 你已精通运用咒语之力削弱敌人的技艺。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with how to safely move something from place to place with magic.
translations: 你已经逐渐熟悉了如何使用魔法安全地将东西从一处移动到另一处。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in moving your subjects with magic across long distances.
translations: 你十分娴熟地掌握了使用魔法远距离移动施法对象的方法。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of moving things from place to place by magical means.
translations: 你已经完全掌握了使用魔法把物体从一处传送到另一处的施法技艺。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with how to return a target to its normal condition.
translations: 你熟悉如何将目标恢复至正常状态。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in returning a target to its base condition, curing any ills it might suffer.
translations: 你娴熟于将目标恢复至其基本状态，治愈其可能遭受的任何疾患。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of restoring a target to its normal condition.
translations: 你已精通将目标恢复至正常状态的技艺。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with how to turn things into other things using magic.
translations: 你熟悉如何用魔法将一物变为他物。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in turning things into other things using magic.
translations: 你娴熟于用魔法将一物变为他物。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of transforming the physical form of creatures and objects.
translations: 你已精通转变生物与物体之物理形态的技艺。
魔法师秘密地下研究室

messages.msgid: Evil has become pervasive throughout the world.  Let your power be the light that shines in the darkness!
translations: 邪恶已经蔓延到世界各地。让你的力量成为在黑暗中闪耀的光芒！

messages.msgid: You channel lifeforce itself into your spiritual energy.  You consume a rune to regain mana.
translations: 将你的生命力量导入你的精神能量。消耗符文恢复魔力。

messages.msgid: With an intense ritual that resembles crossfit, you manage to put some of your pain at bay.
translations: 这是一种类似于体能训练的激烈仪式，可以帮助你将一些疼痛抛之脑后。

messages.msgid: An ethereal-looking undead rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  The type of undead you summon get deadlier with increasing spell level.
translations: 一只从地底深处冒出来的不死人会为你而战。你召唤的不死生物种类会随着法术等级的提高而变得更致命。

messages.msgid: A group of undead animals rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  The type of undead you summon get deadlier with increasing spell level.
translations: 一群从地底深处冒出来的不死动物会为你而战。你召唤的不死生物种类会随着法术等级的提高而变得更致命。

messages.msgid: Using the power of blood contained within a rune, you imbue necrotic energy into your gaze, damaging the target you look at.
translations: 使用存于符文之中的血液力量，将死灵能量注入到你的凝视之中，对你的凝视目标照成伤害。

messages.msgid: Performing a ritual, you turn some of your blood into an animist rune.  You can use the rune to summon creatures, or as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 进行一场仪式，将自身的部分血液转化为泛灵师符文。你可以使用符文来召唤生物，或者作为催化剂用于制造其它物品。

messages.msgid: Force the undead creature you pick to obey your command, making it your ally for a short time.
translations: 强迫你所选择的不死生物服从你的命令，使其暂时成为盟友。

messages.msgid: Force life energy into an allied undead, making them explode with tremendous force.
translations: 将生命能量强行施加于不死生物盟友身上，使其以巨大的威力爆炸。

messages.msgid: Kill an allied creature, converting its life energy into a compact rune that you can use afterwards.
translations: 杀死一个友方生物，将其生命能量转化为一个小巧的符文，之后就可以使用了。

messages.msgid: Violently tears the spirit from the body and binds the resulting shade to your will.
translations: 猛烈地将灵魂从躯体中撕裂，并将由此产生的暗影束缚在你的意志之下。

messages.msgid: Release a resonant bolt of spiritual energy at a nearby target.  It will disrupt the natural link between matter and animus, causing heavy, non-lethal damage.
translations: 向附近的目标施放出一道共振的精神能量波束。它会破坏物质和灵魂之间的自然联系，造成严重但绝不会致命的伤害。

messages.msgid: Grant brief corporality to orphaned spirits and allow them to fight under your command.
translations: 赋予孤魂野鬼短暂的肉体，让他们在你的指挥下战斗。

messages.msgid: Momentarily plunge into the underworld and swap positions with any spirit you command.
translations: 短暂地进入异界，与你所控制下的任何灵魂之一交换位置。

messages.msgid: Banish a monster to a lesser-known nether dimension.  If a monster is more powerful than you can handle, the spell drains your life force to make up the difference.
translations: 把怪物放逐到鲜为人知的异界维度之中。如果怪物比你更强大，这个法术会消耗你的生命来弥补其中的差异。

messages.msgid: Summons ghostly foxfire worked from living marsh vapor to lead your enemies astray.  With more experience, this spell can conjure multiple ghost lights.
translations: 从富有生命力的沼泽水蒸气中召唤幽灵般的狐火，把你的敌人引向歧途。当你有更多的施法经验时，这个法术可以召唤出数只发光的鬼火。

messages.msgid: Agitate old wounds on a creature, causing blood to ooze out of them.
translations: 撕裂生物身上的旧伤口，使其渗出鲜血。

messages.msgid: You link your living blood to dead bones, creating a club hungry for the flesh of the living.
translations: 这个法术将你体内的活血和死者的骨头联系起来，制造出一根渴望收割活物的骨棍。

messages.msgid: You link your living blood to dead bones, creating a club hungry for the flesh of the living.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 这个法术将你体内的活血和死者的血和骨头联系起来，制造出一根渴望收割活物的骨棍。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: You pour mana into an unwilling and unprepared vessel, causing cellular break-down, internal hemorrhaging, muddling ley lines, and overcharging electronics.  The more powerful the spell, the faster the damage happens.  Immensely gruesome and crude, it was once illegal world-wide, not that it matters now.
translations: 你将魔力灌入一个毫无防备的躯体，引发细胞崩解、内脏出血、灵脉紊乱并使电子设备过载。此法术的威力越强，伤害生效就越快。它极为残忍粗暴，曾一度被全球禁用，不过现在也无所谓了。

messages.msgid: Kill an allied creature, consuming its life energy to regain some health.
translations: 杀死一只召唤物，吸收它的生命能量来恢复一些血量。

messages.msgid: You can sense the presence of nearby beings from the Nether.
translations: 你可以感觉到来自异界的附近生物的存在。

messages.msgid: Summon a watcher spirit, whose senses overlap with your own and through whose eyes you can see.  Although they are spirits, they are fragile and dissipate easily in the face of any assault.
translations: 召唤一个守望者之魂，它的感官与你的重叠，你可以通过它的眼睛看到你。 虽然它们是灵魂，但它们很脆弱，面对任何攻击都很容易消散。

messages.msgid:
Sever the connections between your spirit and the spirits of everyone around you, rendering them incapable of perceiving you; the light might hit their eyes and the sounds their ears, but they cannot recognize what those impressions mean.  Anything outside the spell's area of effect will have no trouble spotting you.

This spell does not affect any target without a spirit, such as a robot.
translations:
斩断你与周遭所有生灵的精神联系，使他们无法感知到你的存在。光线或许会映入他们的眼帘，声音或许会传入他们的耳畔，但他们无法辨识这些感官信息的含义。任何处于法术范围之外的目标都能轻易发现你。

此法术对没有灵魂的目标无效，例如机器人。

messages.msgid: Attract spirits of good fortune to a bone, granting minor bonuses as long as it is carried.  Though benevolent, the spirits are capricious, and exactly what benefits they will provide cannot be determined ahead of time.  The bone crumbles to dust when the spell duration expires and the spirits leave.
translations: 将好运灵吸引到骨头上，只要它被携带，就会给你提供少量加成。虽然本性善良，但灵是难以捉摸的，它所提供的加成完全无法事前确定。当法术持续时间结束，灵离开时，骨头会碎成粉末。

messages.msgid: Transform your body to pure spirit, making you invisible and intangible.  You can move incredibly quickly while the spell is in effect and can pass by enemies unseen, but you will be unable to affect the physical world or cast spells.
translations: 将你的身体转化为纯粹的灵体，使你隐身且无形。在法术生效期间，你可以快速移动，并且可以在隐身状态下穿过敌人，但你将无法与物理世界交互或者施法。

messages.msgid: Summon a benevolent spirit to keep watch over you and warn you of imminent attacks, allowing you to dodge some of them.
translations: 召唤一个友善的灵魂来为你警戒，并提醒你即将到来的攻击，让你能够闪避掉其中的部分攻击。

messages.msgid: Placing a warding on food or drink, preventing the spirits of decay from nesting within it.  The mage may affect as much food or drink as they can carry.  The principles by which this spell functions were not discovered until the 20th century, but some animists maintain that radiation is frightening to decay spirits.
translations: 为食物或饮品施加一道护咒，防止腐败的精怪在其中滋生。法师可以影响其所能携带的所有食物或饮品。此法术的原理直到20世纪才被发现，但一些泛灵师坚称，辐射能吓退腐败的精怪。

messages.msgid: I cast Magic… Fissile?  At the darkness?
translations: 我把魔法……裂变？射向黑暗？

messages.msgid: Channel magic through your soul instead of your voice, allowing you to cast spells that require speech even when mute.
translations: 将魔力经由你的灵魂而非声音引导而出，使你在喑哑之时也能施展需要言语的法术。

messages.msgid: Directly assault the target's spirit, bypassing any physical protections they have.
translations: 绕过目标的所有物理防护，直击其心灵。

messages.msgid: Open your senses up to look for the bright corporeal ley lines of those who spent their lives frequently expending their mana.  This also applies to creatures or alien beings that frequently use spells.
translations: 敞开你的感知，去搜寻那些毕生频繁消耗魔力之人的明亮灵脉。此法术对那些经常使用法术的生物或异星存在同样有效。

messages.msgid: Cause the target's wounds to writhe, the flesh to crawl back together, and their injuries to heal.  Disturbing, and painful, but effective.
translations: 使目标的伤口扭曲、血肉聚拢并愈合。过程恐怖且痛苦，但切实有效。

messages.msgid: Evens out damage among your limbs.
translations: 平摊各个肢体受到的伤害。

messages.msgid: This spell extrudes a long and nasty whiplike tentacle of sharp bones and oozing acid from your body, which has a long reach attack and vicious damage.
translations: 该法术会从你体内催生一根骨刺密布、酸液流淌的长鞭状触手，可发出致命的长远距攻击。

messages.msgid: This spell extrudes a long and nasty whiplike tentacle of sharp bones and oozing acid from your body, which has a long reach attack and vicious damage.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.
translations: 该法术会从你体内催生一根骨刺密布、酸液流淌的长鞭状触手，可发出致命的长远距攻击。现在你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: A spell that warps your body in foreign, unnatural ways to increase your physical abilities and strength.
translations: 此法术以诡异、非自然的方式扭曲你的身体，以增强你的体能与力量。

messages.msgid: When cast, the mage opens his mouth and sprays acid in a wide cone to dissolve his foes into goo.  Just imagine what he'll do with the goo.
translations: 当施法时，法师张开他的嘴，向前方扇形范围内的敌人喷射腐蚀性酸液，将它们溶解成黏液。想象一下他该怎么处理这些粘糊糊的玩意。

messages.msgid: This spell grows a large pouch out of your skin on your back, allowing you to store your gear in it.
translations: 这个法术会在你的背部皮肤长出一个大袋子，可以让你存储物品。

messages.msgid: This spell creates a long shaft of bone with a wicked point and blades along its length.
translations: 这个法术可以召唤出一只邪恶的骨矛，拥有长长的手柄及尖锐的刀刃。

messages.msgid: This spell creates a long shaft of bone with a wicked point and blades along its length.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 此法术会创造一根长长的骨矛，矛尖锋利，矛身遍布利刃。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: This ritual grows a small nub of flesh on you, which quickly falls off and turns into a rune attuned to Biomancers.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 此法术会创造一根长长的骨矛，矛尖锋利，矛身遍布利刃。现在你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Spits a warped needle of sinew and bone, carrying with it a sting that slows your victim.
translations: 喷射出一根由筋腱与骨头纠缠而成的扭曲细针，它造成的螫刺会迟缓受害者。

messages.msgid: Projects a spray of acrid blood and gore all around you, growing to ensnare your prey in a field of twitching poisonous tendrils.
translations: 在你四周喷射出辛辣刺鼻的血肉，不断生长并将你的猎物捕获进一片有毒的卷须之中。

messages.msgid: Turns your biological mastery inwards, medically enhancing your flesh.  Rather than strength of healing, it staves off blood loss and purges wounds before they can turn septic, at the cost of increased hunger and thirst.
translations: 将你对生化魔法的掌握转化至体内，增强你的肉体。与医疗能量不同，它通过防止失血，在伤口化脓之前消除伤口，代价是加速新陈代谢，容易饥饿及口渴。

messages.msgid: This spell suspends acid in a layer around you, corroding melee attackers when struck and enhancing your melee damage.
translations: 这个法术在你身体周围召唤出一个酸液光环，腐蚀攻击你的敌人，并增加你的近战伤害。

messages.msgid: This spell suspends acid in a layer around you, corroding melee attackers when struck and enhancing your melee damage.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 此仪式会让你身上长出一个小肉瘤，它会迅速脱落，化为一枚同调了生化术士的符文。你可以将此符文用作配方的催化剂。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Grow webbing on your hands and feet, making quick swimming a breeze.
translations: 手脚上长出蹼，让快速游泳变得轻而易举。

messages.msgid: Grow to enormous size.  Your clothing and equipment will not grow with you.
translations: 成长为巨大的体型。 你的衣服和装备不会随你成长。

messages.msgid: The scroll said that this spell is for "Reducing negative consequences from XE037 exposure", whatever that means.  According the scroll, the spell should be allowed to run its course before reapplication.
translations: 卷轴上记载，该法术用于“减轻XE037暴露带来的负面后果”，具体意义不明。根据卷轴说明，应当等待法术效果结束后，方可再次施放。

messages.msgid: Alter your digestive system to consume rotten food with no ill effects.  This is either a truly ancient spell or otherwise must have been the product of some university thaumaturgical research department.
translations: 改变你的消化系统，让你吃下腐烂的食物而无任何不良反应。 这要么是一个真正古老的咒语，要么一定是某所大学法医学研究部门的产物。

messages.msgid: Grow a pair of lashing tentacles from your shoulders.  While not as long as the Vicious Tentacle, they will strike anyone in melee with you.  You cannot wear rigid armor that covers the shoulders with them.
translations: 从你的双肩生出一对鞭笞触手。长度不及恶毒触手，它们仍会攻击与你近身搏斗的敌人。注意：生长此触手后，你将无法穿戴覆盖肩部的硬质铠甲。

messages.msgid: Vomit up any minor illnesses you might be suffering from, such as colds or the flu.  This is one of the few biomantic cure spells that is castable on other people.
translations: 将你可能患上的任何轻微疾病，如感冒或流感，一并排出。这是为数不多能对他人施放的生化系治疗。

messages.msgid: Possibly the most powerful of the biomantic healing spells, this causes your flesh to literally knit itself together before your eyes.
translations: 这或许是生化魔法中最强大的治疗法术，能让你的血肉以肉眼可见的速度飞速愈合。

messages.msgid: As you can control your body, you can control your blood.
translations: 随着你能控制自己的身体，你也能控制自己的血液。

messages.msgid: Change each of your fingers into a myriad of tiny bone knives, allowing you to cut with surgical precision… or slice your enemies to ribbons.
translations: 将你的每根手指都变成无数微小的骨刃，让你能以手术般的精度进行切割……或是将敌人切成碎片。

messages.msgid: Transmute your blood to magically-enhanced acid, making you immune to acid and also splashing anyone who spills your blood.
translations: 将你的血液转化为被魔法强化的酸液，使你免疫酸液，同时会向使你流血的生物喷溅酸液。

messages.msgid: Magically expand your stomach size, allowing it to consume more food without taking up any more room in your body.  Once a rarely-learned spell, it's much more useful now that you're not always sure where your next meal is coming from.
translations: 扩容你的胃，使它能够装下更多食物，不会挤占其他内脏的空间。 曾经是个无甚卵用的咒语，现在它终于有用了，因为你不知道下一顿饭什么时候才能吃。

messages.msgid: Using water as a catalyst, restore some of your lost blood.  This spell has no effect if you're healthy and uninjured.
translations: 以水为催化剂，恢复你部分流失的血液。如果你健康无伤，此法术将毫无效果。

messages.msgid: The scroll said that this spell is for "Exerting deliberate control over morphogenic alterations", which sounds ominous.
translations: 卷轴上说，此法术用于“对形态发生之变动施加审慎的控制”，听起来有些不祥。

messages.msgid: Your claws glow with yellow acid energy, and as you swipe your claw a wave of acid sweeps forth from it.
translations: 你的爪子散发出黄色的酸液魔法光芒，当你挥动爪子时，一股酸液从中飞溅出来。

messages.msgid: Your maw drips with acid as you make a bite attack.
translations: 当你咬人时，你的大嘴能够分泌出酸液。

messages.msgid: The bite damage in Acid Bite.
You channel your inner draconic magic to protect yourself from damage and reflect some back as acid damage.
translations: 你引导体内的龙族魔力来保护你自己不受伤害，并将一些伤害以酸液伤害的形式反弹给敌人。

messages.msgid: With an ear piercing roar, you channel the inner power of dragons and strike fear into those who stand before you, slowing their escape from your terror.
translations: 伴随着一声刺耳的咆哮，你引导体内的龙族魔力，让那些站在你面前的敌人恐惧不已，降低他们逃离你恐怖力量的速度。

messages.msgid: You let out a mighty roar as you infuse yourself with the power of Dragons.
translations: 伴随着一声刺耳的咆哮，你把龙族魔力灌注进自己体内。

messages.msgid: You conjure up acidic spittle that you can shoot long distances as you close in on your terrified prey.
translations: 在你步步紧逼被你吓坏的猎物时，你能够喷射出一股远距离攻击的酸液。

messages.msgid: Spews a line of acid from your mouth.
translations: 从你的口中喷出一道酸液。
将魔力凝聚成固体结晶型态。

messages.msgid: Gives you the power to see in the dark.
translations: 给你在黑暗中视物的能力。

messages.msgid: Your eyes glow green for a moment.  Now your sight can pierce the darkest shadows.
translations: 你的眼睛闪着绿色的光芒。现在你的目光可以穿透最深沉的阴影。

messages.msgid: You always wanted to fire energy beams like in the animes you watched as a kid.  Now you can!
translations: 你经常想发射光波，就像小时候看过的动画片里那样，现在你可以了！
创造一盏神奇的魔法阅读灯。

messages.msgid: Blind enemies for a short time with a sudden, dazzling light.  Higher levels deal slightly higher damage.
translations: 爆发耀眼的光芒以致盲敌人，等级越高伤害越高。

messages.msgid:
A mass of spectral hands emerge from the ground, grabbing and slowing everything in range.  Higher levels allow a bigger AoE, and longer effect

Larger targets will be <color_yellow>less affected</color> by the spell.
translations:
无数鬼手破土而出，抓住并减速范围内的所有目标。更高等级可以扩大影响范围并延长持续时间。

体型较大的目标受此法术的<color_yellow>影响较小</color>。

messages.msgid: A magical aura distorts light around your body, increasing the amount of attacks you might dodge in a given turn.
translations: 一个魔法光环扭曲了你身体周围的光线，增加了你在一个回合中所能闪避攻击的次数。

messages.msgid: Encases your whole body in a magical aura that protects you from the environment.
translations: 把你的整个身体包裹在一个神奇的光环里，保护你免受环境伤害。

messages.msgid: Encases your whole body in a magical aura that protects you from the environment.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 用一层魔法灵光包裹你的全身，保护你免受环境影响。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Translocates the user to an attuned gate.
translations: 将使用者传送到一个已经开启的易位门。
让施法者不受酸液侵蚀。

messages.msgid: Protects the user from acid.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version, no longer requiring you to hold concentration.
translations: 保护使用者免受酸液伤害。现在你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本，不再需要你持续集中精神。

messages.msgid: Two small shimmering spots appear on your temples, protecting your mind from outside influences.
translations: 你的太阳穴上会出现两个闪闪发光的小点，保护你的心灵不受外界影响。

messages.msgid: Why protect just your mind from outside influences?  More shields all over your body should also prevent you from being teleported forcefully
translations: 为什么只保护你的心智不受外界影响？在身体各处设置更多防护也能防止被强行传送。

messages.msgid: Behind the cool name hides a common joke spell to spook your friends and restrain dogs.  It can be useful in some special cases.
translations: 酷炫的名字背后隐藏着一个常见的玩笑咒语，可以吓唬你的朋友并让狗呆住。它在某些特殊情况下很有用。

messages.msgid: Knowing the Day and the Hour
Probably the single greatest example of technology rendering magic obsolete, this spell allows you know exactly what time it is.
translations: 这个法术可能是科技淘汰魔法的最伟大范例，它能让你准确知道现在的时间。

messages.msgid: Undoubtedly the single most common spell in the world before the Cataclysm, Freshen Up cleans your teeth, sweetens your breath, removes stains and sweat from your clothes, exfoliates you, and gives volume back to your hair.
translations: 这无疑是大灾变前世界上最普及的法术。梳洗术能清洁你的牙齿，清新你的口气，去除衣物上的污渍与汗水，还能为你的皮肤去角质，让你的秀发重现蓬松。

messages.msgid: A favorite of overworked mages and dilettantes who, this spell makes it much easier to fall asleep regardless of how tired you are.
translations: 此法术深受劳累过度的法师和浅尝辄止的魔法爱好者们喜爱，无论你有多疲惫，它都能让你更容易入睡。

messages.msgid: Remove magical effects from your target.  It fails when faced with powerful enchantments or the unique bonuses provided by attunements.
translations: 移除目标身上的魔法效果。 当面对强大的魔法或调谐提供的独特加成时，它就会失效。

messages.msgid: The ultimate anti-magic spell, Disjunction will strip even attunement-related or powerful enchantments from the target.
translations:
反魔法的终极法术。即使是调谐相关、法力高强的附魔效果，法术裂解也能移除。
（译注：移除所有法术效果及法术召唤物品，不会影响永久魔法物品）

messages.msgid: Return crystallized mana into raw mana and absorb it, restoring some of your mana.  The process is slow and not very efficient, but it's easier to transport than mana potions.
translations: 将魔力结晶还原为原始的魔力并将其吸收，恢复你的部分魔力。这个过程非常缓慢，并且效率不高，但相比起魔力药剂更为便携。

messages.msgid: You slowly crush the crystallized mana and as it flares into a burst of light, absorb the now-free mana.
translations: 你将这些结晶化的魔力粉碎，随着它发出一阵闪光，你吸收了这些释放出来的魔力。

messages.msgid: You wobble as you feel inebriated
translations: 你感到一阵醉意，脚步踉跄。

messages.msgid: Your vision shifts in a flash of colors and you reappear elsewhere.
translations: 眼前五彩光芒一闪，回过神时，你已身处别处。

messages.msgid:
This spell causes roots and vines to burst forth from the ground and grab your foes, slowing them and doing a small amount of damage as they dig in.

Larger targets will be <color_yellow>less affected</color> by the spell, and it has <color_red>no effect</color> on targets not on natural ground.
translations:
此法术能使藤蔓与根须破土而出并缠住你的敌人，在紧缚的同时造成少量伤害并使其减速。

体型较大的目标受此法术的<color_yellow>影响较小</color>，且该法术对不处于天然地面上的目标<color_red>无效</color>。

messages.msgid: This spell causes roots to spear out of the ground in a cone and stab into your foes, impaling them.
translations: 此法术会从地面锥形范围内唤出无数根须，如利矛般穿刺并钉住你的敌人。

messages.msgid: This spell creates a projectile of hardwood that shoots forth from the caster's hand at high speed to stab into an enemy.
translations: 这个法术能召唤出一根硬木投射物，从施法者的手中高速射出，刺向敌人。

messages.msgid: This spell conjures a magical wooden recurve bow, as well as a quiver and a set of arrows to go with it.
translations: 这个法术可以变出一把神奇的木制反曲弓，以及与之相配的箭筒和箭簇。

messages.msgid: This spell conjures a magical wooden recurve bow, as well as a quiver and a set of arrows to go with it.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 这个咒语可以变出一把神奇的木质反曲弓，以及与之相配的箭筒和箭簇。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Your connection to living things allows you to go into a magical trance.  This allows you to recover from fatigue quickly in exchange for mana.
translations: 你与生灵的连接使你能够进入一种魔法凝神状态，从而消耗魔力，快速消除疲劳。

messages.msgid: Are you the crazy cat lady?
translations: 你就是那个和猫讲话的怪婆婆吗？

messages.msgid: This spell appears to be very smudged.  You're fairly sure the name should be Cause Fear, but you're also fairly sure it won't have the desired effect because the instructions are hardly legible.  No time like the Cataclysm to find out, though!
translations: 这个法术看上去已被严重污染，你十分确定这法术的名字应该是"恐怖威能"，但是你也十分确定施放它不能造成恐怖，因为它的施放步骤脏到难以辨认。不过，现在是大灾变，没时间搞清楚了！
消灭一片区域中的真菌感染。

messages.msgid: A ritual in which you conjure forth roots and vines in order to make a druidic rune.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 这是一种通过召唤根须与藤蔓来塑造德鲁伊符文的仪式。该符文可以作为配方的催化剂使用。

messages.msgid: You summon a gift of the earth which will purify water.  Rapidly degrades if not utilized.
translations: 你召唤了大地的馈赠，可用于净水。若不及时使用很快就会变质。

messages.msgid: Through giving of one's own life force, you restore withered and barren plant life nearby.  What remains will need time to regrow its full strength.
translations: 通过献祭自身生命力，你可以让附近枯萎贫瘠的植被重获新生。剩下的就得靠时间来尽复生机了。

messages.msgid: Channels some of the user's own life force into healing energy, for the sake of one's allies.
translations: 将使用者自身部分生命力转化为医疗能量，为同伴治疗。

messages.msgid: This spell, which resembles Thornskin through the sap & needles covering the page, seemed to involve thorns and bleeding wounds.  The marred words may have altered the function.
translations: 这个法术，从卷轴上覆盖的汁液和尖刺看来，似乎像是棘皮术，但现在那些荆棘效果变成撕裂皮肤造成流血。也许那些被污染的单词可能改变了法术的效果。

messages.msgid: This spell unleashes your inner beast, growing claws & fangs to rend your foes limb from limb.
translations: 这个法术释放出你内心暗藏的兽性，让你长出尖牙利爪，将你的敌人撕成碎片。

messages.msgid: This spell unleashes your inner beast, growing claws & fangs to rend your foes limb from limb.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.
translations: 这个法术释放出你内心暗藏的兽性，让你长出尖牙利爪，将你的敌人撕成碎片。现在你对这个法术了如指掌，并设计出了你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Call to the wilds for aid from some wolves.
translations: 向荒野呼唤，寻求狼群的援助。

messages.msgid: You focus on the bounty of nature around you and commune with it, improving your health and mood and calming nearby wildlife.  This spell may only be cast outdoors away from civilization.
translations: 你专注于周围的大自然，与之交流，改善你的健康和情绪，并安抚附近的野生动物。此咒语只能在远离文明的户外施放。

messages.msgid: Offer some of your life in a ritual to get tokens of growth in return.
translations: 在仪式中献出你的部分生命来换取成长的象征。

messages.msgid: A spell from a darker sect of druidry, created to forcibly begin the circle of life anew.  For without rot, you cannot have growth.  Affects a huge area, but is indiscriminate; even rusting machines into nothing but dust and slow both in casting and effect.  Once lost entirely to the passage of time, this spell was thought to be no more than a myth, the stuff of fairy tales, albeit grim ones.
translations: 来自德鲁伊黑暗教派的法术，用来强行重启生命循环。因为没有腐化，就无法生长。影响范围很大，且不分敌我；即便是机器也会生锈化为尘土，施法及起效速度都很慢。曾经完全失传在时间的流逝中，这个法术被认为只不过是神话传说，是童话故事的素材，虽然是黑暗童话。

messages.msgid:
Slowly heal your wounds by drawing on the power of nature.

You must be <color_yellow>outdoors and in a natural area</color> away from civilization to cast Restoration.
translations:
利用自然的力量慢慢治愈你的伤口。

你必须在在<color_yellow>户外且远离文明的自然区</color>才能施展恢复。

messages.msgid: Use some magic herbs to heal yourself.
translations: 使用一些魔法草药来治疗自己。

messages.msgid: This spell turns a mixture of bark and leaves into a powerful salve capable of stopping even grievous wounds from bleeding.
translations: 这个法术将树皮和树叶的混合物变成一种强大的药膏，即使是严重的伤口也能止血。

messages.msgid: This spell allows you to hear the trees' wisdom in the rustle of the leaves and the creaking of their roots, discerning the layout of the forest.
translations: 这个法术可以让你在树叶的沙沙声和树根的吱吱声中听到树木的智慧，洞察森林的布局。

messages.msgid: This spell creates a grouping of odd-looking but functional arrows out of forest detritus.
translations: 这个法术从森林碎屑中制造出一组看起来奇怪但功能强大的箭。

messages.msgid: This spell causes an animated vine to burst from the ground and attempt to seize a nearby target and hold it fast.
translations: 该法术会使一根有生命的藤蔓从地面破土而出，试图抓住附近的目标并将其牢牢固定。

messages.msgid: Using your connection to nature, you can sway an animal to your service.  This spell even works on mutated animals.
translations: 利用你与大自然的联系，你可以支配一只动物为你服务。这个法术甚至对变异的动物有效。

messages.msgid: This spell turns a stick into a vicious spear that drips with sticky sap.
translations: 这个法术会把一根棍子变成一把会滴下粘性汁液的凶猛的矛状物。

messages.msgid: This spell turns a bit of bark or a twig into a vicious spear that drips with sticky sap.  You now know this spell like the back of your hand, and no longer need such massive spell components as you did previously.
translations: 这个法术能将树皮或树枝变成一根滴着粘稠汁液的凶恶长矛。 你现在对这个咒语了如指掌，再也不需要像以前那样需要大量的法术组件了。

messages.msgid: Call up thick, swiftly growing brambles, either in a line to form a wall or an arc to trap an enemy.
translations: 召唤出粗壮而迅猛生长的荆棘丛，可令其排成直线，化为坚壁；或使其弯曲成弧，围困敌人。

messages.msgid: This spell transforms the druid's skin into a bark-like material covered in large thorns.  It provides excellent protection but slightly slows you and makes you vulnerable to fire.
translations: 这个咒语将德鲁伊的皮肤变成一种树皮状的物质，上面覆盖着巨大的刺。它提供了极好的保护，但会稍微减慢你的速度，使你容易受到火灾的伤害。

messages.msgid:
While outdoors and not underground, the druid can create a profusion of life around themselves, causing grass to grow through pavement, bushes and flowers to sprout, and trees to grow to full height in moments.

In <color_yellow>addition to</color> mana, this spell also requires <color_red>hit points</color> to cast and <color_yellow>will fail</color> if you are too injured.
translations:
只要身处室外而非地下，德鲁伊就能在自身周围催生万物，令青草破开路面，灌木与花卉萌芽，树木在片刻间长成。

<color_yellow>除了魔力</color>之外，此法术还需消耗<color_red>生命力</color>才能施放，如果你伤势过重，则施法将会<color_yellow>失败</color>。

messages.msgid: Using druidic magic, shape living wood into a log that you can use for other projects without harming the tree.  You must cast this spell on a living tree.
translations: 用德鲁伊魔法，在不伤害树木的情况下用其塑造出可用的原木。你必须对一棵活着的树施放此法术。

messages.msgid: Draw on some of the essence of water, providing protection against the summer's heat.
translations: 汲取部分水的精华，以抵御夏日的酷热。

messages.msgid: Cover yourself in a thin layer of magical seaweed, preventing you from getting wet and allowing you to breathe underwater.
translations: 用一层薄薄的魔法海藻覆盖全身，让你滴水不沾，并能在水下呼吸。

messages.msgid: Transform a bit of water into a magical disinfectant as you pour it over your wounds.
translations: 在你将水浇于伤口之上时，可将其转化为具有魔力的消毒剂。

messages.msgid: Enchant yourself so that the water will buoy you up and prevent you from sinking, allowing you to walk on its surface.
translations: 为自身附魔，水便会托起你，使你免于下沉，从而能在水面上行走。

messages.msgid: Blend in the wilds and urge them to speed your passage.  Trees bend out of the way, bushes do not hinder you, and even grass subtly moves your feet along.  The spell cannot be cast near civilization and similarly will fade if your travels take you out of the wilds.
translations: 融入荒野，并催动它来为你加速。树木将为你让路，灌木将不再阻碍，就连青草也会暗中助你前行。此法术无法在文明区域附近施放，同样，一旦离开荒野，法术也会随之消散。

messages.msgid: Adopt some of the aspect of the bear, protecting you from cold and preparing you for winter.
translations: 获得部分熊之外相，使你免受寒冷侵袭，为过冬做好准备。

messages.msgid: Enchant a set of berries, transforming them into magical fruit that will provide a hearty meal's worth of nutrition and a small amount of healing when eaten.  The goodberries will rot away within 24 hours if not eaten.
translations: 为一捧浆果附魔，将其转化为魔法水果。食用后可提供一顿饱饭的营养，并带来少许治疗效果。若24小时内不食用，这些“好莓果”便会腐烂。

messages.msgid: Call to the waters beneath the earth and bring them to the surface, creating a natural spring.  The waters will subside when the spell's duration ends.
translations: 呼唤地底之水，引其涌上地表，从而创造出一口天然泉眼。当法术持续时间结束时，泉水便会退去。

messages.msgid:
Grant a nearby tree awareness and mobility, letting it shake free from the soil and rise up to crush your enemies.  It will root itself again when the spell expires.

You must be <color_yellow>standing next to a tree</color> for the spell to take effect.
translations:
赋予附近的一棵树木意识与行动能力，使其挣脱土壤，拔地而起，去碾碎你的敌人。当法术失效时，它会重新扎根。

你必须站在<color_yellow>一棵树的旁边</color>才能让此法术生效。

messages.msgid: Encases your arms and hands in a sheath of magical stone, you can punch and defend yourself with it in melee combat.
translations: 召唤岩石包裹手臂和拳头，使你可以在近战战斗中用它来击打敌人和保护自己。

messages.msgid: Encases your arms and hands in a sheath of magical stone, you can punch and defend yourself with it in melee combat.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 将你的手臂和手部包裹在一层魔法岩石之中，你可以在近战中用它来出拳和防御。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Focusing mana into your leg, you stomp your foot and send out a shockwave, knocking enemies around you onto the ground.
translations: 聚集魔力进入你的腿，重重跺脚，发出冲击波，把周围的敌人击倒在地。

messages.msgid: You focus on the stones beneath you and draw from their agelessness.  Your mana is converted to stamina.
translations: 你专注于你下方的坚岩，从它们的经受时间考验的坚韧中获取力量。你将魔力转换成耐力。

messages.msgid: This spell projects a wide spray of sharp metal shards, cutting into your foes and friends alike.
translations: 这法术扇形喷射出大量锋利的金属碎片，敌友不分的切碎它们路上的所有目标。

messages.msgid: This spell projects a piercing rod of conjured iron at those that dare oppose you.
translations: 这法术召唤并发射出一根能穿透敌人的铁条，射穿那些胆敢阻挡你的蠢货。

messages.msgid: Creates an omnidirectional spray of razor sharp metal shards all around you.
translations: 向你四周的所有方向喷射剃刀般锋利的金属碎片。

messages.msgid: Fires a conjured stone projectile at high velocity.
translations: 你召唤并发射出一个高速飞行的石弹。

messages.msgid: Your essence flows around you, and the earth follows.
translations: 你的精魂在身侧流转，而土地也随之变化。

messages.msgid: This ritual creates a small pebble attuned to Earthshapers.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 这仪式会创造出一块与塑地者共鸣的小石块。你可以将符文作为催化剂用于制造其它物品。

messages.msgid: You close your eyes and the earth surrenders its secrets to you.
translations: 你闭上双眼，大地随即向你透露了它的秘密。

messages.msgid: Envelops your entire body in armor formed from living rock, encumbering yet protective.
translations: 将你全身包覆在活化岩石构成的装甲中，累赘但防护森严。

messages.msgid: Envelops your entire body in armor formed from living rock, encumbering yet protective.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 用活体岩石化作的盔甲包裹你的全身，虽显笨重，但保护周全。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Drawing upon the surrounding earth, you form a pillar of solid rock.  Experience will make the task easier, and less disruptive to the surrounding area.
translations: 你用魔法将四周的泥土堆起，形成一根硬石柱。经验的累积将使施法更容易，并减少对周围区域的破坏。

messages.msgid: With a simple touch, you transform the body of your enemy into pure stone.  The effect is temporary, but the target will be totally immobile while the spell lasts.
translations: 只需轻轻一触，你便能将敌人的身体化为纯粹的岩石。该效果是暂时的，但在法术持续期间，目标将完全无法动弹。

messages.msgid: Explode your stone skin, to deal massive damage to all enemies around.
translations: 引爆你的石肤，对附近的敌人造成巨量伤害。

messages.msgid: Summon a stone spikes underground, that penetrate your enemies, and nail them for a while.
translations: 从地下召唤出岩石尖刺，刺穿你的敌人，并使其暂时无法动弹。

messages.msgid: Shape the basic working tools, using your own magic abilities and earth nearby.  Activate to change the shape of a tool.
translations: 塑造出基本的工作用具，使用你自己的魔法能力和附近的土地。激活以更改工具的形状。

messages.msgid: Fill yourself with the power of Earth, and make each your attacks as devastating as an earthquake.
translations: 将大地的能量充满你的身体，让你的每次攻击都像地震一样有毁灭性。

messages.msgid: You cover your body with a layer of small, razor-sharp crystals.  It makes monsters that attack you take some damage in return, and gives you some additional cut damage in melee.
translations: 你用一层小而锋利的晶体覆盖住身体。它使攻击你的怪物受到一些伤害，并在近战中造成一些额外的切割伤害。

messages.msgid: Hide yourself within sand-filled winds.  It's harder to hit you, and monsters can't spot you.  Attacking a target will break the spell.
translations: 将自己藏身于漫天沙风之中。这会让你更难被击中，怪物也无法发现你。攻击目标将会打破法术。

messages.msgid: Shape a strong golem out of stone.  It may help for a while, but you haven't enough energy to support it forever.
translations: 塑造一个强大的石制傀儡。能帮上你很多，但你没有足够的能量永远维持它。

messages.msgid: Pull forth a table of smooth rock from the underground bedrock, using your forces of earthshaping.  You can use it as a table or as a primitive anvil.
translations: 运用你的塑地之力，从地下的基岩中抽出一张光滑的石桌。你可以将它用作桌子或简易的铁砧。

messages.msgid: You extend your senses into the ground, becoming aware of every hill and valley within a large area.  It will only work when in contact with the earth.
translations: 你可以将感官延伸到地面，感知到大片区域内的每一座山丘和山谷。 只有与大地接触时，它才会发挥作用。

messages.msgid: By sensing their movements upon the earth, you can detect nearby sources of danger.  You must maintain a connection to the earth for the spell to function.
translations: 通过感知它们在大地上的运动，你可以探测到附近的危险来源。你必须保持与大地的连接才能使法术发挥作用。

messages.msgid: Draw on the eternal endurance of the stones, slowing your metabolism and staving off hunger and thirst.  However, while the enchantment is in effect, you will not heal.
translations: 利用磐石永恒的耐力，减缓新陈代谢，缓解饥饿和干渴。 不过，当魔法生效时，你将无法痊愈。

messages.msgid: Ask the earth spirits to prepare the earth for growth and planting.
translations: 祈求大地之灵为生长和种植做好准备。

messages.msgid: In an extremity of danger, summon a hollow shell of rock around yourself.  It lasts only a few moments, but sometimes that's all you need.  You must be standing on the living earth to invoke it.
translations: 在极端危险的情况下，在自己周围召唤一个空心的岩石外壳。 它只能持续片刻，但有时这就是你所需要的。 你必须站在生命土地上才能召唤它。

messages.msgid: Compress dirt together so it becomes as hard as rock.  A great way to turn makeshift barricades into a fortress.
translations: 将泥土压缩，使其变得像岩石一样坚硬。将简易路障变成堡垒的好方法。

messages.msgid: When standing on earth or stone, sink into the ground.  While submerged, you will heal faster, sleep will be more restorative, and you will not need to eat or drink.  Cast this spell again to return to the surface.
translations: 站在泥土或岩石上时，可以沉入地面。遁入地下期间，你的治疗速度会加快，睡眠的恢复效果会更好，并且无需进食或饮水。再次施放此法术即可返回地面。

messages.msgid: While holding an item made of natural metal or stone, mold it with your hands, work to repairing any flaws and restoring its condition.  Note that some items may still not be repaired.
translations: 手持由天然金属或石材制成的物品时，你可以用双手对其进行塑形，修复任何瑕疵，恢复其状态。请注意，部分物品可能仍然无法修复。

messages.msgid: While standing on natural earth, sink into it and emerge from any other patch of natural earth within the spell's range.
translations: 站在天然土地上时，你可以沉入其中，并从法术范围内的任何其他天然土地上出现。

messages.msgid: Goblins and wargs have had an innate bond from time immemorial, and even wild wargs will easily heel when a goblin calls…as long as the goblin has some raw meat to feed them with.
translations: 自远古以来，哥布林与座狼之间就有一种先天的羁绊，只要哥布林发出呼唤，即便是野生的座狼也会轻易地跟从……前提是这个哥布林得有生肉喂给它们。

messages.msgid: You take control of the animal's mind!
You activate your ring and three throwing knives appear, ready to throw!
translations: 你激活了你的戒指，三把飞刀随之产生，随时可以投掷！

messages.msgid: You activate your bag and a throwing knife appears, ready to throw!
translations: 你激活了你的袋子，一把魔法飞刀随之产生，随时可以投掷！

messages.msgid: You activate your bag and a throwing knife wrapped in ethereal flames appears, ready to throw!
translations: 你激活了你的袋子，一把包裹着永恒之焰的魔法飞刀随之产生，随时可以投掷！

messages.msgid: You activate your bag and a throwing knife emanating cold appears, ready to throw!
translations: 你激活了你的袋子，一把散发着刺骨冰寒的魔法飞刀随之产生，随时可以投掷！

messages.msgid: You activate your bag and a throwing knife with unnaturally sharp edges appears, ready to throw!
translations: 你激活了你的袋子，一把异常锋利的魔法飞刀随之产生，随时可以投掷！

messages.msgid: You activate your bag and a throwing knife covered in dark ooze appears, ready to throw!
translations: 你激活了你的袋子，一把包裹着黑色软泥的魔法飞刀随之产生，随时可以投掷！

messages.msgid: You activate your bag and with a flash magical energies coalescence in your hand into a shape of knife.  It seems vastly more powerful than other knives that appear from the bag!
translations: 你激活了你的袋子，一瞬间纯净的魔法能量在你的手上汇聚成飞刀的形状。它看起来比袋子里的其他飞刀威力要大得多！

messages.msgid:
Your veins feel like they are on fire!
You start regenerating mana!
translations:
你的血管感觉像是着火了！
你开始恢复魔力！

messages.msgid: Call upon stag beetles for various tasks.
translations: 呼唤锹甲来执行各种任务。

messages.msgid: A stag beetle responds to the call, arriving in the location you are in.  It can be used to carry you and your belongings so long as you have a wildwood rune and the skill to ride it.
translations: 一只鹿角虫响应了呼唤，来到你的面前。只要你持有灵木符文并善于骑乘，便能驾驭它来运载你和你的行囊。

messages.msgid: Generates strong heat at the targeted location, damaging anything susceptible to high temperatures.
translations: 在目标位置产生强热，对一切不耐高温的物质造成伤害。

messages.msgid: Generates an intense heat at the location, greatly damaging anything susceptible to high temperatures.
translations: 在目标位置产生炽热，对一切不耐高温的物质造成严重伤害。

messages.msgid: Summons a small flame that does not affect you, but can be used to light things on fire.  It seems to need you to have some intent to light things on fire, since you are able to put it in your pocket with no issue.
translations: 召唤一小簇不会伤及自身的火焰，可用于引燃他物。此术似乎需要你心存点火之念方能生效，毕竟你都能若无其事地将这火焰揣入兜中。

messages.msgid: Causes jagged icicles to form in the air above the target, falling and damaging them.
translations: 在目标上方的空中凝结出嶙峋的冰锥，随即坠落伤敌。

messages.msgid: You hurl a pea-sized glowing orb that produces a pressure-less blast of searing heat when it hits an obstacle or reaches the target.
translations: 你投出一枚豌豆大小的荧光法球，它在击中障碍或抵达目标时会释放出一股无压的灼热爆风。

messages.msgid: You blast a cone of frigid air toward the target.
translations: 向目标发射一股锥形的极寒空气。

messages.msgid: You're pretty sure you saw this in a game somewhere.  You fire a short-range cone of fire.
translations: 向一片较小的锥形区域喷射火焰。"你肯定在其他游戏中见过这个。"

messages.msgid: You're pretty sure you saw this in a game somewhere.  You fire a short-range cone of ice and cold.
translations: 向一片较小的锥形区域喷射冰寒。"你肯定在其他游戏中见过这个。"

messages.msgid: Freezes the touched target with intense cold.
translations: 用严寒冻结被你触碰的目标。

messages.msgid: Encases your feet in a magical coating of ice, allowing you to glide along smooth surfaces faster.
translations: 将你的脚包裹在一层神奇的冰层中，让你更快地沿着光滑的表面滑行。

messages.msgid: Encases your feet in a magical coating of ice, allowing you to glide along smooth surfaces faster.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 为你的双足覆上一层魔法冰壳，使你在光滑表面上滑行得更快。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: You project a glowing white crystal of ice and it explodes on impact into a blossom of shattering cold.
translations: 你发射出一颗发光的白色冰晶，在撞击之处绽放酷寒。

messages.msgid: Creates a magical shield of ice on your arm, with which you can defend yourself in melee and use it to bash.
translations: 在你的手臂上制造一个魔法冰盾，你可以用它在近战中保护自己，并使用它来攻击。

messages.msgid: Creates a magical shield of ice on your arm, with which you can defend yourself and use it to bash.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 在你的手臂上制造一个魔法冰盾，你可以用它在近战中保护自己，并使用它来攻击。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Covers you in a thin layer of reactive magical ice to attack those who harm you.
translations: 用一层薄薄的魔法冰来保护你，反击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Covers you in a thin layer of reactive magical ice to attack those who harm you.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 为你的身体覆上一层反应性魔法冰甲，用以反击伤你之人。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: This ritual freezes a small fire in order to create a rune attuned to Kelvinists.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 该仪式通过冻结一小簇火焰，创造一枚与“开氏门徒”同调的符文。此符文可用作配方的催化剂。

messages.msgid: This spell ignites a wooden sword, creating a flaming blade able to burn, bruise, and chop.
translations: 这个法术点燃一柄木剑，将其变成一把燃烧的剑。可以对敌人造成烧伤、钝击、斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: This spell ignites a wooden sword, creating a flaming blade able to burn, bruise, and chop.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 这个法术点燃一柄木剑，将其变成一把燃烧的剑。可以对敌人造成烧伤、钝击、斩击伤害。如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: This spell ignites dust scattered in the air, creating a cone of flame.  The hot ashes can cling to targets, causing additional burns over time.
translations: 这个法术点燃散布在空气中的尘埃，释放出一个火焰锥。炽热的灰烬会附着在目标身上，并随着时间的推移造成更多灼伤。

messages.msgid: Your hands freeze anything they touch at temperatures so cold it slows down your foes.
translations: 你的双手在如此寒冷的温度下能冻结接触到的任何物体，它会减慢你触碰到的敌人。

messages.msgid: Heat the nearby air, keeping you warm and providing some protection against ice and cold.
translations: 加热附近的空气，为你保暖，并提供一些防寒保暖措施。

messages.msgid: Cool the nearby air, keeping you cool and providing some protection against heat and flame.
translations: 给附近的空气降温，让你保持凉爽，并提供一些抵御高温和火焰的保护。

messages.msgid: Like the bonfire gathers revelers around it, the kelvinist becomes the life of the party, as their eyes shine with passion and their voice burns with the heat of their conviction.  You will be more convincing while this spell is in effect.  Before the Cataclysm, this was one of the most common spells that apprentices were desperate to learn and master mages were reluctant to teach.
translations: 就像篝火聚集了狂欢者一样，炽霜法师成为了派对的灵魂，他们的眼睛闪耀着激情，声音中燃烧着坚定的热情。生效期间，你会更有说服力。在大灾变之前，这是学徒们渴望学习的常见法术之一，而大师们却不愿意传授。

messages.msgid: Just as the kelvinist can start a fire, they can extinguish it, by transmuting the heat of the fire directly into cold and leaving nothing left to continue the flames.
translations: 就像炽霜法师可以生火一样，他们也可以通过将火焰的热量直接转化为冰冷，不留下任何让火焰持续的东西，来使其熄灭。

messages.msgid: Summon a sphere of ice that will preserve anything placed inside while the container lasts.
translations: 召唤一个寒冰法球，只要法球存续，置于其中的任何物品都将得到保鲜。

messages.msgid: Draw on the essence of ice to freeze out all emotion, rendering you comfortably numb.  This spell used to get you on several lists if the government learned that you knew it, back when there was a government to care about that.
translations: 凭借冰之精华，冻结所有感情，使你变得惬意地麻木。在那个还重视着这个法术的政府还没崩溃的时候，一旦政府知道你了解这个，你必然会上好几个名单。

messages.msgid: A simple spell that hurls a bolt of fire to the target location.  While not as damaging as some more complex spells, it is quick to cast and will ignite anything flammable at the target.
translations: 一个简单的咒语，向目标位置掷出一道闪电。虽然不像一些更复杂的咒语那样具有破坏性，但它施放速度很快，会点燃目标上的任何易燃物。

messages.msgid: With the tiniest amount of heat, unfreeze an item of food or drink and heat it up to a comfortable temperature.
translations: 用最少量的热量解冻食物或饮料，并将其加热到舒适的温度。

messages.msgid: Force a large amount of burning mana into every hostile target affected by the spell, causing them to explode in flames.  Knowledge of this spell required licensing and registration before the Cataclysm, but you're pretty sure the ATF isn't going to be hassling you any time soon.
translations: 将大量燃烧的魔力强制注入每个受法术影响的敌对目标，使其在烈火中爆炸。在大灾变前，了解这个法术需要许可和登记，但现在你很确定 ATF 不会再来找你麻烦了。
蜥蜴人萨满召唤出一只鳄鱼！

messages.msgid: Shroud an area in intense shadows.
translations: 令一片区域被深邃的阴影所笼罩。

messages.msgid: I cast Magic Missile at the darkness!
translations: 我对黑暗发射魔法飞弹！

messages.msgid: Teleports you a short distance in a random direction.
translations: 把你往随机方向传送一小段距离。

messages.msgid: Teleports you randomly near a target location.
translations: 将你随机传送至目标位置附近。

messages.msgid: Summons a well of gravity centered on the targeted location.  Dealing bashing damage to all creatures in the affected area.
translations: 在指定地点的中央召唤一口重力井。对受影响地区的所有生物造成钝击伤害。

messages.msgid: A blast of concentrated magical power that obliterates a large area.
translations: 聚焦过的魔法轰击，可以夷平一大片区域。

messages.msgid: A bolt of magical power that only damages your foes.
translations: 一束破坏性魔法闪电，只会伤害你的敌人。

messages.msgid: This spell gives you an enormous boost of speed lasting a short period of time.
translations: 这法术在短时间内大幅度增加你的速度。

messages.msgid: This spell weakens your target, resulting in a decrease of speed lasting a short period of time.
translations: 这个法术削弱你的敌人，导致其速度暂时降低。
把你的敌人变形成青蛙。

messages.msgid: A beam of focused magical power that damages any foes in its path.
translations: 一束聚焦过的破坏性魔法光束，会伤害到它路径上的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: Teleports you in a random direction a medium distance, to help escape your foes in dangerous situations.
translations: 将你向随机方向传送一段中等的距离，可以在危险情况下帮你逃出敌人包围。

messages.msgid: This ritual forces small amounts of mana to crystallize out into intricate patterns, making a rune attuned to Magi.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 这个仪式能将少量的魔力结晶压成复杂的图案，形成与魔法契合的符文。 你可以将符文作为催化剂用于制造其它物品。

messages.msgid: You align your senses to be closer to those of a cat, becoming more graceful, agile, and coordinated.
translations: 你将感官调谐得更接近于猫，身姿愈发优雅，行动愈发敏捷，举止愈发协调。

messages.msgid: You gain the perception of an eagle.
You gain the strength of an ogre.
You become wily like a fox.
translations: 你变得像狐狸一样狡猾。

messages.msgid: Summon a jar of force in which you can store liquids.
translations: 召唤出一个能够用来储存液体的魔力瓶。

messages.msgid: This spell infuses a sling with tremendous force, delivering devastating pebble shots until the energy tears it apart.
translations: 这个法术将巨大的力量注入投石索，在能量撕碎自己之前，投掷出威力巨大的石子。

messages.msgid: This spell infuses a sling with tremendous force, delivering devastating pebble shots until the energy tears it apart.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.

You focus your mana into a microscopically thin pulsed beam of pure energy, capable of extreme range and precision; as well as unparalleled penetration, provided proper skill.  Once the invention of a notorious assassin, this spell has slain many a king and noble.  Passed on only through direct descendants over the ages, though occasionally shared by them to others.
translations: 你将魔力凝聚为一束微观尺度的纯能量脉冲射线，具备极致的射程与精准度；若技艺纯熟，更能发挥出无与伦比的穿透力。此法术为一位恶名昭彰的刺客所创，曾终结诸多君王与贵族的性命。历经世代仅通过直系血脉单传，虽偶有传承者将其授予外人。

messages.msgid: Reduce the velocity of your falls by a great amount, or to zero if at high mastery.
translations: 将下落速度大幅降低，如果掌握得很好，则可降至零。

messages.msgid: Ascend even the most sheer wall with ease as you cling to surfaces.
translations: 吸附于物体表面，让你能轻松攀上最陡峭的绝壁。

messages.msgid: Mark a particular patch of ground to allow you to return to it later.
translations: 在一块特定的土地上做上标记，这样你以后就可以回到那里。

messages.msgid: Immediately return to the place you marked with Magus's Mark, no matter how far away it is.
translations: 立即回到你标有魔术师标记的地方，无论它有多远。

messages.msgid: A simple but powerful spell, Mageshield will render the caster immune to any single attack.  It is indiscriminate: whether hit by an anti-tank missile or the caster stubbing their toe, it will absorb all energy of the attack and then fade.
translations: 法师护盾，一则简单而强大的法术，能使施法者免疫任何单次攻击。它对攻击一视同仁：无论是反坦克导弹的轰击，还是施法者不慎踢到脚趾的小磕碰，它都会吸收该次攻击的全部能量，然后消散。

messages.msgid: Pull a target or set of items to you.
translations: 拉取一个目标或一组物品给你。

messages.msgid: A popular military spell since ancient times, Arrowflight increases the range of bows and, as it later turned out, firearms.
translations: 此术自古便是备受青睐的军用法术，起初用于增加弓弩的射程，后来人们更发现，它对枪械也同样适用。

messages.msgid: Magically infuse a melee weapon with the hardness and resilience of a diamond as well as its industrial cutting capability, making it supremely sharp and durable.  However, like a diamond, any damage the weapon suffers afterwards cannot be repaired.
translations: 以魔法为近战武器注入钻石般的硬度、韧性及其工业切割能力，使其锋锐无匹，坚固耐用。然其性亦如钻石，一旦受损，便再无修复之可能。

messages.msgid: Affect the air around the target and their vocal cords, preventing them from making any noise whatsoever.  This makes them much more stealthy, but they cannot cast any spells requiring speech.
translations: 影响目标周遭的空气及其声带，令其无法发出任何声响。这能让他们潜行时更为隐秘，却也无法施放任何需要言语的法术。

messages.msgid: Cause the air around the target to glow slightly, revealing their location and making it slightly harder for them to dodge attacks.
translations: 使目标周身的空气微微发光，从而暴露其位置，并令其更难闪避攻击。

messages.msgid: Enchant the air in a location to glow, producing a orb of soft light.  While not particularly bright, the light will last years if you're not lucky and millennia if you are.
translations: 为一处地点的空气附魔使其发光，从而产生一团柔和的光球。此光虽不甚明亮，然时运不济，尚能维系数载；天佑福至，则可明耀千年。

messages.msgid:
Create an impenetrable shell of force around the target, preventing them from moving or acting for the spell's duration.  The shell works in two directions and the target is also immune to all harm.

Adamantine Gaol <color_yellow>cannot be dispelled</color>.
translations:
在目标周围创造一个坚不可摧的力场囚笼，令其在法术持续期间无法移动或做出任何行动。此囚笼内外隔绝，身处其中的目标亦会免疫一切伤害。

金刚之牢<color_yellow>无法被驱散</color>。

messages.msgid: Unleash a wave of force, hurling all nearby targets away from you.  Heavier targets are harder to affect.
translations: 释放一道力场波，将附近所有目标从你身边震开。越重的目标越难被影响。

messages.msgid:
Perform a magical ritual to increase the efficiency by which your body processes mana, granting you the Lesser Mana Efficiency trait.  The ritual must end when the sun is in the sky and you are at least one story above the ground.

The chance of the ritual's success depends in your spell level and Spellcraft skill.
translations:
进行一个魔法仪式以提高你身体处理魔力的效率，授予你魔力容纳（强化）特性。仪式必须在阳光照耀下结束，并且你至少在地面以上一层楼的高度。

仪式成功的几率取决于你的法术等级和法术技巧。

messages.msgid:
Perform a magical ritual to increase the efficiency by which your body processes mana, granting you the Mana Efficiency trait.  You must already have the Lesser Mana Efficiency trait for the spell to take full effect.  The ritual must end within one hour of noon and you are at least four stories above the ground.

The chance of the ritual's success depends in your spell level and Spellcraft skill.
translations:
进行一个魔法仪式以提高你身体处理魔力的效率，授予你魔力容纳（高强）特性。为了使法术完全生效，你必须已经具备魔力容纳（强化）特性。仪式必须在中午前后一小时内结束，并且你至少在地面以上四层楼的高度。

仪式成功的几率取决于你的法术等级和法术技能。

messages.msgid:
Perform a magical ritual to increase the speed by which your body restores its mana, granting you the Lesser Mana Regeneration trait.  The ritual must be performed while standing in a river or a stream.

The chance of the ritual's success depends in your spell level and Spellcraft skill.
translations:
进行一个魔法仪式以提高你身体恢复魔力的速度，授予你魔力再生（强化）特性。仪式必须在河流或小溪中进行。

仪式成功的几率取决于你的法术等级和法术技能。

messages.msgid:
Perform a magical ritual to increase the speed by which your body restores its mana, granting you the Mana Regeneration trait.  You must already have the Lesser Mana Regeneration trait for the spell to take full effect.  The ritual must be performed while standing in a river.

The chance of the ritual's success depends in your spell level and Spellcraft skill.
translations:
进行一个魔法仪式以提高你身体恢复魔力的速度，授予你魔力再生（高强）特性。为了使法术完全生效，你必须已经具备魔力再生（强化）特性。仪式必须在河流中进行。

仪式成功的几率取决于你的法术等级和法术技能。

messages.msgid:
Perform a magical ritual to increase the sensitivity that your body has to mana, granting you the Lesser Mana Sensitivity trait.  The ritual must take place in a natural location away (at least 4 OM tiles) from buildings, roads, or other evidence of civilization.

The chance of the ritual's success depends in your spell level and Spellcraft skill.
translations:
举行一场魔法仪式来提升你身体对魔力的敏感度，从而获得“魔力敏感（强化）”的特性。仪式必须在远离建筑物、道路或其他文明痕迹的自然之地（至少4个地上地图格以外）举行。

仪式的成功率取决于你的法术等级和施法技巧。

messages.msgid:
Perform a magical ritual to increase the sensitivity that your body has to mana, granting you the Mana Sensitivity trait.  You must already have the Lesser Mana Sensitivity trait for the spell to take full effect.  The ritual must take place in a natural location far away (at least 15 OM tiles) from buildings, roads, or other evidence of civilization.

The chance of the ritual's success depends in your spell level and Spellcraft skill.
translations:
进行一个魔法仪式以提高你身体对魔力的敏感度，授予你魔力敏感（高强）特性。为了使法术完全生效，你必须已经具备魔力敏感（强化）特性。仪式必须在远离建筑、道路或其他文明迹象的自然环境中进行（至少15 OM格远）。

仪式成功的几率取决于你的法术等级和法术技能。

messages.msgid: Crystallizes mana into solid form.  Your physiological changes have made this spell much more efficient and easier to cast.
translations: 将魔力凝聚成固体结晶型态。你生理上的变化使这个法术效果更强大，且更容易施放。

messages.msgid: Fires bolts of mana from your fingertips that home in on randomly selected targets in range.
translations: 从你的指尖发射多只魔法火焰箭，随机命中在射程中的目标。

messages.msgid: A mass of spectral hands emerge from the ground, slowing everything in range.  Higher levels allow a bigger AoE, and longer effect.
translations: 从地面伸出无数幽影手，减慢范围内的一切。等级越高，作用范围越大，作用时间越长。

messages.msgid: This spell causes roots and vines to burst forth from the ground and grab your foes, slowing them and doing a small amount of damage as they dig in.
translations: 这个法术会从地下长出藤蔓及树根，紧紧的抓住你的敌人，减慢他们的速度，并对他们造成少量的伤害。

messages.msgid: You launch yourself into a powerful wing-assisted leap.
translations: 你借助双翼的力量，猛然向前飞跃。

messages.msgid: A short-ranged fan of electricity shoots from your fingers.
translations: 从你的指尖发射出几道短距离扇形电流。

messages.msgid: A quick burst of electricity strikes a target and possibly one other nearby.
translations: 释放出一道极快的电流攻击目标，击中目标的同时可能会附带攻击临近的另一目标。

messages.msgid: The go-to spell for many Stormshapers, this iconic spell does just what you expect: shoot lightning from your fingertips.  However, this lightning is more directed than most lightning, and travels in a line through most non-solid targets.
A powerful blast of wind slams into anything in front of your body.
translations: 一阵强风爆出，吹向你身体前的一切。

messages.msgid: A magical wind pushes you forward as you move, easing your movements and increasing speed.
translations: 当你移动的时候，一股神奇的风推动着你前进，让你自如行动并提高速度。

messages.msgid: Creates a crackling magical warhammer full of lightning to smite your foes with, and of course, smash things to bits!
translations: 一个充满闪电的魔幻战锤，用闪电击打你的敌人。当然，也可以把东西砸成碎片！

messages.msgid: Creates a crackling magical warhammer full of lightning to smite your foes with, and of course, smash things to bits!  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.
translations: 一个充满闪电的魔幻战锤，用闪电击打你的敌人。当然，也可以把东西砸成碎片！现在你对这个法术了如指掌，并设计出了你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: This ritual creates a rune attuned to Stormshapers, which looks similar to what you'd expect lightning in a glass pebble to look like.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 该仪式能创造一枚与“风暴塑造者”同调的符文，其形貌宛如封印在琉璃卵石中的闪电。此符文可用作配方的催化剂。

messages.msgid: You fire a small concentrated ball of lightning at the target.  The electricity diffuses rapidly, so it doesn't do much damage, but you're able to fire off several ones quickly.
translations: 你向目标发射一个小型浓缩闪电球。电流会迅速弥散，故而伤害不高，但胜在可以快速连发。

messages.msgid: You call the power of the sky to strike the earth.  Several lightning blasts fire from your finger tips to strike the target.
translations: 你召唤天空的力量来打击大地。几道闪电从你的指尖射出，击中目标。

messages.msgid: By manipulating the charge in the air, you can conjure a sharp snap of lightning over a wide area.  While its destructive potential is a far cry from natural lightning, the light and thunderclap produced will leave your foes reeling.
translations: 通过操控空气中的电荷，你可以在大片区域内召唤出一道闪电。虽然它的破坏力与自然产生的闪电相去甚远，但它所产生的强光和雷击会让你的敌人战战兢兢。

messages.msgid: Draws forth a broad wall of thick fog.  While the sudden force of air pressure will floor any enemies caught in it, the conjuration is otherwise harmless.
translations: 召唤出一堵厚厚的雾墙。虽然突然出现的气压会击倒任何被困在里面的敌人，但这个魔法无法造成其它伤害。

messages.msgid: Manifests an aura of crackling electricity around you to strike attackers with baleful lightning.
translations: 你在你周围召唤出一道噼啪作响的电弧光环，能放出可怕的闪电电击近战攻击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Manifests an aura of crackling electricity around you to strike attackers with baleful lightning.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.
translations: 你在你周围召唤出一道噼啪作响的电弧光环，能放出可怕的闪电电击近战攻击你的敌人。现在你对这个法术了如指掌，并设计出了你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Encases your arm and hand in a sheath of crackling magical lightning, you can punch and defend yourself with it in melee combat.
translations: 召唤闪电包裹手臂和拳头，使你可以在近战战斗中用它来击打敌人和保护自己。

messages.msgid: Encases your arm and hand in a sheath of crackling magical lightning, you can punch and defend yourself with it in melee combat.  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and start to design your own version.
translations: 召唤闪电包裹手臂和拳头，使你可以在近战战斗中用它来击打敌人和保护自己。现在你对这个法术了如指掌，并设计出了你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Summons a small electric spark, that doesn't harm anything.  You can use it to ignite something flammable.
translations: 召唤一道小电火花，什么都伤不到。你可以用它点燃什么易燃物。

messages.msgid: As the sound of the spell moves out of your mouth, it creates a crushing shockwave that shatters everything in its path.
translations: 咒音甫出，便化作一道摧枯拉朽的冲击波，将路径上的一切碾为齑粉。

messages.msgid: Create a high-pressure zone originating from the selected point.  Shortly after, a massive pressure wave will crush everything inside, inflicting barotraumatic injuries on everyone affected.
translations: 创建从选定点开始的高压区。随后，巨大的压力波将粉碎里面的一切，给每个受影响的单位造成伤害。

messages.msgid: Create a high-pressure zone originating from the selected point.  Shortly after, a massive pressure wave will crush everything inside, inflicting barotraumatic injuries on everyone affected.  The pressure differential will also pull unprepared creatures inside the zone before collapsing.
translations: 创建一个从选定点开始的高压区域。随后，巨大的压力波会压碎里面的一切，对所有受影响的单位造成伤害。压力差也会在崩溃前把毫无准备的单位拉进这个区域。

messages.msgid: Cover your head with an air bubble, allowing you to breathe underwater or prevent breathing of toxic gases.
translations: 用气泡覆盖住头部，使你能在水下和有毒气体中呼吸。

messages.msgid: Create arcs of devastating electric charge in an area around you, roasting everything within.
translations: 在你周围的区域产生毁灭性电荷的弧线，烘烤里面的一切。

messages.msgid: Fill your legs with energy and quickly dash to a target destination.
translations: 让你的双腿充满能量，快速冲向目标。

messages.msgid: Briefly become lightning to teleport to a chosen spot, ignoring all obstacles in-between.
translations: 短暂地变成闪电传送到选定的地点，忽略路径上的所有障碍。

messages.msgid: Inject a corrosive electric energy into targets within the affected area, weakening them and dealing huge damage over time.
translations: 向受影响区域内的目标注入腐蚀性电能，削弱它们，并随着时间的推移造成巨大伤害。

messages.msgid: Enhance your sight with your powers which allows you to see creatures of the same energy around you.  This enhanced perception speed enables you to see more attacks incoming, allowing for an additional block or dodge attempt.
translations: 运用你的能力增强你的视觉，使你能看见周围同源能量的生物。这种增强的感知速度使你能察觉到更多即将到来的攻击，从而有机会尝试做出额外的格挡或闪避。

messages.msgid: Your hands start to store a vast amount of energy, which you release with each attack.  You feel the spell will get stronger with a higher mastery.
translations: 你的双手开始蓄积庞大的能量，并在每次攻击时释放。你感觉到随着对该法术掌握程度的提高，其威力将会更强。

messages.msgid: A spell designed for scholars who have recently started to learn stormshaping, allowing them to reduce the damage their often capricious new abilities may cause to themselves.
translations: 一项专为初学风暴塑造者设计的法术，使他们能够减少自己新学到的经常不稳定能力可能对自己造成的伤害。

messages.msgid: Summon a Teravolt, a small, semi-intelligent spirit that homes in on hostile creatures before exploding into a huge spark cloud.
translations: 召唤一只特拉伏特，一只小型、半灵智的灵魂体，它会锁定敌对生物并在接近后爆炸成为一团巨大的电火花云。

messages.msgid: Call out to the sky spirits for aid and ask them to conceal you from your enemies.  The fog will hide your passage, but you do not have any special ability to see through it yourself.
translations: 向天空中的神灵求助，请他们帮你躲避敌人。 大雾会遮住你的通路，但你自己没有任何特殊能力看穿大雾。

messages.msgid: Compress the fury of hurricane winds into a thin shell of raging air around yourself.  This will make it harder for you to lose your footing or be knocked down and occasionally throw attackers away from you, but the whirling winds are loud.
translations: 将狂暴飓风的狂风压缩成薄薄的狂暴气流壳，环绕在自己周围。这样你就不容易失去平衡或被击倒，有时还能将攻击者扔出去，但旋风的声音很大。

messages.msgid: The winds lash out and hurl <npcname> away!
Someone's personal notes were added to this spell.  You're positive that they changed both the name and the function.
translations: 这个法术上添加了某人的个人笔记。你能确定不管是名字还是功效都已经变了。

messages.msgid: Increase the volume of the caster's voice, allowing every word to resound like a peal of thunder.  As a useful side effect, it makes the caster immune to hearing damage caused by loud noises.
translations: 增大施法者的声音音量，使其说出的每个字如同雷霆般回荡。作为一项实用的附加效果，此法术使施法者对因噪音过大导致的听力损伤免疫。

messages.msgid: A blessing that gives you energy and boosts your abilities.
translations: 这是一个能给你能量并提升你的能力的祝福。

messages.msgid: Creates a magical field that hides your visual presence to others.  Colloquially known as invisibility, but without all the science mumbo jumbo.  Attacking a target will break the invisibility.
translations: 创造一个魔法力场，将你的身形从他人视野中隐去。通俗点说就是隐形，但和那些科学上的繁文缛节可不是一回事。攻击目标会打破隐形状态。

messages.msgid: To the outside world, your body fades away and you cease to exist!
translations: 你的身影逐渐消失，在外部世界看来就像不复存在了！

messages.msgid: This blade of light will cut through any evil it makes contact with!
translations: 这把光明之刃将斩断它所接触到的任何邪恶！

messages.msgid: This blade of light will cut through any evil it makes contact with!  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 这把光明之刃将斩断它所接触到的任何邪恶！如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: Evil will not make it through your defenses if your faith is strong enough!
translations: 只要心灵够强大，邪恶袭来不害怕。

messages.msgid: Evil will not make it through your defenses if your faith is strong enough!  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 只要信仰弥坚，邪恶便无法洞穿你的防线！如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。
创造一盏神奇的魔法灯。

messages.msgid: You have found a way to convert your mana into power you can use for your bionics.
translations: 你已找到门路，能将自身魔力转化为可供仿生装置使用的能量。

messages.msgid: This ritual inscribes circuit-like ley-lines into a rune, attuned to Technomancers.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.
translations: 该仪式将电路般的灵脉铭刻于一枚符文之上，并将其调谐至科技法师的频率。你可以将这枚符文用作配方的催化剂。

messages.msgid: This spell arcs two small bolts of electricity into a target, shocking them.
translations: 该法术会向目标发射两道小电流，使其受到电击。

messages.msgid: This spell manipulates some quantum something or other to tunnel you through a short distance of space, and even matter, unfortunately there's that whole uncertainty thing as to where you come out.  It leaves you a little dazed on the other side as you reorient yourself.
translations: 这个法术可以操纵量子什么的，让你穿越一小段空间，甚至是物质。然而不幸的是，某种不确定性之类的东西使你无法完全控制自己以什么方式出现在哪。你在传送后会头晕脑胀，需要一段时间才能恢复。

messages.msgid: This spell stimulates the synapses in your brain beyond normal processing speeds, giving you a large boost in mental processing capability.  It enhances your reflexes, speed, and raw intellectual power.  Use responsibly!
translations: 此法术会刺激你的大脑突触，使其处理速度远超常态，从而大幅提升你的心智处理能力。它能强化你的反应、速度和原始智力。请审慎使用！

messages.msgid: You concentrate and release a focused beam of photons at a target, also known as a laser.
translations: 你集中并对目标释放一束聚焦的光子，又名激光。

messages.msgid: This spell conjures flying animated blades that will cut your enemies down to size.  Into small pieces that is.
translations: 此法术将召唤"活着"的魔法飞剑，切割敌人，切碎为止。

messages.msgid: This spell manipulates light into barely tangible duplicates of a living being, a magical hologram in short.
translations: 这个法术通过操纵光线形成一个几乎不可触及的影子生物，简而言之就是一个魔法全息投影。

messages.msgid: Summons a floating disk that is sworn to carry your burdens.
translations: 召唤一个能够减轻你的负担的飘浮碟。

messages.msgid: You're not a cowboy, but on a steel horse you ride regardless.
translations: 你不是一个牛仔，但是你还是骑着铁骑。

messages.msgid: A bigger ride for bigger loot.  Or a second cowboy.
translations: 更大的座驾，为了更大的战利品，或为了另一位牛仔。

messages.msgid: You overcharge your internal batteries to send a semi-directed beam from your face.  The inventor of this spell must have had some weird sense of humor.
translations: 你将体内的生化电池过载，从你的脸上射出半定向的激光光束。这个法术的发明者一定有某种诡异的幽默感。

messages.msgid: You overcharge your bionic energy through what ley lines you have left, and channel it through the center of your face.
translations: 你将体内生化能量过载，通过你仅存的灵脉将其汇聚于面部中心并射出。

messages.msgid: You fire a cone of X-rays that magically allows you to see that area for a short time.
translations: 你发射出一道X光，并通过魔法来短暂地看清X光所及区域。

messages.msgid: You channel magic into a force capable of opening doors.  This variant can only open wooden doors.
translations: 你引导魔力，将其变成能够打开门的力量。这种法术只能打开木门。

messages.msgid: You channel magic into a force capable of opening doors.  This variant can open any locked door.
translations:
你引导魔力，将其变成能够打开门的力量。这种法术能打开任何锁住的门。
"阿拉霍洞开！"

messages.msgid: This spell generates a magnetic field around a knife, before launching it at high speed.
translations: 这个法术能在一把刀子周围产生磁场，并将其高速发射出去。

messages.msgid: This spell goes even further beyond, launching a knife so fast it can pierce through targets.
translations: 这个法术比之前更进一步，它所射出的飞刀速度快到能够直接穿透目标。

messages.msgid: Overload the target, stunning it briefly.  Originally developed during the Roman Empire to target out-of-control golems, this spell became significantly more popular in modern times when it was discovered it also worked on robots and machinery.
translations: 使目标超载，短暂眩晕。 该法术最初是在罗马帝国时期开发的，用于对付失控的傀儡，到了现代，人们发现该法术对机器人和机械也同样有效，因此变得更加流行。

messages.msgid: One of the most widely-known pre-modern technomantic spells, this allows technomancers to communicate at a distance.  Its use declined rapidly after Guglielmo Marconi invented the radio and suddenly everyone could listen in to their conversations.
translations: 这是最广为人知的前现代技术咒语之一，可以让技术人员进行远距离通信。 在古列尔莫-马可尼发明了收音机之后，它的使用迅速减少，因为突然之间，每个人都可以监听他们的谈话。

messages.msgid: For the technomancer with no enhancements, this spell summons a power supply composed of pure mana that can be used to charge any compatible device.  Just keep it on your person and it will continually recharge your electronic devices until the duration expires.
translations: 对于未安装任何增强模块的科技法师而言，此术能召唤一个由纯粹魔力构成的电源，为任何兼容设备充电。只需随身携带，它就会持续为你的电子设备充电，直至法术效果结束。

messages.msgid: Using the principles of what were once called "voltaic arcs", you can electrically heat metal hot enough to weld it together.
translations: 利用曾经被称为“伏特电弧”的原理，你可以将金属电热到足以将其焊接在一起。

messages.msgid: This fancifully-named spell actually restores power to a battery or power grid.  An esoteric curiosity until electrical power became widespread, even then the power efficiency of fossil fuels rendered it a niche spell.
This spell grants the caster an intuitive understanding of electronics and computers, making their use, repair, and construction much easier.
translations: 该咒语能增加施法者对电子产品和计算机的知识，使其使用、维修和制造更加轻松。

messages.msgid: Enchant an item so that it is capable of drawing power wirelessly through the air from a compatible power source.
translations: 为一件物品附魔，使其能够从兼容的电源处凭空进行无线取电。

messages.msgid: By etching tiny runes on a lens of great quality and infusing it with their magic, the caster can use the lens to see further than even the finest mundane binoculars.  Unfortunately, the arrangement is unstable and the lens will disintegrate after a time.
translations: 通过在优质镜片上蚀刻微小符文并注入魔力，施法者可凭此镜片望见比最精良的凡品望远镜更远的景象。不幸的是，这种结构并不稳定，镜片会在一段时间后崩解。

messages.msgid: This lens can see farther than ever!  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.
translations: 这枚镜片能看得比以往任何时候都远！如今你对此法术已了如指掌，并开始着手设计属于你自己的版本。

messages.msgid: With a word of power, you spur your body to function as a machine would, partially ignoring the effects of pain for a brief moment.
translations: 一声令咒，你催动自己的身体如机械般运作，在短暂的片刻间部分无视痛楚。

messages.msgid: Infuse water with ethanol from the air and your own mana to create some potion starter.  Sometimes it might overreact and overflow.
translations: 将空气中的乙醇和你自己的魔力注入水中，制造一些基础药剂。有时可能会反应过饱和，导致魔力溢出。

messages.msgid: Oversaturates potion starter with mana to create a deadly mana explosion.
translations: 使基础药剂的魔力过饱和，造成致命的魔能爆炸。

messages.msgid: Make a manafusion trap, stabilizing manafusion bombs and giving you some of the excess mana.
translations: 制造一个魔能聚变陷阱，稳定魔能聚变炸弹并返还多余魔力。

messages.msgid: Sends out a partly magical, partly electronic spy drone shaped like a wasp that reveals terrain in a line in front of you.  The wasp can travel through walls.
translations: 派出一只部分魔法、部分电子、外形像黄蜂的侦察无人机，揭示你正前方一条线上的地形。侦察蜂可以穿过墙壁。

messages.msgid: This is a magical device that can take the shape of many tools.  When not in use it looks like a simple screwdriver.
translations: 一个能够变形成各种工具的魔法装置。当它未被使用时，它看起来就像一把简单的螺丝刀。

messages.msgid: Artificers have a special pocket dimension with a magical tool that can cover a wide variety of tasks.  It is only a matter of temporarily summoning the item for use.
translations: 机关术师们能通向一个特殊的口袋维度，其中有把魔法工具，可以完成各种各样的工作。你可以暂时召唤出这个工具供你使用一段时间。

messages.msgid: You overclock your flesh and bionics, charging so fast the friction can ignite the air, to wind up for a skull-cracking punch.
translations: 你将自身肉体和生化插件超频，充能速度如此之快，以至于摩擦都能点燃四周的空气，给对方来一记碎骨拳。

messages.msgid: Heals a little bit of damage on the target.
translations: 治疗一点点目标所受的伤害。

messages.msgid: A more advanced version of Banishment, which is a ritual spell that attempts to banish a monster.  Being closely related to blood magic, the Blood Mage is much more specialized to use a spell like this.
translations: 放逐术的更高级版本，它是一种试图驱逐怪物的仪式法术。由于与血魔法联系紧密，所以血法师更擅长使用这样的法术。
伊克斯蒂赫"毁灭者"之魂

messages.msgid: You allow a demon to possess your body for a short time, giving you great combat abilities.  You still retain control, though lose your spellcasting abilities temporarily.
translations: 你让恶魔短时间占有你的身体，赋予你强大的战斗能力。你仍然保持控制，不过你会暂时失去施法能力。

messages.msgid: Grants the aura that gives the demon traits.  You're not supposed to see this.
A rippling wave of luminous energy spreads from your hands, a beautiful torrent of magnetic force and chill wind.
translations: 一道闪亮能量组成的涟漪自你手中荡漾开，化为磁力与寒风交织的壮丽洪流。

messages.msgid: Create a sturdy shell that wraps around your body, bestowing a sturdy defense.
translations: 创造一个坚固的外壳包裹住你的身体，为你提供坚实的防御。

messages.msgid: Speak a short phrase and transform your footsteps into burning pits of flame, leaving a trail of fire behind you.  Each step will consume mana, but you will be immune to fire while the spell is in effect.
translations: 吟诵短咒，将你的足迹化为灼灼火坑，在身后留下一道烈焰轨迹。每一步都会消耗魔力，但在法术生效期间，你将免疫火焰。

messages.msgid: A purifying blast of raw elemental heat wipes the slate clean, searing the Earth back to her most original state: a barren ball of burning rock.
translations: 原初元素热能掀起的净化大爆炸将地表抹得干干净净，将地球炙烤回她最开始的模样：灼热岩石堆积成的不毛之球。

messages.msgid:
In the sea without lees
Standeth the bird of Hermes
Eating his wings variable
And maketh himself yet full stable
translations:
在无背风处的海中
站立着赫耳墨斯之鸟
吃着自己多变的翅膀
使自己变得完全稳定（注：《黎普列卷轴》）

messages.msgid: A Crusader's magical shield, enhanced to protect the Crusader from all that stands in their way.
translations: 圣战法师召唤出的魔法盾，经过强化能够保护圣战法师不受任何阻挡。

messages.msgid: Crusaders have the ability to summon a magically enhanced shield to their arm to protect them in armed combat.
translations: 圣战法师能在他们的手臂上召唤出一个经过魔法强化的盾，在武装近战时保护他们。

messages.msgid: This blade of light will cut through any evil it makes contact with!  You can change its shape into a dagger, great sword, spear or mace.
translations: 这把光刃将切开它所接触到的任何邪恶！ 你可以将变形为匕首、巨剑、长矛或锤矛。

messages.msgid: A large sword made of glowing, radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.
translations: 一把由灼热照耀的火焰制成的大剑。在砍中敌人时会爆射出灿烂的光芒。

messages.msgid: Concentrating, you change your sword into a much smaller, quicker blade.
translations: 集中精神，你将你的剑换成一个更小，更快的锋刃。

messages.msgid: A short blade made of glowing, radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.
translations: 一把由灼热照耀的火焰制成的匕首。在刺中敌人时会爆射出灿烂的光芒。

messages.msgid: Concentrating, you change your dagger into a much larger, more intimidating form.
translations: 集中精神，你将匕首转变成一把巨大，更具压迫感的形态。

messages.msgid: A very large sword glowing with radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.
translations: 一把由灼热照耀的火焰制成的巨剑。在劈中敌人时会爆射出灿烂的光芒。

messages.msgid: Concentrating, you change your dagger into a longer, much more precise piercing form.
translations: 集中精神，你将匕首转变成一种更长，更精准的穿刺形态。

messages.msgid: A very thin, nimble spear glowing with radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.
translations: 一根非常细长，灵活的长矛，闪耀着绚烂的火焰。 它在戳刺敌人时，会爆发出璀璨的光芒。

messages.msgid: Concentrating, you change your spear into a shorter, more hefty form.
translations: 集中精神，你将长矛转变成一种更短更沉重的形态。

messages.msgid: A short and hefty mace glowing with radiant fire.  It explodes with radiance when striking enemies.
translations: 一把短而重的锤矛，闪耀着绚烂的火焰。在砸中敌人时会爆射出灿烂的光芒。

messages.msgid: Concentrating, you change your spear into a shorter, more robust blade.
translations: 集中精神，你将长矛转变为更短更坚固的剑刃。

messages.msgid: Cause a localized earthquake, knocking down enemies and overturning the earth.
translations: 造成局部地震并会击倒敌人。

messages.msgid: Fire three large rocks at an enemy, causing blunt damage and knocking it back.
translations: 向敌人发射三块巨石，造成钝器伤害并击退敌人。

messages.msgid: You channel heat through your hands to severely burn a target you touch.
translations: 你用双手引导魔法热能，严重烧伤你所接触的目标。
