messages.msgid: You conjure a whip made of solid flame.
translations: 你召唤出一根由固态魔法火焰制成的鞭子。

messages.msgid: You shoot a blade of concentrated force in a straight line, cutting everything in its path.
translations: 你直线射出一把力场凝聚而成的利刃，切割途经路径上的所有物品。

messages.msgid: A shield of pure force that protects you from most types of physical damage.
translations: 纯粹力场形成的护盾，能够保护你不受大部分物理伤害。

messages.msgid: Adds a shield of pure force that protects your body and your clothing from attacks.
translations: 你召唤出一个由纯粹力场凝聚而成的护盾，能够保护你自身和身上装备不受伤害。

messages.msgid: You tie your ley lines to the world's, renewing your flesh as if reborn.
translations: 你将自身灵脉与世界相连，焕活血肉，宛若新生。

messages.msgid: Create a cast of your own body and soul, hidden inside the earth's lines.  When the times come and your body is close to destruction, you can abandon it, transferring your consciousness into the cast.  But it brings with it a great price, and for your immortality, you pay with temporary bodily weakness.
translations: 以自身魂体为模，于地脉深处铸就一具拟身。当时机来临，你的肉身濒临毁灭之际，便可弃之而去，将意识迁入拟身之中。然此不朽之术，代价亦是沉重，你需以暂时的肉体衰弱作为交换。

messages.msgid: Cover yourself in dense, invisible energy of Earth.  Higher level increase your defense abilities.
translations: 将你包裹在源于大地的致密而不可见的能量之中。等级越高，防御力越强。

messages.msgid: Your body is covered in dense, ethereal shell, that protect you.
translations: 致密的无形外壳覆盖你的身躯，保护着你。

messages.msgid: Use the unstoppable force from a glacier to cause severe damage.
translations: 驭使源于冰川的万夫莫当之力造成严重的破坏。

messages.msgid: A gust of wind, colder than any Earthly mountaintop, spirals from your fingers, damaging and pushing anything in its path.
translations: 一阵比大地上任何山顶的都冷的风，从你指间盘旋而出，破坏、推动着途径的一切。

messages.msgid: Use a golem core as a focus to shape clay into a roughly humanoid shape and animate it for some time.
translations: 以一个傀儡核心作为核心，将黏土塑造成一个人形傀儡，并使其运作一段时间。

messages.msgid: You channel the strength of a golem to push an enemy backward.
translations: 你通过魔像的力量将敌人推开。

messages.msgid: Changes and amplifies gravitational pull towards a point you choose, even through walls.  Pulls in items and deals bashing damage in its center.
translations: 改变并增幅你所选定的一点所受的引力，甚至能穿透墙壁。此法术会吸入物品，并对其中心造成钝击伤害。

messages.msgid: Decrease your weight to a minimum, and use a mana flow to jump to your enemies from a long distance.
translations: 将你的体重降至最低，并驾驭一股魔力流从远处跃向敌人。

messages.msgid: When you make contact with an object, it's way easier to manipulate its gravity.  Control gravity around yourself to change your inertia in order to make quick but heavy attacks.
translations: 当你接触一个物体时，操控它的引力会变得轻而易举。掌控你周身的引力来改变自身惯性，从而发动迅捷而沉猛的攻击。

messages.msgid: Decreases mass of weapon on swing, increases the gravity on attack.
translations: 减少你武器挥舞时的重量，在攻击时增强重力。

messages.msgid: You cease your control over gravity.
translations: 你失去了对重力的控制。

messages.msgid: Your fingers stiffen as condensation freezes into claws, intensifying your naturally cold touch and protecting your hands from damage.
translations: 你的手指凝结出坚硬的冰爪，让你的徒手攻击造成寒冷伤害并保护你的双手。

messages.msgid: Harshly drop the temperature inside of your enemies, slowing down their bloodstreams or even shattering organs.
translations: 骤然降低敌人体内的温度，使其血液流动减缓，甚至震碎其脏器。

messages.msgid: Drawing upon the cold in your own blood and the power of your magic you form a large piece of never-thawing ice.
translations: 凭借自己血液中的冰寒和魔法的力量，你召唤出一大块永不融化的魔法坚冰。

messages.msgid: Shoot directed light from your fingertips that is so bright you can see through the skin of the target for an instant.
translations: 从你的指尖射出定向光，其亮度之高可以在一瞬间穿透目标的皮肤。

messages.msgid: Created to disrupt your enemies, they look exactly like you, and act like a real person.
translations: 扰乱你的敌人，它们看起来和你一模一样，并且像一个真人一样行动。

messages.msgid: Fool reality, and swap your position with any other creature in your line of sight
translations: 愚弄现实，和你视线内的任何其他生物交换你的位置

messages.msgid: Magnetize a bullet, and fire it at supersonic speeds by applying an opposite magnetic force to the bullet.  Leaves a trail of sparks
translations: 将子弹磁化后通过一个反向磁场将子弹以超声速发射，并留下一道闪光的尾迹。

messages.msgid: Creates a conductive channel from the caster's hand to the target by ionizing air molecules using a high-powered laser beam, then sends a powerful half million volt charge down the channel.
translations: 通过使用高功率激光束电离空气分子，创建出一条从施法者手到目标的导电通道，然后沿着通道释放出50万伏的强大电荷。

messages.msgid: Send a wave of high-frequency alternating pulses.  It can't hurt living creatures, but is exceptional at stunning and destroying robots.  Even though it isn't an EMP.
translations: 发出一道高频交变脉冲波。它无法伤害生物，但在眩晕和摧毁机器人方面效果卓越，尽管它并非电磁脉冲。

messages.msgid: This drastically increases the target's metabolism to dangerous levels, causing their body to tear itself apart.
translations: 此法术会使目标的新陈代谢急剧提升至危险水平，导致其身体自内崩解。

messages.msgid: The power of mana flows into you, heightening your speed to supernatural levels in a self-destructive way.  You are a blur amongst your enemies, felling them with blows too swift to see.
translations: 魔法能量流入你体内，以自我毁灭的方式将你的速度提升到超自然的水平。你在敌人眼中是一个模糊不清的人影，用看不见的速度击倒他们。

messages.msgid: Using your mana, you began to accelerate ice particles inside a cold mist, eroding everything inside.
translations: 使用你的魔力，你开始加速冰雾中的冰粒子，侵蚀被它包裹的一切物体。

messages.msgid: Small particles of ice orbit around your body, as a beacon for a giant field of frozen energy.
translations: 寒冰的小颗粒围绕着你的身体旋转，就像一个巨大的冰冻能量场的灯塔。

messages.msgid: Cool down every creature in range 'till their flesh cracks, bones shatter, and armor fractures.
translations: 冻结范围内的所有生物，直至它们血肉开裂、骨骼碎裂、甲胄碎断。

messages.msgid: Cook nearby monsters (and yourself to an extent).
translations: 烤熟附近的怪物（还包括你自己）。

messages.msgid: Cause cell damage to everything in a wide area.  Fast to cast, but does damage slowly.
translations: 在大范围内造成细胞损伤，施放速度快，但见效慢。

messages.msgid: Summon a pack of butterflies with razor-sharp wings, to cut every creature in your way.
translations: 召唤出一群长着锋利翅膀的蝴蝶，能把挡路的每个生物都切得粉碎。

messages.msgid: Summons a keeper of the glades, a powerful ancient forest spirit, to defend you.  The keeper may be ridden and will unleash its fury on unnatural enemies, but is much less powerful in the cities than in the forest.
translations: 召唤一位林间守护者，一个强大的远古森林之灵，来为你而战。守护者可以骑乘，它会对非自然的敌人宣泄怒火，但在城市中远不如在森林里强大。

messages.msgid: Release a spray of mana-saturated bioactive solvent.  Your ley lines give you a resistance to this acid due to your mana signature, but others beware!
translations: 喷射出一股魔力饱和的生物活性溶剂。因为你的魔力特征，你体内的灵脉能让你抵御这种酸蚀，但旁人可得当心！

messages.msgid: Who said the human body is weak?  You just need to compress enough mana into your flesh and bones in order to show them who is the deadliest animal in the world.
translations: 谁说人之肉身羸弱不堪？你只需将足够的魔力压缩到血肉筋骨之中，便能让他们瞧瞧，谁才是这世上最致命的猛兽。

messages.msgid: A candle burns the most brightly at both ends, and yet it burns twice as fast.
translations: 一根蜡烛在两头烧时最明亮，但燃烧速度却是原来的两倍。

messages.msgid: You burn a small portion of your soul to gain a large burst of speed.  You will have to wait until your soul has healed before burning a part of it again.
translations: 你燃烧一小部分灵魂，以换取速度的巨大爆发。在你的灵魂痊愈之前，你将无法再次燃烧它。

messages.msgid: A little of your soul has been burned away, leaving you in a weakened state.  The soul heals quickly, but your body regenerates more slowly while the soul is weak.
translations: 你的灵魂有一点被烧毁，让你处于虚弱的状态。灵魂愈合得很快，但当灵魂虚弱时，你的身体再生得更慢。

messages.msgid: You touch an unwilling subject and lightning dances from you to multiple nearby enemies.
translations: 除了目标遭到重创外，闪电还会跳到附近的多个敌人身上。

messages.msgid: Fill your hands with high-voltage electricity, and deal additional electric damage in melee.
translations: 让你的双手充满高压电，并在近战中造成额外的电击伤害。

messages.msgid: You deal additional electric damage in melee.
translations: 让你在近战中造成额外的电击伤害。

messages.msgid: Electric energy is concentrated in your hands, and it's ready to go.
translations: 电流聚集在你的手中，蓄势待发。

messages.msgid: Your hands turn back to normal condition.
translations: 你的手回到了正常状态。

messages.msgid: Summon a small electric imp - fast as lightning, and just as deadly.
translations: 召唤一个闪电小恶魔——快如闪电，也同样致命。

messages.msgid: Summon immovable pillars, that will attack your enemies with devastating lightning bolts.
translations: 召唤出一道不可移动的柱子，用毁灭性的闪电攻击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Fire a blast of sunlight in a wide beam, blinding everything in its path and leaving it bright enough for you to see for a few seconds.
translations: 发射一束阳光，使其路径上的所有生物都失明，并在几秒钟内保持明亮状态。

messages.msgid: You create a stable portal in the fabric of reality to the sun, through which you can draw on its light and temperature.
translations: 你在客观现实的构架上创造出一个通往太阳的稳定传送门，通过它你可以利用太阳的光照和温度。

messages.msgid: With a snap of your fingers, the target takes cold damage and freezes in place.
translations: 只需一个响指，目标就会被冻结在原地并受到寒冷伤害。

messages.msgid: Summon your personal pack of winter wolves to freeze and maul your foes.
translations: 召唤你直属的冬狼群来冻结并撕碎你的敌人。

messages.msgid: In the end, everything succumbs to the grasp of nothingness and stasis.  This spell gives the target a foretaste of that.
translations: 万物终将归于虚无与停滞，此术能令目标预尝其味。

messages.msgid: Creates a chaotic energy field that disrupts enemies inside it.  It is rather random, and its effects can range from almost nothing to killing all hostiles in the area.
translations: 召唤一处充满混沌魔法的力场，扰乱其中的敌人。效果相当随机，法术影响可能从几乎没有到杀死该地区内的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: You tear up the ground beneath you to fire a lava bomb: a globe of lava surrounded by hot, solid rock.  It shatters upon impact, spraying shards of rock and lava everywhere.
translations: 你撕裂脚下的地面，发射出一个熔岩炸弹：一个被炽热的固体岩石包围的熔岩球。它撞击物体时会粉碎，朝四周射出大量碎岩石和熔岩。

messages.msgid: Pulls up the heat of the Earth, along with considerable smoke mixed with ashes.
translations: 引发地球内部蕴含的火焰，还有大量的烟雾和灰烬。

messages.msgid: You strike a poisonous blow and disappear in a puff of toxic smoke.
translations: 你猛烈一击，然后消失在一股有毒的烟雾中。

messages.msgid: This spell takes some of a target's life; part of it comes to you in a less-potent form.
translations: 这个法术会夺去目标的一部分生命；其中一部分以一种不那么有效的形式输送给你。

messages.msgid: Thanks to that apple, your wounds are slowly healing.
translations: 多亏了那个苹果，你的伤口正在慢慢愈合。

messages.msgid: Your flesh and bones start to knit together before your eyes.
translations: 你的肉体和骨骼开始在你的眼前交织在一起。
你身体的再生速度慢了下来。

messages.msgid: No illness is going to get you down now.
translations: 现在，任何疾病都不会让你倒下。

messages.msgid: Thanks to that pear, you can attack faster.
translations: 多亏了那只梨，你可以更快地攻击。

messages.msgid: Your muscle's twitch as the pear's magic fades.
translations: 梨子的魔力逐渐消退，你的肌肉也随之抽搐起来。

messages.msgid: Anyone who attacks you will regret it.
translations: 任何攻击你的人都会后悔的。

messages.msgid: Long thorns grow through your skin, clothes, and armor.
translations: 长长的荆棘穿过你的皮肤、衣服和盔甲。

messages.msgid: The thorns vanish without a trace, leaving your gear unharmed.
translations: 荆棘消失得无影无踪，你的装备却毫发无损。

messages.msgid: The magic of those strawberries is keeping you warm.
translations: 草莓的魔力让你感到温暖。
你会感觉到一种令人愉悦的温暖。

messages.msgid: You shiver as a cool breeze hits your skin.
translations: 一阵凉风拂过，你不禁打了个寒颤。

messages.msgid: Your body will not be corrupted by these vile substances.
translations: 你的身体不会被这些邪恶的物质腐蚀。

messages.msgid: Your range of motion is greatly increased.
translations: 你的活动范围大大增加了。

messages.msgid: You arms are as bendy as rubber.
translations: 你的胳膊像橡胶一样有弹性。

messages.msgid: Your limbs creak as they lose their flexibility.
translations: 你的四肢因失去灵活性而吱吱作响。

messages.msgid: You can see in the dark.
The night doesn't seem so dark anymore.
translations: 夜晚对你不再是一片黑暗。

messages.msgid: The darkness of the night rushes in again.
Your blood is all being held within your body.
translations: 你的血液都被保存在体内。

messages.msgid: You feel a prickle as your wounds ache.
translations: 你的伤口疼痛难忍，感到一阵阵刺痛。

messages.msgid: The magic of those apricots is helping you see better.
translations: 这些杏子的魔力能帮你看得更清楚。

messages.msgid: You can pick out even minute details.
translations: 即使是微小的细节，你也能挑出端倪。

messages.msgid: Distant objects loose their magical clarity.
translations: 远处的物体失去了神奇的清晰度。

messages.msgid: You can eat toxic or spoiled food without penalty.  You still should not eat zombie meat.
translations: 你可以食用有毒或变质的食物而不会受到惩罚。 但还是不能吃丧尸肉。

messages.msgid: Something in your mouth tastes foul.
translations: 你嘴里的东西味道很臭。

messages.msgid: You are being rapidly sobered up.
Your head pounds, but you feel much more alert.
translations: 你的头 "砰砰 "直跳，但却感觉精神了许多。

messages.msgid: You are exhausted from channeling a lot of mana.
translations: 你因为引导了大量魔力而精疲力竭。

messages.msgid: Channeling so much mana is making you tired
translations: 引导大量魔力让你感到疲倦。

messages.msgid: The burden of mana fatigue has faded
translations: 魔力疲乏带来的负荷已消逝不见。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of black dragon mutagen.
translations: 你服用了大量黑龙诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of black dragon mutagen.
translations: 你服用了能改变生命的黑龙诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of concentrated mana.
translations: 你服用了大量魔力诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of concentrated mana.
translations: 你服用了能改变生命的魔力诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You are in contact with iron.  It will cause you pain and discomfort until removed.
translations: 你正接触着铁器，在将其移开前，它会持续给你带来痛苦与不适。

messages.msgid: As the iron touches you, your skin begins to burn.
translations: 铁器触及之处，你的皮肤传来一阵灼痛。

messages.msgid: The burning from the iron finally fades.
translations: 铁器带来的灼痛感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: You are in contact with steel.  It will cause you pain and discomfort until removed.
translations: 你正接触着钢材，在将其移开前，它会持续给你带来痛苦与不适。

messages.msgid: As the steel touches you, your skin begins to itch.
translations: 钢材触及之处，你的皮肤传来一阵瘙痒。

messages.msgid: The itching from the steel finally fades.
translations: 钢材带来的瘙痒感终于消退了。

messages.msgid: You are bolstered and pushed along by the power of the wind.
translations: 你被风的力量所支撑和推动。

messages.msgid: You are bolstered and pushed along by the power of the wind
translations: 你被风的力量所支撑和推动。

messages.msgid: The wind at your back dies down.
Your sight adjusts to the darkness.
translations: 你的视力开始适应黑暗。

messages.msgid: Ghostly arms are trying to hold you in place!
translations: 幽灵般的手臂正试图把你抱在原地！

messages.msgid: Ethereal arms shoot out of the ground and grab onto you!
translations: 虚幻的手臂从地上射出，将你抓住！

messages.msgid: You can see your hands again.
translations: 你可以再次看到你的手了。

messages.msgid: You are filled with energy that improves everything you do.
translations: 你充满了能量，它能改善你所做的每一件事。

messages.msgid: You are filled with energy that improves everything you do!
translations: 你充满了能量，这会改善你所做的每一件事！

messages.msgid: Your body ripples with writhing alien muscles, your limbs lengthen, and your eyes glow with a faint green.
translations: 你的身体随着翻卷的异形肌肉波荡，四肢被拉伸，眼中闪烁着幽幽的绿芒。

messages.msgid: Your body rapidly returns to normal.
translations: 你的身体很快恢复正常。

messages.msgid: Roots and vines entangle your foes.
translations: 树根和藤蔓缠绕着你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Roots and vines burst from the ground and entangle you!
translations: 根须和藤蔓破土而出，缠住了你！

messages.msgid: The roots and vines wither up and die.
Roots rip out from the ground and impale your enemies!
translations: 从地上拔出根来刺穿你的敌人！

messages.msgid: The roots wither up and die.
Light is distorting around you and making it easier for you to avoid attacks.
translations: 光线在你周围扭曲，让你更容易躲避攻击。

messages.msgid: The edges of your vision ripple slightly.
translations: 你视线边缘的景象微微颤动。

messages.msgid: The aura of light distortion around you vanishes.
Clouds of dust around you are hiding you from your enemies.
translations: 你周围的尘埃云使你躲避敌人。

messages.msgid: Dust springs up and hides your presence.
translations: 烟尘升起，遮住了你的身形。

messages.msgid: The clouds of dust around you die down
translations: 你身边的团团烟尘消散了。

messages.msgid: You are protected from acid damage.
You are greatly protected from acid damage.
translations: 你可以得到极大的保护，免受酸的损害。

messages.msgid: Anyone who attacks you will be electrified.
translations: 任何攻击你的人都会被触电。

messages.msgid: The air around you sparks with electricity.
translations: 你周围的空气充满电流。

messages.msgid: The air around you loses its charge.
translations: 你周围的空气不再躁动。

messages.msgid: Your speed is boosted to superhuman levels!
translations: 你的速度被提升到超人的水平！

messages.msgid: You return to your normal speed.
translations: 你速度的回到正常水平。
你的速度受到了魔法的抑制。

messages.msgid: Everyone else suddenly seems to speed up!
translations: 其他人似乎都突然加速了！
你的思维变得更加敏捷了。

messages.msgid: Your mind returns to normal speed.
translations: 你的思维恢复到了正常状态。

messages.msgid: You have the strength of an Ogre!

translations: 你觉得自己被人盯上了！

messages.msgid: You no longer feel like somebody's watching you.
translations: 你不再觉得有人在盯着你了。

messages.msgid: You have the perception of an Eagle!
You have the dexterity of a cat!
You have the cunning of a Fox!
You can not be harmed by anything.
translations: 没有东西能够伤害到你。

messages.msgid: Your skin tingle with the power of the Devs!
translations: 开发者之力刺痛着你的皮肤！

messages.msgid: Your skin stops tingling, your life is empty and meaningless again.
translations: 你的皮肤不再刺痛，你的生活再次变得空虚又毫无意义。

messages.msgid: You are light as a feather and fall like one.
translations: 你像羽毛一样轻盈地掉落。

messages.msgid: Your body feels light as a feather.
The earth pulls you down hard.
translations: 你被引力狠狠拉向了地面。

messages.msgid: Your knees are shaking, your heart beats fast, and your stomach rebels.
translations: 你的膝盖颤抖，你的心跳加快，你的胃中一阵作呕。
你的血肉正在腐烂脱落！

messages.msgid: You feel sickened from overtaxing your body, having extended your influence over such a wide area.
translations: 你因为将自身脏腑过度膨胀以将其覆盖这么大一片范围而感到恶心难受。

messages.msgid: An aura of thin acid, swirling around your body ready to corrode your enemies when struck or while striking.
translations: 一层稀薄的酸蚀光环在你周身盘旋，随时准备在你攻击或被攻击时腐蚀敌人。

messages.msgid: Immunity to bleeding and bites, increased stamina regeneration, increased hunger and thirst gain.
translations: 对流血和咬伤免疫，增加耐力重生速度，饥渴增长速度。

messages.msgid: The tension running through your flesh fades.
translations: 你感到血肉中的紧绷感消退了。

messages.msgid: You feel sluggish and weak, from magically-induced poisoning.
translations: 你感觉到由于生化魔法导致的迟钝及虚弱。

messages.msgid: Thorns are whirling around you, regularly causing cuts into you.
translations: 荆棘在你周围旋转，导致你经常被割伤。

messages.msgid: Thorns in the wind begin slicing into you!
translations: 风中的荆棘刺痛着你的身体！

messages.msgid: The thorns fall to the ground.
Your mind is working incredibly fast and your body struggles to keep up.
translations: 你的大脑运转得异常快，而你的身体却在努力跟上。
闻起来有种到家的感觉。

messages.msgid: You are made of stone.  Fortunately it's temporary.
translations: 你化作了岩石，好在这只是暂时的。

messages.msgid: The cold slows down your foes.
You can feel Mother Nature welcoming you, revitalizing your body and calming the natural fauna around you.
translations: 你能感受到自然之母正欢迎着你的到来，你的身体恢复活力，四周的野生动物也平静下来。

messages.msgid: A warm embrace surrounds you, like that of a mother with her child.
translations: 一股温暖的怀抱围绕着你，如同母亲抱着她的孩子一般。

messages.msgid: Your communion with Mother Nature fades.
translations: 你同自然之母的联结逐渐消散。

messages.msgid: Full of chilled blood, the heart slows as it grows cold.
translations: 充满了冰冷的血液，心跳随着变冷而变慢。

messages.msgid: You feel yourself getting slower, as ice seems to run through your veins.
translations: 你感觉自己的速度越来越慢，因为似乎有寒冰流入你的血管。

messages.msgid: You feel yourself recovering your normal speed.
translations: 你感觉自己恢复了正常的速度。

messages.msgid: Is it possible to dart aside and avoid a cannon ball?  Is it possible to grab an arrow in flight with one hand?
translations: 真有可能闪身躲开炮弹吗？真有可能单手抓住飞箭吗？

messages.msgid: You feel yourself move faster than a bullet.
translations: 你觉得自己比子弹还快。

messages.msgid: You feel yourself returning to your normal speed.
translations: 你感觉自己回到了正常速度。

messages.msgid: Your body returns to its normal state.
translations: 你的身体回归一般状态。

messages.msgid: Ice crystals erode your body from all directions.
translations: 冰晶从各个方向侵蚀你的身体。

messages.msgid: Your body is heavy as the heaviest rocks.  Your attack speed is slowed down, but your melee damage increased drastically.
translations: 你的身体像最重的岩石一样沉。你的攻击速度减慢，但近战伤害大幅提升。

messages.msgid: You feel your body compress and harden.
translations: 你感觉你的身体像被压缩并且变硬。

messages.msgid: You have an intuitive understanding of computers.
translations: 你对计算机多了些直观的理解。

messages.msgid: Your mind no longer easily grasps the flow of electrons.
translations: 你对于机器的思考力消失了。

messages.msgid: Your body functions through pain with mechanical efficiency.
translations: 尽管有些痛苦，你的身体动作仍如机器一般高效。

messages.msgid: Thin layer of almost living crystals, that rapidly grows and moves on the body.
translations: 如同有生命般的薄层晶体，在身上迅速生长和移动。

messages.msgid: You feel a light, purple material cover your body and clothes.
translations: 你感觉到一种轻薄的紫色物质覆盖了你的身体和衣物。

messages.msgid: Enhance your sight with your powers.  It allows you to see creatures of the same energy around you, and some minor bonuses.
translations: 用你的能量增强你的视力。它可以让你看到周围有同样能量的生物，还有一些别的效果。

messages.msgid: Your sight turn back to usual state.
translations: 你的视野恢复到了正常状态。

messages.msgid: Your body will release a massive electric charges when you attack monsters.
translations: 你的身体在攻击怪物时释放出无数电荷。

messages.msgid: A powerful energy streams out of your hands.
translations: 一股强大的能量从你的手中释放出来。

messages.msgid: Make you less vulnerable to electric damage.
translations: 使你受到的电击伤害减少。

messages.msgid: You feel a small sparks under your skin.  They do not harm you.
translations: 你感觉到皮肤下有点小火花。它们并没有伤害到你。
你皮肤下的火花消失了。

messages.msgid: You are frozen, your bones are fragile; cracking in the cold, and your muscles are cut by razor sharp ice.
translations: 你被冻住了，你的骨头变得很脆弱，它们因寒冷而破碎，你的肌肉被锋利的冰割伤。

messages.msgid: Your feel yourself a bit better.
You feel yourself a bit lighter.  You doubt you can lose weight from this.
translations: 你觉得自己更轻盈了。但你不觉得自己的体重会因此下降。

messages.msgid: Make you faster, and allow to hold this state for a while.
translations: 让你在一段时间内速度更快。

messages.msgid: You feel your legs can work much better than before
translations: 你感觉腿脚比以前更好使了。

messages.msgid: Improve your organism's ability to heal himself.
translations: 增强你有机身体的自愈能力。

messages.msgid: You feel an energy in your muscles, jazzed up and full of vitality.
translations: 你会感觉到肌肉充满能量，充满活力。

messages.msgid: The energy in your body fades away.
translations: 你身体里的能量消失了。

messages.msgid: Your reaction now is way better than before.
translations: 你的反应能力显著提升了。

messages.msgid: You can feel the fly wings movement now.
Your reflexes turn back to normal.
A thin layer of energy covers your body, and allows you to take more physical damage than before.
translations: 薄薄的能量层覆盖着你的身体，让你能承受比以前更多的物理伤害。

messages.msgid: Your touch sense are blunted for a bit, but your skin feels more dense.
translations: 你的触觉有一点迟钝，但你的皮肤感觉更致密了。

messages.msgid: Your body emit a lot of light around.
translations: 你的身体向周围散发出大量光芒。

messages.msgid: Your skin glow like an old lantern.  You feel no discomfort for some reason.
translations: 你的皮肤像旧灯笼一样在发光。不过出于某种原因，你没有感到不适。

messages.msgid: Your skin turn back to normal state.
translations: 你的皮肤恢复到了正常状态。

messages.msgid: Increase the amount of ley-lines your body can process at once, making you restore your mana pool faster.
translations: 提升你身体能同时处理的灵脉上限，从而加速魔力池的恢复。

messages.msgid: You can feel the thinnest ley lines around you.
translations: 你能感受到身边最纤细的灵脉。
对魔力的感应又变得迟钝了。

messages.msgid: Increase the amount of mana you can operate.
translations: 增加你可以操控的魔力量。

messages.msgid: You feel a deep mana well inside your body.
translations: 你感觉到身体里存储的魔力进入了一口深井。
你无法再感受到那口深井了。
缓慢地使你受损的身体再生。

messages.msgid: Your flesh and bones start to regenerate before your eyes.
translations: 你的骨肉开始以可见的速度再生。
你的科技法师咒语得到了增强。
你的科技法师的提升会逐渐消失。
你的生化术士咒语得到了增强。
你的生化术士的提升会逐渐消失。

messages.msgid: You feel little hunger or thirst.
translations: 你几乎感觉不到饥饿或口渴。

messages.msgid: Your stomach suddenly rumbles as you feel a pang of hunger.
translations: 你的肚子突然咕咕叫了起来，感到一阵饥饿。

messages.msgid: You can feel them moving around you.
translations: 你可以感觉到他们在你周围移动。

messages.msgid: You can no longer discern the vibrations of the living earth.
translations: 你再也无法辨别生命土地的振动。

messages.msgid: You can sense the presence of things that should not be.
translations: 你可以感觉到不应该存在的东西的存在。
你对界外的感知逐渐减弱。
你能感知到附近的施法者。

messages.msgid: Your awareness of the magically-inclined fades.
translations: 你对施法者的感知力正在消退。

messages.msgid: You see the ley lines of a wielder of magic.
translations: 你看见了魔法操纵者身上的灵脉。

messages.msgid: A protective spirit is looking out for you.
With a soft whisper, the guardian spirit returns from whence it came.
translations: 伴随一声低语，你的守护灵离开了你。

messages.msgid: Your soul gives voice to your magical prowess.
translations: 你的灵魂彰显着你的魔法天赋。

messages.msgid: Your soul no longer speaks directly.
Your skin feels like you just splashed cool water on it.
translations: 你的皮肤好像刚被泼了凉水。

messages.msgid: A warm breeze hits your skin.
translations: 一阵暖风吹拂你的皮肤。

messages.msgid: The air around you is warmer thanks to your magic.
translations: 由于你的魔法，你周围的空气变得温暖。

messages.msgid: A cool breeze hits your skin.
translations: 一阵冷风吹拂你的皮肤。

messages.msgid: The air around you is cooler thanks to your magic.
translations: 由于你的魔法，你周围的空气变得凉爽。

messages.msgid: You burn with the intensity of your conviction.
translations: 你的信念之火正在熊熊燃烧。

messages.msgid: The world seems dreary as your spell fades.
translations: 世界在你的法术消散后显得沉闷不堪。

messages.msgid: You won't hit the ground nearly as hard anymore.
translations: 你几乎不会再那么用力地撞击地面了。

messages.msgid: You can feel gravity take hold of you again.
translations: 你感到大地又一次承载了你。

messages.msgid: You can quickly ascend sheer surfaces.
translations: 你可以快速攀登陡峭的表面。
你增强的攀爬能力恢复如常。

messages.msgid: Your ranged weapons travel much further than physics claims they should.
translations: 你的远程武器射程远超常理。

messages.msgid: Your weapons return to their normal range.
translations: 你的武器射程恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: Your hands and feet have grown webbing, enabling faster swimming.
translations: 你的手和脚长出了蹼，可以更快地游泳。

messages.msgid: With an unpleasant twisting sensation your hands and feet return to normal.
translations: 带着不悦的扭曲感，你的手脚恢复正常。

messages.msgid: Two tentacles sprout from your shoulders, ready to attack your enemies.
translations: 两条触手从你的肩上猛然长出，随时准备攻击敌人。

messages.msgid: Your shoulders itch before two barbed tentacles erupt from them!
translations: 你的肩膀发痒，然后两根带刺的触手从肩膀上冒出来

messages.msgid: The tentacles recede back into your body.
You have transformed your blood into acid.
translations: 你的血液转化为了强酸。

messages.msgid: Your entire body burns for a moment.
translations: 你的整个身体猛地灼烧了一下。

messages.msgid: You are defended against the possible effects of XE037 overexposure.
translations: 您正在抵抗 XE037 过度曝光可能造成的影响。

messages.msgid: You are still defended against the effects of XE037 overexposure but now you feel awful!
translations: 您仍在抵抗 XE037 过度曝光的后遗症，但现在您感觉很糟糕！

messages.msgid: The strange feeling passes and you feel more like yourself.
translations: 奇怪的感觉消失，你觉得自己又一次变得像自己了。

messages.msgid: You are able to exert conscious control over any mutations to your body.
translations: 你能够有意识地控制自己身体的任何变异。

messages.msgid: You can eat rotten food without any trouble, if you can stand the taste.
translations: 如果你能忍受腐烂的味道，你可以毫不费力地吃腐烂的食物。

messages.msgid: Your have a hunger for some overly-aged meat.
You can't believe you even considered eating that!  Yuck!
translations: 你简直不能相信自己居然想过要吃那种东西！哕！

messages.msgid: Know the Day and the Hour
You know exactly what time it is.
translations: 你清楚地知道现在是什么时间。

messages.msgid: Your perfect sense of time fades away.
translations: 你精确的时间感知消失了。
你身后拖曳着一道火焰轨迹。

messages.msgid: The flames you leave behind die down.
translations: 你身后留下的火焰渐渐熄灭了。

messages.msgid: The fog shields you from sight.

translations: 难以控制的狂风在你周围肆虐。

messages.msgid: The wind around you dies down.
Every word you speak resounds like a crash of thunder.
translations: 你所说的每个字都振聋发聩，犹如雷鸣。
你的回复速度快得不可思议。

messages.msgid: Your rapid regeneration slows and stops.
translations: 你的快速回复能力消失了。

messages.msgid: You bleed much less than normal.
translations: 你流血的速度大大减慢了。

messages.msgid: You do not bleed.  At all.
You feel like you could eat a horse.
translations: 你觉得自己饿的能吃下一头牛。

messages.msgid: Your flesh is twisting itself apart!
translations: 你的肉体正在扭曲自己！

messages.msgid: Your flesh writhes where you were hit!
You are immune to heat and fire.
You have shed your physical form.
Your mageshield fades as the attack impacts it.
translations: 你的法师护盾在挡下攻击后应声消散。
你的脚步再次发出了声响。

messages.msgid: Nature no longer speeds your movements.
translations: 自然不再为你提供增速了。

messages.msgid: You can walk on the surface of the water
translations: 你可以在水面上行走了。

messages.msgid: You can no longer walk on the water.
translations: 你无法再于水上行走了。
你的攻击快得不可思议。
你的攻击速度大幅提升。

messages.msgid: Your quick strikes slow to normal speed.
translations: 你的迅捷攻击恢复了正常速度。

messages.msgid: The air around you shimmers in a multitude of colors.
translations: 你周遭的空气闪烁着斑斓的色彩。

messages.msgid: Enchantments are being stripped away from you.
translations: 你身上的魔力正在被剥夺。

messages.msgid: You feel a sudden sense of loss.
All enchantments are being stripped away from you.
translations: 你身上所有的魔力都被剥夺了。

messages.msgid: You feel a sudden acute sense of loss.
translations: 你会突然感到一阵强烈的失落感。

messages.msgid: It's harder for you to draw on your mana than it should be.
translations: 你汲取魔力的过程变得异常困难。

messages.msgid: Your body was split before, which makes you really fragile, but allow you to accept more mana than before.
translations: 之前你的身体被分裂了，这让你确实很脆弱，但却让你比以前接受了更多的魔力。

messages.msgid: Your body turns back to normal state.
translations: 你的身体恢复正常状态。

messages.msgid: Decrease any damage taken in the next 1 second.
translations: 减少接下来 1 秒内受到的任何伤害。

messages.msgid: You feel your mana connected to the Sun, and it makes you better than ever.
translations: 你感觉你的魔力与太阳相连，这使你感觉前所未有的好。

messages.msgid: You don't feel Solar energy in your body anymore.
translations: 你觉得太阳的能量和你的身体失去了链接。

messages.msgid: Consume their nature for your own purposes.
translations: 你强迫它们消耗自己的本性。

messages.msgid: Your speed is boosted enormously thanks to drinking those flames.
translations: 吞噬火焰之后，你的速度得到了极大的提升。
你的血管如同在烈火中燃烧。

messages.msgid: A spirit warns you that attacks are coming.
translations: 一个灵体警告你，攻击即将来临。

messages.msgid: You can talk with your soul.
translations: 你可以与你的灵魂对话。

messages.msgid: You are uneasy and fearful from a Dragon's mighty presence
translations: 你对巨龙的强大存在感到不安和恐惧。

messages.msgid: You are filled with the power of Dragons.
translations: 你的体内充满了巨龙的力量。

messages.msgid: You let out a mighty roar as you are filled with the power of Dragons!
translations: 伴随着一声刺耳的咆哮，你的体内充满了巨龙的力量！

messages.msgid: The Draconic energy fades from within you.
translations: 巨龙的力量从你体内消失了。

messages.msgid: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back, all seemingly grown out of a single solid piece of wood.  Despite the twisted lines, it still looks extremely comfortable.
translations: 这是一把简单的木椅，有四条腿、一个座位和一个靠背，看起来都是由一块实心木头生长出来的。尽管线条扭曲，但它坐起来仍然非常舒适。

messages.msgid: A shelter woven from wildwood weaver's webs.  It can be used to rest, and the weaver provides assistance in any tailoring task.
translations: 由灵木织者的丝网织就的庇护所，可供休憩，织者还能为任何缝纫活计助一臂之力。

messages.msgid: This strangely shaped rock was once a part of an owlbear's complex digestive system, creating a link between owl throat and bear stomach.  It is possible that it could serve a similar purpose in alchemy, helping to bind together two disparate halves.
translations: 这个形状奇特的岩石曾经是枭熊复杂的消化系统的一部分，在枭熊的喉咙和胃之间形成了一种联系。它有可能在炼金术中起到类似的作用，帮助将两个完全不同的部分结合在一起。

messages.msgid: The broken fragment of an owlbear egg.  With luck it might still contain some of its former power, though if nothing else it's still a bit sharp.
translations: 枭熊蛋的碎片。幸运的是，它可能仍然包含一些以前的力量，即便没有，它也仍旧锋利。

messages.msgid: This bracelet has runes engraved on it.  You sense a faint air of mysticism when you look at it.  It would be useful for imbuing mana into material.
translations: 这个手镯上刻着符文。当你看着它的时候，你会感觉到一种神秘的微弱气息。它将有助于将魔力灌注到物质中。

messages.msgid: A wooden band with copper trimmings to be worn on the head.  Touching your temples with it on makes you feel very calm.
translations: 镶有铜边的木质头环。在戴上它时按摩太阳穴会使你感到非常平静。

messages.msgid: A wooden band with silver trimmings to be worn on the head.  Touching your temples with it on makes you feel very calm.
translations: 戴在头上的银饰木带。戴着它触摸你的太阳穴会让你感到非常平静。

messages.msgid: Strong alcohol, infused with mana and concentrated into a liquid that can stabilize spells into liquid form.  You can still drink it, if you want.
translations: 烈性酒精之中注入了魔力并浓缩成液体，能够用来使法术稳定为液体形式。如果你愿意的话，你可以直接喝它。

messages.msgid: Pure ethanol saturated with magical energy.  The sheer power concentrated within causes the surface of the potion to ripple continuously.
translations: 充满魔法能量的纯净乙醇。聚集在其中的魔力使药剂表面不断地波动起伏。

messages.msgid: An organ located above the kidneys responsible for secretion of adrenaline, cortisol, and aldosterone.  This one is huge, whether by nature or mutation.
translations: 位于肾脏上方的负责分泌肾上腺素、皮质醇和醛固酮的器官。这块肾上腺非常巨大，不知道是自然存在的还是突变产生的。

messages.msgid: The powdered remains of a will-o-wisps's physical form.  It seems to still possess an otherworldly glow.
translations: 一缕鬼火遗留下来的物理形态粉末，它似乎还在散发着神奇的光芒。

messages.msgid: Powered by the magic of glow powder and lesser mana potions, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.
translations: 这款极其昂贵的小灯由发光粉末和魔法药水提供动力，其亮度仅够阅读，但是至少可以持续发光十年。关闭盖子可以隐藏光线。

messages.msgid: Powered by the magic of glow powder and lesser mana potions, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.
translations: 这款极其昂贵的小灯由发光粉末和魔法药水提供动力，其亮度仅够阅读，但是至少可以持续发光十年。已经被盖子盖上了，打开盖子可以散发光芒。

messages.msgid: The great plates from behind a bulette's head have always been prized for use in shield and armor making.
translations: 鲨蜥兽头后面的巨大骨板，一直以来都是用来制造护甲和盾牌的珍贵材料。

messages.msgid: As a bulette burrows through the earth its gills collect minute amounts of precious metals and gems which slowly aggregate into lustrous gemstones prized for their beauty and power.
translations: 鲨蜥兽在土石中穿行时，其鳃会吸附微量的贵金属与宝石，并逐渐将它们聚合成璀璨的晶石。这些晶石因其瑰丽的外观与其中蕴含的力量而备受珍视。

messages.msgid: This is the magical essence from a dragon, distilled into a concentrated form.
translations: 浓缩提纯后的龙之魔力精华。

messages.msgid: A long sucking apparatus harvested from stirge corpse.  Makes a poor melee weapon.
translations: 一根从蚊蝠尸体上收获所得的长喙，可以勉强当成武器使用。

messages.msgid: A piece of demon spider exoskeleton.  It is light and very durable, and probably has some magical properties.
translations: 一块恶魔蜘蛛的外骨骼。它不仅轻巧，而且很耐用，大概还有一些魔法属性。

messages.msgid: Pieces of demon spider exoskeleton, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 几片恶魔蜘蛛外壳，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: A large piece of demon spider exoskeleton, painstakingly cut from the corpse of an adult demon spider.  A plate of this size can be used to create armor plating.
translations: 一大块恶魔蜘蛛的外骨骼，煞费苦心地从一只成年恶魔蜘蛛的尸体上切下来。这个尺寸的甲壳板可以用来制造载具装甲板。

messages.msgid: A fang from a demon spider.  It seems to still drip with poison; you might be able to use this in some alchemical recipe?
translations: 恶魔蜘蛛的毒牙。它似乎还在滴着毒液，也许你能把它用在些炼金术配方中吧？

messages.msgid: Alumentum is magically processed coal or charcoal.  It burns as hot as magnesium, and for a significantly longer period of time.  One of the very few magical materials that is still produced in any quantity today due to its usefulness.
translations: 源动之焰是经过魔法处理的煤或木炭。它能像镁一样剧烈燃烧，而且燃烧时间要长得多。由于它的广泛用途，成为为数不多的至今仍在大量被生产的魔法材料之一。

messages.msgid: Crystalized mana in powdered form.  It faintly pulses with arcane energy.
translations: 一撮粉末状的魔力结晶。它所含的奥术能量不断脉动着发出微光。

messages.msgid: A gemstone created by alchemy.  You can feel it attract surrounding mana.
translations: 炼金术创造的宝石。你可以感觉到它吸引着周围的魔力。

messages.msgid: Wood that has been infused with mana.

Mana bombs are powerful explosive devices developed by a little-known alchemist group for use against enemy spellcasters.  These bombs are fueled by pure arcane energy and can kill instantly.  The exact workings are unclear, but they appear to use some kind of massive mana burn.
translations: 魔能炸弹是由一个鲜为人知的炼金术士团体开发的强大爆炸装置，用于对付敌方法师。这些炸弹使用纯奥术能量作为燃料，可以瞬间杀伤。确切的工作原理尚不清楚，但似乎利用了某种快速而剧烈的魔力燃烧。

messages.msgid: You mix the contents of the bottle, and it starts to sizzle.
translations: 你把魔法药剂混合，它开始嘶嘶作响。

messages.msgid: The liquid in the bottle is sizzling.  Throwing it away from you, preferably at an enemy, would be a very good idea.
translations: 瓶子里的液体在嘶嘶作响。把它从你身边扔掉，最好是扔向敌人，这将是一个非常好的主意。

messages.msgid: The reaction has already started - all you can do is get it away from you!
translations: 反应已经开始了——你所能做的就是把它从你身边弄走！

messages.msgid: A pair of stabilized alchemist bombs with concentrated mana linking them.  Any movement in the mana linkage zone provokes an extremely powerful explosion in a small area.
translations: 一对稳定的炼金术士炸弹，被高度提纯的魔力连接起来。在魔力连接区内的任何移动都会引发威力极其强大的小范围爆炸。

messages.msgid: Ichaival, the bow of Odin.  Rumored to fire 10 arrows with every pull of the string.  It has gold and silver ornaments on it, as well as an ornate Raven.
translations: 伊奇巴尔，传说中北欧众神之父奥丁使用的神弓。据说每次拉弦能够射出 10 只箭。这件上面覆盖满了金银饰品，以及一只装饰华丽的渡鸦。

messages.msgid: An arrow composed of a sliver of orichalcum.  The arrow has a mysterious glow.  Has a very high chance of staying intact when fired, however can only be fired from Ichaival.
translations: 由山铜制成的箭，正发出神秘的光芒。射击后有很大概率可以保持完好，但是只能从神弓伊奇巴尔上射出。

messages.msgid: An arrow with a fragment of a druid rune in the arrowhead.  It unleashes a storm of entangling vegetation when it strikes.
translations: 箭头中嵌有德鲁伊符文碎片的箭矢。命中目标时，它会释放出一阵疯长的缠绕草木。

messages.msgid: An arrow with a fragment of a stormshaper rune in the arrowhead.  It trails lightning and explodes with a crash of thunder.
translations: 一支箭，箭头嵌有风暴塑造者符文碎片。飞行时拖曳雷光尾迹，命中时在雷光震响中炸裂。

messages.msgid: An arrow with a fragment of a earthshaper rune in the arrowhead.  It hits the target with the force of an avalanche.
translations: 箭头中嵌有塑地者符文碎片的箭矢。它会以山崩之力冲击目标。

messages.msgid: An arrow with a fragment of a kelvinist rune in the arrowhead.  It explodes into a firestorm.
translations: 一支箭，其箭头上有炽霜法师的符文碎片。 在发射后爆炸并形成火焰风暴。

messages.msgid: A disturbing bone arrow with a fragment of a biomancer rune in the arrowhead.  It showers its target in acid.
translations: 一根令人不安的骨箭，箭头中嵌有生化术士符文的碎片。它会向目标泼洒酸液。

messages.msgid: A metallic arrow with a fragment of a technomancer rune in the arrowhead.  It destroys electronic targets.
translations: 一支金属箭，其箭头上有科技法师的符文碎片。 用来摧毁电子目标。

messages.msgid: An arrow with a fragment of a magus rune in the arrowhead.  It reverses flight briefly after striking its target and then hits another one.
translations: 其箭头上有魔法符文的碎片。 击中目标后，这只箭矢会在短时间内向反方向飞行，从而击中另一个目标。

messages.msgid: An arrow with a fragment of an animist rune in the arrowhead.  It unleashes a cloud of enervating gas.
translations: 箭头中嵌有泛灵师符文碎片的箭矢。它会释放出一团使人衰弱的气体。

messages.msgid: A quiver enchanted to hold 40 arrows or bolts while not taking up any more space than a normal quiver.  Rarely made after the invention of firearms.
translations: 一个被附魔的箭袋，能容纳40支箭或弩矢，但占用的空间与普通箭袋无异。在枪械发明后便鲜有制作。

messages.msgid: A quiver enchanted to hold 80 arrows or bolts while not taking up any more space than a normal quiver.  Rarely made after the invention of firearms.
translations: 一个被附魔的箭袋，能容纳80支箭或弩矢，但占用的空间与普通箭袋无异。在枪械发明后便鲜有制作。

messages.msgid: pair of demon chitin arm guards
messages.plural: pairs of demon chitin arm guards

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned red exoskeletons of demon spiders.  Fire-resistant and very durable.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的恶魔蜘蛛躯壳制成的护臂，轻便耐用而且防火。

messages.msgid: Leg and body armor crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned red exoskeletons of demon spiders.  Fire-resistant and very durable.
translations: 一副由经过精心清理并裁剪过的恶魔蜘蛛躯壳制成的全身护甲，轻便耐用而且防火。

messages.msgid: A helmet crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned red exoskeletons of demon spiders.  Covers the entire head; fire-resistant and very durable.
translations: 一顶由恶魔蜘蛛躯壳制成制成的头盔，能覆盖你的整个头部，轻便耐用而且防火。

messages.msgid: Gauntlets crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned red exoskeletons of demon spiders.  Fire-resistant and very durable.
translations: 一对由恶魔蜘蛛躯壳制成的护手，轻便耐用而且防火。

messages.msgid: Boots crafted from carefully cleaned and pruned red exoskeletons of demon spiders.  Fire-resistant and very durable.
translations: 一对由恶魔蜘蛛躯壳制成的长靴，轻便耐用而且防火。

messages.msgid: A makeshift harness of demon chitin fitted to a thin mesh protecting the neck to flank of canines.  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 一套自制的犬具，上面的恶魔甲壳片和薄薄的网状织物贴合在一起，保护狗的侧面和颈部。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from demon chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套自制的马铠，包含保护马颈的鸡颈、保护马胸的当胸和保护马臀的搭后，上面的恶魔甲壳片和薄薄的网状织物贴合在一起。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: Using the latest advancement in technomancy this bionic is able to convert the innate energy stored in blood into bionic power.  The stronger the blood the better.  It can hold up to 100 mL of blood.
translations: 科技魔法的最新进展使这个生化插件能够将血液中的固有能量转化成生化能量。血液越强，效率越高。可以容纳 100 ml 血液。

messages.msgid: A large gem made with crystallized mana and some other stabilizing metals.  Comes with a specially designed power pack (installed into the skull) that does not interfere with your mana ley lines.  WARNING: for Technomancer use only.  By using this spell you are waiving all liability of Frikken Laser Beams Inc.  and its subsidiaries.
translations: 一枚由魔力结晶与数种稳定金属制成的大型宝石。它附带一个专门设计的能量包（安装于颅内），不会干扰你的魔力灵脉。警告：仅供科技法师使用。施放此法术即代表你同意免除弗里肯激光光束公司及其子公司的一切责任。

messages.msgid: A series of rune-inscribed implants around the eyes allow the user of this bionic to see the ley lines in the bodies of those who frequently use magic, effectively detecting nearby wizards even through obstructing terrain.
translations: 一系列铭刻着符文的植入物被植入眼部周围，让此生化插件的使用者能看见那些频繁施法者体内的灵脉，即便隔着障碍物，也能有效侦测到附近的法师。

messages.msgid: Rune-inscribed metal filaments have been implanted around your eyes, allowing you to detect nearby mages.  Activate to turn it on.
translations: 刻有符文的金属丝已经被植入你的双眼周围，使你拥有侦测附近法师的能力。激活以开启。

messages.msgid: For those who have no use for their mana, this bionic allows the user to convert mana directly into bionic power.  Though the conversion rate is inefficient, mana is free.
translations: 对于那些用不上魔力的人来说，这款仿生植入体能让使用者将魔力直接转化为仿生能源。虽然转化效率低下，但魔力是免费的。

messages.msgid: Tiny bits of orichalcum have been implanted at important intersections in your ley lines, allowing you to turn your mana into bionic power.  Activate to begin the conversion process.
translations: 些许山铜微粒被植入了你灵脉的关键节点，使你能够将魔力转化为生化能量。激活以开始转化过程。

messages.msgid: The ultimate in concealable personal defense, thin filaments are implanted along the ley lines in both of your arms leading to embedded mana crystals in your hands, allowing you to launch blasts of pure magical energy at nearby targets.  The only disadvantage is that it draws on your own personal mana supply rather than bionic power.
translations: 终极的隐蔽式个人防御武器。纤细的丝状物沿着你双臂的灵脉植入，一直连接到嵌入你手掌的魔力晶体，让你能对近处的目标发射纯粹的魔法能量冲击。唯一的缺点是它消耗的是你自身的魔力储备，而非生化能量。

messages.msgid: Implants in your arm's ley lines allow you to project bolts of magical energy from your hands.  This draws on your personal mana stores, not your bionic power.
translations: 你手臂灵脉中的植入物能让你从手中投射出魔法能量箭。此能力消耗的是你自身的魔力，而非生化能量。

messages.msgid: A scale from a black dragon.  It still has its magical properties and acid resistance.
translations: 一块黑龙的鳞片。它仍然保持着它的魔法属性和酸液防护。

messages.msgid: Scales from a black dragon, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 几片黑龙鳞片，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw hide harvested from a black dragon.  It is a large enough piece that it is workable to make armor, and with enough scales you could make scale mail.
translations: 一卷仔细卷好的黑龙皮。这块皮的尺寸足够用来做载具装甲，上面的鳞片也多到能够做鳞甲。

messages.msgid: A treated black dragon hide which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become workable.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.
translations: 一张经过处理的黑龙皮，正在进行必要的化学变化以变得能够使用。当它鞣制完成后你就可以激活它以展开并使用它。

messages.msgid: You carefully unfold the black dragon hide and shake it clean.
translations: 你煞费苦心地展开鞣制中的黑龙皮，把它抖干净。

messages.msgid: The black dragon hide isn't done yet.
translations: 黑龙皮的鞣制尚未完成。

messages.msgid: Prepared hide from a black dragon.  Hard, acid-resistant, and with more scales could make a suit of armor as hard as steel and half as heavy.
translations: 黑龙的优质龙皮，坚固、耐酸，具有很多鳞片，用它制造的盔甲如钢铁般坚固，重量却只有钢的一半。

messages.msgid: Hides from a black dragon, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 几张黑龙皮，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: Boots made of black incredibly durable dragonscale.  Very protective, and surprisingly light.
translations: 一双用黑龙鳞制成的靴子，在拥有极高的防御力的同时令人惊异的轻便。

messages.msgid: Boots made of very durable black dragonhide.  Very protective, and surprisingly light.
translations: 一双用黑龙皮制成的靴子，在拥有极高的防御力的同时令人惊异的轻便。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from black incredibly durable dragonscale, held together with black dragonhide.  It comes equipped with a full face visor with only a thin slit to see out of.  Activate to raise the visor.
translations: 一顶用黑龙鳞与黑龙皮制成的头盔，全覆面设计，只能通过一条细细的开口看见外面。激活以升起面罩。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from incredibly durable black dragonscale, held together with black dragonhide.  The visor is raised.
translations: 一顶用黑龙鳞与黑龙皮制成的头盔，全覆面设计，面罩已经被升起。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from very durable black dragonhide.  It protects your head well, but doesn't cover your face.
translations: 一顶用黑龙皮制成的头盔，提供出色的头部防护，又不会遮挡面部。

messages.msgid: A full suit of incredibly durable black dragon scale mail.  It comes with all the accoutrements that cover your torso, legs, and arms, with the benefit of being very light and flexible.
translations: 全套黑龙鳞甲，部件覆盖躯干、腿、手臂，轻便且灵活。

messages.msgid: A full suit of very durable black dragonhide armor.  It comes with all the accoutrements that cover your torso, legs, and arms, with the benefit of being very light and flexible.
translations: 全套黑龙皮甲，部件覆盖躯干、腿、手臂，轻便且灵活。

messages.msgid: A pair of heavy-duty gauntlets made of incredibly durable black dragonscale that covers your hands.
translations: 一对用黑龙鳞制成的护手，坚固耐用，完全覆盖了双手。

messages.msgid: A pair of gloves made of very durable black dragonhide, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.
translations: 一对用黑龙皮制成的手套，易于穿戴，在极端环境下也能提最大的防护。

messages.msgid: Massive boots made of incredibly durable black dragonscale, modified to fit even the strangest of bodies.  Very protective, and surprisingly light.
translations: 一双用黑龙鳞制成的大码靴子，能容下各种变异肢体，在拥有极高的防御力的同时令人惊异的轻便。

messages.msgid: Massive boots made of very durable black dragonhide, modified to fit even the strangest of bodies.  Very protective, and surprisingly light.
translations: 一双用黑龙皮制成的大码靴子，能容下各种变异肢体，在拥有极高的防御力的同时令人惊异的轻便。

messages.msgid: A pair of heavy-duty gauntlets made of incredibly durable black dragonscale that covers your hands, or whatever you use as hands.
translations: 一对用黑龙鳞制成的大码护手，坚固耐用，完全覆盖了双手或其他变异肢体。

messages.msgid: A pair of gloves made of very durable black dragonhide, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.  Sized to fit even the strangest of anatomy.
translations: 一对用黑龙皮制成的大码手套，易于穿戴，能容下各种变异肢体，在极端环境下也能提最大的防护。

messages.msgid: A massive helmet made from incredibly durable black dragonscale, held together with black dragonhide.  It comes equipped with a full face visor you can raise and is large enough to fit even the strangest of heads.
translations: 一顶用黑龙鳞与黑龙皮制成的大码头盔，全覆面设计，能容下各种变异肢体，只能通过一条细细的开口看见外面。激活以升起面罩。

messages.msgid: A massive helmet made from incredibly durable black dragonscale, held together with black dragonhide.  It is large enough to fit even the strangest of heads.  The visor is raised
translations: 一顶用黑龙鳞与黑龙皮制成的大码头盔，全覆面设计，能容下各种变异肢体，面罩已经被升起。

messages.msgid: A massive helmet made from very durable black dragonhide.  It protects your head well, and doesn't cover your face, but is large enough to fit even the strangest of heads.
translations: 一顶用黑龙皮制成的大码头盔，能容下各种变异肢体，提供出色的头部防护，又不会遮挡面部。

messages.msgid: A massive full suit of incredibly durable black dragon scale mail.  It comes with all the accoutrements that cover your torso, legs, and arms; sized to fit even the strangest of bodies.
translations: 特大码的全套黑龙鳞甲，部件覆盖躯干、腿、手臂，能容下各种变异肢体。

messages.msgid: A massive full suit of very durable black dragonhide armor.  It comes with all the accoutrements that cover your torso, legs, and arms; sized to fit even the strangest of bodies.
translations: 特大码的全套黑龙皮甲，部件覆盖躯干、腿、手臂，能容下各种变异肢体。

messages.msgid: A custom-built backpack.  Made of very durable dragon leather and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.
translations: 一件自制的龙皮背包，经久耐用并且被经过精心制造，使得它能够装下尽可能多的物品。

messages.msgid: A intermediate textbook on magical theories.
translations: 一本魔法理论的中级教科书。

messages.msgid: A beginner textbook on magical theories.
translations: 一本魔法理论的入门教科书。

messages.plural: copies of The Basics of Caster Levels

messages.msgid: This book goes into details about different ways to boost one's caster level above what one would normally achieve.  Domination schools can be boosted by various items detailed inside, while harmony schools can be boosted by circumstances.  Regardless, the book cautions that this boost can not exceed 1 + ( your highest caster level in that school / 5 ).  For animist, they get a boost if they stand in blood.  More blood means a higher maximum boost.  Stormshapers gets a boost while being outside during precipitation.  More precipitation means a higher maximum boost.  Earthshapers get a boost by being underground, and by standing on dirt, sand, clay or the like.  Apparently, standing in pits is also very effective.  Druids gets a boost by standing on grass, fern, bushes, and the like.  Hugging a young tree gives among the highest possible boosts for druids.
translations: 这本书描述让施法等级超出一般水平的不同方法。统御学派以各种物品强化施法等级，调谐学派则依靠环境进行强化。不论情况如何，施法等级都无法超出1+（该学派的最高施法等级/5）。泛灵师站在血里就能获得强化，血越多、最大强化就越高。风暴塑造者在正在降水的户外环境里获得强化。塑地者在地下空间、站在泥土，粘土，沙砾里都能获得强化。站在坑里也行。德鲁伊站在草地、蕨类、树丛等植物里就能获得强化。站在年轻的树边上能给德鲁伊最高等级的强化。

messages.msgid: This book is written in a runic language unfamiliar to you.  Fortunately, there are several very detailed pictures that demonstrate the process of forging a sword from an ingot of silvery metal.  You get the impression that this is some sort of textbook for blacksmiths.
translations: 这本书是用你不熟悉的符文写成的。幸运的是，有几张非常详细的图片展示了用某种银色金属锭锻造刀剑的过程。你觉得这是本铁匠的教科书。

messages.msgid: This is a glossy brochure encouraging students to book vacations at a lake retreat or remote cabin.  The brochure includes lush photographs of a tower on an island and a remote looking cabin in the woods.  It includes a map of the areas.
translations: 这是一本精美的小册子，鼓励学生在湖畔度假地或偏远的小屋里度假。这本小册子有着岛屿上的一座塔和林中一座偏远小屋的华丽照片。里面附带着一张本地区的地图。

messages.msgid: You add the locations to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了一些地点。

messages.msgid: This is a well worn map.  It has pictures of fantastical beasts embellishing the carefully drawn map markers.
translations: 这是一张破旧的地图。它有一些奇形怪状的野兽的照片，装饰着精心绘制的地图标记。

messages.msgid: A photo of a jovial, old wizard, he seems to be dancing with a coat rack in this basement.  There is a stack of suitcases in the background.
translations: 一张快乐的老魔法师的照片，他似乎正在地下室里和一个衣架跳舞。背景里有一堆手提箱。

messages.msgid: On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural and Supernatural Selection
messages.plural: copies of On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural and Supernatural Selection

messages.msgid: This is a mass-market paperback copy of Charles Darwin's famous book where he laid out his theory of evolution and the way that magic influences the course of speciation.  The book was extremely controversial when it came out for positing a recent common ancestor for humans and dwarves and for claiming that elves as a distinct species only date back to 3 million years before present.
translations: 这是查尔斯·达尔文名著的大众平装版。书中不仅阐述了他的进化论，更论证了魔法如何影响物种形成的过程。这本书在出版时曾引发巨大争议，因其提出人类和矮人拥有共同的近代祖先，并宣称精灵作为一个独立物种，其历史仅能追溯至三百万年前。

messages.msgid: Running on Empty: A Social History of those Born Without Magic
messages.plural: copies of Running on Empty: A Social History of those Born Without Magic

messages.msgid: A history of the treatment of the "Empty", people born with the inability to master even the simplest of spells.  From persecution to favored positions (since rulers could be sure the Empty had no magical means of plotting against them), this book chronicles their treatment across the ages.
translations: 一部关于“无魔者”——那些生来就无法掌握哪怕最简单法术的人——所受待遇的历史。从被迫害到受青睐（因为统治者可以确信“无魔者”没有魔法手段来密谋反对他们），这本书记录了他们在各个时代所经历的待遇。

messages.msgid: Prisons and Magic: The History of Past and Present Antimagic Restraints
translations: 监狱与魔法：反魔法拘束史
messages.plural: copies of Prisons and Magic: The History of Past and Present Antimagic Restraints

messages.msgid: A detailed overview of the means used by ancient societies to keep imprisoned magic users inside prisons.  From the chains and gag to the mana-leech shackle, this book covers the myriad of ways prisons dealt with teleportation, invisibility, intangibility and every other magic that could be used for an evasion.
translations: 本书详述了古代社会用以囚禁施法者的种种手段。从锁链口枷到汲魔镣铐，书中介绍了监狱为应对传送、隐身、虚化以及其他所有可用于脱身的魔法而准备的五花八门的对策。

messages.msgid: This annual publication covers the latest advances in bionic technomancy, the implantation of metal into flesh.  There are some pretty promising new developments in here that will now never see the light of day.
translations: 这份年刊涵盖了仿生科技魔法——将金属植入血肉的技术——的最新进展。书中记载了一些前景光明的崭新发展，可惜如今它们再也无缘面世了。

messages.msgid: You can't buy these, so you need to save them until the last boss!  Actually, don't even use them there!
translations: 商店不卖这个，所以要留着打最终Boss用。当然，打最终Boss也可以不用。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of Cat's Grace.  It will increase your dexterity for 50 minutes.
translations: 这是猫之优雅药剂，它会在50分钟内提高你的敏捷。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of Ogre's Strength.  It will increase your strength for 50 minutes.
translations: 这是巨魔之力药剂，它会在50分钟内提高你的力量。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of Eagle's Sight.  It will increase your perception for 50 minutes.
translations: 这是鹰眼药水，它会在50分钟内提高你的感知。

messages.msgid: This is a potion of Fox's Cunning.  It will increase your intelligence for 50 minutes.
translations: 这是狐之狡黠药剂，它会在50分钟内提高你的智力。

messages.msgid: Use it to penetrate everything in line of sight
translations: 用它来刺穿视野中的一切

messages.msgid: A potion that temporarily freezes the higher brain activity for a while.  It was banned by the government due to popularity in the criminal sphere, but some people still know the recipe.
translations: 一种能暂时冻结大脑高级活动的药剂。因在犯罪领域风靡而被政府禁用，但仍有少数人知晓其配方。

messages.msgid: Get out of jail free card for each who care about his life.
translations: 人人皆求免死金牌，惜命者自当人手一张。

messages.msgid: Important part of every professional robber's kit.  It was banned by the government due to the popularity in criminal sphere, but some people still know the recipe.
translations: 职业劫匪装备中的重要一环。因在犯罪领域风靡而被政府禁用，但仍有少数人知晓其配方。

messages.msgid: No one really knows why it was created, but it can be useful in some situations
translations: 没有人真正知道它为什么会被创造出来，但它在某些情况下确实有用。

messages.msgid: They were really useful in middle ages, but the price was too high, and they were supplanted with another incendiary weapon and, long after, with Molotov cocktails.
translations: 这种药水在中世纪确实很有用，但价格太高，它们很快被其他燃烧武器所取代，很久之后，又被燃烧瓶所取代。

messages.msgid: Make you totally invisible, except in mana spectrum.  It was banned by the government due to the popularity in crime sphere, but some people still know the recipe.
translations: 让你在视觉上完全隐形。由于在犯罪领域的流行，它被政府禁止了，但有些人仍然知道这个配方。

messages.msgid: Classical medicine, used from ancient times, that came to us with almost no changes.  Allows you to heal the common illness way faster than before.
translations: 自古以来使用的经典药物，直到如今几乎没有任何变化。让你比以前更快地治愈常见疾病。

messages.msgid: Allow user to survive the fall from any height.  Sadly, the required preparation and effect's weakness do not allow to use it for climbing protection.
translations: 允许使用者在从任何高度坠落时幸存下来。遗憾的是，所需的准备工作和效果的弱点不允许将其用于攀登时的保护。

messages.msgid: Designed by Occult Coalition sorcerers, this potion was fairly popular inside the special operation forces and in the hunting communities.
translations: 这种药水由某个神秘联盟的巫师设计，在特别行动部队和狩猎界相当流行。

messages.msgid: Rearrange neural activity of the creature to be 100% loyal to a blood owner.  It was banned by the government due to the popularity in crime sphere, but some people still know the recipe.
translations: 重新安排生物的神经活动，使其100%地忠诚于使用者。由于在犯罪领域的流行，它被政府禁止了，但有些人仍然知道这个配方。

messages.msgid: At first only an insignificant spell designed to trap and kill small bugs and rodents, someone found it pretty useful in a real fight and improved it with that goal in mind.
translations: 起初它是一种小法术，旨在诱捕并杀死小虫子和啮齿动物，但有人发现它在真正的战斗中很有用，并对它进行了改进时纳入考量。

messages.msgid: They count as doping in Olympic games.  Luckily you are not in a stadium.
translations: 这种药剂在奥林匹克运动会中被视为兴奋剂。幸运的是你不在体育场里。

messages.msgid: Old recipe, used to increase the user's endurance.  The diluted version was used by different armies for fast and long forced marches.
translations: 古老的配方，用于增加使用者的耐力。稀释后的版本被不同的军队用于快速和长时间的强制行军。

messages.msgid: An old marine recipe, that saved a lot of shipwreck victim lives.
translations: 一个古老的海员用配方，拯救了许多船难受害者的生命。

messages.msgid: One among a variety of potions designed to make a person stronger on the battlefield.  Sharpens the user's senses and improves reaction time, increasing their ability to fight in melee.
translations: 众多旨在增强使用者战场实力的药剂之一。它能锐化使用者的感官、提高反应速度，从而增强其近战能力。

messages.msgid: Harden the user's skin, and allow taking more damage with no harm.  Was popular in ancient armies, but now mostly forgotten.
translations: 硬化使用者的皮肤，免受更多的伤害。在古代军队中很流行，但现在大多被遗忘。

messages.msgid: A potion designed during the 19th century and popular among miners wishing to avoid the dangers of explosive gas leaks underground.  It is less popular these days due to the abundance of electric lighters, but still sees occasional use.
translations: 一种设计于19世纪的药剂，曾深受希望避免地下爆炸性气体泄漏危险的矿工们欢迎。如今由于电子打火机的普及，它已不那么流行，但偶尔仍会派上用场。

messages.msgid: Attract the ley-lines to user, increasing the natural mana regeneration.
translations: 吸引灵脉向使用者汇聚，提升魔力的自然恢复速度。

messages.msgid: Splay user's ley-lines, what allow them to use more mana than they usually can.
translations: 强行扩张使用者的灵脉，使其能动用超乎寻常的魔力。

messages.msgid: Start a long-term spell sequence, that increase your regeneration abilities.
translations: 开启一个长期的法术序列，以增加你的再生能力。

messages.msgid: Closer to an alcoholic drink than a potion, this mixture makes your brain feel constant happiness, ignoring the whole boredom of reality.  It causes no addiction, but is still banned in some countries, including the USA (except in Texas and New Hampshire, where it's just frowned upon).
translations: 与其说是药剂，不如说更接近酒精饮料。这种混合物能让你的大脑持续感到快乐，从而忽略现实的索然无味。它不会致瘾，但在某些国家仍被禁止，包括美国（德克萨斯州和新罕布什尔州除外，在那里它只是不被待见）。

messages.msgid: Spread a low lethal toxin on your enemies.  It's surprisingly effective, if you have enough time.
translations: 在你的敌人身上传播一种低致命性的毒素。效果意外地好，前提是你有足够的时间。

messages.msgid: Concentrated potion, teleported right in the enemy body - fast, painful, and guarantee death.
translations: 浓缩的药水，可以直接传送到敌人体内——快速、痛苦，并且保证死亡。

messages.msgid: A remarkably accurate effigy of an undead human, including pieces of bone and organs.  Necromantic magic delays immediate rot, but it won't last forever.  Piercing it with the attached needle could compel it to serve you.
translations: 一只特别逼真的丧尸人偶，有着逼真的骨头和器官。死灵法术暂时阻止了它的腐坏，但是不会长久。用附带的针刺它会让它为你服务。

messages.msgid: A remarkably accurate effigy of an undead human covered with bone, including pieces of organs.  Necromantic magic delays immediate rot, but it won't last forever.  Piercing it with the attached needle could compel it to serve you.
translations: 一只特别逼真的丧尸人偶，覆盖着骨片，里面有逼真的器官。死灵法术暂时阻止了它的腐坏，但是不会长久。用附带的针刺它会让它为你服务。

messages.msgid: A remarkably accurate effigy of an undead cougar, complete with fur, bones, and organs.  Necromantic magic delays immediate rot, but it won't last forever.  Piercing it with the attached needle could compel it to serve you.
translations: 一只特别逼真的不死美洲狮人偶，有着逼真的毛皮、骨头和器官。死灵法术暂时阻止了它的腐坏，但是不会长久。用附带的针刺它会让它为你服务。

messages.msgid: This foul-smelling liquid simulates undead regeneration by accelerating your heart to dangerous levels.  Drinking this in danger or at critical condition may be lethal.
translations: 这瓶闻起来就恶心的液体通过将心跳加速至危险的水平来模拟不死生物的恢复能力。在危险或濒死状态下使用可能会致命。

messages.msgid: This foul-smelling liquid simulates undead regeneration by accelerating your heart to dangerous levels.  Drinking this in danger or at critical condition may be lethal.  Improved infusion techniques lessen the strain of the process.
translations: 这瓶闻起来就恶心的液体通过将心跳加速至危险的水平来模拟不死生物的恢复能力。在危险或濒死状态下使用可能会致命。改进的浸提技术减小了药剂对身体的负担。

messages.msgid: This scroll is imbued with a magical spell that, when activated, will transport you to the Forge of Wonders.  Good for one round-trip.
translations: 这卷卷轴灌注了一道魔法咒语，激活后能将你传送至奇迹熔炉。可供一次往返使用。

messages.msgid: This scroll is imbued with a magical spell that, when activated, will return you to where you were before you warped to the Forge.
translations: 这卷卷轴灌注了一道魔法咒语，激活后能将你送回传送至熔炉前的出发点。

messages.msgid: This scroll is imbued with the magical spell that can unlock any mana-leech shackle when cast.  Utterly useless to anyone not struck wearing one.
translations: 这卷卷轴灌注了解锁任意汲魔镣铐的魔法咒语。对于那些没被这玩意儿铐住的人来说，它毫无用处。
魔术师的弹性势能机关（关）

messages.msgid: This elaborate contraption of wooden sticks under tension and tightly wound strings has a pebble with a magus rune on in its center.  Once activated, this device will transform the stored elastic potential energy into arcane energy, boosting your caster level of magus spells by 1 for as long as the stored energy lasts.
translations: 这个由受拉木棍和紧绷的线组成的精巧机关的中心有一颗刻着魔术师符文的卵石。启动以后，它就会把存储的弹性势能转化为魔力，在能量耗尽前让你的魔术师施法等级提高1级。

messages.msgid: You squeeze the machine and its interior starts spinning.
translations: 你挤压机器，零件开始转动。
魔术师的弹性势能机关

messages.msgid: This elaborate contraption of wooden sticks and strings contains a rapidly spinning pebble with magus rune on.  You feel slightly empowered, as your caster level of magus spells is boosted by 1.
translations: 这个由木棍和线组成的精巧装置内有一颗快速旋转的鹅卵石，石头上刻有魔术师符文。你感觉自己的施法等级提高了1级。

messages.msgid: The device slows down and stops.
translations: 装置逐渐减速，直到完全停下。

messages.msgid: This intricate contraption consists of fine gears, screw drivers, belts, pulleys, springs and other clockwork.  The gearwork is contained in a casing of magically treated glass.  An elegantly drawn magus rune is caged in the center, and a wind-up key extends out of the casing, allowing the device to be powered.  Once wound up, it will boost your magus caster level by 2 for as long as the energy lasts.
translations: 这个复杂的装置由精细的齿轮、螺丝刀、皮带、滑轮、弹簧和其他钟表结构组成。齿轮装置中心有一个绘制精美的魔术师符文，整体装在经过魔法处理的玻璃外壳中。发条钥匙从外壳中伸出。一旦发条上好，在能量耗尽前，它会把你的魔术师施法等级提升2级。

messages.msgid: You wind up the device and it starts making a ticking noise.
translations: 你上好发条，它开始嘀嗒作响。

messages.msgid: This intricate contraption consists of fine gears, screw drivers, belts, pulleys, springs and other clockwork parts moving in a mesmerizing dance.  The gearwork is contained in a casing of magically treated glass and gives off a soft ticking noise.  An elegantly drawn magus rune in the center is being spun and rotated in a neverending complex dance of arcane energy.  The wind-up key extending from the casing slowly spins back into its original position.  You feel empowered, as your caster level of magus spells is boosted by 2.
translations: 这个复杂的装置由精细的齿轮、螺丝刀、皮带、滑轮、弹簧和其他钟表结构组成。齿轮装置装在经过魔法处理的玻璃外壳中。中间有一个绘制精美的魔法符文。发条钥匙正缓慢转回原位。它正把你的魔术师施法等级提升2级。

messages.msgid: A thick candle of magically treated tallow with a kelvinist rune artfully inscribed on the side.  It doesn't burn for quite as long as a regular candle, but it will boost your caster level of kelvinist spells by 1 while burning.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.
translations: 一根由魔法处理油脂制成的粗蜡烛，侧面精巧地刻上了炽霜法师符文。它燃烧的时间不如普通蜡烛长，但燃烧时会将你的炽霜法师法术施法等级提高 1。你需要打火机或火柴来点燃它。

messages.msgid: A thick candle of magically treated tallow with a kelvinist rune artfully inscribed on the side.  It doesn't burn for quite as long as a regular candle, but it will boost your caster level of kelvinist spells by 1 while burning.  The magic of the candle protects it from the wind and from setting your backpack aflame.  This candle is lit.
translations: 一根由魔法处理油脂制成的粗蜡烛，侧面精巧地刻上了炽霜法师符文。它燃烧的时间不如普通蜡烛长，但燃烧时会将你的炽霜法师法术施法等级提高 1。蜡烛的魔力使它免于风吹和点燃你的背包。这根蜡烛已点燃。

messages.msgid: An masterfully crafted metal oil lamp with two elongated nozzles, each containing a wick.  The surface is carved with intricate arcane symbols, including a prominent kelvinist rune.  The magic of the lamp protects it from the wind and from setting your backpack aflame.  It does not provide much light, but will boost your kelvinist caster level by 2 while burning.  Use it to light it.
translations: 一盏制作精良的金属油灯，带有两个细长的喷嘴，每个喷嘴都装有一根灯芯。表面雕刻着复杂的神秘符号，包括一个显眼的炽霜法师符文。油灯的魔力使它免于风吹和点燃你的背包。它不会提供太多光线，但燃烧时会将你的炽霜法师法术施法等级提高 2。通过使用来点亮它。

messages.msgid: An masterfully crafted metal oil lamp with two elongated nozzles, each containing a burning wick.  The surface is carved with intricate arcane symbols, including a prominent kelvinist rune.  The reflections from the flames makes it look like the inscriptions are moving.  The magic of the lamp protects it from the wind and from setting your backpack aflame.  It is lit, consuming oil, boosting your kelvinist caster level by 2, and providing light.  Use it to extinguish the flame.
translations: 一盏制作精良的金属油灯，带有两个细长的喷嘴，每个喷嘴都装有一根燃烧的灯芯。表面雕刻着复杂的神秘符号，包括一个显眼的炽霜法师符文。反射的火光让灯上的铭文看起来像在移动一样。油灯的魔力使它免于风吹和点燃你的背包。它已经点燃，需要消耗油，将你的炽霜法师法术施法等级提高 2以及提供照明。通过使用来熄灭它。

messages.msgid: A fire-hardened clay tablet depicting a technomancer rune.  Breaking the tablet will release the stored magical energy, boosting your technomancer caster level by 1 for a while.
translations: 一块经过火硬化的粘土板，描绘了科技法师符文。打破粘土板会释放储存的魔法能量，暂时将你的科技法师施法等级提高1级。

messages.msgid: You feel a surge of power as the clay tablet crumbles between your fingers.
translations: 当泥板在你的指间破碎时，你会感到一股力量的涌动。

messages.msgid: A jumble of cables, gears, electromagnets, and metal encased in a steel casing inscribed with arcane runes.  A pebble with a technomancer rune is found at the core.  The machine can adjust the electric charge, magnetic field, and angular velocity of said rune.  When active and in your inventory, the machine will automatically detect when you are trying to cast a technomancer spell.  Once that happens, it will use a moderate amount of battery charge to boost your caster level as far as it can.  A larger boost will draw more energy.
translations: 一坨电缆、齿轮、电磁铁、金属，包裹在刻有神秘符文的钢壳中。核心部位有一块刻有科技法师符文的鹅卵石。机器可以调整符文的电荷、磁场和角速度。当机器处于激活状态并在你的物品栏中时，它会自动检测你是否正在尝试施放科技法师法术。一旦如此，它就会使用中量的电池电量尽可能地提升你的施法等级。更大的提升将消耗更多的能量。

messages.msgid: You turn on the doodad and it starts to hum.
translations: 你启动科技法师机关，它开始嗡鸣。

messages.msgid: A jumble of cables, gears, electromagnets, and metal encased in a steel casing inscribed with arcane runes.  A pebble with a technomancer rune is found at the core.  The machine can adjust the electric charge, magnetic field, and angular velocity of said rune.  While active and in your inventory, the machine will automatically detect when you are trying to cast a technomancer spell.  Once that happens, it will use a moderate amount of battery charge to boost your caster level as far as it can.  A larger boost will draw more energy.  A faint humming is heard from inside.
translations: 一坨电缆、齿轮、电磁铁、金属，包裹在刻有神秘符文的钢壳中。核心部位有一块刻有科技法师符文的鹅卵石。机器可以调整符文的电荷、磁场和角速度。当机器处于激活状态并在你的物品栏中时，它会自动检测你是否正在尝试施放科技法师法术。一旦如此，它就会使用中量的电池电量尽可能地提升你的施法等级。更大的提升将消耗更多的能量。它里面正发出微弱的嗡鸣声。

messages.msgid: A hollow bone, about 20 cm long, which has been broken at one end and sharpened into a crude syringe.  A biomancer rune is carved on the surface.  By jabbing it into yourself, you can release stored biomancer booster sludge into yourself, thereby boosting your biomancer caster level by 1 for a while.  Doing so is about as painful as it sounds.
translations: 一根约 20 厘米长的空心骨头，一端折断，并被削成一个简陋的注射器。 表面刻有一个生化术士符文。只要将它刺入自己体内，就能将储存的生化术士强化浆释放到自己体内，从而使自己的生化术士施法等级暂时提高1级。这样做确实像听起来那样痛。

messages.msgid: You feel a surge of power as the bone syringe deposits the sludge inside your body.
translations: 随着骨针筒将强化浆注入你的体内你感觉到一股力量在涌动。

messages.msgid: An elegant, sturdy metal syringe with a biomancer rune carved on the outside.  It can be used to administer stored biomancer booster sludge into yourself, thereby boosting your biomancer caster level by 2 for a while.
translations: 一根优雅、坚固的金属注射器，外部刻有生化术士符文。它可以用来将储存的生化术士强化浆注入自己体内，使生化术士施法等级暂时提升2级。

messages.msgid: You feel a surge of power as the syringe deposits the sludge inside your body.
translations: 随着针筒将强化浆注入你的体内你感觉到一股力量在涌动。

messages.msgid: A thick purple liquid that is filled to the brim with arcane energy.  With the right tool, it can be used to boost your biomancer caster level.
translations: 一种充盈着魔法能量的紫色粘稠液体。如果有正确的工具，它就可以用来强化你的生化术士施法等级。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of rended flesh and bones on it.  It is necessary for Biomancers to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像撕裂骨肉的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的生化术士来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of clockwork and gears on it.  It is necessary for Technomancers to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像齿轮和发条装置的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的科技法师来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of crystal and mana orbs on it.  It is necessary for Magi to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石子上面有一个像结晶与魔力球的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的魔术师来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of steel and rocks on it.  It is necessary for Earthshapers to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像钢铁与岩石的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的塑地者来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of ice and flames on it.  It is necessary for Kelvinists to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像寒冰与烈火的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的炽霜法师来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of lightning and storm clouds on it.  It is necessary for Stormshapers to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像闪电与雷雨云的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的风暴塑造者来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of nature and trees on it.  It is necessary for Druids to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像自然与绿树的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的德鲁伊来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of summoners on it.  It is necessary for Animists to channel magic into their crafts.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像召唤师的符号，对于将魔力导入制品的泛灵师来说必不可少。

messages.msgid: This magical pebble has an insignia of alchemy and potions on it.  While versatile in use, the lack of attunement to any school prevents creation of more advanced recipes.
translations: 这块注魔的小石块上面有一个像炼金术和魔药的符号。虽然它在制造中的用处十分广泛，但是因为缺少与任何魔法流派的共鸣，它无法用于制造高级的物品。

messages.msgid: This egg laid by an owlbear seems almost indistinguishable from a large rock until you touch it and can feel the warm glow of potential life energy from within.  It's hard to believe that an owlbear could grow so quickly from something so small.  Perhaps you could carefully crack it open to get at the liquid golden goodness inside.
translations: 这是一个由枭熊产下的蛋，在你触摸到它之前，似乎与一块石头没有什么区别，你可以从里面感受到温暖的生命力。很难相信一只枭熊能从在小的东西中迅速成长。也许你可以小心地把打开它，以得到里面金黄色的蛋液。

messages.msgid: A large egg laid by an aenor.  You could feed a lot of people with this.
translations: 一枚由艾诺尔产下的大蛋。这一枚蛋足以喂饱很多人。

messages.msgid: The liquid innards of an owlbear egg.  Good eating.
translations: 枭熊蛋里的蛋液。很美味。

messages.msgid: A big, ugly ball of animal spit and licked-off hairs.  Don't swallow it.
translations: 一大团恶心的动物唾沫和舔掉的毛的混合物。不要吞下它。

messages.msgid: The meat from a slain dragon.  It does not seem to respond to cooking the same way as other meat, making it obvious that it still retains some magical properties.
translations: 龙肉，对烹饪的反应与其他肉截然不同，显然还残留着一些魔法性质。

messages.msgid: The mushrooms harvested from a dead shrieker.  Could be used in potions.
translations: 从尖叫蘑菇怪身上获得的蘑菇。可以用来炼制药剂。

messages.msgid: Indistinguishable from pre-Cataclysm lab grown beef.  It should be excellent but somehow it's just edible.
translations: 和大灾变前实验室培育的牛肉没有区别。本来它应该是非常美味的，但不知为何只是勉强可以食用而已。

messages.msgid: Not as tainted as previously and tastes like the real thing.  You do not want to cook this for your friends, though if you do they won't know the difference for a while.
translations: 虽然不像之前那样被感染，尝起来也和真肉一样。但你可不想用它来做东西给你的同伴吃，尽管这样做了他们也一时半会发现不出有什么区别。

messages.msgid: The "heart" of a golem.  Makes a soft humming noise when you hold it close to your ear.
translations: 一颗傀儡的"心"。当你把它靠近耳朵时，会听见它所发出的柔和的嗡嗡声。

messages.msgid: A broken clay golem, looking like a piece of post-modern art.  Could be smashed for clay.
translations: 一个损坏的黏土傀儡，看起来像一件后现代艺术品。打碎可以获得黏土。

messages.msgid: A broken plastic golem, like a giant action figure chewed up by an equally giant puppy.  You could smash it up into recycled plastic bits.
translations: 一个损坏的塑料傀儡，就像一个巨大的人偶被一只同样巨大的小狗咬碎了。打碎可以获得塑料。

messages.msgid: A broken stone golem, not that much different from a big boulder.  Could be smashed for stone.
translations: 一个损坏的石傀儡，看起来像一件后现代艺术品。打碎可以获得石头。

messages.msgid: A broken iron golem, with all iron you would possibly ever need.  Could be smashed for iron.
translations: 一个损坏的铁傀儡，看起来像一件后现代艺术品。打碎可以获得铁。

messages.msgid: A broken forge born, with all orichalcum you would possibly ever need.  Could be smashed for orichalcum.
translations: 一个损坏的炉裔傀儡，看起来像一件后现代艺术品。打碎可以获得山铜。

messages.msgid: A broken earthshaper's golem, almost the same as it's natural stone counterpart.  Could be smashed for stone.
translations: 一个损坏的塑地者傀儡，几乎和天然的石头一样。可以砸碎得到石头。

messages.msgid: This is a bag that can contain more than it should.  The bag magically reduces the weight of its contents and expands less than the amount of stuff you put into it.  It takes a few words and hand-waving to take an item out.
translations: 一个可以装下更多东西的袋子。这个袋子用魔法减轻了内部物品的重量，并且体积也比你放进的物品体积要小得多。只需说句话再挥手就能取出其中的任何物品。

messages.msgid: This dimensional bag has reached the limits of human innovation with a combination of manufacturing and magical secrets.
translations: 这个维度袋是人类将制造和魔法秘密结合所能达到的创新极限。

messages.msgid: A box that uses gravity magic to preserve food.  It makes the box much heavier, but anything in it lasts far longer and you can store more.
translations: 一个使用重力魔法为食物保鲜的盒子。它使盒子里的物品变得更重，但任何存放在其中食物都能保存更长时间，而且可以装下比自身体积更多的物品。

messages.msgid: Each of these mithril coins has a profile of Valzain, and strangely each of these coins is defaced in some way.
translations: 这些秘银币上每一枚都刻着瓦尔扎因的头像，奇怪的是，每一枚上的头像都有着不同程度的污损。

messages.msgid: You scratch your nails against the coin like so many before you, and feel Valzain's tears.  He longingly cries for somewhere that is not here, and now you know where.
translations: 你像之前的许多人一样，用指甲刮擦着硬币，感受到了瓦尔赞之泪。他悲切地哭喊着，渴望着一个不在此处的远方，而现在，你知道那个地方在哪儿了。

messages.msgid: You rub the scratches on the coin, but leave no mark.  Oh, would-be traveller, how can you wear upon his visage like the wagon wheels upon the roads?
translations: 你擦拭钱币上的划痕，却未留一丝痕迹。啊，未来的旅人，你该如何在他面容上留下印记，如同车辙深深刻入道路？
使用了一件普通的灵木饰品。

messages.msgid: A nutrient-rich elixir for wildwood entities.  No longer fit for consumption.
translations: 为灵木生物调制的滋养灵药，现已不宜饮用。

messages.msgid: A gourd sealed with a druid's rune.  You may harvest the liquid inside when it is done brewing.
translations: 一个以德鲁伊符文密封的葫芦。待到内部的液体酿成，你便可从中取用。

messages.msgid: The rune cracks as you open the gourd and collect the liquid.
translations: 在你打开葫芦收集液体时，其上的符文随之碎裂。

messages.msgid: The liquid isn't done brewing yet.
translations: 葫芦里的液体还未酿好。

messages.msgid: This weaver is immature, it needs to be fed with awakened water to grow.  It attentively observes its surroundings.
translations: 这个织造者尚未成熟，需要以觉醒之水喂养方能成长。它正专注地观察着周遭。

messages.msgid: The %s matures.  Another pair of legs sharpen into blades for cutting fabric.  It still has some room to grow.
translations: %s 成熟了。又一对腿锐化为切割织物的刀刃。它还有继续成长的空间。

messages.msgid: The weaver does not have enough liquid.
translations: 织造者没有足够的液体。

messages.msgid: The weaver isn't done growing yet.
This weaver is fully grown.  There's no light behind its eyes, yet.
translations: 这个织造者已完全成熟，只是眼中尚无光彩。

messages.msgid: The %s awakens.  It gazes at you with its many eyes, ready to serve you.
translations: %s 觉醒了。它以众目凝望着你，听候你的差遣。

messages.msgid: You never thought you'd see the day when a wildwood entity would be so playful and docile.  This weaver is ready to serve you, and can be used to repair clothing or create a shelter.
translations: 你从未想过，有朝一日灵木生物竟会如此温顺爱玩。这只织者已准备好为你效劳，可以用来修补衣物或搭建庇护所。

messages.msgid: A tiny broken weaver.  Its legs bent and broken, it can no longer be used to repair clothing or create a shelter.
translations: 一个微小的破损织造者。它的腿已弯折断裂，再也无法用来修补衣物或搭建庇护所。

messages.msgid: A small ball made of wildwood.  A narrative relief of a stag beetle dancing wraps the ball.  A soft chittering noise can be heard from it.
translations: 一枚灵木制成的小球，球体环绕着一圈叙事浮雕，描绘着一只翩翩起舞的鹿角虫，从中还能听见轻柔的虫鸣。

messages.msgid: The %s surges in size.  It shudders and rolls around as the relief begins to move on its own.
translations: %s 的体型猛然暴涨，它不住地颤抖翻滚，其上的浮雕也开始自行蠕动。

messages.msgid: The beetle does not have enough liquid to grow.
translations: 甲虫没有足够的液体来生长。

messages.msgid: The beetle isn't done growing yet.
A large ball made of wildwood.  A narrative relief of a dancing stag beetle wraps the ball.  A soft chittering noise can be heard from it as the relief flows across the surface.
translations: 一枚灵木制成的大球，球体环绕着一圈叙事浮雕，描绘着一只翩翩起舞的鹿角虫。当浮雕于球面流转之时，便能从中听见轻柔的虫鸣。

messages.msgid: A small druid rune wrapped in a leaf.  It appears to be made of some kind of resin, and is very sticky.
translations: 一枚裹在叶中的小型德鲁伊符文。它似乎由某种树脂制成，触感黏腻。

messages.msgid: A simple carved staff, made of wood.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells.  Wielding it slightly increases your mana regeneration
translations: 雕工简陋的长杖，由木头制成。当你施法时，它会散发出魔幻的光芒。手持时稍微增加魔力回复。

messages.msgid: A beautifully carved staff, made of enchanted wood.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells, but it is not a sturdy melee weapon.  Wielding it increases your mana regeneration.
translations: 雕工精美的长杖，由附魔木制成。当你施法时，它会散发出魔幻的光芒，但它不是坚固的近身武器。手持时增加魔力回复。

messages.msgid: A beautifully carved staff, made of enchanted wood and mithril.  It faintly glows with magic when you cast spells, but it is not a sturdy melee weapon.  Wielding it greatly increases your mana regeneration.
translations: 雕工精美的长杖，由附魔木和秘银制成。当你施法时，它会散发出魔幻的光芒，但它不是坚固的近身武器。手持时大大增加魔力回复。

messages.msgid: A sinister looking staff, made of wood and with a red orb of crystallized mana at the handle.  The orb and its rune faintly glow with magic when you cast spells.  Wielding it slightly increases your mana regeneration and allows you to cast the bleed spell.
translations: 一根看起来很邪恶的长杖，由木头制成，杖头上有个红色魔力结晶球。当你施放法术时，球体和它的符文会发出微弱的魔法光芒。手持它会略微增加你的魔力回复，并让你能够施放引血法术。

messages.msgid: A blue pointed hat with stars stitched into it.  Wearing it increases your maximum mana.
translations: 一顶镶有许多星星的蓝色尖顶帽。戴着它可以增加你的最大魔力值。

messages.msgid: This cloak seems to absorb light except for the pinpricks of stars that move across its surface.
translations: 这件长袍似乎能吸收光线，它的表面有无数繁星般的光点在其中移动。

messages.msgid: This bag conjures a magical throwing knife on activation.  Only refills when worn.  It also boosts your throwing abilities.
translations: 这个袋子激活后会变出一把魔法飞刀。仅在穿着能重新充填。它同时也会增强你的投掷技能。

messages.msgid: A pair of silver cufflinks with a wolf's head engraved into them.  Each cufflink has a bright ruby eye and pearl teeth.  They appear to be growling.  There is an inscription, 'When the moon shines.  I become alive.'
translations: 一对纯银袖扣，上面雕刻着狼头。每个袖扣上的狼头都有着明亮的红宝石眼珠和珍珠制成的牙齿。它们看上去仿佛在嚎叫。上面有一行铭文："明月当空，我将复生。"

messages.msgid: The mythical belt of Thor, god of thunder.  Or at least so it appears.  It doubles the wearer's base strength.
translations: 传说中雷神索尔的神奇腰带，至少看起来是这样的。它能使佩戴者的基础力量加倍。
