messages.msgid: A sturdy workman's belt that fits around your waist, covered in easy to access pouches.  Like all dimensional spaces, they hold more than they should with a fair weight reduction.
translations: 一条结实合身的工具腰带，上面套着许多方便取用的袋子。像所有的维度空间一样，放入的物品重量会减轻。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty workman's belt that fits around your waist, covered in easy to access pouches.  Like all dimensional spaces, they hold far more than they should with a substantial weight reduction.
translations: 一条特别结实合身的工具腰带，上面套着许多方便取用的袋子。像所有的维度空间一样，放入的物品重量会大大减轻。

messages.msgid: A wide girdle that fits around your waist, you can sheath or holster any weapon into it in the blink of an eye, and it seemingly stores them somewhere else.
translations: 一条很适合你腰部的宽腰带，你可以在眨眼之间将任何武器收入其中，收入的物品似乎被存放在其他空间之中。

messages.msgid: A custom-built leather utility belt that instantly creates any tool that you reach for.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一条自制的皮革工具带，能够瞬间变出你所想要的任何工具。激活它来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A braided but flexible belt seemingly made of metal.  You can activate it to transform it into a whip and flay your enemies.
translations: 一根看上去似由金属编织而成但又十分灵活的皮带。你可以激活它，把它变成鞭子，然后切碎你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You grab the belt and it uncoils to become a flexible metal whip in your hand!
translations: 你抓起腰带，它瞬间在你手中舒展开，变成一根灵活的铁鞭子！

messages.msgid: A long braided flexible steel bullwhip that narrows into a sharp blade at the end.  Easily capable of slicing and dicing anything that comes at you.  It transforms back into a belt.
translations: 一条编织而成、柔软灵活的钢铁长鞭，末端变成锋利的刀刃。能够轻易切割任何向你袭来的物品。使用它能够将其变回皮带。

messages.msgid: You loop the whip in your hand and it coils back into a belt form in an instant.
translations: 你把鞭子在手中缠绕，使其在瞬间卷曲回皮带形状。

messages.msgid: Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, they look like they've seen a lot of use and will likely see a lot more.  They make your movement a lot less work.
translations: 一双十分坚固却又非常舒适合身的旧钢头皮靴，看上去已经用了很久，而且能继续用上更久。穿上它让你移动变得轻松了不少。

messages.msgid: Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, these boots can be activated once a day to escape from nasty situations, teleporting you a good distance in a random direction.
translations: 一双十分坚固却又非常舒适合身的旧钢头皮靴，这双靴子能够每日激活一次，将你带出任何糟糕的对局，会让你朝一个随机方向传送出一大段距离。

messages.msgid: Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of worn leather and steel, seeming a bit more flexible and breathable than typical for their materials.  The enchantment they bear helps guide their wearer in their motions, to make movement around and over obstacles much more fluid and efficient.
translations: 一双十分坚固却又非常舒适合身的旧钢头皮靴，使用的材料看起来比一般皮靴更柔软透气。靴子所携带的魔法能引导穿戴者移动，使其在通过障碍物时更加迅捷流畅。

messages.msgid: Rugged yet extremely comfortable and well fitting boots of leather with small engraved runes seemingly filled with rubber.  When worn, you are immune to damage from electricity.
translations: 一双十分坚固却又非常舒适合身的旧皮靴，上面雕刻着些似乎充满了橡胶的小型符文。穿上它能让你免疫电击。

messages.msgid: One of the traditional items of the ancient elven warrior societies, these soft leather boots are worked with silver inlays in the shape of vines and leaves.  They allow the wearer to walk in complete silence and move faster when in the wilderness.
translations: 此乃古代精灵战士社会的传统遗物之一。这些柔软的皮靴上饰有藤蔓与绿叶状的银质镶嵌。它们能让穿着者行走时悄无声息，并在荒野中行动自如。

messages.msgid: A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.  Wizards love to name it "Ultima Ratio", describing its colossal might.  Require almost a whole week to restore its charge.
translations: 一个手镯，通体镌刻着大量符文。法师喜欢称之为"最终手段"，用以形容其惊人威力。充能需要将近一周的时间。

messages.msgid: A bracelet, completely covered with a large amount of runes from both sides.  You don't really know how it works, but after use enemies literally freeze in the middle of their movement.  Require almost 7 days to restore its charge.
translations: 一个手镯，内外均完全覆盖着大量魔法符文。你真的不知道它是如何工作的，但使用后敌人还在移动过程中就已经被石化冻结。恢复充能需要将近一周的时间。

messages.msgid: Known as "a worse version of petrification bracelet", this tool casts a spell that temporarily breaks the whole movement system of a creature, disabling its movement for a short time.  Require almost a week to restore its charge.
translations: 又被称为"石化术手镯的更糟糕版本"，这件法器所施放的法术会暂时打断生物的整个移动系统，使其在短时间内无法移动。恢复充能需要将近一周的时间。

messages.msgid: It feels like the world around you just stops.  That's not true, that's just a combination of really fast speed and some mana tricks you can't understand.  Requires a whole week to restore its charge.
translations: 感觉像是你周围的世界停下了。当然，这不是真的，它只是极快的速度和一些你理解不了的魔法技巧的结合。需要一个星期来充能。

messages.msgid: A platinum bracelet covered in runes.  If it was active, it would keep its wearer from casting spells.  Now it's just another useless trinket as you do not know the spells it requires to be activated again.
translations: 一枚遍布符文的铂金手镯。若它被激活，便会禁绝佩戴者的施法能力。但你并不知道激活它所需的咒语，如今它不过是个无用的小玩意罢了。

messages.msgid: A platinum bracelet covered in runes.  It cannot be removed without the appropriate spell and it constantly drains the wearer's mana, preventing them from casting any spell until they get rid of it.
translations: 一枚遍布符文的铂金手镯。若无相应咒语便无法取下，它会持续汲取佩戴者的魔力，令其在摆脱此物前无法施放任何法术。

messages.msgid: A full assembly of medieval arm protection.
translations: 一对源自中世纪的手臂防护的完整集合。

messages.msgid: A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate shield engraved on the top, silver accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a light aura to reduce damage you take.
translations: 一个轻巧而坚固的钢制护腕，顶部刻着华丽的盾牌图案，并用白银突出其错综复杂的设计。它能散发出一道微弱光环保护你全身，减少你所受到的伤害。

messages.msgid: A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate shield engraved on the top, gold accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a strong aura to reduce damage you take.
translations: 一个轻巧而坚固的钢制护腕，顶部刻着华丽的盾牌图案，并用黄金突出其错综复杂的设计。它能散发出一道强力光环保护你全身，减少你所受到的伤害。

messages.msgid: A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate bundle of lightning bolts engraved on the top, silver accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a light aura to reduce electrical damage you take, as well as being able to release a Jolt spell 3 times a day.
translations: 一个轻巧而坚固的钢制护腕，顶部刻着华丽的闪电图案，并用白银突出其错综复杂的设计。它能散发出一道微弱光环保护你全身，减少你所受到的电击伤害，并且能够每日施放三次震颤电击法术。

messages.msgid: A light but extremely sturdy steel bracer with an ornate bundle of lightning bolts engraved on the top, gold accentuates the intricate design.  It protects your body with a strong aura to reduce electrical damage you take, as well as being able to release a Lightning Bolt spell 3 times a day.
translations: 一个轻巧而坚固的钢制护腕，顶部刻着华丽的闪电图案，并用黄金突出其错综复杂的设计。它能散发出一道强力光环保护你全身，减少你所受到的电击伤害，并且能够每日施放三次闪电束法术。

messages.msgid: A set of leather bracers worked with images of arrows in flight and scenes of hunting parties.  Bows you wield will be more accurate and do more damage while you wear these, and you can shoot your arrows farther as well.
translations: 一套皮革臂甲，其上雕饰着飞矢与狩猎队伍的景象。佩戴它时，你所用的弓会更精准，伤害更高，箭矢的射程也更远。

messages.msgid: A pair of light leather bracers with inlays of mithril looking like vines with tiny, leaf-shaped leaves branching off of the vines.  It slightly increases your attack speed at all times, and you may activate it to greatly increase your attack speed for a short time.
translations: 一对轻皮护腕，表面镶嵌着秘银打造的藤蔓纹路，纤细的枝桠上延伸出无数叶形小叶片。它会小幅提升你的攻击速度；激活后，可在短时间内大幅提升攻击速度。

messages.msgid: A magical cloak that shimmers like fresh water under a warm sun.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form that is excellent for swimming, but ill-suited for combat.  You should probably stand in water before you put it on.
translations: 一件魔法斗篷，闪烁的光泽宛如暖阳下的清波。穿上它，你的身体便会变形为极善游弋的形态，但也因此不宜战斗。最好在穿戴前先立于水中。

messages.msgid: A magical cloak that smells of the forest.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form that is strong and resilient in melee combat.  However, you feel as if you would lose a part of yourself.
translations: 一件魔法披风，闻起来仿佛有股森林的气息。穿上它可以使你的身体变形成强壮且能快速回复的熊形态。然而，你的直觉告诉你肯定会失去自己的部分能力。

messages.msgid: A magical cloak that feels soft to the touch.  It can be worn to morph your body to a form well-suited to escaping difficult situations.  However, it is not suited for combat.
translations: 一件魔法披风，摸上去异常的柔软。穿上它可以使你的身体变形成能轻松逃离任何不利环境的鹿形态。然而，这并不适合用来战斗。

messages.msgid: One of the traditional items of the ancient elven warrior societies, this cloth cloak woven with still-living leaves makes its wearer much harder to spot in forests or dense vegetation.  Infamous for their use during the Vietnam War by elves on both sides of the conflict.
translations: 此乃古代精灵战士社会的传统遗物之一。这件布袍以鲜活的树叶织就，能让穿着者在林地或茂密植被中踪迹难寻。在越南战争时期，因冲突双方的精灵皆有使用而臭名昭著。

messages.msgid: A loose silvery iridescent blouse in a style most often associated with pirates and renfaires.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.  This particular one has piratical flairs and glitters with enchantment.
translations: 一件银光闪闪色彩斑斓的宽松上衣，通常与海盗和文艺复兴节联系在一起。当你看着它时，它会闪闪发光。由群勃龙毛纱制成，它有时隐约地映射出在这里事物，有时则不是。这件上有个特别的海盗的标志，闪烁着迷人的光芒。

messages.msgid: A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of silvery iridescent material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.  This particular one has piratical flairs and glitters with enchantment.
translations: 一条制作精良样式古典的宽松马裤，由银光闪闪色彩斑斓的毛纱制成。舒适，但没有口袋。当你看着它时，它会闪闪发光。由群勃龙毛纱制成，它有时隐约地映射出在这里事物，有时则不是。这件上有个特别的海盗的标志，闪烁着迷人的光芒。

messages.msgid: A loose silvery iridescent blouse in a style most often associated with pirates and renfaires.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.
translations: 一件色彩斑斓的宽松上衣，通常与海盗和文艺复兴节联系在一起。当你看着它时，它会闪闪发光。由群勃龙毛纱制成，它有时隐约地映射出在这里事物，有时则不是。

messages.msgid: A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of silvery iridescent material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.  It shimmers as you look at it.  Made of parabolan wool, it sometimes dimly shows reflections of things here and not.
translations: 一条制作精良样式古典的宽松马裤，由色彩斑斓的毛纱制成。舒适，但没有口袋。当你看着它时，它会闪闪发光。由群勃龙毛纱制成，它有时隐约地映射出在这里事物，有时则不是。

messages.msgid: A padded greatcoat assembled by quilting rarely available iridescent wool that was intended as standalone armor, this is half the thickness of a historical gambeson due to the quality of its material.  Famed for its resistance to arrows in olden times, one might wonder how effective it might be against modern projectiles.
translations: 一件由珍稀虹彩羊毛绗缝而成的加厚大衣，其设计本意是作为独立护甲。由于材质上乘，它的厚度仅有传统布面甲的一半。它在古代以抵御箭矢而闻名，不知对现代的抛射物效果如何。

messages.msgid: A thick iridescent wool greatcoat famed for its resistance to arrows in olden times.  Compared to conventional wool, this is much lighter and less warm.  The sleeves are a lot thinner for flexibility and it drapes below your legs, providing additional protection there.
translations: 一件厚实的虹彩羊毛大衣，在古代以抵御箭矢而闻名。与传统羊毛相比，它要轻便许多，也没那么保暖。为了保证灵活性，衣袖做得非常纤薄，衣摆则垂于腿后，提供额外的防护。

messages.msgid: A thick iridescent wool surcoat famed for its resistance to arrows in the olden times.  Compared to conventional wool, this is much lighter and less warm.  It drapes below your legs, providing additional protection there, and it lacks sleeves entirely.
translations: 一件厚实的虹彩羊毛罩袍，在古代以抵御箭矢而闻名。与传统羊毛相比，它要轻便许多，也没那么保暖。衣摆垂于腿后，提供额外的防护，但它完全没有袖子。

messages.plural: pairs of parabolan wool heavy arming pants

messages.msgid: Tough, fairly thick iridescent wool pants worn on their own alongside a gambeson.  These are made of layered wool quilting offering very solid protection, specifically for the purposes of stopping arrows.
translations: 坚韧且相当厚实的虹彩羊毛长裤，可与布面甲一同穿着。此物由层叠的羊毛绗缝而成，能提供非常坚实的防护，尤善抵御箭矢。

messages.plural: pairs of parabolan wool arming mittens

messages.msgid: Thick iridescent wool gauntlets worn in lieu of metal or leather armor.  These are much less encumbering and warm than conventional wool, but they offer excellent protection against arrows.
translations: 厚实的虹彩羊毛护手，可替代金属或皮革护甲。与传统羊毛相比，它们远不那么累赘和闷热，却能提供卓越的箭矢防护。

messages.msgid: A long white coat with several large pockets, with a pentagram on the lapel and a few orichalcum threads sewn into the seams.  Perfect for the stylish-but-effective academic mage.
translations: 一件白色长外套，有几个大口袋，翻领上有一个五角星，接缝处缝着几根山铜线。非常适合时尚但有效的学院派法师。

messages.msgid: A long white coat with several large pockets, with a pentagram on the lapel and orichalcum and mithril threads sewn into the seams.  A director of thaumaturgical research would have worn this or something like this before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一件白色长外套，有几个大口袋，翻领上有五角星，接缝处缝有山铜和秘银线。在大灾难之前，一位风湿病研究主任会穿这个或类似的衣服。

messages.msgid: Rather than using purely wipe media, an additional localized silence spell in this tube quiets gunshots going through to hearing-safe levels.
translations: 除了消音材料之外，这个消音器还含有一个小范围静音法术，能够把枪声降低到对听力安全的水平。

messages.msgid: A small visible-light laser using light shown through a mana crystal that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.  You can rotate the attachment rail to fit under the barrel.
translations: 小型可见激光发射器，使用魔力晶体发射激光，可安装在枪械上，增加命中率与瞄准速度。完全没有缺点——除了增加一点点重量。你可以旋转附挂导轨将其变成枪管下挂瞄具。

messages.msgid: A small visible-light laser using light shown through a mana crystal that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.  You can rotate the attachment rail to fit on the rail.
translations: 小型可见激光发射器，使用魔力晶体发射激光，可安装在枪械上，增加命中率与瞄准速度。完全没有缺点——除了增加一点点重量。你可以旋转导轨将其变成导轨上挂瞄具。

messages.msgid: Adds a blue dot optic made from crystallized mana to the top of your gun, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.
translations: 在你的枪上安装一个使用魔力结晶发光的蓝点瞄具以取代机械瞄准具。提高命中率，增加重量。

messages.msgid: A mask with no facial features at all, just eye and mouth holes, upon activation it makes everything ignore your presence for a while.
translations: 一个除了眼孔和口孔之外没有任何面部特征的面具，激活后，它会使其他生物在一段时间内忽略你的存在。

messages.msgid: A decidedly steampunk-looking half mask that covers the eye area of the face, it has large lenses that correct and greatly enhance the vision of the wearer.
translations: 一个有着明显的蒸汽朋克风的半面具，覆盖在眼部附近，外部有着体积巨大的镜头，能够纠正并大大提高佩戴者的视力。

messages.msgid: A grotesque bone spearhead on a stout wooden pole.  There is a Biomancer rune embedded at the base of the head.
translations: 一根造型奇诡的骨制矛头，固定在一根短粗的木棍之上。在矛头的底部镶有一个生化术士符文。

messages.msgid: A grotesque bone spearhead on a hardened flesh pole.  There is a Biomancer rune embedded in the middle.  You feel this spear squirming in your hand as if alive.
translations: 一个奇怪的骨质矛头生长在坚硬的血肉长杆，中间镶嵌了一个生化术士符文。你觉得这把长矛在你手中不停蠕动，好像还活着一般。

messages.msgid: You feel the spear rapidly contracting and squirming for ranged combat
translations: 你感觉到长矛正在快速收缩和蠕动，变得适合远程战斗。

messages.msgid: This staff incorporates a sturdy crescent wrench on top of a prybar and a hammer on the other in a convenient package.  There is a Technomancer rune embedded in the hammerhead.
translations: 这根法杖由一根撬棍在两端分别加上坚固的月牙形扳手和锤子构成，方便携带。锤头上镶嵌着一个科技法师符文。

messages.msgid: This staff incorporates a sturdy crescent wrench on top of a prybar and a hammer on the other in a convenient package.  There are electronic components in the staff connected to a touchscreen embedded in the staff, you only had time to cram one spell in the prototype software.  There is a Technomancer rune embedded in the hammerhead.
translations: 这根法杖由一根撬棍在两端分别加上坚固的月牙形扳手和锤子构成，方便携带。法杖上的各类电子部件连接到嵌入在法杖之中的触摸屏上，你只能勉强在它的原型系统中编写进一个法术。锤头上镶嵌着一个科技法师符文。

messages.msgid: A quarterstaff with runes carved into it and two glass jars, heat-tempered and infused with mana for durability, to act as mana receptacles.  There are two Magi runes embedded at the tips.
translations: 这根雕刻了符文的长棍上附有两只钢化玻璃罐，注入了魔力以提高耐久度，用于吸收魔力。棍尖上镶嵌有两个魔术师符文。

messages.msgid: A quarterstaff with runes carved into it and two mana pearls at the tip, enchanted with mana for durability.  It fills you with an invigorating sensation.  There are two Magi runes carved into the wood.
translations: 这根长棍上镶嵌了符文，顶端有两颗魔力珍珠，注入了魔力以提高耐久度，握着它能让你感到自己仿佛充满活力。木头上镶嵌有两个魔术师符文。

messages.msgid: A sword with an undulating blade, reminiscent of a flame.  There is a Kelvinist rune embedded in the pommel.
translations: 带有形似火焰的起伏刀刃的剑。剑柄头上镶嵌着一个炽霜法师符文。

messages.msgid: This curved sword, reminiscent of a scimitar, has a handle with an embedded crystal from which a cold wind emanates.  There are Kelvinist runes embedded in the blade.
translations: 这把弯曲的剑的外形与短弯刀相近，剑柄上镶嵌着晶体，寒风从中散发出来。刀锋上镶嵌着一个炽霜法师符文。

messages.msgid: A forged copper axe with silver trimmings and a wooden handle.  There is a Stormshaper rune embedded in the eye.
translations: 一把镶银边的铸造铜斧，装在一根木柄上面。斧柄洞里镶嵌着一个风暴塑造者符文。

messages.msgid: A forged copper hammer-axe with silver trimmings and a wooden handle.  There is a Stormshaper rune embedded in the eye and a Nordic rune reminiscent of Thor, the thunder god, in the hammer side.
translations: 一把镶银边的铸造铜制锤斧，装在一根木柄上面。斧柄洞里镶嵌着一个风暴塑造者符文，在锤侧镶嵌着一个北欧神话符文，让人联想起雷神托尔。

messages.msgid: A steel ritual knife used by Animists to draw blood for summoning.  Their school rune is embedded in the crossguard.
translations: 一把仪式用钢刀，泛灵师用它来放血进行召唤。剑格上面镶嵌着一个泛灵师符文。

messages.msgid: A steel ritual knife used by Animists to draw blood for summoning.  The knife has seen so much bloodshed that the rune at the crossguard seemingly is constantly drenched in blood and gives you preternatural resistance to pain.
translations: 一把仪式用钢刀，泛灵师用它来放血进行召唤。这把刀经历了无数次血祭，以至于剑格上面镶嵌着的泛灵师符文似乎永远被鲜血浸透，这让你对疼痛产生了超自然的抵抗力。

messages.msgid: This versatile weapon uses Technomancy-enhanced springs to keep the staff tips retracted while in baton configuration.  Activate to extend.
translations: 这种多用途武器使用科技魔法增强过的弹簧以保持长杖两端在甩棍模式时收回。激活以展开。

messages.msgid: You snap open your springstaff into staff mode.
translations: 你将弹簧长杖展开成长杖模式。

messages.msgid: This versatile weapon uses Technomancy-enhanced springs to keep the staff tips from retracting while in staff configuration.  Activate to extend.
translations: 这种多用途武器使用科技魔法增强过的弹簧以保持长杖两端在甩棍模式时收回。激活以折叠。

messages.msgid: You collapse your springstaff into baton mode.
translations: 你将弹簧长杖折叠成甩棍模式。

messages.msgid: This is a long and crooked tool used to reap souls, with a skull engraved in its blade.  Magically treated to reduce weight and enhance sharpness, this enchanted weapon is even capable of delivering a strong rupture attack.  Let the harvest begin.
translations: 一把长而弯曲的镰刀，用来收割灵魂，刀片上刻着骷髅头骨。这件魔法武器经过魔法附魔，减轻了重量，增强了锋利度，甚至可以施放强大的魔爆术。让收割开始吧。

messages.msgid: A smooth steel cube the size of your fist.  Several buttons on the sides activate the powers of the cube.
translations: 一个有你拳头大的光滑钢制立方体，上面有数个按钮，能够启动热立方的不同功能。

messages.msgid: You push the torch button and the cube emits a large flame from the top, one that does radiate heat, but won't burn anything.
translations: 你按下火炬按钮，热立方上方随即喷出了一道巨大的火焰。这道火焰会散发热量，但是不会引燃其它物品。

messages.msgid: The heat cube in the torch configuration, where it emits warmth and a bright flame that does not burn.
translations: 热立方目前处于火炬模式，正发出一道温暖的闪耀火焰，却不会引燃其它物品。

messages.msgid: A small gold skeleton key.  You can activate it to unlock locked things.
translations: 一把金制万能钥匙。你可以用它来开锁。

messages.msgid: This is a high quality engraved wooden torch.  On command, the tip bursts into flame and produces a fair amount of light.  It will burn forever.
translations: 这是一个高品质的木雕火炬。根据命令，尖端就会烧起来发出可观的光亮。而它永远不会烧尽。

messages.msgid: You open the flask and discover it full of sweet, sweet, whiskey!
translations: 你打开酒瓶，发现其中已经装满了香甜的威士忌！

messages.msgid: You check the teapot and discover it full of sweet tea!  Sadly, it's cold.
translations: 你检查了一下茶壶，发现里面全是甜茶！遗憾的是，是冷的。

messages.msgid: This is a high quality, engraved steel kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, even a small heating element for melting and joining plastic.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.  It also contains one of those magic spiders that constantly, if slowly, makes new thread.
translations: 一袋装着各种针、几卷线，几把小剪刀，甚至还有用来融化粘合塑料的高品质钢制雕花缝纫套装。可以用它来修改你的衣服和装甲。它主要运用你的裁缝技能。它同时包含一只魔法蜘蛛，能够缓慢但持续地产出新的丝线。

messages.msgid: This is a small glass box that contains a spider that diligently works day and night to produce silk thread that it stores in a reservoir you can open and retrieve it from.
translations: 这是一个装着一只蜘蛛的小玻璃盒。这只蜘蛛日以继夜地产出丝线并储存起来，你打开盒子便可以收集。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load a bolt-action rifle.
translations: 一块体积小巧中有凹槽的金属片，用来让射手为某些栓动步枪快速装弹使用。

messages.msgid: A bow made of multiple materials to maximize energy efficiency.  There are two Druid runes embedded at the tips.
translations: 一把采用多种材料复合制成以增加储能效率的弓。弓背两端镶嵌着两个德鲁伊符文。
M47A1 科技魔法 "美杜莎" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A magically-enhanced update to the Phillips & Rodgers' M47 Medusa, a  multi-caliber revolver aimed at survivalists.  While Technomancy improves the reliability with smaller cartridges, it is not as accurate as dedicated caliber revolvers due to freebore.
translations: 一把经过魔法增强的菲利普斯和罗杰斯公司出品的 M47 "美杜莎"左轮手枪，这把手枪是一把多口径左轮手枪，专为生存主义者定制。虽然科技魔法提高了手枪发射小口径子弹时的可靠性，但由于是滑膛发射，和对应口径的左轮手枪相比命中率还是略低。

messages.msgid: Pistolet modèle Gardes de la Marine
messages.plural: several Pistolet modèle Gardes de la Marine

messages.msgid: These beautifully-made enchanted flintlock pistols were specially made for young noble scions in the Gardes de la Marine.  They still exist today as unspeakably-rare heirlooms that remain combat-worthy due to their magical nature.
translations: 一把制作精良的附魔燧发手枪，专门为海军卫队的年轻贵族子弟制造。它们作为家族珍宝传承至今，因为它们的魔法属性，它们仍然能用来作战。

messages.msgid: Constructed similarly to a falcata, this forward-sloping blade has a short-barrel pump shotgun attached to the blade's spine for finishing blows or a first strike.
translations: 它的结构类似于一把伊比利亚短剑，这把向前倾斜的短刀上有一把短筒泵动式霰弹枪，连接在刀背上，以终结对手或先发打击。

messages.msgid: A modernized version of the Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 by Cannith Industries, chambered in 7.62x51 NATO.  The barrel is enchanted to give bullets a minor freezing property.
translations: 一把由坎尼斯工业公司改进的现代版莫辛纳甘1891/30步枪，使用7.62x51 NATO弹。枪管被施了魔法，子弹具有轻微的冰冻特性。

messages.msgid: Once a flesh spear, now a grotesque pipe like object with an barrel made from bone and coated in flesh.  There is an biomancer rune embedded in the tooth like trigger.  Uses sharpened bone as an ammo.
translations: 曾经是根肉矛，现在是一种奇怪的管状物体，连接着一个由骨头制成的枪管，上面覆盖着血肉。牙齿状枪机上镶嵌着一个生化术士符文。使用磨尖骨头作为弹药。

messages.msgid: You feel the spear rapidly contracting and squirming for close combat
translations: 你感觉到长矛正在快速收缩和蠕动，变得适合近战。

messages.msgid: A sharp bone, you wonder why someone had the trouble to make this.
translations: 一根锋利的骨头，天知道是谁自找麻烦做了这玩意出来。

messages.msgid: One of the traditional items of the ancient elven warrior societies, this bow is enchanted to fire further, hit harder, and last longer than any normal wooden bow of its design could.  Before the Cataclysm they were still made in small quantities for ceremonial purposes but no longer saw battlefield use, since the special forces of Tokoyo, Hy-Brasil, Alfheim, and the other elven nations long ago switched to using firearms.
translations: 此乃古代精灵战士社会的传统遗物之一。这把弓经过附魔，比任何同设计的普通木弓射程更远、威力更强、更为经久耐用。大灾变前，人们仍会为仪式之用而少量制造，但早已退出战场，因为东京、巴西岛、阿尔弗海姆及其他精灵国度的特种部队，很早以前就转而使用枪械了。

messages.msgid: A thin copper band ring, engraved with a single sealed scroll.  Increases mana capacity slightly.
translations: 一枚纤细的铜质指环，表面刻有一卷封存的卷轴。略微提升魔力容量。

messages.msgid: A thin silver band ring, engraved with two sealed scrolls.  Increases mana capacity somewhat.
translations: 一枚纤细的银质指环，表面刻有两卷封存的卷轴。一定程度提升魔力容量。

messages.msgid: A thin gold band ring, engraved with a bound book.  Increases mana capacity moderately.
translations: 一枚纤细的金质指环，表面刻有一本封存的书。中等提升魔力容量。

messages.msgid: A thin platinum band ring, engraved with two bound books.  Increases mana capacity greatly.
translations: 一枚纤细的金质指环，表面刻有两本封存的书。大幅提升魔力容量。

messages.msgid: An ornate silver ring engraved with daggers that conjures three mundane throwing knives on activation.
translations: 一枚华丽的银制戒指，上面刻着匕首。它被激活时能够在你手中召唤出三把普通的飞刀。

messages.msgid: A thin silver band ring, depicting an eel coiled on itself.  Allows you to dodge an extra attack per turn.
translations: 一个轻薄的银戒指，上面画着一条鳗鱼。让你每回合额外闪避一次攻击。

messages.msgid: A thin gold band ring, depicting a bicephalous eel coiled on itself.  Allows you to dodge two extra attacks per turn.
translations: 一个轻薄的金戒指，上面画着一条盘绕在自己身上的双头鳗鱼。让你每回合额外闪避两次攻击。

messages.msgid: A copper ring that makes you a little stronger when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铜戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己稍微强壮了一些。

messages.msgid: A silver ring that makes you a good bit stronger when you wear it.
translations: 一枚银戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己强壮了不少。

messages.msgid: A golden ring that makes you surprisingly stronger when you wear it.
translations: 一枚金戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己更加强壮了。

messages.msgid: A platinum ring that makes you much stronger when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铂金戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己非常强壮。

messages.msgid: A copper ring that makes you a little more agile when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铜戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己稍微灵敏了一些。

messages.msgid: A silver ring that makes you a good bit more agile when you wear it.
translations: 一枚银戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己灵敏了不少。

messages.msgid: A golden ring that makes you surprisingly more agile when you wear it.
translations: 一枚金戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己更加灵敏了。

messages.msgid: A platinum ring that makes you much more agile when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铂金戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己非常灵敏。

messages.msgid: A copper ring that makes you a little more intelligent when you wear it.

messages.msgid: A platinum ring that makes you much more perceptive when you wear it.

messages.msgid: A platinum ring that makes you much faster when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铂金戒指，戴上它让你觉得自己非常迅捷。

messages.msgid: A copper ring that reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铜戒指，戴上后能够减轻你受到的部分伤害。

messages.msgid: A silver ring that appreciably reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
translations: 一枚银戒指，戴上之后能够显著减轻你所受到的伤害。

messages.msgid: A golden ring that greatly reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
translations: 一枚金戒指，戴上之后能够大大减轻你所受到的伤害。

messages.msgid: A platinum ring that vastly reduces some of the force of damage you take when you wear it.
translations: 一枚铂金戒指，戴上之后能够极大减轻你所受到的伤害。

messages.msgid: A glistening ring holding a small dimensional space inside.  Can store only a little but you can draw items instantly.
translations: 一个闪闪发光的内含乾坤的戒指。只能存储体积很小的物品，但你可以将其瞬间取出。
选择要放入戒指的物品

messages.msgid: A glistening ring holding a small dimensional space inside.  Capable of storing a medium-sized weapon you can draw instantly.
translations: 一个闪闪发光的内含乾坤的戒指。可以存储一把中型武器，而且能将其瞬间取出。

messages.msgid: A crimsonite ring with a dappled pattern that protects you from fire.
translations: 一枚带有斑驳花纹的绯红石戒指，可护佑你免受烈焰侵袭。

messages.msgid: A platinum ring that allows you fly for a short time each day, and prevents fall damage while worn.
translations: 一枚铂金戒指，能让你每日飞行片刻，并在佩戴期间免受坠落伤害。

messages.msgid: A golden ring that greatly reduces your need to eat, drink, or sleep while it is worn.  It will do nothing for feelings of hunger, and it requires a full day of being worn for the magic to take effect.
translations: 一枚金戒指，佩戴时可大幅减少你对食物、水分和睡眠的需求。然而，它无法消除饥饿感，并且需要连续佩戴一整天后才能生效。

messages.msgid: A large silver coin that, when activated by uttering the word on the back, turns into the item pictured on the front, in this case a longsword.
translations: 一大枚银币。当念出硬币背面的文字时，它会变成正面图案内的物品，比如说这枚上面的长剑。

messages.msgid: You say the command word engraved on the token, and it rapidly grows and morphs into a shiny pristine longsword!
translations: 你念出硬币上篆刻的咒文，它迅速增大，化作了一把闪亮的崭新长剑！

messages.msgid: A heavy metal guard that covers the fist and increases striking power, with stout padding underneath to protect the wearers hand.  It has been enchanted to emit dark magical flames that only harm enemies.
translations: 一只沉重的金属护手，套在拳头上可以增加打击力度，下方增加了结实的衬垫保护穿戴者的手不受伤害。这只拳套被附过魔，发出只会伤害敌人的黑暗魔法火焰。

messages.msgid: A large gleaming metal gauntlet covered in magical symbols that allows you to land astoundingly powerful blows.
translations: 一对闪闪发光的金属护手，上面覆盖着魔法符文，使你可以使出威力无穷的拳击。

messages.msgid: A stone battle glove with carved runes encasing the hand, protecting it while increasing striking power.  There is an Earthshaper rune embedded in the palm.
translations: 一个石制手套，上面围绕手的四周刻着符文，保护手的同时增强打击力量。手套的掌心镶嵌着塑地者符文。

translations: 一根细长的木制法杖，在底端有一个魔力晶体插槽，激活时会施放一次法术。这根法杖发射的是魔法飞弹。

messages.msgid: pair of magical armored stone gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of magical armored stone gauntlets

messages.msgid: A magical flexible stonelike substance for protection and attack.
translations: 一种柔韧的石头状魔法物质，用于保护和攻击。

messages.msgid: This is a small flame you can hold in your hand.  With a thought, you can cause it to light something on fire, or you can throw it to ignite something flammable.
translations: 这是一团可以握在手里的火焰。通过意念，你可以让它来点火，或者把它扔出去来点燃可燃物。

messages.msgid: Small electric spark, that does not disappear under your force.  With a thought, you can cause it to light something on fire, or you can throw it to ignite something flammable.
translations: 微小的电火花，在你的力量下不至消失。只需一个念头，可使其点燃某些东西，或者你可以扔出它来引燃什么易燃物。

messages.msgid: A magical light source that will light up a small area.
translations: 一盏魔法灯，能照亮一小块区域。

messages.msgid: A small magical light that you can read by.
translations: 一盏小型魔法灯，能让你阅读书籍。

messages.msgid: A lightweight but tough shield crafted entirely of magical ice.
translations: 一个轻巧但坚硬的盾牌，完全是用魔法冰组成的。

messages.msgid: A magical slick icy coating on your feet.  While quite fast on flat floors, they make it difficult to move on rough terrain.
translations: 你的脚上有一层魔法形成的光滑冰层。虽然在平坦的地面上速度相当快，但在崎岖的地形上很难移动。

messages.msgid: A crackling magical warhammer full of lightning to smite your foes with, and of course, to smash things to bits!
translations: 一个充满闪电的魔法战锤，用闪电击打你的敌人。当然，也可以把东西砸成碎片！

messages.msgid: A long, writhing, tentacle covered in sharp bonelike blades and spikey protrusions.
translations: 一条长而扭曲的触须，上面覆盖着锋利的骨质刀片和尖刺状突起。

messages.msgid: A long whip made of blue-hot magical flames.  The heat is horrendous when touching an enemy.
translations: 由炽热的魔法烈焰制成的长鞭。当它接触敌人时会释放出可怕的酷热。

messages.msgid: A large pouch of tough flesh on your back, filled with tiny tentacles that grasp and hold anything you place inside.  It shifts and adjusts itself to minimize encumbrance.
translations: 你的背上长出了一个坚硬的肉袋子，里面有细小的触手，可以抓住你放在里面的任何东西。它们不断改变和调整自己，以减少累赘。

messages.msgid: This is a wicked spear/halberd hybrid entirely created of bone.
translations: 这是一柄邪恶的长矛，完全是由骨头组成的。

messages.msgid: A magically conjured ornate recurve bow of solid flexible wood.  A matching conjured wooden arrow appears when you draw the string back for firing.
translations: 一把魔法生成的华丽反曲弓。由结实而有弹性的木料制成，拉开弓弦就会自动生成一只箭。

messages.msgid: A magically conjured quiver, marvelously light and easy to wear despite the arrows it holds.
translations: 一个用魔法召唤出来的箭筒，虽然里面装着箭，但却出奇的轻巧，而且佩戴方便。

messages.msgid: A magically conjured quiver, marvelously light and easy to wear despite the arrows it holds.  This is an enhanced version, created by your increased mastery of the spell.
translations: 一个用魔法召唤出来的箭筒，虽然里面装着箭，但却出奇的轻巧，而且佩戴方便。这是你通过精通法术创造出来的增强版。

messages.msgid: A magically conjured arrow made of twisted wood.
translations: 一支扭曲木头组成的魔法箭。

messages.msgid: A arrow that looks more like it was grown than carved.  Despite that, it flies straight and true.  It explodes into a mass of entangling vegetation when it hits its target.
translations: 这支箭看起来更像是天生生长而不是雕刻成这样的。尽管如此，它飞得又直又准。当它击中目标时，它会爆炸成一团缠绕的植被。

messages.msgid: A magical seed that can be squeezed to release purifying dust, which can then be used to purify up to a gallon of water.
translations: 这个魔法种子被挤压后会释放出净化粉末，能够用于净化一加仑的水。（一加仑约为3.785升）

messages.msgid: You squeeze the seed in your palm, and it begins to turn to a fine dust.
translations: 你挤压掌中的种子，它们开始变成粉末。

messages.msgid: This handful of fine dust glows with a growing intensity.
translations: 这一小撮微尘发出越来越强烈的光芒。

messages.msgid: A magical powder that can be scattered on growing crops to make them grow faster.
translations: 一种魔法粉末，可以撒在正在生长的庄稼上，让它们长得更快。

messages.msgid: A thin layer of magical ice, covering the entire body.  It doesn't provide much armor, instead dealing significant damage to enemies that try to attack you.
translations: 一层覆盖全身的魔法冰霜。它不提供护甲，而是会对试图攻击你的敌人造成大量伤害。

messages.msgid: A thin layer of shifting, almost fluid living rock, covering the entire body.
translations: 一层覆盖全身的薄薄的不断移动的岩石，仿佛是有生命的液体一般。

messages.msgid: Ouch, this really smarts!  It'll go away soon, maybe?
translations: 哎哟，这可是太聪明了！也许它很快就会消退？

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing, invisible layer of magical aura that protects you from the environment.
translations: 一个覆盖全身的肉眼无法看见的环境防护光环。

messages.msgid: The manifestation of your rage.  It won't disappear until you calm down.
translations: 你内心怒火的具象形态。在你冷静下来之前会一直存在。

messages.msgid: This wooden sword is ablaze!  It seems to be safe-ish to hold, but will burn up soon.
translations: 这把木剑被点燃了！它的握把看上去还挺安全的，但剑身很快就会烧光。

messages.msgid: A pulsating club made of bone, stained with an ever-moving blood coating eager to absorb the living.
translations: 一根不停搏动的骨棒，覆盖着一层不断移动的渴望吞噬活物的血液涂层。

messages.msgid: A leather sling, quivering with energy when in your palm to the point of almost tearing.  A pebble appears when you begin spinning it.
translations: 一根皮革投索，其中蕴含的能量让它在你掌中不停颤抖到几乎要被撕裂的程度。当你开始甩动它时，一枚石子会凭空出现在其中。

messages.msgid: You have become the werewolf.  Boys becoming men, men becoming wolves.
translations: 你变身成了狼人。男孩变成男人，男人变成狼人。

messages.msgid: An aura of black and green draconic energy, swirling around your body protecting you and punishing those who strike you.
translations: 一层包含着龙族魔力的黑绿色光环，在你的身体周围盘旋，保护你，并且惩罚任何胆敢攻击你的人。

messages.msgid: Claws made from ice, able to freeze on contact while mauling foes.  You, however, feel only a slight chill on your hands.
translations: 由冰制成的爪子。能让你在攻击时冻住敌人，而你不过是觉得手上稍稍有点冷罢了。

messages.msgid: A summoned magic armor.  It gets shinier and sturdier with each spell level and is affected by your intelligence.
translations: 一个被召唤出的魔法盔甲。它会随着每个法术等级变得更加闪亮和坚固,并受到你的智力影响。

messages.msgid: A three-liter container made out of transparent force.  Can be used to store liquids.
translations: 一个用透明魔法力量构成的三公升容器。可以用来储存液体。

messages.msgid: This is a summoned mana sword, between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords in size.  It glows shiny, and its edge is sharper the more spell level and intelligence you have.
translations: 响应召唤而来的魔力剑，尺寸介于轻型武装剑和现代双手剑之间。它闪闪发光，你的法术等级与智力越高，它的边缘就越锋利。

messages.msgid: A sturdy shell that wraps your body, granting a sturdy defense.
translations: 一件结实的外壳紧紧包裹着你的身体，提供了坚固的防护。

messages.msgid: A small, capsule-shaped field containing a stable portal to the sun.  You can feel solar energy radiating from it, and it saturates your body.
translations: 一个小巧的球形形状的领域，内含通往太阳的稳定传送门。你可以感受到从其中散发出的太阳能量，它浸润着你的全身。

messages.msgid: You cover the pocket sun, and now the gap doesn't emit light.
translations: 你把口袋太阳盖起来，现在缝隙中不再发光了。

messages.msgid: A small, capsule-shaped field containing a stable portal to the sun.  It is currently covered.
translations: 一个小型胶囊状的力场，其中包含了一个通向太阳的稳定传送门。它被盖起来了。

messages.msgid: You remove the cover on the pocket sun, and now the gap emits light again.
translations: 你把口袋太阳的盖子拆开，现在缝隙中再次发出了光。

messages.msgid: A small ethereal pocket located under your left arm.  You can store your potions here, but it seems it has no real limitations.
translations: 左臂下的无形小口袋。你可以在它里面存储药剂，但它看起来没有真正的限制。

messages.msgid: A thin and flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations:
一个细薄而扁平的投掷用小刀。它没有刀刃，而且形状也很怪异，这让它无法作为工具使用。
"The world！"

messages.msgid: A thin and flat knife made for throwing, wrapped in ethereal flames.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations: 一个细薄而扁平的投掷用小刀，被永恒燃烧的魔法火焰包裹着。它没有刀刃，而且形状也很怪异，这让它无法作为工具使用。

messages.msgid: A thin and flat knife made for throwing, emanating frigid cold.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations: 一个细薄而扁平的投掷用小刀，被刺骨的魔法冰寒包裹着。它没有刀刃，而且形状也很怪异，这让它无法作为工具使用。

messages.msgid: A thin and flat knife with wide edge made for throwing, seems unnaturally sharp.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations: 一个细薄而扁平的投掷用小刀，看上去异常锋利。它没有刀刃，而且形状也很怪异，这让它无法作为工具使用。

messages.msgid: A thin and flat knife made for throwing, made of porous substance and covered in dark ooze.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations: 一个细薄而扁平的投掷用小刀，由多孔物质制成，覆盖着黑色浓稠物质。它没有刀刃，而且形状也很怪异，这让它无法作为工具使用。

messages.msgid: A transparent blade that seems to radiate intent to be thrown.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.
translations: 一把透明的刀刃，散发着挥之即投的意念。它的刀刃切割效率低下，而且形状也很怪异，这让它不适合作为工具使用。

messages.msgid: Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common hammer.
translations: 你使用魔法塑形后，此工具可以当锤子使用。

messages.msgid: Your hammer transforms into a pickaxe!
Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common pickaxe.
translations: 你使用魔法塑形后，此工具可以当镐子使用。

messages.msgid: Your pickaxe transforms into an ax!
Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common axe.
translations: 你使用魔法塑形后，此工具可以当斧子使用。

messages.msgid: Your ax transforms into a knife!
Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common knife.
translations: 你使用魔法塑形后，此工具可以当刀子使用。

messages.msgid: Your knife transforms into a shovel!
Shaped with your own magic, this tool has the same abilities as the common shovel.
translations: 你使用魔法塑形后，此工具可以当铲子使用。

messages.msgid: Your shovel transforms into a hammer!
Now you can breath under water, like a fish.
translations: 现在你能像鱼一样在水下呼吸了。

messages.msgid: These two tiny shields on your temples should protect your mind from outside influences
translations: 你太阳穴上的这两个小防护罩应该会保护你的大脑不受外界影响

messages.msgid: The tiny shields all over your body should protect your mind from outside influences and your body from being moved by outside magic
translations: 遍布周身的微小护盾，既能守护心神免受外界侵扰，亦可保护躯体不被外部魔法所移动。

messages.msgid: A mixture of bark, moss, and leaves, glowing softly with verdant energy.
translations: 树皮、苔藓和树叶的混合物，散发出柔和的绿光。

messages.msgid: A magically-summoned aetherspeaker, capable of communicating long-distance with other aetherspeakers or conventional radios.  With a command word, it may instead scan for radio signals.
translations: 一台用魔法召唤出来的以太对讲机，能与其他以太对讲机或传统无线电进行远距离通信。通过命令词，可以让它对无线电信号进行扫描。

messages.msgid: An aetherspeaker tuned to listen for radio signals from the surrounding area.  With a command word, it may change frequency or switch to communicating with other aetherspeakers or radios.
translations: 一台用于用于收听周围区域无线电信号的以太扬对讲机。使用命令词，可以改变频率或切换模式与其他以太对讲机、无线电通信。

messages.msgid: A smoothly-curved conglomeration of mana, humming softly as it provides power.
translations: 光滑弯曲的魔力聚集体，在提供能量时发出轻轻的嗡嗡声。

messages.msgid: Your hands can spark with electricity powerful enough to heat metal to searing temperatures and weld it together.  You can also zap the undead with it.
translations: 你的手可以产生足够强大的电流，将金属加热到灼热的温度并将其焊接在一起。你还可以用它来攻击不死者。

messages.msgid: A twisted wooden spear whose branches twine together into a vicious point sticky with sap.
translations: 一根扭曲的木矛，其树枝缠绕在一起，形成一个粘满树液、杀气 腾腾的矛头。

messages.msgid: Your skin is bark-like and covered in thorns.
translations: 你的皮肤像树皮一样，布满荆棘。

messages.msgid: Your fingers are a series of knives made of bone and flesh.  Enemies beware.
translations: 你的手指是一串骨头和肉做成的刀。敌人可有得受了。

messages.msgid: Covered in magical seaweed, you can travel and breathe underwater as long as this spell is in effect.
translations: 魔法海藻覆盖着你的身体，只要此法术生效，你便能在水下畅行呼吸。

messages.msgid: A large, hollow sphere of ice.  Food placed inside will not rot.
translations: 一个巨大的寒冰空心球体。存储在里面的食物很难腐坏。

messages.msgid: Think as the bear.  Move as the bear.  Sleep as the bear.
A bone from some creature or other, inhabited by benevolent spirits.
translations: 不知是何种生物的骨头，其中栖宿着仁善的精魂。

messages.msgid: This lens has been etched with small symbols and infused with mana.  Holding it up to your eye allows you to see further than any mundane binoculars allow.
translations: 这枚透镜上蚀刻着细小的符号，并被注入了魔力。将它举至眼前，便能看到比任何寻常望远镜所及更远之处。

messages.msgid: A set of magical berries.  They look absolutely delicious.
translations: 一把魔法浆果。它们看起来肯定很美味。

messages.msgid: Blood of a dragon, it radiates warmth and looking at it you see moving patterns form and disappear in it as if looking at an actual fire.
translations: 采自龙身上的血。它散发着热量，呈现出火焰般变化的纹理。

messages.msgid: Blood that is filled to the brim with arcane energy.  It releases a faint blue glow.
translations: 充满了魔法能量的血液。它发出微弱的蓝光。

messages.msgid: A tall, homemade candelabra that holds multiple everburning torches.  You could set it up somewhere to kindle the torches and provide light.
translations: 一个自制的高大火炬台，上面插着多根不灭火炬。你可以把它放在某处，点燃火把提供照明。

messages.msgid: This is a high quality engraved wooden torch, placed into a wood and metal sconce and ready to be attached to a wall.  It will burn forever with a smokeless light.  Now you can light your wizard's ritual room in the traditional fashion.
translations: 这是一个高品质的雕刻木制火炬，装在一个木头、金属制造的壁灯中，可以固定在墙上。 它将永远燃烧，发出无烟的光。 现在，你可以用传统方式为法师的仪式室照明了。

messages.msgid: This is a beautiful, non-scale model of the solar system.  A complex series of gears allows the relative motions of the planets to be studied at the turn of a crank.  You could set this up somewhere to decorate.
translations: 一套漂亮的非真实比例太阳系模型。一系列复杂的齿轮使你能在摇柄转动时进行行星相对运动的研究。你可以把它放在什么地方作为装饰。

messages.msgid: A smallish patch of iridescent felt; could be disassembled for parabolan wool fiber.
translations: 小块的色彩斑斓的毛毡片，可以拆解出群勃龙毛纱。

messages.msgid: Parabolan wool yarn; could be used to knit iridescent wool clothing.
translations: 群勃龙毛纱；可用于编织色彩斑斓的毛线服装。

messages.msgid: This strange plant feels slightly oily and smells odd.  The smell seems to change slowly, from loamy earth to a rich vegetal smell to something acrid that burns your nose to an herbal scent, with no discernable pattern.  You're not sure what this is.
translations: 这种奇怪的植物摸起来有点油腻，闻起来也很奇怪。 气味似乎在慢慢变化，从泥土味到浓郁的植物味，再到烧鼻子的刺鼻味，再到草药味，没有明显的规律。 你不确定这是什么。

messages.msgid: A fractal corolla winds inward in mathematical harmony, reflecting beauty in its ideal form.
translations: 一个分形的花冠在数学的和谐中向内蜿蜒，反映了其理想形式的美。

messages.msgid: A handful of moonflowers glitter like tiny stars and faintly smell of morning dew.  Properly harvested, they will never wilt or wither.
translations: 一把月光花像小星星一样闪闪烁烁，还带着淡淡的晨露气味。只要采摘的方法正确，它们就永远不会枯萎。

messages.msgid: A small rod of curled white petals, delicately shielding toxic pollen that will lead to an agonizing, if mercifully quick death.  Infamously used by romantic assassins, when an artistic death is deemed more important than practicality.
translations: 一根由卷曲的白色花瓣组成的小棒，巧妙地保护着有毒的花粉，这将导致痛苦的——但也是仁慈的快速死亡。在浪漫的刺客间声名狼藉，他们认为艺术性的死亡比实用性更重要。

messages.msgid: Dark colored leaves and bitter roots, firmly tied together in a small sheaf.  It's not toxic, but many people have died trying to taste it, due to the airway obstruction.
translations: 一小捆草穗，由深色的叶子和苦味的根牢牢捆在一起扎成。草穗本身无毒，但很多人在品尝它的时候因呼吸道阻塞死亡。

messages.msgid: Slim stripes cut from a bioluminescent mushroom, still surrounded by a faint glowing aura.
translations: 从发光蘑菇上切下的长条，仍然被微弱的光环所包围。

messages.msgid: Pure white moss capsules, shaped like a goat's horn.  The fine spores contained within are a powerful magical reagent, and can be consumed to recover small amounts of health.
translations: 纯白色的苔藓孢子囊，形状像山羊的角。其中包含的细小孢子是一种强大的魔法试剂，食用后可以恢复少量健康。

messages.msgid: Stalks cut from a golden reed.  They have a strong, spiced aroma.
translations: 从金芦苇上剪下的茎秆，具有强烈的香料味。

messages.msgid: Heavy wooden shells surrounding a diminutive white fruit.
translations: 沉重的木质外壳，包裹着一个微小的白色果仁。

messages.msgid: Knife sharp thorns from a dragonail bush.  Eating them raw would be a dangerous challenge.
translations: 来自龙尾丛的荆棘，像刀一样锋利。生吃它们将是一个危险的挑战。

messages.msgid: The black root of a moly plant, extracted from the ground through great effort.  Rumored to grant protection to those who consume it.
translations: 雪滴草的黑色根部，费很大功夫才从地下挖出。据说可以为食用者提供保护。

messages.msgid: A small flower cut from a fern, it has a faint honeyed aroma.  Believed to bring good luck to whoever finds it.
translations: 从蕨类植物上剪下来的小花，有一种淡淡的蜂蜜香味。人们相信能给找到它的人带来好运。

messages.msgid: Large chunks of funnelcap meat, still leaking fine amounts of clear sap.
translations: 大块的漏斗菇组织，仍在渗出细密的透明汁液。

messages.msgid: A red puffball flower cut from a sojourner's palm.  When wind wafts between its petals, you can hear the sounds of faraway places.
translations: 一朵从行者棕榈上剪下的红色蓬蓬花。当风在它的花瓣间飘荡时，你可以听到遥远地方的声音。

messages.msgid: A pink whisk shaped flower with a powerful alcoholic smell.
translations: 一种粉红色拂尘状的花，具有强烈的酒精味。

messages.msgid: A set of goblin teeth, small but needle-sharp.
translations: 一排哥布林牙齿，牙齿小而尖利。

messages.msgid: A set of lizardfolk teeth, made for biting chunks of out their prey.
translations: 一排蜥族牙齿，为切割猎物而生。

messages.msgid: You have a majestic crown of antlers.
translations: 你生出了一顶雄伟的鹿角王冠。

messages.msgid: Your scales have grown to cover your hands and elongate the tips in to jagged claws that can be serviceable as cutting and piercing weapons in unarmed combat.
translations: 你的鳞片已生长至覆盖双手，指尖也随之伸长，化为锯齿状的利爪，可在徒手格斗中充当切割与穿刺的武器。

messages.msgid: All of your fingers have developed into huge scaled talons.  They prevent wearing gloves, but you can use them to powerful effect in melee combat and you appear to have uncovered some secrets about black dragons.
translations: 你的手指都变成了巨大的利爪。这让你穿不了手套，但它们在近战战斗中能造成强大伤害，而且这似乎让你领悟了一些黑龙的秘密法术。

messages.msgid: Thin but as tough as titanium, your draconic black scale can even withstand bullets from small firearms
translations: 你的龙族黑鳞薄如蝉翼，却坚逾钛金，甚至能抵御小型枪械的子弹。

messages.msgid: The damage done and light emitted by this sword increase with intelligence.
translations: 这把剑所造成的伤害和释放的光芒随着智力的增加而增加。

messages.msgid: This magical armor improves with your intelligence and the spell's level.
translations: 这种魔法护甲会随着智力和咒语等级的提高而增强。

messages.msgid: A magical hammer whose damage increases with the spell.
translations: 一把魔法锤子，其伤害会随着法术的增加而增加。

messages.msgid: A coating of lighting on your hand and lower arm.
translations: 在你的手和下臂上涂一层光源。

messages.msgid: Icy talons to freeze your enemies.
translations: 冰爪可以冻结你的敌人。

messages.msgid: The spirits within are giving you their blessing.
translations: 其中的精灵对你施加了祝福。

messages.msgid: Looking through your enchanted lens allows you to see farther than ever.
translations: 你被祝福的眼瞳让你看得比以前更远。

messages.msgid: Some crystallized mana.  This can be reloaded into rechargeable mana crystals, but can never be unloaded.
translations: 一些结晶化的魔力。能被装进可复装的魔力晶体，但无法再抽取出来。

messages.msgid: This is a small mana crystal specifically designed to be attached to wand tips.
translations: 这是一个小型魔力晶体，专门被设计用来存储魔杖所需的能量。

messages.msgid: Mjölnir, the legendary hammer of Thor.  It is rumored to be able to level mountains with a single blow.  You feel the power of Asgard coursing through the hammer.
translations: 妙尔尼尔，传说中雷神索尔使用的锤子。据传只要一击就能把整座大山夷为平地。你能通过锤子感受到来自仙宫阿斯加德的力量。

messages.msgid: Gungnir, the spear of Odin.  It is rumored to be the perfect spear, perfectly hitting any target regardless of the wielder's strength or skill.  It feels like Odin's protecting you.
translations: 冈格尼尔，传说中北欧众神之父奥丁使用的长矛。据传它是完美的长矛，无论持用者的力量或技能如何，它都能完美地击中任何目标。拿着它让你有种被奥丁守护的感觉。

messages.msgid: Gram, the sword of Sigurd.  It is rumored to be the sword that slayed the legendary dragon, Fafnir.  Once said to have cleaved Regin's anvil in half, the edge is impeccable.
translations: 格拉墨，传说中英雄齐格鲁德使用的魔剑。据传是斩杀传说中恶龙法夫尼尔的剑。据说曾将侏儒雷金的铁砧劈成两半，它的剑刃无懈可击。

messages.msgid: Laevateinn, the staff of Loki.  Said to have been plucked from the gates of Hel by Loki.  Imbued with a mysterious magic, the magic of the trickster god himself.
translations: 列瓦汀；来自古诺尔斯语。传说中火与诡计之神(亦是谎言之神)的洛基使用的魔杖，所以又名灾厄之杖。由洛基在海拉的冥界之门前所铸，收藏于绝望之箱之中由辛玛拉保管。但与丰饶之神弗德的胜利之剑和火巨人苏尔特尔所持的炎之魔剑为并不为同一物。这柄符文大剑充满了神秘的魔力，来自欺诈之神自己所赋予的魔咒。

messages.msgid: A variant of the combat knife that is made of orichalcum instead of steel.  Sharper and easier to maintain than steel while just as dense, this knife also has a thinner blade, which shaves off some weight.
translations: 一把由山铜而不是钢材制成的战术匕首。山铜制品比钢更锋利，更容易维护，虽然密度和钢一样，但它的刀刃更薄，减少了自身的重量。

messages.msgid: A variant of the longsword that is made of orichalcum instead of steel.  Sharper and easier to maintain than steel while just as dense, this longsword also has a thinner blade, which shaves off some weight.
translations: 一把由山铜而不是钢材制成的长剑。山铜制品比钢更锋利，更容易维护，虽然密度和钢一样，但它的剑刃更薄，减少了自身的重量。

messages.msgid: A fire axe made with orichalcum instead of steel.  This makes it possible to chop through harder materials, and in the very well-funded fire stations is preferred.
translations: 一把由山铜而不是钢材制成的消防斧。这让它能够砍开更坚硬的材质，成为资金非常充足的消防局的首选消防斧。

messages.msgid: Wolfsbane pikes are generally antiques brought over from Europe.  Forged during the days when the Black Forest went from France to Transylvania, these spears targeted the Loup Garou that were weak against fire.
translations: 狼牙棒通常是从欧洲带来的古董。这些长矛是在黑森林能从法国一直覆盖到特兰西瓦尼亚的时期铸造的，用来对抗那些怕火的狼人。

messages.msgid: This is a classic medieval sword, the size being in-between the lighter arming sword and later two-handed swords.  Thanks to the mysterious silvery metal it was forged from, it is stronger than tempered steel while weighing substantially less.
translations: 这是一把经典的中世纪长剑，大小介于轻型武装剑和后来的双手剑之间。由于它是由秘银金属锻造而成，它比回火钢更坚固，但重量要轻得多。

messages.msgid: A lump of raw orichalcum.  Needs to be reformed into an ingot to be useful.
translations: 一块未经过处理的山铜。需要先将其打造成锭才能进一步使用。

messages.msgid: A sliver of orichalcum broken from a larger piece.  Needs to be reformed into an ingot to be useful.
translations: 一块未经过处理的山铜碎片。需要先将其打造成锭才能进一步使用。

messages.msgid: An ingot of orichalcum.  About 3cm by 7cm by 12cm in size, ready to be used for various blacksmithing tasks.
translations: 一块山铜锭。约有3x7x12厘米大小，能够被用来锻造成各种物品。

messages.msgid: A lump of raw mithril.  Needs to be reformed into an ingot to be useful.
translations: 一块秘银原材。需要被改造成锭来使用。

messages.msgid: An ingot of mithril.  About 3cm by 7cm by 12cm in size, ready to be used for various blacksmithing tasks.
translations: 一块秘银锭。约有3x7x12厘米大小，能被用于各种锻造任务。

messages.msgid: An ingot of crimsonite.  About 3cm by 7cm by 12cm in size, ready to be used for various blacksmithing tasks.
translations: 一块绯红石锭。尺寸约为3厘米 x 7厘米 x 12厘米，可用于各类锻造任务。

messages.msgid: A very concentrated form of mana potion.
translations: 一种高度浓缩的魔法药剂。

messages.msgid: A mana potion mixed with mutagen.  It might help you connect with magic.
translations: 一瓶混合了诱变剂的魔法药剂。它可能会帮助你与魔法建立联系。

messages.msgid: An alchemic concoction made from the remains of a slain black dragon and a bit of potion base.  Ancient and Academic texts talk of profound changes from consuming this.
translations: 一份炼金药剂，使用一条被杀的黑龙的残骸和一点药剂基料制成。古籍和学术文献都谈及喝下它所带来的深刻转变。

messages.msgid: A super-concentrated mutagen that seems to swirl with the anger of a black dragon.  Do you dare leave your humanity behind and inject it?
translations: 超浓缩的诱变剂，看起来充满了黑龙的怒火。你胆敢挑战放弃人性来注射它吗？

messages.msgid: A fist-sized lump of plant matter taken from a brackenwight.  It still glows a very faint green.
translations: 从巨蕨怪上取下的拳头大的植物块。仍在发出微弱的绿光。

messages.msgid: A tangled tuft of mossling fur, more like grass or lichen than the fur of an animal.  A cow might be able to eat it, but you couldn't.
translations: 一团乱蓬蓬的苔藓毛皮，更像是草或地衣，而不是动物的毛皮。牛也许能吃它，但你不能。

messages.msgid: A strip of bark taken from a fallen dryad.  It's still slightly supple, as though it were attached to a living tree.
translations: 从陨落的树精身上取下的一片树皮。它仍然略显柔软，像仍附在活树上一样。

messages.msgid: A glittering gemstone that once formed one of the eyes of a gnome.  You feel like you're being watched when you look at it.
translations: 这颗闪闪发光的宝石曾是土地精的一只眼睛。 看着它时你总有种被监视的感觉。

messages.msgid: An apple infused with mana.  It will heal you if you eat it.
translations: 充满魔力的苹果。吃了它能够治愈你。

messages.msgid: A peach infused with mana.  It will cure illness if you eat it.
translations: 充满魔力的桃子。吃了它能够治好疾病。

messages.msgid: A pear infused with mana.  It will allow your blows to strike quicker if you eat it.
translations: 充满魔力的梨子。吃了它能让你的击打更迅速。

messages.msgid: A handful of blackberries infused with mana.  It will harm those who attack you if you eat it.
translations: 一把充满魔力的黑莓。吃了它会伤害那些攻击你的人。

messages.msgid: A handful of raspberries infused with mana.  It will lessen your pain if you eat it.
translations: 一把充满魔力的覆盆子。吃了它会减轻你的痛苦。

messages.msgid: A handful of strawberries infused with mana.  It will keep you warm even on an icy-cold day.
translations: 一把充满魔力的草莓。即使在冰冷的日子里，它也会让你保持温暖。

messages.msgid: A handful of elderberries infused with mana.  It will keep you alert and awake.
translations: 一把充满魔力的接骨木果。它会让你保持警觉和清醒。

messages.msgid: A handful of blueberries infused with mana.  One handful is more satisfying than a whole bottle of water.
translations: 一把充满魔力的蓝莓。一把比一整瓶水更令人满足。

messages.msgid: A handful of cranberries infused with mana.  It will remove impurities in your blood.
translations: 一把充满魔力的蔓越莓。它会清除你血液中的杂质。

messages.msgid: A handful of huckleberries infused with mana.  It will make you much more flexible.
translations: 一把充满魔力的越橘。它会让你变得更加灵活。

messages.msgid: A handful of wintergreen berries infused with mana.  It will allow you to see in the dark.
translations: 一把充满魔力的冬青果。它能让你在黑暗中看清周围。

messages.msgid: A handful of cherries infused with mana.  It will prevent you from bleeding.
translations: 一把充满魔力的樱桃。它可以防止你流血。

messages.msgid: A handful of apricots infused with mana.  It will enhance your visual acuity.
translations: 一把充满魔力的杏子。它会增强你的视觉敏锐度。

messages.msgid: A handful of grapes infused with mana.  It will cure intoxication.
translations: 一把充满魔力的葡萄。它能治愈醉酒。

messages.msgid: A mayapple infused with mana.  It will allow you to eat questionable food without harm.
translations: 充满魔力的鬼臼果。它能使你吃可疑食物时不受到伤害。

messages.msgid: potion fruit (starry false Solomon's seal berries)
messages.plural: potion fruits (starry false Solomon's seal berries)

messages.msgid: A handful of starry false Solomon's seal berries infused with mana.  It will restore your mana.
translations: 一把注入了魔力的多花黄精果。它能恢复你的魔力。

messages.plural: copies of Black Dragons: Swamp Ruins

messages.msgid: This book details black dragons: The most evil of dragons, who live in ruins generally in swamps.  Immune to acid and breathe acid.  The book also details how to prepare its hide and craft various armors that make use of some of its acid resistance.
translations: 这本书详细介绍了黑龙，龙中最邪恶的一种。黑龙栖息在沼泽遗迹之中，能喷出酸液并对酸液免疫。这本书还介绍了如何鞣制黑龙的皮革，并用所得皮革制造防酸护甲。

messages.msgid: A Comprehensive Analysis on Black Dragons
messages.plural: copies of A Comprehensive Analysis on Black Dragons

messages.msgid: This book painstakingly delves into the history of black dragons, gruesomely detailing their acts, the cults that worship them, and those that oppose them.  In its pages are some alchemical formulae that can be concocted using the remains of dead black dragons.
translations: 这本书深入研究了黑龙的历史，可怕地详述了它们的行为方式，崇拜它们的邪教，以及对抗它们的手段。书中有一些炼金术配方，可以用死去黑龙的遗骸来调制魔法物品。

messages.plural: copies of A Beginner's Guide to Alchemy

messages.msgid: A paperback tome for the art of liquid magic, alcohol not included.
translations: 一本关于液体魔法技艺的平装书，酒精需要自行购买。
附魂者的死灵法术指南
messages.plural: copies of A Soulbinder's Guide to Necromancy

messages.msgid: A paperback tome for the art of binding undead creatures' souls to dolls, along with emulating their healing factor.
translations: 一本有关死灵法术的平装版典籍，介绍了将不死生物的灵魂依附到玩偶上的法术，以及模拟它们的恢复能力的方法。

messages.msgid: Small old notebook without cover.  There are some illegal potion recipes, that you can't find in common books
translations: 没有封面的老旧小记事本。里面有一些非法的药剂配方，在普通书籍中找不到的那种。

messages.msgid: Huge, hardcover book, filled with the most detailed information about alchemy history, usage, and future, authored by Trismegistus.  Modern edition, published by Noita Press.
translations: 巨大的硬壳精装书，充满了关于炼金术历史、使用和未来的最详细信息，作者是赫耳墨斯·特里斯墨吉斯忒斯。现代版，由Noita出版社出版。

messages.msgid: A paperback tome for the art of combining modern technology with magic.  There is a disclaimer on the back: `Cannith Industries bears no responsibility for malfunctions or accidents for any products mentioned herein`.
translations: 一本平装本书籍，主题是将现代科技和魔法结合的技术。书背上有一段免责声明："坎尼斯工业对使用本书所涉及的任何产品所引发的故障或事故不负任何责任"。

messages.msgid: The Weapons of Asgard and Beyond
messages.plural: copies of The Weapons of Asgard and Beyond

messages.msgid: An ornate book which appears to be written in Norse runes.  Based on the detailed illustrations, it appears to contain information about crafting numerous weapons used by various Gods.
translations: 一本精美华丽的古书，似乎是用北欧符文写的。从书中详细的插图来看，它似乎包含了关于制造北欧众神所使用的各种武器的信息。

messages.msgid: A leatherbound book with an embossed cauldron on the cover.  Inside it describes ways to purify food magically.
translations: 一本皮面精装书，封面上有个凸印的大锅图案。书中详细地描述了各种使用魔法净化食物的方法。

messages.msgid: A book with a brass coverplate.  It professes to teach one how to make magical metals such as Orichalcum.  It is dry reading even for an alchemical tome.
translations: 一本有着黄铜板封面的书。它号称能够教人如何制造山铜等魔法金属。即使按照炼金术手册的标准来说，它也要更枯燥乏味。

messages.plural: copies of Protection from Magical Beasts

messages.msgid: A leatherbound book with a picture of a shield holding back dragonfire on the cover.  There are many ways to turn monster skins and hides into protective equipment inside.
translations: 一本皮革装订的书，封面上画着一个盾牌挡住了龙炎。里面描述了把各种怪物毛皮制成防护装备的方法。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of Enchantment

messages.msgid: A paperback tome on the art of imbuing items with magic properties.
translations: 一本关于向物体注入魔力的工艺的平装书。
一本关于附魔武器的教科书。

messages.msgid: A Comprehensive History of Botanical Enchantment
messages.plural: copies of A Comprehensive History of Botanical Enchantment

messages.msgid: A history of the ancient art of "botanical enchantment", infusing fruit with mana to create primitive potions.  While one of the earliest methods of alchemy known, discovered in prehistoric times, advancement in alchemical techniques (to say nothing of modern chemistry) rendered it a curiosity at best in the decades leading up to the Cataclysm.  Still, the book details several methods of botanical enchantment that would probably be useful.
translations: 古代 "植物魔法 "的历史，将魔力注入水果以制造原始药剂。 虽然这是已知最早的炼金术之一，在史前时代就已发现，但炼金技术的进步（更不用说现代化学了）使得它在大灾变前的几十年里充其量只是一种奇物。 不过，书中还是详细介绍了几种可能有用的植物魔法方法。

messages.plural: copies of The Arcane Archer's Companion

messages.msgid: A reference book discussing the ancient and now mostly-forgot art of enchanted archery.  With firearms so convenient and taking much less training to use, it has long since fallen out of favor, but this book is so detailed you could revive it for yourself with the recipes it contains.
translations: 一本探讨古老且几近失传的附魔箭术的参考书。由于枪械如此便利，且所需训练极少，这门技艺早已失宠。但此书内容详尽，你或可凭其中记载的配方，为自己重现这门技艺。

messages.plural: copies of The Journeyman Enchanter's Primer

messages.msgid: Despite the title, this seems to be written in Middle English.  A little obtuse, but you can make out most of the words well enough.
translations: 除了封面，这本书好像是用中古英语写的。尽管有些晦涩难懂，但你还是能理解大部分文字描述。

messages.msgid: A paperback tome on the art of growing wildwood entities.
translations: 一本关于培育灵木生物之道的平装典籍。

messages.msgid: A proper wizard is always prepared, crystallize your mana for the future!
translations: 一名合格的魔法师永远准备周全，把你的魔力结晶化以留待未来！

messages.msgid: The darkness holds no secrets for the arcane.  Adjust your sight to see in perfect darkness!
translations: 黑暗在奥术面前没有任何秘密。调整你的视觉使你能在完全黑暗中看清物体！

messages.msgid: The light can not interact with you unless you want it to.  Become invisible!
translations: 没有你的允许，光将不会与你发生作用。隐身！

messages.msgid: A magical aura distorts light around your body, making it easier to dodge enemy attacks.
translations: 一个魔法光环扭曲了你身体周围的光线，使你更容易闪避敌人的攻击。

messages.msgid: Harried by evil spirits or creatures from beyond?  This spell will keep your mind safe!
translations: 被邪恶的灵魂或来自另一个世界的生物骚扰？这个法术会保护你的心灵！

messages.msgid: You channel your life force itself into your spiritual energy.  You spend HP to regain mana.
translations: 将你的生命力量导入你的精神能量。消耗生命恢复魔力。

messages.msgid: An ethereal-looking zombie rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  You may be able to summon more with a higher level in this spell.
translations: 一只从地底深处冒出来的丧尸会为你而战。如果你这个法术的等级够高的话，就能召唤出更多它的同类。

messages.msgid: You pour mana into an unwilling and unprepared vessel, causing cellular break-down, internal hemorrhaging, leylines to become muddled, and electronics to overcharge.  Immensely gruesome, crude, and was once illegal world-wide, not that it matters now.
translations: 你将魔力注入一个不情愿且毫无准备的躯壳，导致其细胞破裂、内脏出血、灵脉陷入混乱，并使电子设备过载。此法术极为血腥粗暴，曾被全球明令禁止，不过现在这都不重要了。

messages.msgid: Kill a summoned creature, consuming its life energy to regain some health.
translations: 杀死一只召唤物，吸收它的生命能量来恢复一些血量。

messages.msgid: A few decrepit looking animals rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  You may be able to summon better with a higher level in this spell.
translations: 几只看起来很衰弱的动物从地底深处爬出来为你战斗。 如果这个咒语的等级更高，你也许能召唤出更好的动物。

messages.msgid: Kill an ally creature, converting its life energy into compact rune, that you can use afterwards.
translations: 杀死一个友方生物，将它的生命能量转化为易于携带、方便使用的符文。

messages.msgid: Force the undead creature you pick to obey your command, making it an ally for a short time.
translations: 强迫你所选择的不死生物服从你的命令，使其成为短期内的盟友。

messages.msgid: Explode a living energy inside your undead, to release a tremendous force around.
translations: 在你的丧尸体内引爆生命能量，释放庞大的力量。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Knit the Rent Flesh
messages.plural: Scrolls of Knit the Rent Flesh

messages.msgid: Cause the target's wounds to pull themselves together.
translations: 使目标的伤口自行弥合。

messages.msgid: This spell extrudes a long nasty whiplike tentacle of sharp bones and oozing acid from your body, it has a long reach attack and vicious damage.
translations: 该法术会从你体内催生一根骨刺密布、酸液流淌的长鞭状触手，可发出致命的长远距攻击。

messages.msgid: A spell that warps your body in alien ways to increase your physical abilities and strength.
translations: 这个法术能以怪异的方式将你的躯体完全扭曲，并增强你的力量及感知。

messages.msgid: This spell causes roots to spear out the ground and stab into your foes in an arc, impaling them.
translations: 这个法术使树根刺穿地面，以弧形刺入你的敌人，刺穿他们。

messages.msgid: This spell conjures a magical wooden recurve bow that fires endless arrows for as long as it lasts.
translations: 这个法术可以召唤出一个魔法木弓，它可以发射无尽的箭，直到它持续时间结束。

messages.msgid: Call to the wild for aid from some wolves.
translations: 向荒野呼唤，寻求狼群的援助。

messages.msgid: A spell from a darker sect of druidry, created to forcibly begin the circle of life anew.  For without rot, you cannot have growth.  Affects a huge area, but is indiscriminate and slow both in casting and effect.  Once lost entirely to the passage of time, this spell was thought to be no more than a myth, the stuff of fairy tales, albeit grim ones.
translations: 来自德鲁伊黑暗教派的法术，用来强行重启生命循环。因为没有腐化，就无法生长。影响范围很大，且不分敌我；即便是机器也会生锈化为尘土，施法及起效速度都很慢。曾经完全失传在时间的流逝中，这个法术被认为只不过是神话传说，是童话故事的素材，虽然是黑暗童话。

messages.msgid: Directed magical energy that slowly heals your body from wounds.
translations: 被引导的魔法能量，可以慢慢治愈你的身体创伤。

messages.msgid: Uses magic energy from herbs to heal your wounds.
translations: 使用来自草药的魔法能量治愈你的伤口。

messages.msgid: Turns a bunch of leaves and bark into an effective bandage.
translations: 将一些树叶和树皮做成强大的绷带。

messages.msgid: Your hands tries to transform the body of your enemy into a pure stone.  The effect is temporary, but it can deal significant damage.
translations: 你的双手会试图将敌人的身体变成一块纯粹的石头。效果是暂时的，但可以造成巨大伤害。

messages.msgid: You cover your body with a layer of razor sharp crystals.  Monster that attack you will take some damage in return, and gives you some additional cut damage in melee.
translations: 给你的身体覆盖上一层如剃刀般锋利的晶体。怪物在攻击你时会反过来受到伤害，并在近战中造成一些额外的切割伤害。

messages.msgid: Hide yourself between the sand gust.  It's harder to hit you, and monster's can't spot you.
translations: 将自己藏入沙尘暴中，你更难被打中，怪物也无法发现你。

messages.msgid: Shape a strong golem out of the stone.  It may help for a lot, but you have not enough energy to support it forever.
translations: 塑造一个强大的石制傀儡。能帮上你很多，但你没有足够的能量永远维持它。

messages.msgid: Pull the smooth rock underground, using your forces of earth shaping.  You can use it as a table, or as a primitive anvil.
translations: 用你塑造大地的力量，拉出地下的光滑岩石。 你可以把它当作桌子，或者当作原始的铁砧。

messages.msgid: Use magic to reveal nearby terrain.
translations: 使用魔法显示附近的地形。

messages.msgid: Causes an intense heat at the location, damaging the target.
translations: 在指定地点制造强烈热能，以伤害目标。

messages.msgid: Summons a small flame that does not burn you, but you can use it to light things on fire.  It seems to need you to have some intent to light things on fire, because you are able to put it in your pocket with no issue.
translations: 召唤出一朵不会烧到你的小火苗，可以用来点燃其它物品。看起来你需要有点燃东西的想法它才会点火，因为你可以把它安全的存放在你的口袋里。

messages.msgid: Causes jagged icicles to form in the air above the target, falling and damaging it.
translations: 在目标上方制造冰刺，坠落造成伤害。

messages.msgid: You hurl a pea-sized glowing orb that when reaches its target or an obstacle produces a pressure-less blast of searing heat.
translations: 投掷一颗豌豆大小的炽热球体，到达目标或遇到障碍物时发生剧烈烧灼。

messages.msgid: Creates a magical shield of ice on your arm, you can defend yourself with it in melee combat and use it to bash.
translations: 在你的手臂上制造一个魔法冰盾，你可以用它在近战中保护自己，并使用它来攻击。

messages.msgid: Covers you in a thin layer of magical ice to protect you from harm.
translations: 用一层薄薄的魔法冰来保护你不受伤害。

messages.msgid: Teleports you in a random direction a short distance.
translations: 把你向一个随机的方向传送一小段短距离。

messages.msgid: Summons a well of gravity with the epicenter at the location.  Deals bashing damage to all creatures in the affected area.
translations: 在指定地点召唤一口重力井。对受影响地区的所有生物造成钝击伤害。

messages.msgid: This spell slows a single target greatly for its duration.
translations: 此法术可在持续时间内极大地延滞单个目标。

messages.msgid: You become more graceful, agile, and coordinated.
translations: 你会变得更优雅、更敏捷、更协调。

messages.msgid: You focus your mana into a microscopically thin pulsed beam of pure energy, capable of extreme range and precision; as well as unparalleled penetration, provided proper skill.  Once the invention of a notorious assassin, this spell has slayed many a king and noble.  Passed on only through direct descendants over the ages, though occasionally shared by them to others.
translations: 你将魔力凝聚为一束微观尺度的纯能量脉冲射线，具备极致的射程与精准度；若技艺纯熟，更能发挥出无与伦比的穿透力。此法术为一位恶名昭彰的刺客所创，曾终结诸多君王与贵族的性命。历经世代仅通过直系血脉单传，虽偶有传承者将其授予外人。

messages.msgid: The go-to spell for many Stormshapers, this iconic spell does just what you expect: you shoot lightning from your fingertips.  However, this lightning is more directed than most lightning, and travels in a line through most non-solid targets.
translations: 对于许多风暴塑造者来说，这个标志性法术正如你所期待的那样：你可以从指尖射出闪电。不过这种闪电比其他闪电更有方向性，并以直线穿过大多数非固体目标。

messages.msgid: A powerful blast of wind slams into anything in front of your outstretched hand.
translations: 伸出手掌，喷射强风，冲击你面前的一切。

messages.msgid: The spell moves out of your mouth, creating a giant shockwave that shatters everything in its path.
translations: 咒语从你的嘴里出来，产生一个巨大的冲击波，摧毁它路径上的一切。

messages.msgid: Enhance your sight with your powers.  It allows you to see creatures of the same energy around you, and block or dodge an additional attack your enhanced perception speed could anticipate.
translations: 用你的能量增强你的视力。它可以让你看到周围拥有同样能量的生物。增强的感知速度使你能够看到即将到来的攻击，增加额外的格挡或闪避次数。

messages.msgid: Your hands start to emit a huge amount of energy, that you release with each attack.
translations: 你的双手开始发出巨大的能量，每次攻击时都会释放。

messages.msgid: Insulate the skin against electrical damage.  Particularly useful for the apprentice Stormshaper, whose magical control is weak and whose efforts could easily end in self-electrocution.
translations: 使皮肤绝缘，防止电击伤害伤。特别适用于魔法控制能力很弱的风暴塑造初学者，防止他的努力因自我触电告终。

messages.msgid: Summon a Teravolt, a small, semi-intelligent spirit that homes onto hostile creatures and explodes into a huge spark cloud.
translations: 召唤一只特拉伏特，一只小型半灵智的灵魂体，会在爆炸成为巨型电火花云前吸附到敌对生物身上。

messages.msgid: A spell of blessing that gives you energy and boosts your abilities.
translations: 给予你能量和提升你能力的祝福法术。

messages.msgid: You have found a way to convert your spiritual energy into power you can use for your bionics.
translations: 你发现了一种将你的魔力转换成生化能量的方法。

messages.msgid: This spell creates a very short range bolt of electricity to shock your foes.
translations: 这个法术产生一个非常短的闪电来电击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: This spell stimulates the synapses in your brain beyond normal processing speeds, giving you a large boost in mental processing capability, including enhancing your reflexes, speed, and raw intellectual power.  Use responsibly!
translations: 这个法术会刺激你大脑中的神经突触，使其速度超过正常的处理速度，大大增强你的思维处理能力，包括增强你的反应能力、速度和智力能力。请谨慎使用。

messages.msgid: You fire a small concentrated ball of lightning at the target.  The electricity diffuses quickly, so it doesn't do much damage, but you're able to fire off several quick ones in a row.
translations: 你向目标发射一个小闪电球。电流扩散很快，所以不会造成太大的伤害，但你可以连续发射几个。

messages.msgid: You use the power of your own blood to imbue necrotic energy into your gaze, damaging the target you look at.
translations: 你使用自身血液的力量将死灵能量注入到你的凝视之中，对你的凝视目标照成伤害。

messages.msgid: You summon a gift of the earth which will purify water.  Greater levels yield greater numbers of seeds.
translations: 召唤大地的馈赠，可用于净水。等级越高，获得的种子数量就越多。

messages.msgid: You fire a cone of X-rays that magically allow you to see that area for a short time.
translations: 你发射出一道X光，并通过魔法来短暂地看清X光所及区域。

messages.msgid: You overcharge your internal batteries to send a semi-directed beam from your face.
translations: 你将体内的生化电池过载，从你的脸上射出半定向的激光光束。

messages.msgid: With a shout and a gesture, the target starts bleeding from old wounds.
translations: 随着咒语念出并做出手势，使目标的旧伤口开始流血。

messages.msgid: Banish a monster to the lesser-known nether dimension.  If a monster is more powerful than you can handle, the spell drains your life force to make up the difference.
translations: 将怪物放逐至鲜为人知的异界维度。若怪物力量超出你的掌控，此法术将汲取你的生命力以弥补差距。

messages.msgid: This spell creates an invisible aura to protect you from acid.
translations: 这法术能产生一个肉眼无法看见的防酸光环保护你。

messages.msgid: This scroll details how a spell called 'Lightning Blast' which is commonly used among Stormshapers can be altered to become much more powerful, at a much higher mana cost.
translations: 这幅卷轴详细描述了一个被称为"闪电冲击"的常见的风暴塑造者法术是如何被改造变得更强大的，但施放时将会消耗更多的魔力。

messages.msgid: Make the terrain answer to your call.
Summons ghostly foxfire worked from living marsh vapor, to lead your enemies astray.  With more experience, this spell can conjure multiple ghost lights.
translations: 从富有生命力的沼泽水蒸气中召唤幽灵般的狐火，把你的敌人引向歧途。当你有更多的施法经验时，这个法术可以召唤出数只发光的鬼火。

messages.msgid: You can channel magical energy to open locked wooden doors from a short range away.
translations: 你可以引导魔力打开近距离内锁着的木门。

messages.msgid: You can channel magical energy to open any locked door from a short range away.
translations: 你可以引导魔力打开近距离内任何锁着的门。

messages.msgid: Summons a small electric spark, that do not harm anything.  You can use it to ignite something flammable.
translations: 召唤一道小电火花，什么都伤不到。你可以用它点燃什么易燃物。

messages.msgid: You manifest an aura of crackling electricity around you to strike attackers with baleful lightning.
translations: 你在你周围召唤出一道噼啪作响的电弧光环，能放出可怕的闪电电击近战攻击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: This scroll is covered in sap and rose thorns.  You can still make out some of the writings, but it probably won't work the same.
translations: 这个卷轴上覆盖着汁液和玫瑰刺。你仍然可以辨认出卷轴中的一些文字，它应该能够施放出些法术，但不知道是否会有效。

messages.msgid: Unleash your inner beast by snapping a fur-covered bone, becoming beastly.
translations: 折断一根毛皮覆盖的骨头，释放出你内心暗藏的兽性，变得如同野兽一般。

messages.msgid: Ignite a wooden sword to create a flaming saber.
translations: 点燃一柄木剑，将其变成一把燃烧的剑。

messages.msgid: A pocketful of combustible powder is ignited, creating a cone of flame with ashes that stick to those in its path.
translations: 点燃一小袋可燃火药粉末，形成一个火炎锥，燃烧的灰烬覆盖在范围内的所有物品之上。

messages.msgid: Animate a layer of acid around you, burning attackers and increasing your melee damage.
translations: 在你身体周围召唤出一个酸液光环，腐蚀攻击你的敌人，并增加你的近战伤害。

messages.msgid: Link your live blood to dead blood and bones, creating a club eager to harvest the living.
translations: 将你体内的活血和死者的血和骨头联系起来，制造出一根渴望收割活物的骨棍。

messages.msgid: Release a resonant bolt of spiritual energy at a nearby target.  It will disrupt the natural link between matter and animus, causing heavy but never lethal damage.
translations: 向附近的目标释放一道共振的精神能量波束。它会破坏物质和灵魂之间的自然联系，造成严重但绝不会致命的伤害。

messages.msgid: Infuse a sling with excess energy, delivering devastating throws before it tears itself apart.
translations: 为投石索灌注入过量能量，在它撕碎自己之前，打出威力巨大的投掷打击。

messages.msgid: Emulate a railgun, launching a knife at high speed.
translations: 和磁轨炮原理一样，用魔法能量将一把刀高速发射出去。

messages.msgid:
Manafied Infernal Combustion Engine (Rideable)
Detailed schematics for a motorcycle, that are somehow simultaneously obviously impossible and yet intriguingly intuitive.
In one margin, the word 'Mojocycle' has been scrawled in a flowing hand.
translations:
魔法内燃机（可驾驶）
一辆摩托车的详细设计图，看起来明显无法实现的同时却又奇妙地符合直觉。
在设计图的空白处潦草地写着"魔托车"三个字。

messages.msgid: Causes an intense heat at the location, greatly damaging the target.
translations: 在目标位置产生巨大热量，对目标造成极大伤害。

messages.msgid: Summon a jar of force you can use to store liquids in.
translations: 召唤出一个能够用来储存液体的魔力瓶。

messages.msgid: Your connection with nature allows you to become one with it; you revitalize your body while in communion with the flora and fauna around you.
translations: 你与大自然建立起的联结让你与它融为一体。当你同周围的动植物联结时，能迅速恢复生命活力。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Whisper of the Leaves
messages.plural: Scrolls of Whisper of the Leaves

messages.msgid: Deepen your bond with the forest and understand the whispers of the trees.
translations: 加深你与森林的联系，了解树木的低语。

messages.msgid: Sink your senses into the earth and learn of the approach of anything walking upon it.
translations: 把你的感官沉入大地，学习任何在大地上行走的东西的方法。

messages.msgid: Like the unyielding stone, lessen your need for food or water.
translations: 像坚硬的石头一样，减少你对食物和水的需求。

messages.msgid: Scroll of the Turning of the Earth
messages.plural: Scrolls of the Turning of the Earth

messages.msgid: Ask the earth spirits to prepare the earth for planting and sowing.
translations: 请大地之灵为种植和播种准备。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Harvest of the Hunter
messages.plural: Scrolls of Harvest of the Hunter

messages.msgid: Create usable arrows out of forest detritus.
translations: 用森林碎屑制作有用的箭头。

messages.msgid: Open your mystic senses and locate the things that should not be.
translations: 打开你神秘的感官，找出不应该出现的东西。

messages.msgid: Winter-be-gone through the power of modern magic.
translations: 以现代魔法之力，令凛冬退散。

messages.msgid: Summer-be-gone through the power of modern magic.
translations: 以现代魔法之力，令炎夏终结。

messages.msgid: Who's afraid of heights?  Not you, after you read this scroll.
translations: 恐高？只要读了这卷轴，你就再也不会了。

messages.msgid: Free climb better than the best.
translations: 自由爬行胜过最好的攀登。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Limbs of the Frog
messages.plural: Scrolls of Limbs of the Frog

messages.msgid: Swim with the fishes, with your froggy hands and legs.
translations: 和鱼一起游，用你青蛙般的手和腿。

messages.msgid: Grow to enormous size and crush your enemies.
translations: 成长到巨大的规模和粉碎你的敌人

messages.msgid: This research paper has an extremely complicated series of formulae with various genetic code diagrams interspersed.  It claims that the spell will reduce the negative effects of XE037 exposure.
translations: 这份研究论文包含一系列极其复杂的公式，其中还穿插着各种遗传密码图。据称，该法术能减轻XE037暴露带来的负面影响。

messages.msgid: Eat rotten food with no ill effects.  It doesn't make it taste any better, though.
translations: 吃没有不良影响的腐坏食物。但这并没有让它的味道变好。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Knowing the Day and the Hour
messages.plural: Scrolls of Knowing the Day and the Hour

messages.msgid: Cast this spell to know exactly what time it is.  You're amazed anyone is still making these scrolls; this spell might as well be a museum piece.
translations: 施放这个法术来知道确切的时间。你很惊讶有人还在制作这些卷轴；这个法术还不如进博物馆呢。

messages.msgid: Mark an area to be aetherically resonant so that you can easily find it later; for example, by using the Word of Recall spell.
translations: 将一个区域标记为以太共振，这样你以后就可以很容易地找到它；例如通过使用回忆之词咒语法术。

messages.msgid: The counterpart to Magus's Mark, reciting this simple spell will instantly return you to wherever it was that you cast that spell.
translations: 与魔法印记相对应的是，背诵这个简单的咒语会让你立即回到你施放那个咒语的地方。

messages.msgid: Summon a spirit through whose eyes you can see.  This spell was frowned upon pre-Cataclysm due to the potential for misuse, but its many legitimate uses kept it on the curriculum at major universities' thaumaturgical studies departments.
translations: 召唤一个灵魂，通过他的眼睛你可以看到。由于有可能被误用，这个咒语在大灾变前是不受欢迎的，但它的许多合法用途使它成为主要大学自然学系的课程。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Beguiling the Savage Beast
messages.plural: Scrolls of Beguiling the Savage Beast

messages.msgid: Charm an animal into your service for a time.  They don't even technically have to be savage!
translations: 你可以魅惑一只动物，为你服务一段时间。它们甚至不一定非得是野兽！

messages.msgid: Stop a robot, golem, or cyborg in their tracks.  Be perfectly prepared for a different kind of apocalypse.
translations: 让机器人、傀儡或半机械人停下脚步。为另一种世界末日做好充分准备。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Speak through the Aether
messages.plural: Scrolls of Speak through the Aether

messages.msgid: Summon up a magical device that allows you to communicate through radio waves.  Well, maybe there's someone still out there.
translations: 召唤一个可以让你通过无线电波交流的神奇设备。也许有人还在外面。

messages.msgid: Power all of your devices using mana instead of electricity.
translations: 使用魔力而不是电力为所有设备供电。

messages.msgid: Weld metal using touch alone.  It'll do a number on a zombie too.
translations: 仅用触摸就能熔接金属。它也会对丧尸产生一定的影响。

messages.msgid: When the going gets tough, the tough summon yards-thick walls of solid rock around themselves.
translations: 当事情变得艰难时，强者会召唤出几码厚的坚固岩石墙。

messages.msgid: Transform a long stick into a spear that drips with sticky sap.
translations: 把一根长木棍变成一支能滴下粘稠树液的长矛。

messages.msgid: Conjure a lashing bunch of animated vines that will grab and hold your enemies.
translations: 召唤一束活跃藤蔓，抓住并捆缚你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Transform your skin into bark covered in sharp thorns.
translations: 把你的皮肤变成布满尖刺的树皮。

messages.msgid: Conjure a bunch of thick brambles out of the ground to either form a wall or slow your enemies.
translations: 从地上召唤一束浓密的荆棘，形成一堵墙或减缓你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Summon up a large cloud of mist that will conceal your movements from your enemies.
translations: 召唤一大团雾来掩护你的行动，不让你的敌人看见。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Heart of the Hurricane
messages.plural: Scrolls of Heart of the Hurricane

messages.msgid: Compress raging storm winds into a shell around you to protect you.
translations: 将肆虐的风暴风压缩成一个围绕你的外壳来保护你。

messages.msgid: Someone has scribbled on this scroll in…colored pencil?  You're pretty sure whatever it does now isn't the spell's original function.
translations: 有人用彩色铅笔在这个卷轴上乱涂乱画了吗？你很确定它现在的作用不是法术最初的作用。

messages.msgid: Grow a pair of barbed tentacles from your shoulders that will attack enemies in melee range.
translations: 从你的肩膀上长出一对带刺的触手，可以攻击近战范围内的敌人。

messages.msgid: Snap your fingers and get rid of that nasty cold or flu, with the slight disadvantage that you'll have to vomit it out.
translations: 响指一打，就能摆脱那恼人的感冒或流感，只是有个小小的缺点：你得把病根吐出来。

messages.msgid: Enemy wizards got you down?  Just remove all their magic and punch them in the face.
translations: 敌人的魔法师把你打倒了？只要除掉他们的魔法，然后一拳打在他们脸上。

messages.msgid: Remove all magic from your target, even rare or powerful spells.  Who's the archmage now?
translations: 移除目标的所有魔法，即使是稀有或强大的魔法。现在谁是大法师？

messages.msgid: Cuts?  Lacerations?  Torn organs?  Fix all that with this handy spell.
translations: 无论是割伤、撕裂伤，还是内脏破损，用这个便捷的法术都能统统修复。

messages.msgid: Keep all that blood in your body.
translations: 让你宝贵的血液尽数留存于体内。

messages.msgid: Turn your fingers into myriad bone knives.
translations: 将你的手指化为无数骨刃。

messages.msgid: Turn your blood into acid, just like that movie you used to watch all that time.
translations: 将你的血液化为强酸，就像你看过无数遍的那部老电影一样。
