messages.msgid: Grow an entire forest from nothing, given enough time and mana.  There were druids who made good money doing this for industrial logging, the ethics of which were always good to start an argument at a party.
translations: 只要有足够的时间和魔力，就能凭空造出一整片森林。曾有些德鲁伊靠这门手艺为工业伐木大赚其钱，至于其中的道德问题，总能在派对上引发一场激烈的争论。

messages.msgid: Grow a log from a living tree and prune it without violence.
translations: 从活树上催生出一根原木，并以温和无伤的方式将其截取。

messages.msgid: Using a bit of water, transfer water's refreshing chill to yourself.
translations: 只需些许清水，便能将水的清凉惬意转移到自己身上。

messages.msgid: Grow magical seaweed to form a protective coating, allowing you to travel the depths.
translations: 催生出魔法海藻形成一层保护膜，使你得以畅游深海。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Wash the Wounds Clean
messages.plural: Scrolls of Wash the Wounds Clean

messages.msgid: Disinfect your wounds with just a bit of water and magic.
translations: 只需些许清水与魔力，便可为你的伤口消毒。

messages.msgid: Walk on water using the power of your magic.
translations: 凭借你的魔法之力，你将能行走于水面之上。

messages.msgid: Charge a battery using only your mana!  Once of niche use, now a vital skill.
translations: 仅凭魔力就能为电池充电！这曾是一项用途狭隘的法术，如今却成了至关重要的技能。

messages.msgid: Fire yourself up to give a persuasive speech with this spell.
translations: 借助此法术点燃你的激情，发表一场振奋人心的演说。

messages.msgid: Turn a fire directly into cold, putting it out.  Once one of the most commonly-known spells in the world, the lack of open flames in daily life has lead to a steep decline in its use.
translations: 将火焰直接转化为极寒，从而将其熄灭。这曾是世上最广为人知的法术之一，但由于日常生活中鲜少使用明火，这项法术也随之式微。

messages.msgid: Summon a sphere of ice to preserve your food inside.  Once a vital spell to keep food from rotting, then a party trick to keep drinks cold at the beach, and now back to vital once again.
translations: 召唤一个冰霜法球来保鲜食物。它曾是防止食物腐烂的关键法术，后来沦为在海滩上冰镇饮料的派对戏法，而今又再度变得至关重要。

messages.msgid: Turn dirt into solid rock.  Useful for making a fortress or a castle in a fraction of the time.
translations: 将泥土化为坚岩。对于在短时间内建造堡垒或城堡而言，这招非常实用。

messages.msgid: Sink into the depths of the earth to heal more quickly and make sleep more restful.  You don't need to eat or drink either…  Say, how many earthshapers are still asleep down there?
translations: 沉入地底深处，加速痊愈，安享沉眠。在此期间你无需进食饮水……话说回来，现在还有多少塑地者仍沉睡在地底深处呢？

messages.msgid: The single most well-known spell in the entire world before the Cataclysm.  Why take a shower and do your laundry if you can get magic to do it for you?
translations: 这大概是大灾变前全世界最广为人知的法术了。既然魔法能代劳，谁还愿意亲自动手洗澡洗衣呢？

messages.msgid: Highly restricted before the Cataclysm, this spell allows you to turn into pure spirit and pass through the physical world unseen and insubstantial.
translations: 此法术在大灾变前受到严格管制，它能让你化为纯粹的灵体，以无形无质的状态穿行于物质世界，不被察觉。

messages.msgid: A common protective spell even before the Cataclysm, Mageshield will render you completely invincible…against a single attack.
translations: 即便是在大灾变前，这也是一种常见的防护法术。法师护盾能让你变得金刚不坏……但只能抵挡一次攻击。

messages.msgid: A favored spell of those hiking the Appalachian Trail, this spell increases your speed in the wilderness.
translations: 此法术曾深受阿巴拉契亚小径徒步者的青睐，它能提升你在荒野中的行进速度。

messages.msgid: Highly-restricted before the Cataclysm, this spell prevents you from feeling any emotion for the duration.
translations: 此法术在大灾变前受到高度管制，在持续期间，它能让你屏蔽一切情感。

messages.msgid: Pull a distant creature or item toward you.  The ultimate spell for the couch potato mage.
translations: 将远方的生物或物品拉向自己，堪称懒癌法师的终极法术。

messages.msgid: Scroll of A Shadow in the Crowd
messages.plural: Scrolls of A Shadow in the Crowd

messages.msgid: Cut yourself off from your fellows, and also make yourself invisible to them.
translations: 让你与同伴们相互隔绝，并使他们无法察觉你的存在。

messages.msgid: Summon benevolent spirits into a bone, granting minor benefits.
translations: 召请善灵，将其附入骸骨之中，以求些许助益。

messages.msgid: Take on some of the characteristics of the bear, making it much easier to survive the winter.
translations: 让你获得部分熊的特性，从而能更轻松地度过寒冬。

messages.msgid: For when you don't know where your next meal is coming from and you want to make sure absolutely nothing goes to waste.
translations: 当你不知道下一顿饭从何而来，并想确保丁点食物都不被浪费时，此术便可派上用场。

messages.msgid: Never spend any time tossing and turning again with one of the most popular pre-Cataclysm spells.
translations: 有了这个大灾变前最受欢迎的法术，你再也无需辗转反侧、夜不能寐。

messages.msgid: Hurls a bolt of fire at the target, just like the name implies.
translations: 顾名思义，此术会向目标投出一道火焰弹。

messages.msgid: Greatly increases the volume of the caster's voice while also making them immune to any hearing damage the resulting noise would cause.  Very popular at pre-Cataclysm metal concerts, both on and off the stage.
translations: 极大增强施法者的音量，同时使其免受随之而来的噪音所造成的听力损伤。在大灾变前的金属音乐会上，此术在台上台下都备受欢迎。

messages.msgid: Manipulate gravity, atmospheric drag, and friction to increase the effective ranged of ranged weapons, both bows and firearms.
translations: 操控重力、空气阻力与摩擦力，从而增加远程武器的有效射程，无论是弓箭还是枪械都同样适用。

messages.msgid: Summon a benevolent spirit to watch over the caster and warn them of imminent attack.
translations: 召唤一位善良的精魂来守护施法者，并在攻击迫近时发出警示。

messages.msgid: Gain an intuitive understanding of computers and electronics, allowing an easier time repairing or using them.
translations: 增强对计算机和电子产品的的理解，使其修理或使用更容易。

messages.msgid: Warm up your food using pure mana.
translations: 只用魔力加热你的食物。

messages.msgid: Enchant a weapon with the metaphysical essence of diamonds, greatly increasing its power.
translations: 为武器附上金刚石的形而上精萃，大幅提升其威力。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Abjure Spirits of Rot
messages.plural: Scrolls of Abjure Spirits of Rot

messages.msgid: Banish the decay spirits from the food you're carrying, making it last much longer before going bad.
translations: 驱散你所携带食物中的腐败精魂，让食物的保质期大大延长。

messages.msgid: With some earth and stone and a song, repair and item made of natural stone or metal.
translations: 以些许泥土、石块为引，辅以歌谣，便可修复一件由天然石料或金属制成的物品。

messages.msgid: Enchant a tool to accept power wirelessly from a compatible source.
translations: 为一件工具附魔，使其能够从兼容的能量源处进行无线充能。

messages.msgid: Enchant a lens with the ability to see beyond the horizon.
translations: 使一个镜头具有看到地平线以外的能力。

messages.msgid: Grant yourself brief reprieves from the effects of pain.
translations: 让自己暂时摆脱疼痛的困扰。

messages.msgid: This scroll has been scribbled over again and again in the handwriting of more than one person.  The notes in the margins imply some sort of departmental competition, but no matter the results you can still make out a functional spell in the mess.
translations: 这张卷轴上反复被不同人的笔迹涂写过。其边缘的注释暗示了某种部门间的竞赛，无论结果如何，你仍然可以在这些混乱的文字中中辨认出一个有效的法术。

messages.msgid: Speak with your soul instead of your voice, allowing casting spells in silence.
translations: 以灵魂代替喉舌发声，从而实现无声施法。

messages.msgid: Shut that pesky enemy wizard right up with this spell.
translations: 用这个法术，让那个讨厌的敌方法师立刻闭嘴。

messages.msgid: Limn the target in a soft green or blue light.  Great at parties.
translations: 为目标勾勒出一圈柔和的绿色或蓝色光芒，是派对上的绝佳表演。

messages.msgid: Turn crystallized mana back into mana you can use.  Doing that repeatedly is a great way to make huge quantities of mana vanish into the Aethereum.
translations: 将魔力结晶重新转化为可用的魔力。当然，反复这样做也是个能让巨量魔力凭空消失在以太界里的绝佳途径。

messages.msgid: Transform a set of berries into a set of even better berries that keep you full and heal your wounds.  Delicious and nutritious.
translations: 将一把浆果转化为效果更佳的魔法浆果，既能果腹又能疗伤，可谓是美味又营养。

messages.msgid: Use your own spirit to attack the target's spirit.
translations: 以自己的精神为武器，攻击目标的精神。

messages.msgid: Create a permanent glowing orb of light in the air.  Well, it will take a few years to see if it's really permanent; hopefully you'll live to know the answer.
translations: 在空中创造一个永久性的发光光球。当然，它是否真的“永久”，还得过上几年才能见分晓，希望你到时候还活着。

messages.msgid: Using water as a medium, restore some of your lost blood.  Be more careful where you put that blood next time.
translations: 以水为媒介，补充部分你已失去的血液。下次可得小心点，别再把血弄得到处都是了。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Fountain of the Depths
messages.plural: Scrolls of Fountain of the Depths

messages.msgid: Call up the hidden waters from the depths of the earth to the surface.  Less convenient than a faucet, but the plumbing has been off for a while.
translations: 将深藏于地底的水源呼唤至地表。虽然不如水龙头方便，但如今这世道，供水系统早就瘫痪了。

messages.msgid: Imprison the target in an impenetrable shell of force.
translations: 将目标囚禁于一个坚不可摧的力场囚笼之中。

messages.msgid: Sink into the ground and re-emerge somewhere nearby.  More likely to keep you in shape than the ability to teleport to the kitchen from your bedroom.
translations: 遁入地下，再于别处现身。这可比让你从卧室传送到厨房的法术更能锻炼身体。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Awakening of the Forest Guardian
messages.plural: Scrolls of Awakening of the Forest Guardian

messages.msgid: Give motion and awareness to a tree, allowing it to shake free of the soil and crush your enemies.
translations: 赋予树木行动与意识，使其拔地而起，碾碎你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Scroll of Flames of the Apocalypse
messages.plural: Scrolls of Flames of the Apocalypse

messages.msgid: Call forth an inner fire from every enemy in the spell's radius, causing multiple explosions.
translations: 从法术范围内的每个敌人体内引燃真火，造成连环爆炸。

messages.msgid: Open up your senses to detect the brighter ley lines of those who habitually use their magic.
translations: 敞开你的感知，去侦测那些习惯性使用魔法之人身上更为明亮的灵脉。

messages.msgid: This research paper has an extremely complicated series of formulae with various genetic code diagrams interspersed.  It claims that the spell will allow conscious control over any "morphogenic alterations".
translations: 这篇研究论文阐明了一系列极其复杂的公式，其间点缀着各种基因编码图谱。据其所述，此法术可让施法者凭意识掌控自身的任何“塑形变异”。

messages.msgid: Unless a wave of force to hurl anyone nearby backwards.  Great for the commute.
A Technomancer's Guide to Debugging C:DDA
messages.plural: copies of A Technomancer's Guide to Debugging C:DDA

messages.msgid: static std::string description( spell sp ) const;

messages.plural: copies of A Beginner's Guide to Magic

messages.msgid: You would describe this as more like a pamphlet than a spellbook, but it seems to have at least a few interesting spells you can use.
translations: 比起一本魔法书，你更愿意把它描述为一本小册子，但似乎它至少有几个你可以使用的有趣法术。

messages.plural: copies of An Introduction to Applied Meteorology

messages.msgid: A professional-looking book on stormshaping, structured after many college textbooks.  It has less to apply than one might expect from its size.
translations: 一本关于风暴形成的专业书籍，是在查阅过许多大学教科书之后精心编写的。比起它的厚度，在现实中它的应用范围却小得多。

messages.plural: copies of Wizarding Guide to Backpacking

messages.msgid: This appears to be the spell version of a guide for what things to take with you when backpacking.  It's a little bulky, but will certainly prove useful.
translations: 这是一个可以随身携带的法术指南书，虽然有点笨重，但是可以教会你不少有用的法术。

messages.msgid: This charred husk of a book still contains many ways to light things aflame.
translations: 这本表皮烧焦的魔法书里包含了许多火焰法术。

messages.plural: copies of A Treatise on Magical Elements

messages.msgid: This details complex diagrams, rituals, and choreography that describes various spells.
translations: 它详细描述了各种法术所使用的复杂符号、仪式和步伐编排。

messages.plural: copies of The Limits of Magical Recovery

messages.msgid: A study of the progress of using magic to cure ailments and heal wounds throughout the ages, from the earliest simple rituals to set bones all the way through modern thaumaturgical research into cancer treatments and curing Orcus's disease.  Some of the descriptions are detailed enough to be used as spell formulae.
translations: 本书研究了魔法在疗伤治病领域的古今发展，从最初接续断骨的简单仪式，一直到现代针对癌症和奥库斯之病的魔法疗法研究。其中一些描述足够详尽，可以直接用作法术配方。

messages.msgid: The Paladin's Guide to Modern Spellcasting
translations: 圣骑士的现代施法指南
messages.plural: copies of The Paladin's Guide to Modern Spellcasting

messages.msgid: This slim book almost seems to be made from ice, it's cold to the touch.
translations: 这本薄薄的书好像是用冰做的，摸起来很冷。里面包含了许多关于寒冷的法术。

messages.msgid: The Tome of The Oncoming Storm
messages.plural: copies of The Tome of The Oncoming Storm

messages.msgid: A large book embossed with crossed lightning bolts and storm clouds, it tingles to the touch.
translations: 一本巨大的书，上面镶有交叉闪电和风暴云的印记，摸上去会感觉刺痛。
生化电学，以奥术方法分析
messages.plural: copies of Bioelectricity, An Arcane Approach

messages.msgid: A small, but thick book, that covers the most recent developments in the field, including real examples.
translations: 一本小而厚的书，涵盖了该领域的最新发展，其中包含了一些真实的案例。

messages.msgid: A large, illustrated book, that describes the unpopular side of stormshaping - wind control.  Despite being less "cool", it has more control, and can be as devastating as lightning.
translations: 一本大型插图书，描述了风暴塑形中不太流行的一方面——风的控制。尽管不如其他元素那么“酷”，但它更易于掌控，并且可以像闪电一样具有毁灭性的力量。

messages.msgid: How Electromancy Changed the Vietnam War
translations: 电力学如何改变越南战争
messages.plural: copies of How Electromancy Changed the Vietnam War

messages.msgid: A scholarly work, that discusses the electromancy boom in the 60's and how the mass military draft of fresh, inexperienced mages changed the war, with examples of tactics and spells used by year.  Summary says "it changed nothing".
translations: 一部学术著作，论述了60年代电法术的爆发式增长，以及征召大量的新手法师如何改变了战争，书中列举了各年使用的战术和法术实例。其摘要中写道：“它并未改变什么。”

messages.msgid: A small book, containing spells created by a novice magician.
translations: 一本小型书籍，内部包含了由一名新人魔法师创造的几个法术。

messages.plural: copies of Of Light and Falsehoods

messages.msgid: A small white book, it subtly amplifies the ambient light around it.
translations: 一本白色小册子，它似乎略微放大了环境光。

messages.plural: copies of The Tome of Flesh

messages.msgid: A small tome, seemingly covered in tanned human skin.
translations: 一本小书，表面覆盖着古铜色的人类皮肤。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of Trees

messages.msgid: The Utility of Mana as an Energy Source
messages.plural: copies of The Utility of Mana as an Energy Source

messages.msgid: This book details spells that use your mana to recover various physiological effects.
translations: 书中详细描述了使用魔力恢复各种生命效果的法术。

messages.msgid: While no longer popular in the age of nitrogen fertilizer and industrial farm equipment, copies of this tome continued to be published for years for a small audience of back-to-nature, do-it-yourself organic mage-farmers.
translations: 虽然在氮肥和工业化农机时代，这本小册子已不再流行，但多年来，这本小册子仍在为少数回归自然、自己动手的有机农夫出版。

messages.msgid: The Tome of The Battle Mage
messages.plural: copies of The Tome of The Battle Mage

messages.msgid: Your standard wizardy looking spellbook, filled with Magus combat spells.  You sure lucked out!
translations: 你的标准魔法书，写满了魔术师的战斗法术。你真走运！

messages.msgid: The Tome of the Hollow Earth
messages.plural: copies of The Tome of the Hollow Earth

messages.msgid: This large dusty spellbook seems perpetually, well, dusty.  It contains a considerable amount of earthly power.
translations: 这本尘封的大型魔法书似乎总是被灰尘覆盖着。它蕴含着惊人的的大地之力。

messages.msgid: Memoirs of the Champion of Earth
messages.plural: copies of Memoirs of the Champion of Earth

messages.msgid: A book written by someone obviously very self-absorbed who describes himself as "Chosen of Gaia, the Only Champion of Terra".  Despite his arrogance, his mastery in combining different earthshaper's abilities as described in the book make him an accomplished sorcerer worth learning from.
translations: 由一位显然非常自恋的人所写的书，他自称为“盖亚神选，唯一的大地冠军”。尽管他非常傲慢，但他在书中描述的那些，将不同塑地者的能力结合起来的大师级技巧，使他成为一个值得学习的杰出巫师。

messages.msgid: One Spell is All You Need!
messages.plural: copies of One Spell is All You Need!

messages.msgid: This advertising booklet promotes one spell that allows you to create a different tool for different purposes.  Surprisingly, it works as the book says - you can change the shape of your tool, depending on your needs.
translations: 一本广告小册子宣传的一个法术，能够让你为不同目的创造不同的工具。令人惊讶，就像书里说的，你可以依据你的需要改来你工具的形状。

messages.plural: copies of The Tome of Magical Movement

messages.msgid: This small lightweight book seems to almost not entirely exist, let's say it 97% does.  It contains Magus spells focused on movement.
translations: 这本小巧轻便的书似乎并不完全存在，也许97%存在。它包含有关移动的魔术师法术。

messages.msgid: This looks like someone was designing a new spell, but spilled a mug of coffee on it and crumpled it up in anger.  You can tell that it will definitely cast something, but you can't be sure that it will work very well.
translations: 看起来像是有人想在上面设计出一个新法术，但却把一杯咖啡洒在上面，愤怒地把它揉成一团。你能看得出它应该能够施放出些法术，但不知道是否会有效。

messages.plural: copies of Necromantic Minions for Dummies

messages.msgid: This book details various ways of summoning an undead minion to fight for you.  They all appear to disappear after a short time, crumbling to dust.
translations: 这本书详细介绍了召唤不死仆从为你战斗的各种方法。但它们似乎在消失前只能维持较短的时间，之后就化为尘土。

messages.msgid: This thick manual instructs the spellcaster on manipulating and empowering various forms of matter and energy.
translations: 这本厚厚的手册教导施法者如何操纵和增强各种形式的物质和能量。
科技魔法新手入门指南
messages.plural: copies of Complete Idiot's Guide to Technomancy

messages.msgid: This colorful guide, full of diagrams and cartoons, teaches a couple of very basic Technomancy spells for the not-so-bright pupils.
translations: 非常简单的科技魔法指南。这本彩色的指南，充满了图表和卡通元素，教不太聪明的学生了一些非常基本的科技魔法法术。

messages.plural: copies of Technomancy and the Electromagnetic Spectrum

messages.msgid: This lab reference material book is thick and overflowing with information on combining magic with EM radiation.
translations: 这本实验室参考材料书很厚，里面充满了如何将魔法与电磁辐射结合的信息。
工程法师的实用指南书
messages.plural: copies of The Mage-Engineer's Practical Guide

messages.msgid: This is a heavy, university thaumaturgical-program-level guidebook.  It discusses the various practical applications of magic in repairwork and engineering, with a focus on immediately-usable techniques instead of airy theoretical approaches.
translations: 这是一本厚重的，大学级别的魔法学课程指南手册。它讨论了魔法在维修工作和实际工程中的各种应用，这本书专注于那些即用性的技术，而不是空洞的理论方法。

messages.msgid: A famous animist grimoire from early modernity.  Its cryptic passages describe and map connections between the spiritual world and ours.
translations: 一本著名的早期现代性泛灵师魔法书。它用晦涩难懂的段落叙述及描绘了灵界和我们所在世界之间的联系。

messages.msgid: A small tablet of blackened stone, apparently cut from a much larger slab.  Golden runes glow over its surface, and slowly shift into intelligible sentences when you stare at them.
translations: 一小块黑色石板碎片，显然是从一个大得多的石板上被削下来的。金色符文在它的表面闪闪发光，当你盯着它们看时，会慢慢地变成能被你读懂的句子。

messages.msgid: Geospatial Systems: The Lie Of Linearity
translations: 空间与地理：线性的谎言
messages.plural: copies of Geospatial Systems: The Lie Of Linearity

messages.msgid: This book outlines in great detail how time and space are wibbly-wobbly and non-Euclidean.  It also appears to have a dozen different coordinate systems that it uses nearly interchangeably, which makes it hard to follow.  There's lots of jargon, but with intense study you can probably learn a thing or two about portals.
translations: 这本书非常详细地概述了时间和空间的摇摆不定和非欧几里得的理论。它似乎使用了十几种不同的坐标系，但作者并未对此做太多区分，这使得它很难被人理解。书里有很多术语，但是通过深入研究，你可能会学到一些关于传送的知识。

messages.msgid: A very, very old and heavy tome of various spells lost to the ages, either for good reason, or simply through the passage of time.  There are very few copies in existence, usually owned by those of great power, and yet all of them seem to have the last dozen pages or so torn out, in haste.
translations: 一本非常、非常古老的沉重典籍，里面有各种各样的早已失传的法术，要么出于合理原因，要么只是因为时间流逝而失传。该书现存传世副本极少，通常仅为那些有权势之人所有，但似乎所有副本都被十分匆忙地撕去了最后的十几页。

messages.plural: copies of Transcendence of the Human Condition

messages.msgid: The Human is the only creature that seeks to improve himself.  This study examines different spells that can heighten various senses temporarily, in hopes to discover a more permanent solution.
translations: 人类是寻求自我提升的生物。这本著作详细研究了许多可以暂时增强人类身体极限的法术，希望能从中寻找到一个更持久的解决方案。

messages.msgid: Wherever You've Gone, There You Can Be
translations: 无论你走到哪里，你都可以在那里
messages.plural: copies of Wherever You've Gone, There You Can Be

messages.msgid: A very sarcastically-written guide to using magic to get into and out of places you absolutely are not supposed to be.
translations: 这是一本非常讽刺的指南，教你如何使用魔法进出你绝对不应该去的地方。

messages.msgid: It's the End of the World, But You'll Feel Fine
translations: 这是世界末日，但你会感觉很好
messages.plural: copies of It's the End of the World, But You'll Feel Fine

messages.msgid: This thick paperback book is a collection of the proper magical preparations to survive various disasters.  Unfortunately, the zombie apocalypse section doesn't account for everything that's gone wrong in the Cataclysm, but there's still a lot of useful knowledge here.
translations: 这本厚厚的平装书收集了在各种灾难中生存的正确魔法准备。 遗憾的是，"丧尸启示录 "部分没有考虑到大灾变中出现的所有问题，但这里仍有很多有用的知识。

messages.msgid: Written by the elven archdruid Tylindel Melithilarahd over 500 years ago, this weighty tome was considered *the* most important book of the Harmonist druidic movement up until just before the Cataclysm.  Archdruid Melithilarahd's death in 2016 ended his overt patronage of his own works, allowing other writers to attempt to make their mark, especially younger elves who did not have such a strident anti-modern attitude.  In addition to all the philosophical essays about the importance of living in harmony with nature and allowing plants to grow where they will are several plant-based druidic spells.
translations: 这本厚重的书是由精灵德鲁伊——泰林德尔·梅丽瑟拉拉德在500多年前撰写的，直到大灾变前都被认为是“和谐主义”德鲁伊运动中最重要的书籍。德鲁伊梅丽瑟拉拉德于2016年去世，结束了他对自己作品的公开支持，使其他作家得以尝试留下自己的印记，尤其是那些没有如此强烈的反现代态度的年轻精灵。书中除了关于与自然和谐共生及允许植物自由生长的重要性的哲学论文外，还包括了几种基于植物的德鲁伊法术。

messages.plural: copies of The Lazy Mage's How-to Guide

messages.msgid: A thin book full of spells designed to help the practitioner short-cut having to actually do any work.  Considering the effort involved in studying magic, you're not sure any actual time is being saved.
translations: 一本薄薄的书，充满了旨在帮助从业者缩短实际工作时间的法术。考虑到学习这些魔法所需的努力，你不确定是否真的能节省任何时间。

messages.msgid: A thin book about the usefulness of magic in hiking, such as keeping clean, keeping the weather good, staying dry, and otherwise avoiding all the problems of the mundane outdoors.
translations: 一本薄薄的书，有关魔法在徒步旅行中的用法，例如保持清洁、维持天气良好、保持干燥，以及避免其他世俗户外活动中的所有问题。

messages.msgid: The Effects of Technological Progress on Magic
translations: 技术进步对魔法的影响
messages.plural: copies of The Effects of Technological Progress on Magic

messages.msgid: A thick book about the history of magic's interactions with technology.  It delves deeply into why technological solutions have mostly replaced magic in daily life even though mages can have immense personal power: the incompatibility of Control and Harmony schools, the technological ease-of-use from the end-user perspective, and even the way some nations' legal systems have worked to discourage magic use so as to prevent individuals from attaining too much power.
translations: 一本关于魔法与技术相互作用的历史的厚书。 它深入探讨了为什么技术解决方案在日常生活中大部分取代了魔法，尽管法师可以拥有巨大的个人力量：控制与和谐学派的不兼容，从最终使用者的角度来看技术的易用性，甚至各国的法律体系一直致力于阻止魔法的使用，以防止个人获得过多的力量。

messages.plural: copies of The Home Mage's Healthcare Manual

messages.msgid: A reference book for the practical use of magic in healing the sort of wounds that are likely to occur at home: burns from cooking, scraped knees, cuts from knives, bruises, colds and the flu, and so on.
translations: 一本实用的，关于治疗在家中可能发生的受伤的魔法参考书：例如治疗烹饪烧伤、膝盖擦伤、刀伤、淤青、感冒和流感等。

messages.msgid: Travels Among the Ljósálfar: Their Customs, Food, Lifestyle, Celebrations, and Ceremonies
translations: 与光精灵同行：他们的习俗，食物，生活方式，庆祝活动和仪式
messages.plural: copies of Travels Among the Ljósálfar: Their Customs, Food, Lifestyle, Celebrations, and Ceremonies

messages.msgid: An old 19th-century travelogue, detailing the author's travels among the elven tribes of northern Greenland.  The section about the midwinter festival and the northern lights is particularly detailed.
translations: 一本19世纪的古老旅行记，详细记述了作者在格陵兰北部精灵部落中的旅行。书中关于隆冬节和极光的描述部分特别详细。

messages.plural: copies of Storm Chasing In Complete Safety

messages.msgid: A description of weather patterns, geological formations in particularly storm-prone areas, essays from well-known storm chasers, proper equipment and safety, how to keep dry, and a way to use magic to completely avoid any possible danger from the storm itself.  The book does explicitly warn that if a tree falls on you, you're on your own, though, so the title seems to be more than half marketing.
translations: 这本书描述了特别容易发生暴风雨的地质形态以及气象模式、也包含了著名追风者的文章、适当的装备介绍，一些安全知识、如何在暴风雨中如何保持干燥，以及如何使用魔法以完全避免暴风雨本身的任何可能危险。然而书中明确警告，如果非常不幸树砸在了你的身上，你就只能自认倒霉，所以似乎书名大半都是营销的噱头。

messages.msgid: Fashion Over Function: A Thaumaturgical Guide to Wearing Whatever, Whenever
translations: 时尚胜过功能：何时何地穿何物的奇术指南
messages.plural: copies of Fashion Over Function: A Thaumaturgical Guide to Wearing Whatever, Whenever

messages.msgid: A thin guide to using magic to avoid extremes of both hot and cold, allowing you to design your wardrobe around always looking good rather than having to account for summer's heat or winter's chill.
translations: 一本关于利用魔法来避免极端酷热或严寒的简易指南，让你能够设计自己的衣橱，不必考虑夏天的酷热或冬天的寒冷，始终保持良好的外观，

messages.plural: copies of A Cat Cafe at Home!

messages.msgid: A very thin book, filled with glossy photos, about how to use druidic magic to call up cats whenever you are feeling lonely, if you can't afford one, or if you live in a place that doesn't normally allow pets.  The people in the photos watching half-a-dozen cats play sure look happy.
translations: 一本插入了很多精妙照片的，非常薄的书，书中介绍了如果你买不起猫，或者生活在通常不允许养宠物的地方，如何在你感到孤独时使用德鲁伊魔法召唤猫。照片中欣赏很多嬉戏中的猫的人们看起来非常开心。

messages.msgid: Save Water and Time, with Magic!
messages.plural: copies of Save Water and Time, with Magic!

messages.msgid: This very thin booklet about the ecological benefits of using magic instead of a mundane morning cleaning routine.  At the bottom of the back cover is an abstract logo of two people holding both hands with a tree growing through the resulting circle, and the words "Gaia's Children" beneath it.
translations: 这本非常薄的小册子讲述了使用魔法而不是世俗的常规清晨清洁所带来的生态益处。在封底的底部是一个抽象的标志，两个人手拉手，形成一个圆圈，一个树从圆圈中生长出来，下面写着“盖亚的子女”。

messages.msgid: Mystic Survival in the End Times
messages.plural: copies of Mystic Survival in the End Times

messages.msgid: A somewhat alarmist book about the ways to survive after the collapse of civilization, using simple magic to deal with common problems.  Sadly, there are no anti-zombie combat spells within.
translations: 一本有些危言耸听的书，讲述了在文明崩溃后生存的方法，以及使用简单的魔法来解决常见问题。不幸的是，书中没有关于反僵尸的战斗法术。

messages.msgid: A guide to using earthshaping magic to shortcut the backbreaking work of digging and hauling needed to redo one's yard.
translations: 一本指南，介绍如何利用塑地魔法来减少重新布置庭院时费力的挖掘和搬运工作。

messages.msgid: The Limitations of the Mana Economy
messages.plural: copies of The Limitations of the Mana Economy

messages.msgid: A study of the inherent non-scalability of magical solutions to problems, touching on the difficulty of producing crystallized mana in the quantities needed for industrial use, the long time period necessary for magical materials like orichalcum, mithril, or crimsonite to reach reliability, the way that earthshaping and druidism specifically require wilderness for some of their spells, and the way that an average mage exhausts their mana pool within fifteen minutes of working on any major project without extensive study and training.
translations: 本书研究了魔法方案固有的不可规模化问题，其中涉及诸多难点：工业化生产所需的魔力结晶难以量产；山铜、秘银、绯红石等魔法材料需要漫长时间才能达到可靠标准；塑地术和德鲁伊教的某些法术明确要求在野外施展；以及一名普通法师在未经大量研习与训练的情况下，只要进行任何重大项目，不出十五分钟便会耗尽魔力。
创造属于你自己的特效
messages.plural: copies of Make Your Own Special Effects

messages.msgid: A guide to using magic to create practical special effects, whether for a birthday celebration, house party, or simply for your own amusement.
translations: 使用魔法创造实用特效的指南，无论是用于生日庆祝、家庭聚会，还是仅用于娱乐自己。

messages.plural: copies of Gardening the Druidic Way

messages.msgid: A reference tome for using magic to garden in a "organic, traditional, earth-centered way", as the back cover states.
translations: 正如封底所述，这是一本关于如何以“有机的、传统的、以大地为中心的方式”用魔法来打理花园的参考手册。

messages.msgid: Let No Wall Stand in Your Way!
messages.plural: copies of Let No Wall Stand in Your Way!

messages.msgid: This book claims to be an aid to people who always forget their keys or need to get into their car quickly, but the selection of spells seems pretty suspicious to you.
translations: 这本书自称能帮助那些总是忘带钥匙或急着进车的人，但在你看来，书里的法术名堂可不那么简单。

messages.plural: copies of A Study of Nethereum Incursions

messages.msgid: An academic book about the history of known Nethereum incursions, including the 1908 Tunguska incident, the disappearance of the army of Cambyses, various dancing plagues, the earthquake that destroyed the kingdom of Mgarzhbag, the Week Without Sun in the 7th century, and more, along with a variety of speculation about possible other historical and pre-historical incursions.
translations: 一本关于已知的虚质入侵历史的学术著作，内容包括1908年通古斯大爆炸、冈比西斯大军失踪之谜、各种舞蹈瘟疫、摧毁姆加日巴格王国的地震、公元7世纪的无日之周等等，此外还对其他可能存在的历史及史前入侵事件进行了种种推测。

messages.msgid: Born of a Gale: A Taxonomy of Air and Weather Spirits
translations: 生于狂风：空气、天气精灵鬼怪的分类学
messages.plural: copies of Born of a Gale: A Taxonomy of Air and Weather Spirits

messages.msgid: A formal study of the various sylphs, anemoi, shedim, hytersprites, hyades, ame-onna, and other spirits associated with air, wind, or weather.
translations: 对各种风元素、阿涅弥伊（古希腊神话风神）、谢迪姆（希伯来神话伪神）、海特灵（英国神话妖精）、许阿得斯（古希腊神话雨仙女）、雨女（日本神话妖怪）以及其他各种空气、风或天气相关的精灵鬼怪的正式研究。

messages.msgid: Akyâluaban: the Book of the Living Stone
messages.plural: copies of Akyâluaban: the Book of the Living Stone

messages.msgid: A copy of a religious text from the Ghâzkhud dwarven religion.  Amidst the prayers and songs and meditations on the ancestors and the earth and the stones are some spells, though pious traditional ghâzkhudians would react with shock if you called them that.
translations: 一份加兹库德矮人教的宗教典籍。在祷文、圣歌以及对先祖、大地与岩石的沉思中，也夹杂着一些法术——尽管虔诚而传统的加兹库德信徒若是听你这么说，定会大惊失色。

messages.msgid: The Magical Method of Tidying Up
messages.plural: copies of The Magical Method of Tidying Up

messages.msgid: This obvious cash-in book does have some actual practical spells amongst all the philosophical-sounding essays about the importance of cleanliness.
translations: 这本明显是跟风捞钱的书，在那些听起来颇具哲理、大谈洁净重要性的文章之间，确实夹杂了一些实用的法术。

messages.plural: copies of The Healing Power of Nature

messages.msgid: A description of the various ways to use natural herbs and plants to fuel magical healing.  There is a lot of useful knowledge of here if you sift through the book and filter out the various chapters about the dangers of allopathic medicine and modern post-industrial lifestyles.
translations: 本书描述了利用天然草药植物来驱动魔法治疗的各种方法。只要你能仔细通读，并滤掉那些大谈对抗疗法和后工业化生活方式之危害的章节，便能从中学到许多有用的知识。

messages.msgid: Now You See We: Technomantic Transit In Action
translations: 现在你看到我们了：科技魔法传输应用
messages.plural: copies of Now You See We: Technomantic Transit In Action

messages.msgid: A book about how technomancy, usually thought of as being based around electricity and human enhancement, somehow also encompasses quick moment but only when holograms are involved.  At least half the book is descriptions of experiments performed by research thaumaturges to find the exact boundaries of technomancy when movement is involved.
translations: 一本关于科技魔法的书，通常被认为基于电力和人体强化内容，在某种程度上也包含了快速，但仅限于涉及全息图。这本书至少有一半是对研究人员进行的实验的描述，他们希望在涉及运动的情况下找到科技魔法的确切边界。

messages.msgid: Magical Mishaps: When Spells Go Wrong
translations: 魔法事故：当法术失控时
messages.plural: copies of Magical Mishaps: When Spells Go Wrong

messages.msgid: A series of stories of the various ways magic can go wrong if the wrong ingredients, words, or gestures are used.  A lot of the stories are merely funny, like the magus who in trying to alter the Sorcerer's Hand spell caused music to follow her everywhere she went, but there's the occasional real tragedy mixed in as a cautionary tale.
translations: 这是一个系列故事，讲述了如果使用了错误的材料、词语或手势，魔法可能出错的各种方式。 很多故事都很有趣，比如一个魔法师在试图改变 “巫师之手 ”的咒语时，导致她所到之处音乐如影随形，但偶尔也会有真正的悲剧发生，以儆效尤。
运用疗愈法术进行间歇性断食
messages.plural: copies of Intermittent Fasting Using Biomancy

messages.msgid: A guide to using biomancy to perform extreme intermittent fasting, eating an enormous amount of food only once every 2-5 days, depending on the mage's skill.  The book is filled with both glossy photos of extremely fit, beautiful people and warnings to make sure that your stomach isn't full when the spell wears off.
translations: 这是一本使用生化魔法进行极限间歇性禁食的指南，即每2-5天只用吃一顿巨量的食物，具体取决于施法者的魔法水平。书中既有身材姣好、容貌出众的人物图片，也有提醒读者在法术效果消失时确保处于空腹状态的警告。

messages.msgid: A Year of Living Without Magic
messages.plural: copies of A Year of Living Without Magic

messages.msgid: A guide to living without any magic at all, including ways to perform tasks that were traditionally performed with magic, such as starting fires, tending minor wounds, cooking and preserving food, doing laundry, and so on.  Somewhat hypocritically, it does include a dispelling spell in the back of the book.
translations:
这本指南教你如何不用魔法完成各种日常任务，比如点火、处理小伤口、烹饪和保存食物、洗衣等等。
有些讽刺的是，文末附带了一个驱散魔法。

messages.plural: copies of Beyond Sleeping Easy with Sorcery

messages.msgid: This self-help book is themed around the Peaceful Rest spell, famed before the Cataclysm as an easy way to avoid tossing and turning.  Laudably, the book seems to be mostly about eventually weaning the reader off the need to cast a spell to be able to fall asleep on time.
translations: 这本自助读物以“安宁之眠”法术为主题，该法术在大灾变前曾因能轻松解决辗转反侧的问题而闻名。值得称道的是，这本书的主要目的似乎是让读者最终戒除对施法才能按时入睡的依赖。

messages.plural: copies of Practical Pyromancy, Seventh Edition

messages.msgid: The 2020 edition of the classic tome of fire magic, not containing any restricted battle magic but popular all the same.
The Rites of the First Circle
messages.plural: copies of The Rites of the First Circle

messages.msgid: A weighty tome containing all three of the Rites of the First Circle, the rituals used by dedicated mages to increase their ability to channel and recover mana.
translations: 一本厚重的典籍，收录了全部三种“一环仪式”，这是专注的法师们用以增强其引导与恢复魔力能力的仪式。

messages.msgid: The Rite of the First Circle: Mana Pool
messages.plural: copies of The Rite of the First Circle: Mana Pool

messages.msgid: A lengthy list of the rituals and components necessary to slightly increase the efficiency by which the mage's body processes mana.
translations: 一份冗长的清单，详述了略微提升法师身体处理魔力效率所需的仪式与材料。

messages.msgid: The Rite of the Second Circle: Mana Pool
messages.plural: copies of The Rite of the Second Circle: Mana Pool

messages.msgid: A lengthy list of the rituals and components necessary to increase the efficiency by which the mage's body processes mana.
translations: 一份冗长的清单，详述了提升法师身体处理魔力效率所需的仪式与材料。

messages.msgid: The Rite of the First Circle: Mana Flow
messages.plural: copies of The Rite of the First Circle: Mana Flow

messages.msgid: A lengthy list of the rituals and components necessary to slightly increase the rate by which the mage's body regains mana.
translations: 一份冗长的清单，详述了略微加快法师身体恢复魔力速率所需的仪式与材料。

messages.msgid: The Rite of the Second Circle: Mana Flow
messages.plural: copies of The Rite of the Second Circle: Mana Flow

messages.msgid: A lengthy list of the rituals and components necessary to increase the rate by which the mage's body regains mana.
translations: 一份冗长的清单，详述了加快法师身体恢复魔力速率所需的仪式与材料。

messages.msgid: The Rite of the First Circle: Mana Sense
messages.plural: copies of The Rite of the First Circle: Mana Sense

messages.msgid: A lengthy list of the rituals and components necessary to slightly increase the sensitivity that the mage's body has to  mana.
translations: 一份冗长的清单，详述了略微增强法师身体对魔力敏感度所需的仪式与材料。

messages.msgid: The Rite of the Second Circle: Mana Sense
messages.plural: copies of The Rite of the Second Circle: Mana Sense

messages.msgid: A lengthy list of the rituals and components necessary to increase the sensitivity that the mage's body has to mana.
translations: 一份冗长的清单，详述了增强法师身体对魔力敏感度所需的仪式与材料。

messages.msgid: Sail the High Seas with Sorcery on Your Side
messages.plural: copies of Sail the High Seas with Sorcery on Your Side

messages.msgid: This romanticized book of dubious historical accuracy details how pirates used magic to their advantage while sailing.  From better telescopes to banks of fog to hide their approach, it seems that according to this author at least, piracy was a true terror to behold.
translations: 这本历史准确性存疑的浪漫主义书籍详细描述了海盗如何在航行中利用魔法来为自己谋利。 从更好的望远镜到掩盖他们接近的浓雾，至少在这位作者看来，海盗是真正的恐怖。

messages.msgid: This cauldron made of demon spider chitin seems to absorb the light.  It will hold 16 liters of material and will absorb poisons from it.  It may have other properties that require discovery.
translations: 这个由恶魔蜘蛛甲壳所制成的大锅似乎正在吸收四周的光线。它能够容纳16升原料，并吸收其中的毒素。它可能还有其他需要你发现的隐藏属性。

messages.msgid: This is an alchemical cauldron made of orichalcum.  The metal is especially resistant to the unique types of corrosion caused by alchemy.
translations: 这是一个用山铜制成的炼金术大锅。这种金属特别耐炼金时产生的特殊腐蚀。

messages.msgid: This is a portable version of the charcoal forge that is magically enhanced and fortified with demon spider chitin in order to be able to resmelt magical metals into their workable ingot form.
translations: 一个便携式版本的火炭锻造台，它使用了恶魔蜘蛛甲壳进行附魔和强化，以便能够将魔法金属熔化成能够制造物品的锭。

messages.msgid: Some alchemical mortar, ready to be used in building projects expecting temperatures on par with dragonbreath.
translations: 一堆炼金术制造的灰泥，已经准备好，随时可以用到需要抵抗龙炎般高温的工程建设项目中。

messages.msgid: The natural cluster of parabolan wool fibers.  Could be processed to felt patches or yarns.
translations: 一簇天然群勃龙毛纱纤维。可以加工成毛毡补丁或毛纱。

messages.msgid: A broken shard of glassteel covered in sharp edges.  You could use it as a weapon, but you might want to wear gloves.
translations: 一片碎玻璃钢，边缘锋利。可以拿来戳人，不过还是先戴上手套比较好。

messages.msgid: A stout knotty club with a large knob at the top.  While it's very heavy, it's a very effective weapon in the hands of a strong opponent.
translations: 一根顶端有个十分粗壮疙瘩的坚固木棍。虽然它很重，但在力量强大的人手中，它是非常有效的武器。

messages.msgid: A wooden melee weapon with a hand-forged steel forked spearhead attached to the end.  It can be used for stabbing opponents either in close-range or as a thrown weapon, and in the right hands can also readily disarm opponents.
translations: 这根木制近战武器的顶端安装了一个手工锻造的三叉钢叉。它可以用来近距离穿刺敌人，也可以作为投掷武器使用，在知道如何正确使用的人手中可以很容易地解除对手的武装。

messages.msgid: This weapon measures about 3 feet in length and is fletched like an arrow for better accuracy.  The business end of the javelin has wicked-looking barbs which could cause significant bleeding.
translations: 这根大约有3英尺（约90厘米）长的标枪上像箭一样安装了尾翼，提高了命中率。它的尖端有个看上去很邪恶的倒钩，能够导致大量出血。

messages.msgid: A folding frame made of orichalcum pipes.  Not as light as aluminum, but significantly sturdier.
translations: 一种由山铜管制成的折叠框架。不像铝那么轻，但非常坚固。

messages.msgid: A frame made of orichalcum.  Significantly sturdier than steel, but also much more expensive.
translations: 一个由山铜制成的车架。比钢制车架要坚固得多，但同时也比它昂贵得多。

messages.msgid: A frame made of orichalcum.  Partially torn down in order to reduce weight at the cost of durability.
translations: 一个由山铜制成的车架，为了减轻重量而简化了结构，也降低了耐久度。

messages.msgid: A magically manifested combustion engine.  Despite operating entirely off of mana rather than normal fuel, it otherwise functions exactly as a conventional internal combustion engine.
translations: 一台使用魔法制造的内燃机。尽管完全使用魔力作为燃料，在其它方面它却和普通的内燃机没有什么不同。

messages.msgid: You skin feels like stone.  You can't move.
translations: 你的皮肤摸起来有如顽石。你动弹不得。

messages.msgid: Your whole body goes rigid and you can't move a muscle!
translations: 你全身僵直，动不了一点！

messages.msgid: The rigidity fades and you can move again.
The actual spell that lets you walk on water.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 这是真正能让你在水上行走的法术。如果你获得了它，那说明游戏出bug了。

messages.msgid: You can easily walk on the surface of the water.
translations: 你能轻松在水面上行走。

messages.msgid: An aura of thin acid, swirling around your body ready to corrode when struck or while striking.
translations: 一层稀薄的酸液光环，围绕着你的身体周围旋转，随时准备腐蚀任何攻击你或你所攻击的物品。

messages.msgid: A ghostly skeleton rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  You may be able to summon more with a higher level in this spell.
translations: 一只幽灵似的骷髅，从大地深处被召唤出来为你战斗。如果你这个法术的等级够高的话，就能召唤出更多它的同类。

messages.msgid: A decrepit looking large cat rises from the depths of the earth to fight for you.  You may be able to summon more with a higher level in this spell.
translations: 一只看起来饱经风霜的巨猫，从大地深处被召唤出来为你战斗。如果你这个法术的等级够高的话，就能召唤出更多它的同类。

messages.msgid: A sawn-off double-barrel shotgun mounted on a metal cestus.  The lack of a stock to absorb recoil means some strength is required to fire.
translations: 一把安装在金属拳套上的锯短双管霰弹枪。由于没有吸收后坐力的枪托，这意味着需要一些力量才能开火。

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing, invisible layer of magic distorts light around your body.  Allows you to dodge two extra attacks in a given turn.
translations: 一个覆盖全身、看不见的魔法光环扭曲了你身体周围的光。让你在一个回合中获得两次额外闪避攻击的能力。

messages.msgid: You are unseen in between of the sand that cover you.
translations: 躲藏在沙子中间来不被发现。

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing, invisible layer of protection against acid.
translations: 一个覆盖全身的肉眼无法看见的防酸光环。

messages.msgid: An invisible aura that strikes melee attackers with arcs of electricity.
translations: 一个肉眼无法看见的能向近战攻击你的敌人放出电弧的光环。

messages.msgid: You have a much easier time hiding in the forest.
translations: 在森林中，你能更轻易地隐藏自己。

messages.msgid: Summons a Shambling Mound, a giant carnivorous plant mess with devastating area attacks.  It is too slow for a normal fight, but excels at defending its shaman.
translations: 召唤一个蹒跚土丘，它是一团由巨型食肉植物纠缠而成的怪物，能发动毁灭性的范围攻击。其行动迟缓，不善于常规作战，但极为擅长守护召唤其的萨满。

messages.msgid: This is the spell that actually fires when you cast Reading the Earthbones.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 这就是当你施展解读地骨时，实际上会触发的咒语。如果你有的话，那就是个BUG。

messages.msgid: The secrets of the living earth are revealed to you.
translations: 生命土地将向你揭示它的秘密。

messages.msgid: Flap your wings and fly upward.
You have studied this school in particular.  +1 caster level for your selected school.
translations: 你专门地对这个领域进行了学习。在你所选的领域施法等级 +1。
你的身体平平无奇，真是令人沮丧。

messages.msgid: You are able to store a little more mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你可以在你的身体里储存比正常略多的魔力。

messages.msgid: You are able to store more mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你可以在你的身体里储存比正常多的魔力。

messages.msgid: You are able to store a lot more mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你可以在你的身体里储存比正常多很多的魔力。

messages.msgid: You are able to store a little less mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你的身体里储存的魔力比正常略少。

messages.msgid: You are able to store less mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你的身体里储存的魔力比正常少。

messages.msgid: You are able to store a lot less mana in your body than usual.
translations: 你的身体里储存的魔力比正常少很多。

messages.msgid: Your natural mana regeneration is slightly faster than normal.
translations: 你的自然魔力再生比正常速度稍快。

messages.msgid: Your natural mana regeneration is faster than normal.
translations: 你的自然魔力再生比正常速度快。

messages.msgid: Your natural mana regeneration is much faster than normal.
translations: 你的自然魔力再生比正常快很多。

messages.msgid: Your natural mana regeneration is slightly slower than normal.
translations: 你的自然魔力再生比正常速度稍慢。

messages.msgid: Your natural mana regeneration is slower than normal.
translations: 你的自然魔力再生比正常速度慢。

messages.msgid: Your natural mana regeneration is much slower than normal.
translations: 你的自然魔力再生比正常要慢很多。

messages.msgid: You can sense the mana in your body slightly better than normal, allowing you to tap into more of your reserves.
translations: 你可以感觉到你体内的魔力比正常情况更好一些，现在你能获得较高的魔力储备上限增加25%。

messages.msgid: You can sense the mana in your body better than normal, allowing you to tap into more of your reserves.
translations: 你可以感觉到你体内的魔力比正常情况下要好，魔力储备上限增加90%。

messages.msgid: You can sense the mana in your body much better than normal, allowing you to tap into more of your reserves.
translations: 你可以感觉到你体内的魔力比正常情况下要好得多，现在你能获得更高的魔力储备。

messages.msgid: You have a hard time sensing the mana in your body, making less of your reserves available for use.
translations: 你很难感觉到你体内的魔力，你的魔力储备只能发挥出部分水平，影响了你的上限。

messages.msgid: Your breath is sticky and slimy somehow.  This won't damage your interactions with people but it's definitely noticeable.
translations: 不知怎么的，你的呼吸变得又粘又滑。虽然这不会让你无法与他人互动，但影响绝对是显而易见的。

messages.msgid: Your breath could metaphorically melt lead.  It's horrible.  It's so bad that it can actually distract from your attempts to intimidate someone.
translations: 你的呼吸可以如比喻一般融化铸铅。太可怕了。它糟糕到能够分散你恐吓别人时的注意力。

messages.msgid: Gives all of the debug spells at max level.
translations: 将所有调试法术设置为最高级。

messages.msgid: You are fish-like.  Just keep swimming!
You are bear-like, granting you raw bestial power in exchange for intelligence.
translations: 你像熊一样，以智力换取原始的兽性力量。

messages.msgid: You are deer-like, giving you the ability to move quickly and escape danger.  It is hard to use your arms in combat, however.
translations: 你像鹿一样，使你有能力快速移动并逃离危险。然而，在战斗中很难使用你的手臂。

messages.msgid: You aren't where you seem to be.
translations: 你似乎不在你所在的地方。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Empty, the rare few unable to cast even the simplest spells.  Your complete lack of mana prevents you from ever casting any magic, no matter how well you know it.  At least it doesn't prevent the use of magical items and potions.
translations: 你是一个无魔者，是那寥寥无几的、连最简单的魔法都无法触及之人。你体内没有丝毫魔力，这使得你无论多么精通魔法，都无法施展任何法术。值得庆幸的是，这不妨碍你使用魔法物品和药水。

messages.msgid: For a reason or another you are wearing a mana-leech shackle, leaving you constantly empty of mana.  Should you get rid of it you will regain the ability to use your mana, but this is much easier said than done.  You know that these shackles are often used in prisons, so maybe you could find a way to remove it in there?
translations: 由于某种原因，你戴着一副汲魔镣铐，它会不断榨干你的魔力。只要能摆脱它，你就能恢复施法能力，但这说起来容易，做起来难。你很清楚这种镣铐常见于监狱，也许在那儿能找到解开它的法子？

messages.msgid: You were born with an allergy to iron and, to a lesser extent, steel.  Wearing or touching anything made of iron or steel will cause you pain and discomfort.
translations: 你天生对铁过敏，对钢的过敏程度会轻一点。穿戴或接触任何由铁或钢制成的东西都会让你感到疼痛和不适。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master channeling spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the channeling school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握引导系法术。你无法施展任何引导学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master evocation spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the evocation school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握塑能系法术。你无法施展任何塑能学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master conjuration spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the conjuration school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握咒法系法术。你无法施展任何咒法学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master enhancement spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the enhancement school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握强化系法术。你无法施展任何强化学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master enervation spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the enervation school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握弱化系法术。你无法施展任何弱化学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master conveyance spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the conveyance school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握传送系法术。你无法施展任何传送学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master restoration spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the restoration school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握恢复系法术。你无法施展任何恢复学派的法术。

messages.msgid: No matter how hard you try, you never managed to master transformation spells.  You are unable to cast any spell of the transformation school.
translations: 无论你多么努力，你都没法掌握变化系法术。你无法施展任何变化学派的法术。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a bear.  Roar.
translations: 你可以变身为一头熊。咆哮吧。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a cougar and stalk your enemies.
translations: 你可以变身为一头美洲狮，悄然追踪你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You can transform yourself into a deer.
You can transform yourself into a raven and take wing.
translations: 你可以化身为渡鸦，振翅高飞。

messages.msgid: Large ram horns curl around your ears on each side of your head.  Gives you a headbutt attack and head protection.
translations: 你的头部两侧长出了大公羊一样的角，蜷曲在你的耳旁。这使你能头槌攻击敌人并提供了头部防护。

messages.msgid: Your toes have merged into cloven hooves, like that of a goat.  You also have coarse brown fur from the waist down.
translations: 你的脚趾和山羊一样，已经变成了偶蹄。你从腰部以下也长出了粗糙的棕色毛皮。

messages.msgid: You are possessed by a greater demon, giving you great strength and combat abilities but reducing your fine motor control skills.  This gives you a slower crafting speed and the inability to cast spells.
translations: 你被一只大恶魔附身了，这赋予你强大的力量和战斗能力，但却减少了你对精细运动的控制。这使你制造速度变慢而且无法施放法术。

messages.msgid: You have a short, stubby goat tail.
translations: 你有一根又短又粗的山羊尾巴。

messages.msgid: Magic has made you grow to enormous size!
translations: 魔法让你长成巨大的身躯！

messages.msgid: You have a pair of vicious barbed tentacles growing from your shoulders.
translations: 你的肩膀上长出了一对带刺的恶毒触手。

messages.msgid: You lash at %s with your tentacles!
It's hard to think.  Let the instinct take over.
translations: 思考很困难。让本能驾驭你。

messages.msgid: You have gained a bond with a stag beetle.
translations: 你与一只锹甲建立了羁绊。

messages.msgid: Your presence is so dangerous you can freeze everything around yourself.  You are currently suppressing this power.
translations: 你的存在是如此危险，你可以冻结自己周围的一切。但你压制着这毁灭之力。

messages.msgid: Everything around you is covered in frost!
translations: 你身边万物皆挂满冰霜！

messages.msgid: Your presence is so dangerous you can freeze everything around yourself.
translations: 你的存在是如此危险，你可以冻结自己周围的一切。
你压制住了你的冰冻能力。

messages.msgid: Your body and soul were split in half, and part of it were left inside the ley-line, connected with your main body with tiniest, ethereal thread.  In danger situation, you will abandon your main body and turn back into copy, with all knowledge and skills you have.
translations: 你的身与魂被一分为二，其中一半留在了灵脉之中，通过一根最纤细的虚无丝线与你的本体相连。危急时刻，你将舍弃本体，带着所有知识与技能回归到那个分身。

messages.msgid: Your presence is so dangerous living creatures nearby are smashed.  You are currently suppressing this power.
translations: 你的存在危险至极，以至周边寸草不生。但你正压制着这种毁灭之力。

messages.msgid: Living creatures around you are crushed!
translations: 你周围的活物被压碎了！

messages.msgid: Your presence is so dangerous living creatures nearby are smashed.
translations: 你的存在危险至极，以至周边寸草不生。
你压制住了你的霜冻加压能力。

messages.msgid: You can perceive radiation being emitted in your surroundings with sufficient precision to see while totally blind.  You suppress it now.
translations: 你能够感知周遭环境散发的辐射，其精度足以让你在完全失明时视物。你现在抑制了这项能力。

messages.msgid: You can perceive radiation being emitted in your surroundings with sufficient precision to see while totally blind.
translations: 你能够感知周遭环境散发的辐射，其精度足以让你在完全失明时视物。
你压制住了你的辐射感官。

messages.msgid: You can feel the living energy of creatures around you, which allows you to predict their movements or words.  You suppress it now.
translations: 你能够感受到周围生物的生命能量，这让你可以预测它们的动作或发言。你现在抑制着这项能力。

messages.msgid: You reach out with your powers, seeking nearby living beings.
translations: 你使用你的能力探索附近是否还有生命。

messages.msgid: You can feel the living energy of creatures around you, which allows you to predict their movements or words.
translations: 你能够感受到周围生物的生命能量，这让你可以预测它们的动作或发言。
你压制住了你的读心能力。

messages.msgid: Your presence is so dangerous you can burn living creatures around you.  You suppress it now.
translations: 你的存在是如此危险，你可以燃烧周围的生物。但你现在把这股力量压制住了。

messages.msgid: Living creatures around you start to burn!
translations: 你周围的活物开始燃烧！

messages.msgid: Your presence is so dangerous you can burn living creatures around you.
translations: 你的存在是如此危险，你可以燃烧周围的生物。
你压制住了你的灵魂加压能力。

messages.msgid: Your body emits a large amount of cold energy, which freezes all enemies near you.  You suppress this ability now.
translations: 你的身体发出大量寒冷的能量，使你附近的所有敌人都被冻结。 你现在抑制着这项能力。
你周围的活物开始冻结！

messages.msgid: Your body emits a large amount of cold energy, which freezes all enemies near you.
translations: 你的身体发出大量寒冷的能量，使你附近的所有敌人都被冻结。
你压制住了你的冰冻光环。

messages.msgid: Your body can emit an aura of deadly toxins.  You suppress this ability now.
translations: 你的身体能散发出致命的毒素气场。你现在抑制了这项能力。

messages.msgid: Living creatures around you are poisoned!
translations: 你周围的活物开始中毒！

messages.msgid: Your body can emit an aura of deadly toxins.
translations: 你的身体能散发出致命的毒素气场。
你压制住了你的毒性光环。

messages.msgid: You have a sky- or sea-colored skin tone.
You have a green skin tone.
You have a gray skin tone.
You have an almost pure black skin tone.
You have an opalescent skin tone, pale with a faint shimmering rainbow of colors.
translations: 类似蛋白石的肤色，白中带着轻微的七彩光泽。

messages.msgid: You have a reddish or very ruddy skin tone.

With the mechanically-minded Technomancer and the sheer power of lightning from a Stormshaper, the Artificer has a unique confluence of skills and spells to be perfect for invention.  While modern inventions and machines have won out in a modern society, after a Cataclysm one has a chance to go back to roots of things.  To make weird gadgets that are just as likely to explode as explode the thing you're pointing at.
translations: 作为同时拥有了机械思维的科技法师和拥有闪电力量的风暴塑造者，机关术师所掌握的技艺和法术在发明方面完美而独特的汇合在一起。虽然现代发明和机器已经在现代社会中取得了胜利，但在经历了一场大灾变之后，人们终于能有机会回归事物的本源。你制造出的各类奇怪小玩意自身就和被你所瞄准的东西一样容易爆炸。

messages.msgid: The alchemist comes from the technomancer's skills with unliving matter combined with the animist's grasp on the ambient ley lines.  It requires magical talent and lots of time, but is invaluable for creating powerful magical effects in a storable, accessible form.
translations: 炼金术士之道，是科技法师的无机物处理技巧与泛灵师的环境灵脉掌控力相结合的产物。它需要魔法天赋和大量时间投入，但其价值无可估量——能够将强大的魔法效应以可储存、易取用的形式创造出来。

messages.msgid: The Biotek is quite simply the marriage of technology and flesh.  It was not even discovered as an attunement until recent times due to the great advancements in technology in the last 50 years.  The Biotek is unique as it is the only known attunement that warps the Aethereum in such a way as to allow cybernetics to coincide with magical abilities, to an extent.
translations: 生化技师是技术和肉体的简单结合。由于科技在过去50年中的巨大进步，直到最近人们才发现了魔法调谐现象。生化技师是独一无二的，因为它是唯一已知能够在某种程度上扭曲以太的魔法调谐，从而让生化插件与魔法能力在某种程度上融合一致。

messages.msgid:
Animists are known for their blood magic, and being a Biomancer you are able to take it another step further by strengthening your blood.  The dark arts have opened to you, and while dangerous, are incredible to behold.

Ichor: Your Blood Mage abilities grant you the ability to steal some health from your enemies from time to time, and immunity to bleeding.
translations:
泛灵师以他们的血魔法而闻名，作为一名生化术士，你可以通过强化自身血液而更进一步。黑魔法的大门已经向你敞开了，虽然危险，却让人欲罢不能。

神血：你的血法师能力赋予你偶尔吸取敌人血量的能力，同时你会免疫流血。

messages.msgid:
Named for the auroras that grace the poles of the earth, the Boreal mage specializes in auras that protect ethereally.  Boreal mages definitely know their way around cold spells, but their real strength is protection.

Boreal Wind: Your Boreal Mage abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.  Also, your hands emit a small amount of cold, increasing your damage in melee.
translations:
以优雅地照亮了地球的两极的极光命名，北寒法师专门研究魔法保护的光环。北寒法师当然也很了解寒冷法术，但他们真正强大之处还是在于防护。

北风：你的北寒法师能力赋予你的温度条件的良好抵抗力，初次之外，你的双手还能散发微量寒气，增加你的近战伤害。

messages.msgid:
The Cleansing Flame is the fire that burns away the chaff, in preparation for the regrowth of new life.

Cleansing Blaze: Your Cleansing Flame abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.  You are also immune to infection, as your body cleanses every tainted part of you, constantly.
translations:
净火法师是燃尽糟粕，迎接世间万物新生的火焰。

净化烈焰：你的净化火焰能力赋予你对温度条件的良好抵抗力。您还可以免受感染，因为您的身体会不断地净化您身体的每个受污染的部分。

messages.msgid: The Crusader attunement is a clashing dichotomy of Man and Nature.  Utilizing man's propensity for tools and nature's resilience, the Crusader is a juggernaut in armed combat.
translations: 圣战法师魔法调谐中专注于人与自然的矛盾二分法。圣战法师同时利用人类使用工具的倾向和以及自然的复原能力，是武装近战中的佼佼者。

messages.msgid:
Stone is superior to flesh.  You have allowed this axiom into your life, and work to correct your own weakness with biomancy.  The strength of the Earth rushed up to meet you with open arms.

Earth Creep: Your Earth Elemental body grant you good resistance against cut damage, total immunity to electricity, great strength, and colossal stamina.
translations:
岩石胜于血肉。你将此奉为圭臬，并以炼体之术弥补自身血肉的弱点。大地之力奔涌而来，欣然将你拥入怀中。

大地之躯：你的土元素之躯让你对切割伤害有很强的抗性，对电流完全免疫，并赋予你强大的力量和无穷的耐力。

messages.msgid:
You have used your expertise in Biomancy to change your body more toward your affinity for fire as a Kelvinist.  Fire doesn't bother you as much anymore, and your blood is flammable when it touches the air, resulting in a gout of flame when something hurts you.  You are also starting to study more spells that focus on using your own body's affinity for fire.

Salamander: Your Fire Elemental abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions and heat damage.  Also, your body emits streams of blistering heat towards anyone who attacks you.
translations:
通过你所掌握的生化术士的力量，你已经改变了你的身体，提升了自身炽霜法师对火的魔法亲和度。火焰不再那么让你烦恼了，而且你的血液一旦接触到空气就会燃烧，这使你受到任何伤害时，就会喷出一道火焰。你也开始研究更多专注于你身体内在与火的魔法亲和度的魔法。

火妖精：你的火元素能力赋予你对温度条件和热伤害的良好抵抗力。 此外，你的身体还能向任何攻击你的人喷射灼热的热流。

messages.msgid: Flame and heat flash out from where you've been hit.
translations: 火焰和热量自你被击中的地方涌出。

messages.msgid: %1$s's body jets fire and heat out from the wound.

Force = Mass x Acceleration.  This is the typical thing that people think of nowadays when the word is used, but Force Mages have a different meaning, coming from traditional roots: untyped magical damage appears to be a ghostly "force."  This might be the effect of the attunement, but the cause is even more intriguing: they appear to turn Newton's Third Law on its head.  Magical scholars of the 21st century have theorized that this isn't really the case; instead of the opposite reaction happening on this plane of existence, a Force Mage uses the Aetherium's alternate Laws to rebound the force back upon itself, effectively doubling the force in the same direction instead.  However this ability comes with limitations, as the Force Mage can only do this for melee damage.

Motion: Your Force Mage abilities grant you better speed, and increased damage in melee.
translations:
力 = 质量 x 加速度。如今人们一提到“力”这个词，通常想到的就是这个公式。但对于“原力法师”而言，“力”这个词有着源于传统的不同含义：无属性的魔法伤害表现为一种幽灵般的“力”。这或许是心智调和带来的效果，但其成因更加耐人寻味：他们似乎颠覆了牛顿第三定律。21世纪的魔法学者们曾提出理论，认为事实并非如此；原力法师并非让反作用力在本位面生效，而是利用乙太界的替代法则将力反弹，使其作用于自身，从而有效地将同一方向的力加倍。然而，这项能力也有限制，原力法师只能对近战伤害做到这一点。

动能：你的原力法师能力会提升你的速度，并增加你的近战伤害。

messages.msgid:
The Champion of the Earth, Gaia's Chosen is blessed on all things nature, animate and inanimate.

Gaia's Champion: Your Gaia's Chosen abilities grant you a larger HP pool, and enemies have a chance to impale themselves upon your thorns when they attack you.  However, the thorns growing from your skin means you feel pain more acutely.
translations:
大地之英，盖亚神选，受到一切自然造物——无论有生命或无生命——的祝福。

盖亚之英：你的盖亚神选能力会增加你的生命值上限。此外，敌人在攻击你时，有几率被你身上的荆棘刺穿。不过，从皮肤上长出的荆棘也让你对疼痛的感受更为敏锐。

messages.msgid: Thorns tear at your opponent as they strike you.
translations: 荆棘袭向攻击你的敌人。

messages.msgid: %1$s's thorny brambles bite into their attacker.

The power of a Glacier Mage is backed by a thousand tons of ice and snow, with a brutal might in their spells.  While they are skilled with cold spells, their greatest strength is in offense.

Stalactite: Your Glacier Mage abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions, and enemies are often hurt when try to attack you in melee.
translations:
冰川法师的力量源于万吨冰雪，其法术蕴含着残暴的力量。尽管他们擅长寒冷法术，但最大的优势在于进攻。

冰锥：你的冰川法师能力让你对极端温度有良好的抗性，并且敌人在近战中攻击你时往往会受到伤害。

messages.msgid:
The Golemancer is the ancient myth of the clay golem, made reality from constant use of Animist summons and Earthshaper self-strengthening spells.  Takes some traits from the golems they create, such as immunity to slowing effects.

Clay: Your Golemancer abilities make you perfectly steady, as nothing can slow you down.  Your body also deflects some of the damage you take.
translations:
魔像师是粘土魔像这一古老神话的具象化，是长期使用“泛灵师”的召唤法术和“塑地者”的自我强化法术的产物。他们会从自己创造的魔像身上获得一些特性，比如对减速效果免疫。

陶土之躯：你的魔像师能力让你稳如磐石，任何事物都无法减缓你的速度。你的身体也能偏转一部分你所受到的伤害。

messages.msgid:
The fundamental Laws of the universe are thought of as the end-all-be-all in magical circles, and the Gravity Mage is a result of mages mucking around with those laws.  Unfortunately, this attunement does not give supreme control over gravity as a fundamental force, though the affinity is prominent and comes with some non-negligible benefits.

Weight: Your Gravity Mage abilities increase your attack speed and melee damage for a bit, double your ability to carry weight, and allow you to climb without using ladders or support.
translations:
在魔法界，宇宙的基本法则被认为是至高无上的。而重力法师，就是法师们瞎捣鼓这些法则的产物。不幸的是，这种调谐并不能让你完全掌控作为基本力之一的重力，但其亲和力非常显著，也带来了一些不可忽视的好处。

重负：你的重力法师能力会略微提升你的攻击速度和近战伤害，使你的负重能力加倍，并让你无需梯子或支撑物即可攀爬。

messages.msgid: The Technomancer specializes in augmenting humans without actually modifying them; and the Overclocker takes the heat aptitude of a Kelvinist and puts that to work.  You are able to think significantly faster, and are able to align your ley lines for spellcasting faster as a result.
translations: 科技法师专精于在不改变人之本质的前提下进行增强；而超频法师则借鉴了炽霜法师对热能的适应性并加以运用。因此，你能够以更快的速度思考，并能更迅速地校准自身灵脉以进行施法。

messages.msgid:
Through your power in Biomancy, you have changed your body towards your Kelvinist affinity for ice.  Extreme cold has less effect on you, and your superchilled skin causes frostbite when touching others.  You're also starting to research more magic that focuses on your body's inherent ice affinity.

Iceberg: Your Ice Elemental abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions and cold damage, your hands can emit small amount of cold, increasing your damage in melee, and enemies impale themselves on ice spikes when they attack you.
translations:
通过你所掌握的生化术士的力量，你已经改变了你的身体，提升了自身炽霜法师对冰的魔法亲和度。极端寒冷对你的影响更小，而当你接触他人时，你的超冷皮肤会瞬间造成冻伤。你也开始研究更多专注于你身体内在与冰的魔法亲和度的魔法。

冰山：你的冰元素能力赋予你对温度条件和寒冷伤害的良好抵抗力，你的双手能造成少量的寒冷伤害，提升你的近战伤害，同时任何攻击你的人会被寒冰尖刺刺伤。

messages.msgid: Through the fine manipulation of light, an Illusionist might craft deceptively convincing and dangerous illusions.  An Illusionist excels at avoiding direct confrontation, instead relying on decoys and traps to slip by undetected.
translations: 通过对光的精细操控，幻术师可能会制造出具有欺骗性的、令人信服的、而且十分危险的幻象。幻术师擅长于避免直接对抗，而是依靠投影和陷阱在未被察觉的情况下溜走。

messages.msgid:
This attunement grants you a magical control over the forces of magnetism.

Power: Your Magnetism Mage abilities grant you a good defense against firearms, perfect electric immunity, and the ability to see electric creatures from any distance.
translations:
这种心智调谐赋予你操控磁力的魔法。

磁力：你的磁力法师能力让你对枪械有良好的防御力、对电流完全免疫，并且能够从任何距离看到带电的生物。

messages.msgid:
This attunement focuses on continuously freezing foes to death.

Blizzard: Your Permafrost Mage abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.  Also, enemies who attack you may find themselves frozen solid.
translations:
这一调谐专注于持续冻结你的敌人，将其拖入死亡。

暴风雪：你的永霜法师能力赋予你对温度条件的良好抵抗力，除此之外，攻击你的敌人会被冻结。

messages.msgid: The Radiation mage was discovered as an attunement in the 20th century, closely guarded as a military secret in close relation to the Manhattan Project.  It was declassified in 1989 as a part of the attunement awareness movement, but it is still poorly understood even by the very few researchers that wrote books on attunements.
translations: 辐射法师在 20 世纪作为一种魔法调谐被发现，由于其发现过程与曼哈顿计划密切相关，因此一直被作为军事机密严密保管。但在 1989 年，它作为魔法调谐全民科普运动的一部分而被解密，但是至今仍未有研究者彻底理解其原理，即使对于极少数写过魔法调谐专著的研究者也是如此。

messages.msgid:
Deeply attuned to the spiritual fabric that shapes and nurtures the natural world, shamans call upon the primeval spirits of nature for aid and advice.  Be careful however, for ancient spirits are fickle and unknowable things.

Spirits: Your Shaman abilities double your natural mana regeneration.
translations:
体内魔法深深地调谐适应了塑造和培育了这个自然世界的精神体系。萨满巫师向大自然的原始精魂寻求帮助和建议。不过要小心，因为古灵是变幻莫测难以预测的生物。

幻灵：你的萨满巫师能力使你的自然魔力再生翻倍。

messages.msgid: The shapeshifter is the Biomancer refined - able to use a flicker of mana to change shape at the drop of a hat to make yourself more inviting or shape others into desired shapes.
translations: 变形者是一位精益求精的生化术士，摘帽瞬间就能仅用少许的魔力改变自身形状，将你自己变的更迷人或其他想要的体型。

messages.msgid:
The Soulfire is a phenomena of the caster's spirit binding to a fragment of a spirit of flame.  This makes it possible for the Soulfire to use its namesake as an element - much like fire, it does burn, but it burns away at the soul instead of the flesh.

Spirit Flames: Your Soulfire abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.  Your hands also emit the purest of blazes, which increases your damage in melee.
translations:
灵魂之火是施法者将自身部分灵魂与火焰碎片结合而成的现象。这使得魂火法师可以像使用火焰一样使用这种命名了自身魔法调谐的元素，它确实能够燃烧，但它燃烧的是你的灵魂而非肉体。

灵魂之火：你的魂火法师能力赋予你对温度条件的良好抗性。除此之外，你的双手可以散发最纯净的火焰，提高你的近战伤害。

messages.msgid:
You've used your knowledge of Biomancy to change your body into a form befitting a Stormshaper.  You can better withstand the power of electricity, and sparks leap from your skin when something hits you.  You're beginning to study spells that utilize your body's affinity for the electric.

Cyclone: Your Storm Elemental abilities grant you total electric immunity, and reflective zippers to anyone who tries to attack you.
translations:
通过你所掌握的生化术士的力量，你已经改变了你的身体，提升了自身风暴塑造者对电的魔法亲和度。你能更好地承受电的力量，被物体击中后皮肤还会迸发出电火花。你也开始研究更多专注于你身体内在与电的魔法亲和度的魔法。

旋风：你的暴风术师能力赋予你完全免疫电击伤害的能力，除此之外，反射性的电流会射向任何试图攻击你的人。

messages.msgid: Electricity arcs out from where you've been hit.
translations: 雷电自你被击中的地方涌出。

messages.msgid: %1$s's body arcs electricity from the wound.

A stormcaller is a stormshaper with an additional affinity toward the weather in a localized area.  Historians agree that the druid requirement has something to do with the Druid's affinity for nature, just like their ability to summon animals.  You will know a stormcaller is in the room if your ears pop and your hair stands straight on end.  Stormcallers are not known for their subtlety.
translations: 唤风者是对本地区的天气有额外魔法亲和度的风暴塑造者。历史学家一致认为德鲁伊的前置需求与德鲁伊对自然的魔法亲和相关，就像他们召唤动物的能力一样。当你开始耳鸣，毛发竖立之时，你就知道房间里来了位唤风者。唤风者从来不当隐姓埋名之辈。

messages.msgid:
The Sun Mage has been studying the Laws governing heat, and has attained a special relationship with that life-giving yellow orb in the sky.  Glimpses of the Sun meet its foes, and its own burning light pierces the darkness.

Solar Warrior: Your Sun Mage abilities blind everyone who are mean to you.
translations:
日炎法师通过长期研究热量传导规律，与天空中那个造就生命的黄色火球产生了特殊的联系。太阳的光辉将击穿黑暗，使任何瞥见这光芒的敌人畏惧。

太阳战士：你的日炎法师能力会使任何对你图谋不轨的人失明。

messages.msgid: A brilliant light radiates from where you've been hit.
translations: 一道刺眼的闪光自你被击中的地方四散开来。

messages.msgid: %1$s's body is enveloped in a bright glare.
translations: %1$s的身体笼罩在耀眼的强光中。

messages.msgid:
The barren cold of the world's far reaches flows through the Tundra Mage.  They find power in the all-pervasive frost of the North and in the creatures that defy its deathly chill.

Arctic: Your Tundra Mage abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions.
translations:
世界尽头的荒芜严寒，在苔原法师的血脉中流淌。他们从北方无处不在的霜冻和那些藐视致命严寒的生物身上汲取力量。

极寒：你的苔原法师能力让你对极端温度有良好的抗性。

messages.msgid:
Where there is nothing, there is still power, and the Void Mages embody that power.  The ability to wield emptiness itself is at their fingertips, and no living creature can withstand the call of the void.

Drainer: Your Void Mage abilities grant you perfect night vision, and envenom everyone you attack.
translations:
在一无所有之中，仍有魔力，而虚空法师的体内饱含着这一力量。掌控虚空本身的能力就在他们指尖，没有任何活物能够抵挡虚空的召唤。

吞噬者：你的虚空法师能力赋予你完美夜视的能力，同时会在攻击时使敌人中毒。

messages.msgid:
One of the most destructive forces on earth, a Volcano Mage takes some aspect of its namesake.  Their spells tend to be a little slow, but their resilience in proximity to a volcano is legendary.

Lava: Your Vulcanist abilities grant you good resistance to temperature conditions, total heat immunity, and immunity to smoke.
translations:
作为地球上最具毁灭性的力量之一，火山术士人如其名，身具其部分特质。他们的法术往往有点慢，但在火山附近的韧性却是传奇级别的。

熔岩：你的火山术士能力让你对极端温度有良好的抗性，并对高温和烟雾完全免疫。

messages.msgid:
While biomancers focus on both life and death; Wither Mages set their sights on the transitional period between these two stages.  They wield entropy and decay hand and hand, using it to enhance their combat prowess to surgical precision.  This confluence of abilities are what lead to assassin mages gaining this attunement.

Fading: Your Wither Mage abilities grant you the ability to consume the enemies powers for a short time.
translations:
生化术士专注于生死两界，而凋零法师则着眼于生死之间的过渡阶段。他们将熵与衰变玩弄于股掌之间，以此将自身的战斗技艺磨炼至手术般的精准。正是这种种能力的融合，使得刺客型法师获得了这种心智同调。

凋亡：你的凋零法师能力让你能够在短时间内吞噬敌人的力量。

messages.msgid: A tradition as old as magic, the Magus focuses on binding and shaping the energy of the universe to their will.
translations: 作为和魔法本身一样古老的魔法流派，魔术师专精于随心所欲结合并塑造宇宙的能量。

messages.msgid: The animist tradition is a relatively new school of magical thought, formed through combination of many older ways that focus on harmony and connection to the natural world.  This does not mean that animists are passive: the natural world is a savage place.
translations: 泛灵师是一个相对较新的魔法理论流派，它由许多注重与自然世界的联系以及和谐的古老理论融合而成。但这并不意味着泛灵师们只会被动挨打：不要忘了，自然界可是一个野蛮的地方。

messages.msgid: Disciples of the great Archwizard Lord Kelvin.  Kelvinists focus their magic on manipulation and control of the temperature of their environment, leading to spectacularly powerful explosions or bone-chilling cold.  Your powers grant you some immunity from fire that increases with your skills.
translations: 伟大的大魔法师开尔文勋爵的信徒。炽霜法师们凝聚魔力，操控温度，引发炽烈爆炸，制造刺骨严寒。你的力量赋予你一定的火焰防护，这会随着你的技能而提高。

messages.msgid: Stormshapers follow ancient arcane disciplines of meditation and harmony with the winds and tides that shape the planet.  Through their deep connection to these forces, they can request powerful changes.  Your powers grant you some immunity from electricity that increases with your skills.
translations: 风暴塑造者遵循古老的奥术信条，依靠冥想与风暴和潮汐融为一体来改造这个世界。通过他们与这些力量的深入联系，他们可以请求强大力量的改变。你的能力赋予你一些对电的免疫力，这随着你的技能而提高。

messages.msgid: Technomancers are the new breed of modern magician, blending their arcane might with their advanced knowledge of the fundamental nature of the universe.  They use technology to enhance their magic and vice versa.
translations: 科技法师是现代魔法师的新兴流派，他们将神秘的奥术力量与他们对宇宙基本性质的深入了解结合为一体。他们使用科技来强化他们的魔法，反之亦然。

messages.msgid: Earthshapers have allowed their minds to sink deep within the stones and metals of the planet, and become one with its secrets.  To a master Earthshaper, spells can be as permanent as the stones they are created from, and time is measured in geological eras.
translations: 塑地者将自身思想深深地沉入地球的石头和金属之中，并与它的秘密融为一体。对于一位塑地者大师来说，法术可以像他们所创造出来的石头一样持久，而持续时间可以用地质时代来衡量。

messages.msgid: The Biomancer focuses on manipulating and even absorbing flesh; their own, and that of other living or dead things.  Most other wizards find their powers gross and disturbing, but no one can question the potency of their abilities, and certainly not their adaptability to any situation.
translations: 生化术士着重于操纵甚至吸收血肉：自己的，以及其他活物或者死尸的血肉。大多数魔法师认为他们的法术令人恶心与不安，但没人敢质疑它们的威力，当然也没有人敢质疑他们对各种情况的适应力。

messages.msgid: Druids follow a wild tradition of allegiance and rebirth within the world of nature, especially the cycle of death and rebirth that is the plant world.  A powerful Druid is as much a part of that world as the human one.
translations: 德鲁伊忠心遵循自然界中重生复苏的野性传统，特别是植物界中所存在的死亡和重生的轮回。一位强大的德鲁伊和那个世界的联系将会和与人类世界的联系一样紧密。

messages.msgid: Acid boils through your veins.  You feel ancient power swell within you.
translations: 酸液在你的血管里沸腾。你感觉到古老的力量在你体内膨胀。

messages.msgid: You sometimes think back about the world you left behind.  You're glad you burned it in your wake.
translations: 你有时会回想起你所离开的世界。你很高兴自己在觉醒时把它烧成灰烬。

messages.msgid: Your skin has grown thick and a set of draconic black scales has grown to cover most of your body, acting as natural armor.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤变得厚实，一层龙族黑鳞覆盖了你身体的大部分，如同天生的盔甲，并能极大地减轻潮湿效果。

messages.msgid: Your legs and feet have become reptile-like and your toenails have grown into short claws.  Fortunately they don't impede your movement.
translations: 你的腿和脚已经变得像爬行动物，你的脚趾甲已经长成了短爪。幸运的是，它们并不妨碍你的行动。

messages.msgid: Your legs and feet have become dragon-like and the claws on your toes have developed into incredibly tough talons.  These are fearsome and powerful, but prevent you from wearing shoes and slightly impede your movement.
translations: 你的腿和脚已经变得像龙一样，脚趾上的爪子已经坚硬得难以置信。这些爪子可怕而有力，但使你无法穿鞋，还会略微妨碍你的行动。

messages.msgid: You slash %s with your clawed feet!

You have grown noticeably taller, broader, and menacing.  Much of it is useful muscle mass (Strength +2), but you find it throws off your balance and you get in your own way (+10 torso and arm encumbrance), and you notice people are starting to treat you differently.
translations: 你明显地长高长壮长可怕了。你变得更强壮（力量+2），但是你发现你的平衡感被破坏了，甚至会自己绊到自己（+10躯干和手臂累赘），而且人们对待你的态度也有所改变。

messages.msgid: You carry your rugged body with the dignity you deserve, but are all the more menacing for it.  Strength +2.
translations: 虽然你的身材高大威猛，但是你也拥有与之相匹配的力量和敏捷。力量+2。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are enhanced by some growing innate magic.  You are slightly stronger.  Strength + 1
translations: 你的肌肉被体内的魔法强化。你比以前强壮了少许。力量+1

messages.msgid: The connection to your inner magic is growing and your muscles are stronger, but you're a little more clumsy.  Strength + 3, Dexterity - 1
translations: 你与体内魔力的联系正在增强，你的肌肉也变得更加强壮，但你的动作却有点笨拙。力量+3，敏捷-1

messages.msgid: The magic within you courses through your muscles, greatly empowering them.  This costs you valuable flexibility and coordination, however.  Strength + 5, Dexterity - 2
translations: 你体内的魔法不断锻炼着你的肌肉，极大地增强了它们的力量。然而，这会使你失去宝贵的灵活性和协调性。力量+5，敏捷-2

messages.msgid: Your internal magic has filled you with unimaginable strength, but you can't move as freely as your form once could.  This is no problem.  Strength + 8, Dexterity - 3
translations: 你体内的魔法已经让你充满了难以想象的力量，但是你的形体再也不能像以前一样自由地移动。这算不上问题。力量+8，敏捷-3

messages.msgid: You have a pair of long, curved back, dragon-like horns.  They allow you to make a strong bashing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
translations: 你头上有一对又长又向后弯曲的龙角。你可以用你的头撞击对方造成钝击伤害，但也让你没法戴上不是织物做的帽子。

messages.msgid: You headbutt %s with your draconic horns!

You have a pair of large, black scaled dragon wings.  While you have control of them and can make attacks with them, they are not large enough nor strong enough to allow you to fly and they throw you off balance, greatly reducing your ability to dodge.  They can be used to cast a protective spell on yourself however.
translations: 你的背后有双巨大的黑色龙翼，虽然你控制了它们，可以用它们攻击敌人，但它们不够大，不够强壮以至于不但让你飞不起来还使你的身体失去了平衡，降低了你的闪避能力。不过，你可以用来它们对自己施放保护法术。

messages.msgid: You bash %s with your powerful wings!

Your digestive issues have developed to become overly acidic which greatly impacts your ability to normally digest food, resulting in getting far less nutrition from the food you eat and making your need to eat more often.
translations: 你消化系统的问题已经发展变得过酸，这极大地影响了你消化正常食物的能力，导致你从食物中获得的营养要变得少得多，而且你需要更经常地进食。

messages.msgid: Your digestive issues may not have settled entirely, but you can somewhat control them and now you have the ability to spit acid!
translations: 你消化系统的问题可能还没有完全解决，但你可以控制它，现在你能吐出酸液吐息！

messages.msgid: Your muscle response is dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 5 (2.8) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C).  Unfortunately, this doesn't seem to help you conserve any energy.
translations: 你的肌肉反应速度受环境温度影响。在18.3℃(65F)以下，温度每降低2.8℃(5F)，你的速度将下降1%。不幸的是，这似乎无法帮助你减少任何食物消耗。

messages.msgid: Your muscle response is highly dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 3 (1.7) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C).  Unfortunately, it seems you have to exert more energy to keep moving.
translations: 你的肌肉反应速度严重受环境温度影响。在18.3℃(65F)以下，温度每降低1.7℃(3F)，你的速度将下降1%。不幸的是，似乎你必须消耗更多能量才能持续移动。

messages.msgid: Your body has become permanently cold-blooded.  Your speed lowers or raises 1% for every 2 (1.1) degrees below or above 65 F (18.3 C).  All this and you need even more food to maintain your energy.
translations: 你已经完全变异为冷血动物。在温度低于/高于18.3℃(65F)时，每 1.1℃(2F)的变化会使你的速度降低/提高 1%。这使得你需要更多的食物来维持你的能量。

messages.msgid: You are imbued with the ancient magic powers of dragons, improving your mana reserves and opening your mind to amazing feats of magic.
translations: 你的体内灌注了黑龙一族的古老魔法能量，它提高了你的魔力储备上限，并让你领悟到了绝妙的魔法专长。

messages.msgid: Your mind has fully opened to the power and ancient heritage of dragons.  You can access even greater quantities of mana and you have access to more dragon spells.
translations: 你的头脑已经与龙族古老力量和遗存完全融合。它进一步提高了你的魔力储备上限，并让你领悟到了更多的龙族法术。

messages.msgid: Your scales have grown up and around your mouth, digging into your gums and retracting your lips.  On the down side, it makes speaking difficult.  On the positive side, it makes it very easy to bite things, though what's driving you to do that?
translations: 你的鳞片开始在你的嘴周围生长，它们扎在你的牙床上，让你的嘴唇回缩。往坏了说，这让你说话困难。往好了说，这让你咬东西变得很容易，但你为什么要这么做呢？

messages.msgid: Your face and jaws have extended to a long, toothy dragon maw.  It's fearsome and causes grievous wounds, but prevents wearing mouth gear.
translations: 你的脸和下巴都变得很长，变成了长着利齿的龙嘴。它看上去非常可怕，而且能造成严重的伤口，但你嘴部无法穿戴任何装备了。

messages.msgid: You have a short, stubby tail that has strange bumps and ridges.  You can wiggle it, but it serves no purpose.
translations: 你有一个粗短的尾巴，长着奇怪的凸起和脊。你可以扭动它，但它并无作用。

messages.msgid: You have a short, dragonlike tail.  You can use it decently as a club of sorts, but it's not doing anything to help you balance.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你有一条又短又粗的龙尾巴。你可以像挥舞棍棒一样轻松使用它，但它并不能帮助你保持平衡，还会让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You have a long, thick, dragonlike tail.  It doesn't help you balance or dodge any better, but it is a powerful bashing weapon.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你有一条又长又厚的龙尾。它并不能使你保持平衡或是提升闪避能力，但能当作威力强大的钝击武器。让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: Your scales have grown to cover your hands and elongate the tips in to jagged claws that can be serviceable as cutting and piercing weapons in unarmed combat.  You can still use them normally, but you can't wear gloves.
translations: 你的鳞片开始在你的手上生长，并且指尖部分伸长成了锯齿状的爪，在徒手格斗时可以当作斩击和刺击武器使用。你仍旧可以正常控制双手，但你穿不了手套了。

messages.msgid: You have become something more than human.  Something better - and far, far worse.  Combat skills are easy to learn and maintain, and unlike lesser predators, your mental faculties don't suffer at all.
translations: 你已经变得超越人类了。一些更好的东西——但也有更糟糕的东西。战斗技能很容易学习和维持，而且与较小的掠食者不同，你的智力根本不会受到影响。

messages.msgid: Your mind and brain have fully adapted to your new place at the top of the magical food chain.  You can effortlessly master and maintain combat skills, and your malevolent intellect only grows.
translations: 你的思想和大脑已经完全适应了你在神奇食物链顶端的新位置。你可以毫不费力地掌握和维持战斗技能，而你的恶意智力只会不断增长。

messages.msgid: Like your scale and hide, your remaining flesh has been transmuted by black dragon's essence.  You are invulnerable to acid now.
translations: 如同你的鳞片和皮肤，你残余的血肉已被黑龙精萃所嬗变。你现在对强酸完全免疫。

messages.msgid: Your heart beats in time with the rhythm of the Earth.
translations: 你的心脏与地球的节奏同步跳动。

messages.msgid: Trust the humans to make a mess of the world.  Trust a dwarf to rebuild it better than they found it.
translations: 相信人类会把世界搞得一团糟。相信一个矮人能把它重建得比他们发现的更好。

messages.msgid: You hear the songs of nature.
translations: 你听到了大自然的歌声。

messages.msgid: The first elves sprang forth from magic and moonlight before the ancestors of humanity stopped scurrying through the underbrush to avoid the dinosaurs.  You won't let that legacy die with you.
translations: 在人类的祖先不再为了躲避恐龙而匆忙穿梭于灌木丛之前，第一批精灵从魔法和月光中诞生了。你不会让这份遗产随你而去的。

messages.msgid: You feel the urge to steal a baby or two.
translations: 你有一种想偷一两个孩子的冲动。

messages.msgid: Long ago, the others feared your people as hunters in the night.  In this new world, it's time to revive that legacy.
translations: 很久以前，其他人就像夜间的猎人一样害怕你的人民。在这个新的世界里，是时候重振这一传说了。

messages.msgid: You remember the warmth of your home swamps.
translations: 你记得你家沼泽的温暖。

messages.msgid: The old world was nothing like your home swamps, but this new world is something you understand.
translations: 旧世界一点也不像你们家乡的沼泽，但这个新世界是你们所了解的。

messages.msgid: You feel the call of the sky.  There are treasures out there to collect.
translations: 你感受到了天空的召唤。那里有宝藏等着你去收集。

messages.msgid: In the ruins of the old world, you're sure there are plenty of new places to go and new things to find.
translations: 在旧世界的废墟中，你肯定有很多新的地方可以去，也有很多新东西可以找到。

messages.msgid: Dwarves are smaller than humans, the better to deal with confined spaces underground, but as solid as the mountains (+2 STR, -1 DEX).
