translations: 矮人比人类矮小，能够更好地适应地下狭窄的空间环境，但他们拥有如山脉般坚实的体魄（+2 力量，-1 敏捷）。

messages.msgid: Born from the living earth, your people are naturally adept at the manipulation of the physical world.  Your crafting speed is 10% faster, and you can even craft in darkness.
translations: 你的族群诞生于活土之中，天生擅长操纵物质世界。你的制作速度提升10%，甚至能在黑暗中制作。

messages.msgid: Long ages underground or under the night boughs have made your people capable of seeing into the infrared spectrum.
translations: 长期生活在地下或夜间的树枝下使你们的人能够看到红外光谱。

messages.msgid: Elves are more lithe and frail than humans, but possess an almost otherworldly grace (-1 STR, +2 DEX).
translations: 精灵比人类更柔弱，但拥有近乎超凡脱俗的优雅。力量 -1，敏捷 +2。

messages.msgid: The elves are often called the "Fair Folk" due to their preternatural beauty, and you are no exception to this custom.
translations: 精灵常因其超凡之美被称作“仙灵”，在这一惯例上，你亦不例外。

messages.msgid: Like a cat, elven eyes are well-attuned to low levels of light, able to pick up even the slightest glimmer.  You have greatly-enhanced night vision.
translations: 精灵的眼睛，如同猫眼般敏锐，即使在幽暗中也能捕捉到最细微的闪光。你拥有极其强大的夜视能力。

messages.msgid: Your delicate pointed ears allow you to hear all the sounds of the world.
translations: 你精致尖尖的耳朵可以让你听到世界上所有的声音。

messages.msgid: Rather than sleep insensate like humans do, you blend living night and dreams into a harmonious whole.  You are not bothered by light levels, and need much less sleep per night.
translations: 你不像人类那样睡得毫无知觉，而是把活生生的黑夜和梦境融合成一个和谐的整体。你不会受到光线水平的影响，每晚需要的睡眠也会少得多。

messages.msgid: The elves were born of nature and the elements, and long ages under the trees allow them to quickly pass through their forest homes.
translations: 精灵是大自然和自然元素的产物，在树下生活了很长时间，使他们能够快速穿越森林家园。

messages.msgid: Goblins are much smaller than humans, often no more than half the height.  You have a harder time carrying things and can't eat as much, but you're better at dodging and make very little noise when you move.
translations: 哥布林比人类小得多，通常不超过一半的高度。你很难拿东西，也不能吃那么多，但你更善于躲避，移动时很少发出噪音。

messages.msgid: Your people have always had an easier time operating at night, away from the hated light of the sun.
translations: 你的人在晚上行动总是比较容易，远离讨厌的阳光。

messages.msgid: Your teeth are longer and more pointed than not.  Before the Cataclysm it was considered extremely gauche to bite anything in a fight; it was a mark of the goblins' uncivilized past.  But, needs must.
translations: 你的牙齿又长又尖。在大灾变之前，战斗时咬人曾被认为是无礼之举，是未开化者的残留。但是，有需就有用。

messages.msgid: While your reddish eyes have been known to give other people a start, they help you see in the dark.  You have much better night vision than a human, even being able to craft in the dark.
translations: 虽然你泛红的双眼时常会吓别人一跳，但它们能帮助你在黑暗中视物。你的夜视能力比人类要好得多，甚至能在黑暗中进行制作。

messages.msgid: Lizardfolk are taller and stronger than humans but not much thicker and are surprisingly fast for their size (+1 STR, +1 DEX).
translations: 蜥族比人类更高、更强壮，但挨揍程度并没有强太多，相对其体型而言动作十分迅捷。力量 +1，敏捷 +1。

messages.msgid: Your feet are heavily webbed, with three large scaled toes and a dewclaw in the back, allowing you to swim faster.  However, your feet are not designed for human footwear.
translations: 你的脚上是三个巨大的鳞状脚趾，脚趾间长有厚蹼，脚后跟有一个露爪，让你游得更快。然而，你的脚穿不进人类的鞋子。

messages.msgid: While not completely predatory, the lizardfolk are generally not particularly invested in the welfare of warmbloods.  Their death does not affect you greatly, and your ability to maintain combat skills is enhanced.
translations: 虽然不是完全的掠食性动物，但蜥蜴族通常不会特别关注温血动物的福利。他们的死亡不会对你造成太大的影响，而且你维持战斗技能的能力得到了增强。

messages.msgid: Your face and jaws are those of a predatory lizard, with a set of sharp teeth to go with them.  They look NASTY--as do the bite wounds they can inflict--but prevent wearing mouthgear.
translations: 你的脸和下颚呈现出掠食性蜥蜴的形态，还长着一副与之相配的锋利牙齿。它们看起来相当骇人——它们所能造成的咬伤也同样如此——但这会让你无法穿戴任何口部装备。

messages.msgid: Ravenfolk are about the same size as humans, though their feathers and wings obviously set them apart.
translations: 鸦族的体型和人类差不多，不过它们的羽毛和翅膀显然使它们与众不同。

messages.msgid: Your legs and feet are those of a raven, with three long talons at the front and one at the back, ending in wicked claws and preventing you from wearing shoes.  Fortunately they don't impede your movement, and you could use them as part of a leaping attack.
translations: 你的双腿和双脚是渡鸦的形态，前有三根长趾，后有一根，趾末是邪异的利爪，这让你无法穿鞋。幸运的是，它们并不会妨碍你的移动，而且你可以在跳跃攻击时用上它们。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of large raven wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  Your body is too heavy to be able to fly, but if you're not too weighed down, you might be able to glide from a ledge or lessen the impact of a fall.
translations: 你有一对巨大的渡鸦翅膀从你的肩胛骨伸出。你的身体太重了，无法飞行，但如果你没有负重太多，或许能从高台上滑翔而下，或减轻坠落时的冲击力。

messages.msgid: Your large beak allows you to imitate nearly every sound humans can make, as well as let out very loud screeches.  And also rip into flesh, if it comes to that.
translations: 你巨大的鸟喙让你几乎能模仿人类发出的所有声音，也能发出非常响亮的尖啸。而且，情势所逼的话，还能用它来撕裂血肉。

messages.msgid: You stab into %s with your beak!

Your bones are nearly hollow, a remnant of your people's past as creatures of the air.  Your body is very light as a result, enabling you to move and attack 20% faster, but also frail; you can carry 40% less, and bashing attacks injure you more.
translations: 你的骨头几乎是空心的，，这是你们族群过去作为空中生物的遗留特征。由于你的身体很轻，你的行动速度增加20%，但你的体质也弱，你的最大载重量减少40%，而且你受到的钝击伤害有所提升。

messages.msgid: You need to have shiny objects on your person or you just can't concentrate very well.  You suffer a morale penalty unless you're wearing at least six items made of gold or silver.
translations: 你身上必须得有闪闪发光的物件，否则就难以集中精神。除非你穿戴着至少六件由黄金或白银制成的物品，否则你会受到士气惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your ley lines surge with mana and power.
translations: 你的灵脉中，魔力与权能正汹涌澎湃。

messages.msgid: Magic is in you.  Magic is you.
translations: 魔法在你体内。你就是魔法。

messages.msgid: Your internal ley lines have become much easier for you to control, resulting in you being able to naturally create crystallized mana.
translations: 你对体内灵脉的掌控变得更加精妙，使你能够自然而然地生成魔力结晶。

messages.msgid: Your hands glow with mana energy.  You can fire seeker bolts from your fingertips.
translations: 你的双手闪耀着魔法能量。你可以用指尖发射能够追踪敌人的火焰箭。

messages.msgid: You no longer need to move your arms to cast spells, due to your ley lines becoming untethered from your arms.  Hand and arm encumbrance no longer applies to spells, and you can cast regardless of wielded objects.
translations: 你的灵脉已与双臂解绑，因此施法时无需再依赖手臂动作。手部与臂部的累赘将不再影响施法，你甚至可以在手持物品时进行吟唱。

messages.msgid: You no longer need to use your voice to enforce your will upon the world.  Verbal spells do not require an incantation, and mouth encumbrance no longer applies to spell failure chance.
translations: 你不再需要发出声音便可将自身意志强加于这个世界之上。需言语的法术无需吟唱咒语，嘴部累赘不再增加法术失败几率。

messages.msgid: Your body is unnaturally weak.  -2 Strength.
translations: 你的身体异常虚弱。力量 -2。

messages.msgid: The constant thrum of mana makes your ley lines visibly glow beneath the skin of your torso and limbs, shedding a small amount of light.  However, it also makes you slightly warmer.
translations: 魔力的持续嗡鸣让你躯干与四肢皮下的灵脉清晰可见地发出辉光，散发出微弱的光芒。然而，这也让你的体温略微升高了。

messages.msgid: Casting a spell sometimes causes your mana to grow overexcited, making the normally-dim glow of your ley lines much brighter.  This extends the glow to your entire body.
translations: 施法有时会导致你的魔力变得过度兴奋，使你灵脉原本暗淡的光芒变得明亮许多，并扩散至你的全身。

messages.msgid: Your mana sometimes swirls off your leylines and excites the air, creating a eldritch glow around you, occasionally happening when you cast or a spell or when your mana is high enough.  All you can do when it happens is wait for it to subside.
translations: 你的魔力有时会从魔力脉络中盘旋而出，激发周围的空气，在你周身形成一种诡秘的辉光。这种情况偶尔会在你施法或魔力足够高时发生。发生这种情况时，你所能做的只有等待它自行消退。

messages.msgid: Violence excites your ley lines.  Whenever you hit an enemy in melee, you have a chance of regaining some mana.
translations: 暴力能够唤醒你体内的灵脉。当你在近战中攻击命中敌人时，你就有几率获得一些魔力。

messages.msgid: A slimmed magical metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.
translations: 一个轻便的魔法金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加载具大小。

messages.msgid: An expensive magical metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.
translations: 一个昂贵的魔法金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加载具大小。

messages.msgid: A magically manifested combustion engine.  Despite operating entirely off of mana rather than normal fuel, it otherwise functions exactly as a conventional internal combustion engine.  Somehow.
translations: 一台使用魔法制造的内燃机。尽管完全使用魔力作为燃料，在其它方面它却和普通的内燃机没有什么不同。原理未知。

messages.msgid: An everburning torch that has been placed into a sconce for easy attachment to a wall.
translations: 放置在壁灯中的不灭火炬可轻松固定在墙上。

messages.msgid: A column of mana energy that enables a floating disk to move.
translations: 一系列魔法能量，使飘浮碟能够移动。

messages.msgid: A shape of pure mana that can float and carry items.
translations: 一个由纯粹魔力构成的飘浮碟，可以用来搬运物品。
在一片锥形区域喷出花粉。

messages.msgid: You are resting in the depths of the earth.  You should never actually see this.
Settled to slumber with their hoard.
Entered the halls of the King Under the Mountain.
Fell from your perch on the World Tree.
translations: 从你栖息的世界树上掉下来。

messages.msgid: Settled to slumber with their hoard.
Entered the halls of the King Under the Mountain.
Fell from your perch on the World Tree.
translations: 从你栖息的世界树上掉下来。

messages.msgid: Dabbler (Knowing the Day and the Hour)

translations: 一术之长（召唤守望者之魂）
海巴西勒大使荣誉卫队

messages.msgid: You took a few classes about magical theory before the Cataclysm and still remember most of it.
translations: 你在大灾变之前上过几门关于魔法理论的课程，并且仍然记得其中的大部分内容。

messages.msgid: You were either a practicing mage or made a formal study of magical theory.  You could have designed spells in your spare time, if you had wanted.
translations: 你要么是一名执业法师，要么对魔法理论进行了正规研究。只要你愿意，你能在空闲时设计出新法术。

messages.msgid: You could have taught magical theory to mages, whether you know any spells or not.
translations: 你可以向法师传授魔法理论，无论自己是否懂得法术。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Freshen Up, the most common spell in the pre-Cataclysm world.  It saved up a lot of time before work in your old life and you've certainly made a lot of use of it now that there's no more running water.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。对你来说，这个法术是梳洗术，大灾变前世界中最常见的法术。在你以前的生活中，为你在节省了工作前的时间，而现在已经没有自来水了，你肯定也需要更多地使用它了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Crystallize Mana.  Sure, it ruined your social life and you slept for 12 hours a day, but you made a tidy sum of money producing mana crystals for mages who needed them.  Too bad all that money is useless now.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。对你来说，这个法术是制造魔力结晶。当然，它毁了你的社交生活，毕竟你每天要睡12个小时，但你通过为有需求的法师们加工魔力水晶赚了不少钱。只是这些钱对当下来说毫无帮助。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Magical Light.  It was mostly a party trick, to be honest, and the weeks learning to cast a spell that any smartphone could replicate showed you how much work trying to learn real magic actually was.  But the nights are dark enough nowadays that you're glad you put in the effort.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是魔法阅读灯。说实话，这不过是个派对小把戏，而花了几周时间学习这个任何智能手机都能复制的法术，让你意识到学习真正的魔法有多难。然而，如今的夜晚黑暗得足以让你感激当初的努力。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Aura of Protection.  To be honest, you originally learned it to try to replace the umbrella you kept leaving at home and were very disappointed when that didn't work.  It's saved you at least once from some strange gas in the air, though, so all that effort paid off.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是保护光环。说实话，最初你学习它是为了代替你那总是忘在家的雨伞，当发现它无法替代雨伞时，你感到非常失望。不过，它至少曾在空气中出现奇怪气体时救了你一次，你的努力没有白费。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Sound Bomb.  You mostly used it for jokes, to play pranks on your friends and annoy the neighborhood dogs, but it's proven its worth now at the end of the world.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是声波炸弹。大多数时候你用这个法术和朋友开玩笑，或是吓唬邻居家的狗。但在这个世界末日，它证明了自己的价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knowing the Day and the Hour.  Your non-mage friends were always asking you why you bothered learning what was widely considered to be the least useful spell in the world, and sometimes you weren't sure yourself.  Even now that the network is done, you're still not entirely sure how important it is to know that it's exactly 6:12 a.m. vs. just "sunrise".  But if it ever is important, you'll know it.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是知晓时间。你那些非法师朋友总是问你，为什么要费心学习被广泛认为是世界上最无用的咒语，有时你自己也不确定。即使现在已经没有网络，你仍不确定知道现在是早上6点12分而不是“日出”有多重要。但如果它很关键，你会知道的。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Peaceful Rest.  Ever since you were a child, you dreaded bedtime.  Falling asleep was an ordeal, a battle between you and the bed, and it seemed like no matter how many sheep you counted, sleep hygiene habits you practiced, or exhausted you felt, it was an hour or more until you finally fell into sleep.  You became a mage because you were tired of having 5% of your life stuck staring at the ceiling while waiting for sleep to come, and ever since the world ended, you're even more grateful you can fall asleep whenever you need to.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是安睡术。 自你孩提时代起，你就很害怕睡觉时间。入睡对你来说是一场煎熬，是你与床之间的战斗，似乎无论你数了多少只羊，遵循了多少睡眠卫生习惯，或者感到多么疲惫，最终还是要经过一个小时甚至更久才能入睡。你成为了一名法师，因为你厌倦了把生命中的5%浪费在盯着天花板等待入睡的过程中。而自从世界终结之后，你更加感激自己能够在需要时随时入睡。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Ignus Fatuus.  It was mostly just for your amusement, summoning the will-o'-the-wisps at sundown and watching them dance, but they've proven handy more than once lately by leading some monster astray while you ran for your life.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是召唤鬼火。你学习这个法术主要是为了自娱自乐，例如在日落时召唤鬼火，看它们在夕阳中舞蹈。但最近它们已经不止一次派上了用场：引开怪物，让你逃命。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Summon Watcher Spirit.  You initially learned it to keep an eye on your cat while you were doing chores around the house, but it ended up being even more valuable than you thought once the world ended.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是召唤守望者之魂。你最初学会它是为了在做家务时盯紧你的猫，但在世界末日来临后，它比你想象的更有价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Witchsight.  People asked you why you would bother learning a spell that only let you know if other people were mages, but every bit of information helped.  A gun you can see, an expensive suit, the size and strength of a person or the way they carry themselves, but a mage's talent is all hidden until they a cast spell.  Unless, of course, you knew how to look, and you did.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是巫术视觉。人们常常问你，为什么要费心学习一种只能识别别人是否是法师的魔法，但你始终认为，做出判断时的每一丝信息都至关重要。一把枪、一套昂贵的西装、一个人的体型、力量和行为举止，仅靠视觉就能获取这些信息。而法师的天赋却是不可见的，直到他们施展魔法。除非，你知道如何去观察，而你正好知道。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knit the Rent Flesh.  Certainly no one ever asked your reasons for studying biomancy, especially after you saw that guy get hit by a truck running a red light and managed to stop him from bleeding out before the paramedics arrived.  It was disturbing to watch, but it was undoubtedly effective.  As long as you're light on your feet, you won't have to worry about dying of your injuries now.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“血肉缝合”。当然，没人会问你学习生化术的原因，尤其是在你亲眼目睹一个倒霉蛋被闯红灯的卡车撞倒，并在急救人员赶到前成功为他止血之后。那一幕固然触目惊心，但效果也毋庸置疑。只要你身手敏捷，现在就不用担心会因伤势过重而死了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Carrion Feast.  You had your reasons for studying it, certainly, and perhaps it is best not to speculate about them now.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是腐肉盛宴。 你当初肯定有自己的理由去研究它……现在最好不要对那个理由过多猜测。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Water's Cooling Touch.  You always hated summer, the stickiness, the heat, the sunburns, and your dislike of the weather drove you to study druidic magic to overcome it.  With your water bottle handy, you'll never have to worry about being too hot in the sun again.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是清凉之触。 你一直很讨厌夏天，那种粘腻感、酷热、晒伤，而对天气的厌恶驱使你去学习德鲁伊魔法来克服它。手握水瓶，你再也不用担心在烈日下过热了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Traverse the Wilds.  Part of the joy of hiking is taking your time, of being away from the tyranny of clocks and schedules and deadlines.  But sometimes, it was nice to just see the miles fly by, to reach the summit before sunrise and take in the view without getting up at 2 a.m., to finish the entire trail and still have time to sit down and eat a leisurely dinner.  And it's not like you teleported, after all.  Regardless of the magic, you still had to walk every single step.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是穿行荒野。徒步的乐趣之一在于放慢脚步，远离时钟、日程安排和最后期限的束缚。不过有时候，能看到里程数迅速增加也是一种享受。在日出前到达山顶欣赏美景而不必凌晨两点起床，完成整条路线后还能有时间坐下来悠闲地吃一顿晚餐。不同于瞬间移动，不管有多少“魔法”在内，每一步都需要你亲自走完。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  Biohacking was your passion, trying to optimize your life through diet, exercise, and sleep tricks, and you turned to druidic magic to cut out wasted time.  When the Pomodoro timer went off, you scurried to the fridge, grabbed a handful of berries and enchanted them, scarfed them down, and then got back to work.  You never had to deal with meal replacement nonsense, you just ate your berries and got things done.  Your clients are dead now and everything you worked on is ash and dust, but eating those berries has proven to be the best habit you picked up.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是“神莓术”。与其通过规划饮食、锻炼和睡眠来提升生活质量，不如用生物骇客技术……我是说德鲁伊魔法，来减少浪费的时间。你从不操心下一顿吃什么，当闹钟响起时，你只需从冰箱里抓起一把浆果，施个魔法，迅速吞下，然后重新投入到工作中去。如今甲方已不在人世，你努力完成的一切也化为了灰烬，但吃浆果的习惯被证明是你养成过的最好的习惯。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Utility Molding.  You read a pamphlet once entitled, "One Spell is All You Need!" and thought it seemed like a good idea.  And true, maybe you've never needed a mining pick before, but the ability to all up a knife or a shovel or a hammer whenever you want has come in handy countless times.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是工具塑造术。你曾读过一本名为《一个咒语搞定一切！》的小册子，觉得这是个好主意。的确，也许你永远用不上矿镐，但随时召唤出一把刀、铲子或锤子的能力却可以无数次派上用场。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Tremorsense.  It kept you safe, letting you know if someone was nearby even if you were absorbed in a task or listening to music, but now that most of the people you meet want to eat you it's proven invaluable.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是震颤感知。它能保证你即使在专注于某项任务或听音乐时，也能知道附近是否有人。而现在大多数你遇到的人都想吃掉你，这个法术变得更有价值了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, the Turning of the Earth.  Gardening was your passion and you got sick of manually digging rows in early spring or mid-summer weather.  After your studies you could just cast the spell and the earth neatly parted, waiting for seeds to be planted.  Once the canned food runs out, you're sure you'll get even more use of your powers.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是翻土术。 你曾热衷于打理庭院，但你厌倦了在初春或盛夏的天气里手动挖沟。在完成学业后，你只需施展一个法术，泥土就会整齐地分开等待播种。在罐头吃完后，你确信你这份力量会变得更加有用。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Finger Firelighter.  You had a lot of great conversations with people, late at night outside clubs and restaurants, when they'd ask for a light and you'd just snap your fingers.  Lately, though, you've used it to cook food more than light cigarettes and haven't had anyone to talk to, but at least the fires at night are warm.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是火焰之指。你曾经在深夜俱乐部或餐厅外与别人有过很多精彩的对话，他们向你借火，你只需打个响指。最近，你更多用它来做饭而不是点烟，也没有人与你交谈，至少夜里的火焰还是温暖的。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Flames of Passion.  Alcohol is a social lubricant, and if you already had a drink in your hand, why not use it to let you loosen up and make it easier to talk to people?  You were out at parties almost every weekend and had a wide circle of friends.  Hopefully at least a few of them made it through all of this.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是热情之火。酒精是一种社交润滑剂，如果你已经手握一杯酒，为什么不借此放松一下，让自己更容易与人交谈呢？在大灾变发生前，几乎每个周末你都会出去参加聚会，朋友圈相当广泛。希望如今还能有几个人能够陪你度过这一切。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Slowfall.  Some people become mages due to a dream, or a goal they want to pursue, but for you it was the memory of falling down the stairs as a child and breaking your leg.  With your magic you could jump off a roof and it was no more dangerous than jumping off a low stone wall, and that's been pretty useful for some of the situations you've found yourself in since the Cataclysm.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是羽落术。有些人成为法师是因为追求梦想，或是实现目标，而你成为法师的缘由却是小时候下楼梯摔断了腿。凭借你的魔法，你现在从屋顶跳下来的危险性和跳下矮墙差不多。自从大灾变发生以来，这种能力在你遇到的许多情况中都非常有用。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Faerie Fire.  Maybe it wasn't a great use of your time, but it was fun at parties and one time when your cat ran off it made it very easy to find her.  Since the Cataclysm, though, your magical powers have become much more useful.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是妖精之火。也许学这个有点浪费时间，但在派对上用一用还是挺有趣的。有一次你的猫跑掉了，用这个技能很容易就找到了她。自从大灾变以来，你的魔法力量变得更加有用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Sorcerer's Hand.  Alright, fine, you admit it, you learned magic because of laziness.  It seems odd to say, with all the hours after work and late at night, studying until you could make your keys twitch and fall off the table and eventually until you can grab a drink from across the room, but it's true.  You could reach nearly everything without having to get up.  Anyway, you're way more active now, and being able to grab things from across the room has come in handy more than once since the end of the world.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是“法师之手”。没错，你承认你学魔法是因为懒得动。（这话听起来有点奇怪，毕竟你花了那么空余时间去练习魔法，让钥匙颤动、从桌上掉下，最终还能隔着房间取杯饮料，但这确实是你学魔法的源动力。）你几乎不用起身就能拿到一切东西。不管怎样，现在的你活跃多了，而在世界末日之后，隔空取物的能力已经多次证明了它的价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Spider Climb.  A lot of people in the rockclimbing community said you were cheating, and, to be honest, they were right.  But every time you saw one of those spectacular views from the summit, well, those complaints didn't mean that much.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是蛛行术。许多攀岩爱好者都认为你这是在作弊，有一说一，确实。 但是，每当你目睹山顶上那壮丽的景色时，那些抱怨也就没那么重要了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Windrunning.  It's embarrassing to admit, but you became a mage because you were always running late.  Just one spell made it much easier to catch that bus, to beat that red light across the crosswalk, to make it to work on time instead of a few minutes late.  Nowadays you have a lot more practice at running and that speed still comes in handy.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是风行术。虽然有些难以启齿，但你成为法师是为了避免迟到。只需一个法术就能让你更容易赶上公交车，闯过人行道上的红灯，准时赶到上班地点，而不是迟到几分钟被骂得狗血淋头。如今奔跑已经成为了生存必须的技能，这份速度更有用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Fire Spark.  Most people when they wanted to light a fire thought of kelvinists, but electricity always fascinated you.  You used to love watching the storms roll in, sitting on your porch as the lightning played across the sky, and while summoning lightning bolts wouldn't have been useful for anything at all, catching fires with a spark has come in handy.
translations: 你是你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是“电火花”。说到点火，大多数人会想到炽霜法师，但你更热衷于闪电的力量。你曾经喜欢坐在门廊上，看着风暴滚滚而来，闪电在天空中舞动。召唤一束电火花并没有什么实际用途，但点燃火堆绝对够用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Air Bubble.  It was originally because of your diving trips.  You were sick of having the goggles and the respirator between you and the sea, and if one simple spell would make it so you didn't have to worry about that again, you were willing to put in the time to learn it.  When you had to swim across that river to escape the horde a while ago, it definitely proved its worth.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“气泡术”。你最初学习它，是为了潜水之旅。你早已厌倦了潜水镜和呼吸器将你与大海隔开的感觉，如果一个简单的法术能让你一劳永逸，你愿意花时间去学习。不久前，当你不得不游过那条河以躲避尸潮时，这个法术终于证明了它的价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Lamp.  Sure, phones had lights, but they weren't nearly as bright as a magical one was, and it was pretty nice to just recite the words and light up an entire room like a high-powered flashlight.  Now that the power's out, it's even more useful.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“魔法灯”。诚然，手机也有照明功能，但亮度远不及魔法之光，而且只需念诵咒语，就能像大功率手电筒一样照亮整个房间，这种感觉实在不错。如今电力中断，这个法术就更有用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knock.  You originally learned it because you always forgot your keys and after the third time you were locked out of your apartment, to turned to magic to solve the problem.  Of course, once you did have to use magic to get back in you realized that anyone else could have done the same thing, so in the end it just ruined your peace of mind.  At least now you can be sure there's no one home at the places you're entering.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“敲击术”。你最初学它，是因为老是忘带钥匙。在你第三次被锁在公寓门外后，你转而求助于魔法来解决问题。当然，当你有一次真的用魔法开门进去后，你突然意识到，其他人也能用同样的方法进来。结果，这反而让你不得安宁。至少现在，你可以确定你闯入的屋子里空无一人了。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Firstborn, called "alfar" or "sidhe" or, more recently, "elves" by the humans.  Your people had integrated into human society before the Cataclysm, doing jobs involving animals and nature since modern industry was never to your liking.  Had technological development continued, you might have been forced to make some unpleasant compromises, but not as unpleasant as you have during the end of the world.
translations: 你们是长生族的一员，被人类称为 "阿尔法 "或 "西德"，最近又被称为 "精灵"。 在大灾变之前，你们已经融入了人类社会，从事与动物和大自然有关的工作，因为现代工业并不符合你们的喜好。 如果科技继续发展，你们可能会被迫做出一些令人不快的妥协，但不会像你在世界末日那样令人不快。

messages.msgid: You are a Child of the Stone, called "dwarf" by the humans.  The legends tell that long ago, your people were born of stone and mined your way up to the surface world and its light, where you found the other sapient species of Earth.  While the scale of the human world was always a bit of a problem, you fit in well due to your people's long tradition of craftsdwarfship and hard work.  Now that society has collapsed, maybe you can turn that same drive to rebuilding it.
translations: 你是石之子，被人类称为 "矮人"。 传说在很久以前，你们的祖先从石头中诞生，通过采矿来到地表世界，并在那里发现了地球上的其他智慧物种。 虽然人类世界的规模一直是个问题，但由于你们的民族有着悠久的手工艺和勤劳的传统，你们很好地融入了这个世界。 现在社会崩溃了，也许你们可以把这种动力转化为重建社会的动力。

messages.msgid: You are a goblin.  Before the Cataclysm your people were always a little out of place: the houses weren't designed for you, the shops weren't open when you were awake, and your appearance sometimes gave human or elven children nightmares that you were going to steal them or reminded dwarves of the ancient wars your peoples fought.  As it turned out, you weren't what any of them should have been worrying about.
translations: 你是哥布林。 在大灾变之前，你的族群总是有点格格不入：房子不是为你设计的，商店在你醒着的时候也不开门，你的出现有时会让人类或精灵的孩子做噩梦，以为你要偷走他们，或者让矮人想起你们族群的古代战争。 事实证明，他们不应该担心你。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Scaled Ones, called "lizardfolk" by the warmbloods.  For generations, your tribe served a dragon as its eyes and ears in the outside world, until civilization encroached far enough that even all the dragon's might could not hold it back.  You were sent out to integrate into the modern world, but you were only there a few years before human science ended their world.  Now, you have to survive in the mess they've created.
translations: 你是鳞类的一员，被温血种称为 "蜥族"。 世世代代以来，你们的部落一直为龙服务，充当龙在外部世界的耳目，直到文明蚕食到连龙的所有力量都无法阻挡的地步。 你们被派去融入现代世界，但只待了几年，人类科学就终结了他们的世界。 现在，你们必须在人类制造的混乱中生存下去。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Kor'uru, called "ravenfolk" by those who can't make the appropriate clacking sound due to their lack of beak.  While your people could not fly without the aid of magic, you were always drawn to explore the world, and had traveled to nearly every country and continent even before modern society made such travel easy.  You were well-integrated into society at all levels…and that made you just as vulnerable as everyone else when it fell.
translations: 你是科乌鲁的一员，因为没有鸟嘴而无法发出 "咔咔 "声的人称你为 "鸦族"。 虽然没有魔法的帮助，你们的族人无法飞行，但你们总是喜欢探索世界，甚至在现代社会让旅行变得容易之前，你们就已经走遍了几乎所有的国家和大陆。 你们在各个层面都融入了社会……这让你们在社会衰落时和其他人一样脆弱。

messages.msgid: You found a pamphlet with bright colors claiming you can be a Wizard, oddly serene with the world falling down around you.
translations: 你发现了一本宣称能让你成为魔法师的炫丽手册，在世界在你身边崩溃时，它让你感到一股奇特的宁静。

messages.msgid: You have loved fire all of your life.  You have now discovered your inner fire, and want to exercise that upon the world.
translations: 一生所恋，炽焰浓烟，心炎既现，熔炼人间。

messages.msgid: The ancient circle of druids is gone with the Cataclysm.  Nature must thrive.
translations: 古老的德鲁伊祭坛在大灾变中随风而逝了。但自然终将繁盛。

messages.msgid: You always had to hide your magic, as it was generally not an acceptable type of magic in the wizarding world, but with the Cataclysm you need to pull every trick out of the book.
translations: 你以前总是不得不隐藏自己的魔法，因为它在魔法师世界中不被大多数人所接受，但现在面对大灾变时，你需要使出浑身解数利用好每一个法术。

messages.msgid: The son of a weatherman, you were always interested in the weather.  Recently you found it was possible to manipulate the weather yourself through arcane means!  Unfortunately you did not have long to enjoy your power, as events unfolded…
translations: 你爸以前是个气象员，所以你也对气象学很感兴趣。最近你发现你居然可以用神秘的方法操作天气！可惜你没来得及发挥你的力量，大灾变就到来了……

messages.msgid: You were always tough in a fight.  Your coach managed to teach you a trick or two to make you a little tougher.
translations: 你在打架的时候总是最能抗的那个。你的教练在此基础上教了你几个绝招，让你变得更加能抗。

messages.msgid: With the recent Cataclysm, the way you found to cheat on tests may have to find some other use.
translations: 随着大灾变的到来，你可能得想办法把在考试时学会的作弊技巧用在其它方面了。

messages.msgid: You segregated yourself from society because you wanted to concentrate on improving yourself.  It was you and your best friend, but now the apocalypse won't leave you alone.
translations: 你把自己与社会隔离开来，因为你想集中精力提升自我。这本是你自己最好的朋友，但现在大灾变可不会让你一个人呆着。

messages.msgid: You lost your faith when your spouse died of illness.  You've been drinking yourself to death ever since.  God is punishing everyone with this apocalypse, you are going to show them your brand of mercy.
translations: 当你的配偶因病去世时，你失去了你的信仰。从那以后你就一直喝得烂醉如泥。上帝用大灾变惩罚每一个人，而你要向它们展示你仁慈的烙印。

messages.msgid: You've long suspected the world might suddenly turn over.  With your training, spells, and revolver, your chances are far better than most.
translations: 你早就怀疑世界会突然终结。有了你的训练、法术和左轮手枪，你活下去的几率比大多数人都要高得多。

messages.msgid: You are a highly sought exotic magic dancer.  You can heat the room temperature with your moves and your body, but whenever it lights too much you freeze it with your magic, granting you great control over your public.  They can see, but never touch.
translations: 你是一位备受追捧的魔法舞者。你可以用你的动作和身体来让室内的气氛变得更火热，但每当"温度"太高时，你就会用你的魔法让它"冷"静下来，让你可以很好地控制你的观众。对他们来说，你只可远观而不可亵玩也。

messages.msgid: You are an expert in dimensionalism, with its most common example being teleportation magic, that is the reason why you could survive while your colleagues could not.  Your only hope is that your highly specialized skills will continue keeping you alive.
translations: 你是维度方面的专家，你最常用的魔法是传送魔法，这就是为什么你生存下了来，而你的同事却不能。你唯一的希望是你那高度专业化的技能可以继续让你继续活着。

messages.msgid: Helped by all kind of magical tools and your great talents, you were planning your next great break in.  The world ended before you had time to escape with all of your ill-gained plunder, but at least now nobody can stop you now from breaking whatever locks you desire.
translations: 在各种神奇的工具和天赋的帮助下，你正在计划你的下一票大案。然而在你带着所有不义之财逃离之前，世界就终结了，但至少现在没有人能阻止你撬开任何你想要的撬开的锁了。

messages.msgid: You were lucky enough to find a weird flask that refills itself with whiskey!  You now spend your days just waiting for every refill and keeping it from the hands of any envious neighbor of yours.
translations: 你很幸运地找到了一个装满威士忌的奇怪瓶子！现在，你每天都在等待瓶子又一次被填满，并确保任何嫉妒你的邻居都离它远远的。

messages.msgid: You were the most prepared of them all.  The miner that never lacked tools and could control the ground itself.  Sadly, you are not sure those abilities will save you in what is to come.
translations: 你是所有人中准备最充分的。矿工从不缺少工具，还能够控制地面。遗憾的是，你不确定这些能力能不能在未来拯救你。

messages.msgid: You are a descendant of a long line of housekeepers for magical families.  Trained in several spells to facilitate your job you were easily hired to take care of your current job, sadly, it looks like this could be your last.
translations: 你是那些魔法家族世袭管家的后代。经过几次培训，你很轻易地就被雇佣来做你现在的工作，遗憾的是，这可能是你最后一次工作了。

messages.msgid: For a long time you lived in the wild, free of interference from whatever inhabited outside the woods, now that the woods are collapsing you finally return to civilization.
translations: 你在野外生活了很长一段时间，从来没有受到森林外任何人的干扰，而现在，森林正在倒塌，你终于又回到了文明世界。

messages.msgid: You were a skillful and committed archer druid, making constant excursions to the forests in which you dedicated yourself to living off of and with what nature had to offer you.  You were returning from your last travel when civilization fell upon itself.
translations: 你曾是一名技艺精湛、心志坚定的弓箭手德鲁伊，时常远行至森林深处，致力于依靠自然的馈赠生活，并与之和谐共存。当文明世界分崩离析之际，你恰好结束最后一次旅行归来。

messages.msgid: You've loved death since you can remember, always attracted to that cold and fair skeletal hand, but love is often unrequited, you have not been allowed a meeting yet.  One night, you had a dream, since you are not allowed to meet death, why not bring that joy to everyone else instead?  After much training and hardship you have now become the Grim Reaper itself.
translations: 你从记事起就爱上了死亡，总是被那只冰冷而美丽的骷髅手所吸引，但爱往往是无回报的，你还没有被允许见上它一面。一天晚上，你做了一个梦，既然你不被允许面对死亡，为什么不把这份快乐带给其他人呢？经过大量的训练和磨难，你现在已经成为了死神。

messages.msgid: You've long had an obsession with horror novels, and used your wealth to augment yourself with spells and bionics into a denizen of the night.  Your neglect to your health in your pursuit has left you pale and unlively.
translations: 你一直对恐怖小说着迷，并利用你手中的财富买来各种法术和生化插件强化自己，使你成为一个暗夜的居民。你在追求抛瓦的过程中忽视了自己的健康，结果使你面色苍白，毫无生气。

messages.msgid: A year of enrollment in a wizard's academy has taught you patience, wisdom, and a handful of useful spells.  With the teachers converted into the undead and classes canceled, the final lesson has begun.
translations: 在法师学院学习的一年教会了你耐心、智慧和一些有用的法术。随着导师们沦为亡灵、课程也被迫取消，这最后一课，也就此开始。

messages.msgid: Your metal career soared to new heights when you swapped special effects for acrid gore and spiked whips.  It seems the Cataclysm is now your final tour.
translations: 当你把特效换成辛辣刺鼻的血肉和带刺的长鞭时，你的金属摇滚职业生涯飙升到了一个新的高度。看来大灾变现在是你的最后一次巡演了。

messages.msgid: You were enrolled in an experimental law enforcement program designed to decrease suspect casualties and equipment costs by substituting tasers and bullets for less-lethal Stormshaping.
translations: 你是一项实验性执法部门计划的参与者，目的是通过将电击枪和子弹替换为低致命性的风暴塑造者法术来减少嫌疑犯的伤亡以及设备采购成本。

messages.msgid: You've made a name for yourself in underground magic boxing rings as an unstoppable punching machine.  Now that all your opponents are undead, there's no need to hold back.
translations: 你在地下魔法拳击圈中声名显赫，被称为一台挡不住的打桩机。既然你所有的对手都变成不死人了，那也没必要留手了。

messages.msgid: After failing out of medical school, you took their mundane methods and combined it with magic to save your patients.  Now that they all want to kill you, the lack of a license is the least of your worries.
translations: 医学院肄业后，你将医术和魔法相结合来救治病人。现在他们都想杀了你，你再也不用担心没有行医执照的问题了。

messages.msgid: Abandoned at a young age and raised by moose, you had to master the wilds to survive.  While the modern world has been devoured, you and your steed are no stranger to hardship.
translations: 你幼年时就被遗弃，被驼鹿们养大，你只能靠了解荒野才能生存。当现代世界被吞噬时，你和你的坐骑对今后的艰苦困难并不陌生。

messages.msgid: You were a special operative conducting covert sniper ops in sub-zero temperatures, and had just finished your tour when society was destroyed.  Having retained your gear, it's time to join the new war.
translations: 你是一名特种部队的特工，在零度以下的地点执行狙击任务。你的行动刚刚结束，社会就被摧毁了。你有幸保存了执勤时的装备，是时候加入新的战争了。

messages.msgid: Penned in a cell without fuel, you've been extinguished for years for setting buildings on fire.  In your escape, you grabbed your familiar tool to reignite the embers.
translations: 你被关在一个没有燃料的囚室之中，因为纵火而被监禁多年。在你逃跑时，你抓起熟悉的工具重新点燃了灰烬。

messages.msgid: These bastards were destroying Earth far before the undead came, and mauling those execs was worth the federal charges.  Now, you may have greater priorities than pollution.
translations: 这些混蛋在不死者到来之前就已经毁灭了地球，干掉那些企业高管配得上联邦罪行。现在，你可能有比除掉污染更重要的事情。

messages.msgid: You learned Kelvinist spells to keep equipment costs down on your ice cream truck.  While their tastes have changed, the kids still scream for you.
translations: 你学了些炽霜法师的法术来降低冰淇淋车的设备成本。虽然口味变了些，但现在孩子们还是会为你尖叫。

messages.msgid: You entertained the masses, displaying an expert hand tossing knives conjured from nowhere.  Now, you're bringing the show to them.
translations: 你是娱乐大众的专业表演家，总能变戏法一样从不知何处掷出飞刀，现在到你表演真正的技术的时候了。

messages.msgid: You were a ceremonial guard for the Hy-Brasilean ambassador to the United States, equipped to bring to mind the elven forest warriors of old.  You were trained in archery, since you had to use your bow to impress foreign dignitaries, but you never expected you'd actually have to take it into a real battle.  Then the Cataclysm hit.  The ambassador and most of your fellow guards are dead, and you'll probably never see home again, but hopefully your skills will keep you alive.
translations: 你曾是海巴西勒驻美大使的仪仗卫士，装备风格旨在让人联想到古代的精灵森林战士。你接受过箭术训练 —— 毕竟要用弓箭给外国政要留下深刻印象，但你从未想过自己真的要带着它投身实战。直到大灾变降临。大使和你多数同僚都已丧生，你或许再也回不了家乡，但希望你的技艺能让你活下去。

messages.msgid: The ancient druidic art of taking animal forms had mostly fallen out of favor by the modern era, since most people didn't need to be a bear in their daily lives and even if they did transform into a raven, they still had to physically fly to their destination and couldn't check the internet for directions.  You, however, studied the ancient arts and gained the ability to transform yourself.  It's come in very handy since the world ended.
translations: 古老的德鲁伊变形之术在现代已大多失宠 —— 毕竟日常生活中，人们多半犯不着变成一头熊；就算真能化作渡鸦，也还是得亲自飞抵目的地，没法上网查路线。但你却潜心研习了这门古老技艺，掌握了变形的能力。在世界末日降临后，这本事可派上了大用场。

messages.msgid: Dabbler (Knowing the Day and the Hour)

translations: 一术之长（召唤守望者之魂）
海巴西勒大使荣誉卫队

messages.msgid: You took a few classes about magical theory before the Cataclysm and still remember most of it.
translations: 你在大灾变之前上过几门关于魔法理论的课程，并且仍然记得其中的大部分内容。

messages.msgid: You were either a practicing mage or made a formal study of magical theory.  You could have designed spells in your spare time, if you had wanted.
translations: 你要么是一名执业法师，要么对魔法理论进行了正规研究。只要你愿意，你能在空闲时设计出新法术。

messages.msgid: You could have taught magical theory to mages, whether you know any spells or not.
translations: 你可以向法师传授魔法理论，无论自己是否懂得法术。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Freshen Up, the most common spell in the pre-Cataclysm world.  It saved up a lot of time before work in your old life and you've certainly made a lot of use of it now that there's no more running water.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。对你来说，这个法术是梳洗术，大灾变前世界中最常见的法术。在你以前的生活中，为你在节省了工作前的时间，而现在已经没有自来水了，你肯定也需要更多地使用它了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Crystallize Mana.  Sure, it ruined your social life and you slept for 12 hours a day, but you made a tidy sum of money producing mana crystals for mages who needed them.  Too bad all that money is useless now.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。对你来说，这个法术是制造魔力结晶。当然，它毁了你的社交生活，毕竟你每天要睡12个小时，但你通过为有需求的法师们加工魔力水晶赚了不少钱。只是这些钱对当下来说毫无帮助。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Magical Light.  It was mostly a party trick, to be honest, and the weeks learning to cast a spell that any smartphone could replicate showed you how much work trying to learn real magic actually was.  But the nights are dark enough nowadays that you're glad you put in the effort.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是魔法阅读灯。说实话，这不过是个派对小把戏，而花了几周时间学习这个任何智能手机都能复制的法术，让你意识到学习真正的魔法有多难。然而，如今的夜晚黑暗得足以让你感激当初的努力。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Aura of Protection.  To be honest, you originally learned it to try to replace the umbrella you kept leaving at home and were very disappointed when that didn't work.  It's saved you at least once from some strange gas in the air, though, so all that effort paid off.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是保护光环。说实话，最初你学习它是为了代替你那总是忘在家的雨伞，当发现它无法替代雨伞时，你感到非常失望。不过，它至少曾在空气中出现奇怪气体时救了你一次，你的努力没有白费。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Sound Bomb.  You mostly used it for jokes, to play pranks on your friends and annoy the neighborhood dogs, but it's proven its worth now at the end of the world.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是声波炸弹。大多数时候你用这个法术和朋友开玩笑，或是吓唬邻居家的狗。但在这个世界末日，它证明了自己的价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knowing the Day and the Hour.  Your non-mage friends were always asking you why you bothered learning what was widely considered to be the least useful spell in the world, and sometimes you weren't sure yourself.  Even now that the network is done, you're still not entirely sure how important it is to know that it's exactly 6:12 a.m. vs. just "sunrise".  But if it ever is important, you'll know it.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是知晓时间。你那些非法师朋友总是问你，为什么要费心学习被广泛认为是世界上最无用的咒语，有时你自己也不确定。即使现在已经没有网络，你仍不确定知道现在是早上6点12分而不是“日出”有多重要。但如果它很关键，你会知道的。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Peaceful Rest.  Ever since you were a child, you dreaded bedtime.  Falling asleep was an ordeal, a battle between you and the bed, and it seemed like no matter how many sheep you counted, sleep hygiene habits you practiced, or exhausted you felt, it was an hour or more until you finally fell into sleep.  You became a mage because you were tired of having 5% of your life stuck staring at the ceiling while waiting for sleep to come, and ever since the world ended, you're even more grateful you can fall asleep whenever you need to.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是安睡术。 自你孩提时代起，你就很害怕睡觉时间。入睡对你来说是一场煎熬，是你与床之间的战斗，似乎无论你数了多少只羊，遵循了多少睡眠卫生习惯，或者感到多么疲惫，最终还是要经过一个小时甚至更久才能入睡。你成为了一名法师，因为你厌倦了把生命中的5%浪费在盯着天花板等待入睡的过程中。而自从世界终结之后，你更加感激自己能够在需要时随时入睡。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Ignus Fatuus.  It was mostly just for your amusement, summoning the will-o'-the-wisps at sundown and watching them dance, but they've proven handy more than once lately by leading some monster astray while you ran for your life.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是召唤鬼火。你学习这个法术主要是为了自娱自乐，例如在日落时召唤鬼火，看它们在夕阳中舞蹈。但最近它们已经不止一次派上了用场：引开怪物，让你逃命。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Summon Watcher Spirit.  You initially learned it to keep an eye on your cat while you were doing chores around the house, but it ended up being even more valuable than you thought once the world ended.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是召唤守望者之魂。你最初学会它是为了在做家务时盯紧你的猫，但在世界末日来临后，它比你想象的更有价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Witchsight.  People asked you why you would bother learning a spell that only let you know if other people were mages, but every bit of information helped.  A gun you can see, an expensive suit, the size and strength of a person or the way they carry themselves, but a mage's talent is all hidden until they a cast spell.  Unless, of course, you knew how to look, and you did.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是巫术视觉。人们常常问你，为什么要费心学习一种只能识别别人是否是法师的魔法，但你始终认为，做出判断时的每一丝信息都至关重要。一把枪、一套昂贵的西装、一个人的体型、力量和行为举止，仅靠视觉就能获取这些信息。而法师的天赋却是不可见的，直到他们施展魔法。除非，你知道如何去观察，而你正好知道。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knit the Rent Flesh.  Certainly no one ever asked your reasons for studying biomancy, especially after you saw that guy get hit by a truck running a red light and managed to stop him from bleeding out before the paramedics arrived.  It was disturbing to watch, but it was undoubtedly effective.  As long as you're light on your feet, you won't have to worry about dying of your injuries now.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“血肉缝合”。当然，没人会问你学习生化术的原因，尤其是在你亲眼目睹一个倒霉蛋被闯红灯的卡车撞倒，并在急救人员赶到前成功为他止血之后。那一幕固然触目惊心，但效果也毋庸置疑。只要你身手敏捷，现在就不用担心会因伤势过重而死了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Carrion Feast.  You had your reasons for studying it, certainly, and perhaps it is best not to speculate about them now.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是腐肉盛宴。 你当初肯定有自己的理由去研究它……现在最好不要对那个理由过多猜测。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Water's Cooling Touch.  You always hated summer, the stickiness, the heat, the sunburns, and your dislike of the weather drove you to study druidic magic to overcome it.  With your water bottle handy, you'll never have to worry about being too hot in the sun again.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是清凉之触。 你一直很讨厌夏天，那种粘腻感、酷热、晒伤，而对天气的厌恶驱使你去学习德鲁伊魔法来克服它。手握水瓶，你再也不用担心在烈日下过热了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Traverse the Wilds.  Part of the joy of hiking is taking your time, of being away from the tyranny of clocks and schedules and deadlines.  But sometimes, it was nice to just see the miles fly by, to reach the summit before sunrise and take in the view without getting up at 2 a.m., to finish the entire trail and still have time to sit down and eat a leisurely dinner.  And it's not like you teleported, after all.  Regardless of the magic, you still had to walk every single step.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是穿行荒野。徒步的乐趣之一在于放慢脚步，远离时钟、日程安排和最后期限的束缚。不过有时候，能看到里程数迅速增加也是一种享受。在日出前到达山顶欣赏美景而不必凌晨两点起床，完成整条路线后还能有时间坐下来悠闲地吃一顿晚餐。不同于瞬间移动，不管有多少“魔法”在内，每一步都需要你亲自走完。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  Biohacking was your passion, trying to optimize your life through diet, exercise, and sleep tricks, and you turned to druidic magic to cut out wasted time.  When the Pomodoro timer went off, you scurried to the fridge, grabbed a handful of berries and enchanted them, scarfed them down, and then got back to work.  You never had to deal with meal replacement nonsense, you just ate your berries and got things done.  Your clients are dead now and everything you worked on is ash and dust, but eating those berries has proven to be the best habit you picked up.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是神莓术。与其通过规划饮食、锻炼和睡眠来提升生活质量，不如用生物骇客技术……我是说德鲁伊魔法，来减少浪费的时间。你从不操心下一顿吃什么，当闹钟响起时，你只需从冰箱里抓起一把浆果，施个魔法，迅速吞下，然后重新投入到工作中去。如今甲方已不在人世，你努力完成的一切也化为了灰烬，但吃浆果的习惯被证明是你养成过的最好的习惯。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Utility Molding.  You read a pamphlet once entitled, "One Spell is All You Need!" and thought it seemed like a good idea.  And true, maybe you've never needed a mining pick before, but the ability to all up a knife or a shovel or a hammer whenever you want has come in handy countless times.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是工具塑造术。你曾读过一本名为《一个咒语搞定一切！》的小册子，觉得这是个好主意。的确，也许你永远用不上矿镐，但随时召唤出一把刀、铲子或锤子的能力却可以无数次派上用场。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Tremorsense.  It kept you safe, letting you know if someone was nearby even if you were absorbed in a task or listening to music, but now that most of the people you meet want to eat you it's proven invaluable.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是震颤感知。它能保证你即使在专注于某项任务或听音乐时，也能知道附近是否有人。而现在大多数你遇到的人都想吃掉你，这个法术变得更有价值了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, the Turning of the Earth.  Gardening was your passion and you got sick of manually digging rows in early spring or mid-summer weather.  After your studies you could just cast the spell and the earth neatly parted, waiting for seeds to be planted.  Once the canned food runs out, you're sure you'll get even more use of your powers.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是翻土术。 你曾热衷于打理庭院，但你厌倦了在初春或盛夏的天气里手动挖沟。在完成学业后，你只需施展一个法术，泥土就会整齐地分开等待播种。在罐头吃完后，你确信你这份力量会变得更加有用。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Finger Firelighter.  You had a lot of great conversations with people, late at night outside clubs and restaurants, when they'd ask for a light and you'd just snap your fingers.  Lately, though, you've used it to cook food more than light cigarettes and haven't had anyone to talk to, but at least the fires at night are warm.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是火焰之指。你曾经在深夜俱乐部或餐厅外与别人有过很多精彩的对话，他们向你借火，你只需打个响指。最近，你更多用它来做饭而不是点烟，也没有人与你交谈，至少夜里的火焰还是温暖的。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Flames of Passion.  Alcohol is a social lubricant, and if you already had a drink in your hand, why not use it to let you loosen up and make it easier to talk to people?  You were out at parties almost every weekend and had a wide circle of friends.  Hopefully at least a few of them made it through all of this.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是热情之火。酒精是一种社交润滑剂，如果你已经手握一杯酒，为什么不借此放松一下，让自己更容易与人交谈呢？在大灾变发生前，几乎每个周末你都会出去参加聚会，朋友圈相当广泛。希望如今还能有几个人能够陪你度过这一切。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Slowfall.  Some people become mages due to a dream, or a goal they want to pursue, but for you it was the memory of falling down the stairs as a child and breaking your leg.  With your magic you could jump off a roof and it was no more dangerous than jumping off a low stone wall, and that's been pretty useful for some of the situations you've found yourself in since the Cataclysm.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是羽落术。有些人成为法师是因为追求梦想，或是实现目标，而你成为法师的缘由却是小时候下楼梯摔断了腿。凭借你的魔法，你现在从屋顶跳下来的危险性和跳下矮墙差不多。自从大灾变发生以来，这种能力在你遇到的许多情况中都非常有用。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Faerie Fire.  Maybe it wasn't a great use of your time, but it was fun at parties and one time when your cat ran off it made it very easy to find her.  Since the Cataclysm, though, your magical powers have become much more useful.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是妖精之火。也许学这个有点浪费时间，但在派对上用一用还是挺有趣的。有一次你的猫跑掉了，用这个技能很容易就找到了她。自从大灾变以来，你的魔法力量变得更加有用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Sorcerer's Hand.  Alright, fine, you admit it, you learned magic because of laziness.  It seems odd to say, with all the hours after work and late at night, studying until you could make your keys twitch and fall off the table and eventually until you can grab a drink from across the room, but it's true.  You could reach nearly everything without having to get up.  Anyway, you're way more active now, and being able to grab things from across the room has come in handy more than once since the end of the world.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是法师之手。没错，你承认你学魔法是因为懒得动。（这话听起来有点奇怪，毕竟你花了那么空余时间去练习魔法，让钥匙颤动、从桌上掉下，最终还能隔着房间取杯饮料，但这确实是你学魔法的源动力。）你几乎不用起身就能拿到一切东西。不管怎样，现在的你活跃多了，而在世界末日之后，隔空取物的能力已经多次证明了它的价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Spider Climb.  A lot of people in the rockclimbing community said you were cheating, and, to be honest, they were right.  But every time you saw one of those spectacular views from the summit, well, those complaints didn't mean that much.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是蛛行术。许多攀岩爱好者都认为你这是在作弊，有一说一，确实。 但是，每当你目睹山顶上那壮丽的景色时，那些抱怨也就没那么重要了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Windrunning.  It's embarrassing to admit, but you became a mage because you were always running late.  Just one spell made it much easier to catch that bus, to beat that red light across the crosswalk, to make it to work on time instead of a few minutes late.  Nowadays you have a lot more practice at running and that speed still comes in handy.
translations: 你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是风行术。虽然有些难以启齿，但你成为法师是为了避免迟到。只需一个法术就能让你更容易赶上公交车，闯过人行道上的红灯，准时赶到上班地点，而不是迟到几分钟被骂得狗血淋头。如今奔跑已经成为了生存必须的技能，这份速度更有用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Fire Spark.  Most people when they wanted to light a fire thought of kelvinists, but electricity always fascinated you.  You used to love watching the storms roll in, sitting on your porch as the lightning played across the sky, and while summoning lightning bolts wouldn't have been useful for anything at all, catching fires with a spark has come in handy.
translations: 你是你是只会一个法术的千百万人中的一员。 对你来说，这个法术是“电火花”。说到点火，大多数人会想到炽霜法师，但你更热衷于闪电的力量。你曾经喜欢坐在门廊上，看着风暴滚滚而来，闪电在天空中舞动。召唤一束电火花并没有什么实际用途，但点燃火堆绝对够用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Air Bubble.  It was originally because of your diving trips.  You were sick of having the goggles and the respirator between you and the sea, and if one simple spell would make it so you didn't have to worry about that again, you were willing to put in the time to learn it.  When you had to swim across that river to escape the horde a while ago, it definitely proved its worth.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“气泡术”。你最初学习它，是为了潜水之旅。你早已厌倦了潜水镜和呼吸器将你与大海隔开的感觉，如果一个简单的法术能让你一劳永逸，你愿意花时间去学习。不久前，当你不得不游过那条河以躲避尸潮时，这个法术终于证明了它的价值。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Lamp.  Sure, phones had lights, but they weren't nearly as bright as a magical one was, and it was pretty nice to just recite the words and light up an entire room like a high-powered flashlight.  Now that the power's out, it's even more useful.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“魔法灯”。诚然，手机也有照明功能，但亮度远不及魔法之光，而且只需念诵咒语，就能像大功率手电筒一样照亮整个房间，这种感觉实在不错。如今电力中断，这个法术就更有用了。

messages.msgid: You were one of the hundreds of millions of people who knew a single spell.  In your case, Knock.  You originally learned it because you always forgot your keys and after the third time you were locked out of your apartment, to turned to magic to solve the problem.  Of course, once you did have to use magic to get back in you realized that anyone else could have done the same thing, so in the end it just ruined your peace of mind.  At least now you can be sure there's no one home at the places you're entering.
translations: 世上有数亿人仅会一个法术，你便是其中之一。而你掌握的，正是“敲击术”。你最初学它，是因为老是忘带钥匙。在你第三次被锁在公寓门外后，你转而求助于魔法来解决问题。当然，当你有一次真的用魔法开门进去后，你突然意识到，其他人也能用同样的方法进来。结果，这反而让你不得安宁。至少现在，你可以确定你闯入的屋子里空无一人了。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Firstborn, called "alfar" or "sidhe" or, more recently, "elves" by the humans.  Your people had integrated into human society before the Cataclysm, doing jobs involving animals and nature since modern industry was never to your liking.  Had technological development continued, you might have been forced to make some unpleasant compromises, but not as unpleasant as you have during the end of the world.
translations: 你们是长生族的一员，被人类称为 "阿尔法 "或 "西德"，最近又被称为 "精灵"。 在大灾变之前，你们已经融入了人类社会，从事与动物和大自然有关的工作，因为现代工业并不符合你们的喜好。 如果科技继续发展，你们可能会被迫做出一些令人不快的妥协，但不会像你在世界末日那样令人不快。

messages.msgid: You are a Child of the Stone, called "dwarf" by the humans.  The legends tell that long ago, your people were born of stone and mined your way up to the surface world and its light, where you found the other sapient species of Earth.  While the scale of the human world was always a bit of a problem, you fit in well due to your people's long tradition of craftsdwarfship and hard work.  Now that society has collapsed, maybe you can turn that same drive to rebuilding it.
translations: 你是石之子，被人类称为 "矮人"。 传说在很久以前，你们的祖先从石头中诞生，通过采矿来到地表世界，并在那里发现了地球上的其他智慧物种。 虽然人类世界的规模一直是个问题，但由于你们的民族有着悠久的手工艺和勤劳的传统，你们很好地融入了这个世界。 现在社会崩溃了，也许你们可以把这种动力转化为重建社会的动力。

messages.msgid: You are a goblin.  Before the Cataclysm your people were always a little out of place: the houses weren't designed for you, the shops weren't open when you were awake, and your appearance sometimes gave human or elven children nightmares that you were going to steal them or reminded dwarves of the ancient wars your peoples fought.  As it turned out, you weren't what any of them should have been worrying about.
translations: 你是哥布林。 在大灾变之前，你的族群总是有点格格不入：房子不是为你设计的，商店在你醒着的时候也不开门，你的出现有时会让人类或精灵的孩子做噩梦，以为你要偷走他们，或者让矮人想起你们族群的古代战争。 事实证明，他们不应该担心你。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Scaled Ones, called "lizardfolk" by the warmbloods.  For generations, your tribe served a dragon as its eyes and ears in the outside world, until civilization encroached far enough that even all the dragon's might could not hold it back.  You were sent out to integrate into the modern world, but you were only there a few years before human science ended their world.  Now, you have to survive in the mess they've created.
translations: 你是鳞类的一员，被温血种称为 "蜥族"。 世世代代以来，你们的部落一直为龙服务，充当龙在外部世界的耳目，直到文明蚕食到连龙的所有力量都无法阻挡的地步。 你们被派去融入现代世界，但只待了几年，人类科学就终结了他们的世界。 现在，你们必须在人类制造的混乱中生存下去。

messages.msgid: You are one of the Kor'uru, called "ravenfolk" by those who can't make the appropriate clacking sound due to their lack of beak.  While your people could not fly without the aid of magic, you were always drawn to explore the world, and had traveled to nearly every country and continent even before modern society made such travel easy.  You were well-integrated into society at all levels…and that made you just as vulnerable as everyone else when it fell.
translations: 你是科乌鲁的一员，因为没有鸟嘴而无法发出 "咔咔 "声的人称你为 "鸦族"。 虽然没有魔法的帮助，你们的族人无法飞行，但你们总是喜欢探索世界，甚至在现代社会让旅行变得容易之前，你们就已经走遍了几乎所有的国家和大陆。 你们在各个层面都融入了社会……这让你们在社会衰落时和其他人一样脆弱。

messages.msgid: You found a pamphlet with bright colors claiming you can be a Wizard, oddly serene with the world falling down around you.
translations: 你发现了一本宣称能让你成为魔法师的炫丽手册，在世界在你身边崩溃时，它让你感到一股奇特的宁静。

messages.msgid: You have loved fire all of your life.  You have now discovered your inner fire, and want to exercise that upon the world.
translations: 一生所恋，炽焰浓烟，心炎既现，熔炼人间。

messages.msgid: The ancient circle of druids is gone with the Cataclysm.  Nature must thrive.
translations: 古老的德鲁伊祭坛在大灾变中随风而逝了。但自然终将繁盛。

messages.msgid: You always had to hide your magic, as it was generally not an acceptable type of magic in the wizarding world, but with the Cataclysm you need to pull every trick out of the book.
translations: 你以前总是不得不隐藏自己的魔法，因为它在魔法师世界中不被大多数人所接受，但现在面对大灾变时，你需要使出浑身解数利用好每一个法术。

messages.msgid: The son of a weatherman, you were always interested in the weather.  Recently you found it was possible to manipulate the weather yourself through arcane means!  Unfortunately you did not have long to enjoy your power, as events unfolded…
translations: 你爸以前是个气象员，所以你也对气象学很感兴趣。最近你发现你居然可以用神秘的方法操作天气！可惜你没来得及发挥你的力量，大灾变就到来了……

messages.msgid: You were always tough in a fight.  Your coach managed to teach you a trick or two to make you a little tougher.
translations: 你在打架的时候总是最能抗的那个。你的教练在此基础上教了你几个绝招，让你变得更加能抗。

messages.msgid: With the recent Cataclysm, the way you found to cheat on tests may have to find some other use.
translations: 随着大灾变的到来，你可能得想办法把在考试时学会的作弊技巧用在其它方面了。

messages.msgid: You segregated yourself from society because you wanted to concentrate on improving yourself.  It was you and your best friend, but now the apocalypse won't leave you alone.
translations: 你把自己与社会隔离开来，因为你想集中精力提升自我。这本是你自己最好的朋友，但现在大灾变可不会让你一个人呆着。

messages.msgid: You lost your faith when your spouse died of illness.  You've been drinking yourself to death ever since.  God is punishing everyone with this apocalypse, you are going to show them your brand of mercy.
translations: 当你的配偶因病去世时，你失去了你的信仰。从那以后你就一直喝得烂醉如泥。上帝用大灾变惩罚每一个人，而你要向它们展示你仁慈的烙印。

messages.msgid: You've long suspected the world might suddenly turn over.  With your training, spells, and revolver, your chances are far better than most.
translations: 你早就怀疑世界会突然终结。有了你的训练、法术和左轮手枪，你活下去的几率比大多数人都要高得多。

messages.msgid: You are a highly sought exotic magic dancer.  You can heat the room temperature with your moves and your body, but whenever it lights too much you freeze it with your magic, granting you great control over your public.  They can see, but never touch.
translations: 你是一位备受追捧的魔法舞者。你可以用你的动作和身体来让室内的气氛变得更火热，但每当"温度"太高时，你就会用你的魔法让它"冷"静下来，让你可以很好地控制你的观众。对他们来说，你只可远观而不可亵玩也。

messages.msgid: You are an expert in dimensionalism, with its most common example being teleportation magic, that is the reason why you could survive while your colleagues could not.  Your only hope is that your highly specialized skills will continue keeping you alive.
translations: 你是维度方面的专家，你最常用的魔法是传送魔法，这就是为什么你生存下了来，而你的同事却不能。你唯一的希望是你那高度专业化的技能可以继续让你继续活着。

messages.msgid: Helped by all kind of magical tools and your great talents, you were planning your next great break in.  The world ended before you had time to escape with all of your ill-gained plunder, but at least now nobody can stop you now from breaking whatever locks you desire.
translations: 在各种神奇的工具和天赋的帮助下，你正在计划你的下一票大案。然而在你带着所有不义之财逃离之前，世界就终结了，但至少现在没有人能阻止你撬开任何你想要的撬开的锁了。

messages.msgid: You were lucky enough to find a weird flask that refills itself with whiskey!  You now spend your days just waiting for every refill and keeping it from the hands of any envious neighbor of yours.
translations: 你很幸运地找到了一个装满威士忌的奇怪瓶子！现在，你每天都在等待瓶子又一次被填满，并确保任何嫉妒你的邻居都离它远远的。

messages.msgid: You were the most prepared of them all.  The miner that never lacked tools and could control the ground itself.  Sadly, you are not sure those abilities will save you in what is to come.
translations: 你是所有人中准备最充分的。矿工从不缺少工具，还能够控制地面。遗憾的是，你不确定这些能力能不能在未来拯救你。

messages.msgid: You are a descendant of a long line of housekeepers for magical families.  Trained in several spells to facilitate your job you were easily hired to take care of your current job, sadly, it looks like this could be your last.
translations: 你是那些魔法家族世袭管家的后代。经过几次培训，你很轻易地就被雇佣来做你现在的工作，遗憾的是，这可能是你最后一次工作了。

messages.msgid: For a long time you lived in the wild, free of interference from whatever inhabited outside the woods, now that the woods are collapsing you finally return to civilization.
translations: 你在野外生活了很长一段时间，从来没有受到森林外任何人的干扰，而现在，森林正在倒塌，你终于又回到了文明世界。

messages.msgid: You were a skillful and committed archer druid, making constant excursions to the forests in which you dedicated yourself to living off of and with what nature had to offer you.  You were returning from your last travel when civilization fell upon itself.
translations: 你曾是一名技艺精湛、心志坚定的弓箭手德鲁伊，时常远行至森林深处，致力于依靠自然的馈赠生活，并与之和谐共存。当文明世界分崩离析之际，你恰好结束最后一次旅行归来。

messages.msgid: You've loved death since you can remember, always attracted to that cold and fair skeletal hand, but love is often unrequited, you have not been allowed a meeting yet.  One night, you had a dream, since you are not allowed to meet death, why not bring that joy to everyone else instead?  After much training and hardship you have now become the Grim Reaper itself.
translations: 你从记事起就爱上了死亡，总是被那只冰冷而美丽的骷髅手所吸引，但爱往往是无回报的，你还没有被允许见上它一面。一天晚上，你做了一个梦，既然你不被允许面对死亡，为什么不把这份快乐带给其他人呢？经过大量的训练和磨难，你现在已经成为了死神。

messages.msgid: You've long had an obsession with horror novels, and used your wealth to augment yourself with spells and bionics into a denizen of the night.  Your neglect to your health in your pursuit has left you pale and unlively.
translations: 你一直对恐怖小说着迷，并利用你手中的财富买来各种法术和生化插件强化自己，使你成为一个暗夜的居民。你在追求抛瓦的过程中忽视了自己的健康，结果使你面色苍白，毫无生气。

messages.msgid: A year of enrollment in a wizard's academy has taught you patience, wisdom, and a handful of useful spells.  With the teachers converted into the undead and classes canceled, the final lesson has begun.
translations: 在法师学院学习的一年教会了你耐心、智慧和一些有用的法术。随着导师们沦为亡灵、课程也被迫取消，这最后一课，也就此开始。

messages.msgid: Your metal career soared to new heights when you swapped special effects for acrid gore and spiked whips.  It seems the Cataclysm is now your final tour.
translations: 当你把特效换成辛辣刺鼻的血肉和带刺的长鞭时，你的金属摇滚职业生涯飙升到了一个新的高度。看来大灾变现在是你的最后一次巡演了。

messages.msgid: You were enrolled in an experimental law enforcement program designed to decrease suspect casualties and equipment costs by substituting tasers and bullets for less-lethal Stormshaping.
translations: 你是一项实验性执法部门计划的参与者，目的是通过将电击枪和子弹替换为低致命性的风暴塑造者法术来减少嫌疑犯的伤亡以及设备采购成本。

messages.msgid: You've made a name for yourself in underground magic boxing rings as an unstoppable punching machine.  Now that all your opponents are undead, there's no need to hold back.
translations: 你在地下魔法拳击圈中声名显赫，被称为一台挡不住的打桩机。既然你所有的对手都变成不死人了，那也没必要留手了。

messages.msgid: After failing out of medical school, you took their mundane methods and combined it with magic to save your patients.  Now that they all want to kill you, the lack of a license is the least of your worries.
translations: 医学院肄业后，你将医术和魔法相结合来救治病人。现在他们都想杀了你，你再也不用担心没有行医执照的问题了。

messages.msgid: Abandoned at a young age and raised by moose, you had to master the wilds to survive.  While the modern world has been devoured, you and your steed are no stranger to hardship.
translations: 你幼年时就被遗弃，被驼鹿们养大，你只能靠了解荒野才能生存。当现代世界被吞噬时，你和你的坐骑对今后的艰苦困难并不陌生。

messages.msgid: You were a special operative conducting covert sniper ops in sub-zero temperatures, and had just finished your tour when society was destroyed.  Having retained your gear, it's time to join the new war.
translations: 你是一名特种部队的特工，在零度以下的地点执行狙击任务。你的行动刚刚结束，社会就被摧毁了。你有幸保存了执勤时的装备，是时候加入新的战争了。

messages.msgid: Penned in a cell without fuel, you've been extinguished for years for setting buildings on fire.  In your escape, you grabbed your familiar tool to reignite the embers.
translations: 你被关在一个没有燃料的囚室之中，因为纵火而被监禁多年。在你逃跑时，你抓起熟悉的工具重新点燃了灰烬。

messages.msgid: These bastards were destroying Earth far before the undead came, and mauling those execs was worth the federal charges.  Now, you may have greater priorities than pollution.
translations: 这些混蛋在不死者到来之前就已经毁灭了地球，干掉那些企业高管配得上联邦罪行。现在，你可能有比除掉污染更重要的事情。

messages.msgid: You learned Kelvinist spells to keep equipment costs down on your ice cream truck.  While their tastes have changed, the kids still scream for you.
translations: 你学了些炽霜法师的法术来降低冰淇淋车的设备成本。虽然口味变了些，但现在孩子们还是会为你尖叫。

messages.msgid: You entertained the masses, displaying an expert hand tossing knives conjured from nowhere.  Now, you're bringing the show to them.
translations: 你是娱乐大众的专业表演家，总能变戏法一样从不知何处掷出飞刀，现在到你表演真正的技术的时候了。

messages.msgid: You were a ceremonial guard for the Hy-Brasilean ambassador to the United States, equipped to bring to mind the elven forest warriors of old.  You were trained in archery, since you had to use your bow to impress foreign dignitaries, but you never expected you'd actually have to take it into a real battle.  Then the Cataclysm hit.  The ambassador and most of your fellow guards are dead, and you'll probably never see home again, but hopefully your skills will keep you alive.
translations: 你曾是海巴西勒驻美大使的仪仗卫士，装备风格旨在让人联想到古代的精灵森林战士。你接受过箭术训练 —— 毕竟要用弓箭给外国政要留下深刻印象，但你从未想过自己真的要带着它投身实战。直到大灾变降临。大使和你多数同僚都已丧生，你或许再也回不了家乡，但希望你的技艺能让你活下去。

messages.msgid: The ancient druidic art of taking animal forms had mostly fallen out of favor by the modern era, since most people didn't need to be a bear in their daily lives and even if they did transform into a raven, they still had to physically fly to their destination and couldn't check the internet for directions.  You, however, studied the ancient arts and gained the ability to transform yourself.  It's come in very handy since the world ended.
translations: 到了现代，古老的德鲁伊艺术--化身为动物--大多已经失宠，因为大多数人在日常生活中并不需要化身为熊，即使化身为乌鸦，也要亲自飞到目的地，无法上网查路。 而你却学习了古代艺术，获得了变身的能力。 自从世界末日之后，它就派上了大用场。

messages.msgid: You've been preaching your faith for a long time, but the recent events have begun to make you doubt it.  Wandering in your temple, you just found books that may restore your faith or shatter it completely.
translations: 你已经宣扬你的信仰很长一段时间了，但最近的事件让产生了动摇。你在神殿里游荡，发现了一些书籍。也许它能够恢复你的信仰。但也说不定会完全摧毁它。

messages.msgid: You have been an apprentice to a wizard for some time now, working on a prototype device that could perhaps be used to escape from the Cataclysm.  Something went wrong with the maiden voyage though, and your teacher teleported his insides into his outsides.  Now you have to figure out how to survive on your own.  At least he left his notebook…
translations: 你成为一名魔法师学徒已经有一段时间了，你正在研制一种可以用来逃离大灾变的原型设备。不过，处女航出了点问题，你的老师把他自己的内脏传送到了体外。现在你要想办法靠自己生存。至少他忘了把笔记本带上……

messages.msgid:
When the chaos that led up to the Cataclysm began, your teacher told you about a secret hideout they had prepared in the event of a terrible disaster and suggested that you go wait there for a couple weeks to wait out the worst of the riots.  As it turned out, things got much worse than you imagined, and as the weeks turned into months and your teacher grew more and more agitated, they prepared a ritual that they hoped would turn back time and allow you to return to the weeks before the Cataclysm to warn the world.

While waiting in the library for the ritual to conclude, you just heard a scream from the ritual room and some rustling elsewhere in the shelter.  You're not sure you're so safe here anymore…
translations:
大灾变前夕，混乱初现时，你的导师曾跟你提起过一处秘密藏身处 —— 那是为应对灭顶之灾准备的。他们建议你先去那里待上几周，避过骚乱最严重的阶段。可事态的恶化远超想象，几周拖成了数月，导师也变得越来越焦躁。于是，他们准备了一场仪式，希望能逆转时光，让你回到大灾变发生前的几周，以此警示世人。

你在藏书室里等待仪式完成，却突然听到仪式室传来一声尖叫，藏身处的其他地方也响起了窸窸窣窣的动静。你开始不确定，这里是否还安全……

messages.msgid: You have been an apprentice to a wizard for some time now, you've saved for years for your dream vacation at a secluded wizard tower.  Your journey of self-discovery is interrupted by the Cataclysm.  Now you have to figure out how to survive on your own.
translations: 自从你成为一名魔法师的学徒已经有一段时间了，你已经储蓄多年，梦想能在一座僻静的法师塔里中度假。你的自我发现之旅被突如其来的大灾变打断了。现在你得自己想办法活下去。

messages.msgid: You are an exile, whether because of people shunning you because of who you are or from a personal choice.  The dead aren't willing to leave you be.
translations: 你是一个流放者，不管是因为人们害怕你的背景而回避你，亦或是因为你个人的选择。但这些亡者并不想放过你。
